title: Associate Data Coordinator
description:
Premier Research is looking for a Associate Data Coordinator to join our Clinical Data Sciences team.

You will help biotech, medtech, and specialty pharma companies transform life-changing ideas and breakthrough science into new medicines, devices, and diagnostics. What we do is profoundly connected to saving and improving lives, and we recognize our team members are the most valuable asset in delivering success.

  • We are here to help you grow, to give you the skills and opportunities to excel at work with the flexibility and balance your life requires.

  • Your ideas influence the way we work, and your voice matters here.

  • As an essential part of our team, you help us deliver the medical innovation that patients are desperate for.

Join us and build your future here.


What You will be Doing:


  • Assists in the preparation of documentation, such as CCGs, DMP, Data Report Specifications, External Data Transfer Specifications, etc.
  • Supports UAT on studies, including testing of edit checks, etc.
  • Assists in maintaining databases and supports DB updates
  • Performs data entry
  • Generates reports for data review
  • Reviews CRFs, data listings to ensure all data captured follow protocol, CCGs, DMP, etc.
  • Generates queries to appropriate internal or external personnel (e.g., investigational sites, Clinical Research Associates and client representatives) to resolve problematic data identified during various aspects of the data management process
  • Reviews responses to queries and resolves discrepancies
  • Assists with external data and/or serious adverse event reconciliation
  • May act as a Lead Data Coordinator or Safety Reviewer
  • Assists document submission to Trial Master File (TMF)
  • Supports TMF Quality Control (QC) activities
  • Supports database QC activities
  • Assists in QC of study reports, CRF archive files
  • Supports the Data Scientist and/or PM in reporting financial project stats, study metrics, dashboard updates, project status

What We Are Looking For:


  • Bachelor’s degree or above (preferably in a Life Science discipline)
  • 0–1 years of industry experience
  • Fluent in English (written and spoken)
  • Strong analytical, investigative, and problem-solving skills
  • Proven ability to learn, navigate, and leverage new systems quickly
  • Exceptional organizational skills, high attention to detail, and a customer-service mindset
  • Ability to multitask and balance competing priorities in a fast-paced environment

title: 2027 Pre-commit (February & July 2027 Bar Takers)
description:
2027 PRE-COMMIT EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITIES

***GRADUATES TAKING THE FEBRUARY 2027and JULY 2027 TEXAS STATE BAR EXAM ***

Pre-commit Intern Salary

The 2027 Pre-commit Intern Salary is $28.00 an hour

Entry Level ADA

Misdemeanor 3 & 2 = $93,100.80

HCDAO wants to give select recent law-school graduates, awaiting their Texas Bar results an opportunity to join our office, specifically in the Misdemeanor Trial Bureau, and become familiar with the day to day as an HCDAO ADA. Candidates are afforded a highly dedicated support staff to help them along the way. The Office also frequently hires 2L and 3L law students serving in voluntary internships, and 3rd and 4th year undergraduate students serving in voluntary internships. For more information and application details, please see below.

The Harris County Assistant District Attorney at a Glance:

The Harris County District Attorney's Office is dedicated to making our community safer through the pursuit of truth and justice. Our role as prosecutors is not to convict, but to ensure that justice is done. We are committed to protecting the public, serving with integrity and dedication to the truth, being a voice for survivors, while upholding the rights of the accused. We believe in a criminal justice system that is both compassionate and efficient, where public safety and fairness are not mutually exclusive.

Our office strives to lead with transparency, empathy, and accountability, creating a justice system that works for everyone in Harris County. Together, we will rebuild trust, reduce backlogs, and ensure that every individual receives the justice they deserve.

Pre-commit Program

Every year, HCDAO accepts applications for our Pre-commit program. HCDAO Pre-commits are treated as Misdemeanor 3 attorneys while they await their bar results. They will conduct victim and witness interviews; (2) conduct formal plea procedures; (3) do trial preparation; (4) research and writing; and (5) conduct jury selection and jury trials. Post Bar fellows routinely go to court to conduct court dockets, hearings, and trials. Pre-commits may also be required to complete additional assignments, specific projects, or observations as prescribed by their Chief.

Pre-commit / M#3 Duties

Typically first assigned to the Misdemeanor Trial Bureau, where cases of all types are handled from preliminary hearings to jury trials. The progression from the Misdemeanor Trial Bureau into other units is based on the needs of the office and demonstrated ability and work ethic. After an initial period in the Misdemeanor Division, Assistant District Attorneys move on to the Felony Trial Bureau where they handle a range of felony cases, including serious crimes such as aggravated robbery and murder. Assistant District Attorneys may also have the opportunity to work in specialty divisions such as Crimes Against Children, Financial Crimes, Trafficking, and Mental Health.

Job Description:

  1. Assistant District Attorney represents the State of Texas in criminal proceedings in the Harris County Criminal District Courts and County Criminal Courts at Law. The Assistant District Attorney duties include the following:
  • Prepare case files, evidence, documents for court proceedings
  • Interview victims and witnesses.
  • Analyze assigned cases and prepare the cases for trial.
  • Interact with victims, police, and witnesses to make critical decisions to support court proceedings.
  • Conduct legal research and prepare motions.
  • Present cases, cross examine witnesses, and make arguments in the court.
  • Perform administrative tasks in connection with other assigned duties.

Hours:

Monday through Friday, hours may vary based on the division needs. Hours may vary based on the business needs of the department.

Qualifications

Applicants must be recent law school graduates prepping for the February 2027 or July 2027 Texas State Bar Exam. Qualified candidates should also have an excellent academic record. Pre-commits typically come to the program after completion of their Texas State Bar Exam however, there are some exceptions based on HCDAO’s current needs.

The program has about a 3-6 month term that could lead directly to employment with HCDAO if the fellow does well during their fellowship and passes the Texas State Bar exam. Our Pre-commits will be paid a salary of $28.00 per hour. If a pre-commit is offered an ADA position upon passing their Texas State Bar, he/she will then be granted our starting Misdemeanor 3 ADA pay and full benefits. HCDAO offers a host of very attractive benefits, and as a public employee, the new ADA qualifies for the Public Student Loan Forgiveness Program as well!

Note:

Applicants that are chosen for our pre-commit program will be sworn in and transferred into a Misdemeanor #3 ADA position and will begin receiving entry level ADA pay ($93,100.80) upon receiving passing bar exam results. If a chosen applicant does not pass their Texas State Bar Exam, the applicant must be present on the day of exam results release. The applicant must resign from their pre-commit position, return all assigned equipment, and badges to HCDAO HR Operations.

Application Process

Please set up a profile in our application tracking system and complete the application in its entirety. Upload your:

  • Cover letter
  • Resume
  • Official transcripts
  • Any trial, mock trial or moot court experience

***Your completed application and required documents will be reviewed. If you are approved for the Pre-commit Program with HCDAO, you will be subject to a full background investigation. When the investigation concludes and is approved, you will receive an email from the HR Professional Coordinator containing more info on the program and directions for getting started.

______________________________________________________________________________________

Assistant District Attorney Salaries vary by level of experience:

Felony Chief- $149,635.20

Felony 2- $124,072.00

Felony 3- $110,780.80

Misdemeanor 2- 98,904.00

Misdemeanor 3 - $93,100.80

Harris County offers a competitive benefits program, including comprehensive group health and related benefits plan as well as defined benefit retirement plan. The following list of benefits is offered only to employees in regular (full-time) positions:

  • Medical
  • Dental

  • Professional development opportunities
  • Dependent Care Reimbursement Plan
  • Healthcare Reimbursement Account

The following benefits are also available to regular (full-time) employment and may be available to part-time employees:

title: Senior Director of Implementation
description:
1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $500M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

As the Senior Director, Implementation, you’ll report to the Vice President, Customer Success and set the strategic and operational direction for 1Password’s implementation and professional services function. You’ll lead a team responsible for helping customers across Small and Medium-sized Businesses (SMB), Commercial, and Enterprise segments adopt 1Password successfully, improve time to value, and achieve measurable outcomes.

How we’re using AI today

Across GTM, we’re transforming the way we work with AI. We expect every seller, CSM, and team member to become a power user, using it daily to work smarter and move faster. AI is already embedded in how we operate – from real-time coaching that sharpens how we sell and interact with customers, to surfacing insights that help us anticipate needs – creating more time for meaningful customer engagement. If you’re excited to reshape how you think, make decisions, and drive growth with AI, you’ll feel right at home here.

This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.

What we're looking for:

  • Bring 10+ years of experience in professional services, customer onboarding, or implementation, including at least 5 years in a leadership role, with experience in cybersecurity and Software as a Service (SaaS) environments.

  • Demonstrate a strong background in technical implementations, systems, infrastructure, and integrations for complex customers.

  • Apply experience from implementation, professional services, solutions architecture, or technical account management environments.

  • Scale onboarding and implementation programs across SMB, Commercial, and Enterprise customer segments.

  • Build capacity-planning models and use utilization, delivery performance, and other Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to guide decisions.

  • Combine strategic thinking with a willingness to engage directly in complex customer situations, team challenges, and operational details.

  • Influence senior leaders and cross-functional partners through clear communication, sound judgment, data, and a strong understanding of customer and business needs.

What you can expect:

  • Define and execute the strategic vision for implementation and professional services, including the launch and evolution of scalable services offerings.

  • Lead, coach, and grow a cross-functional team of Solutions Architects, Onboarding Specialists, Project Managers, and Implementation Specialists.

  • Establish scalable playbooks, frameworks, and processes that improve onboarding, implementation quality, customer adoption, and time to value.

  • Partner with Sales, Customer Success, Product, Marketing, and Operations to create effective transitions from pre-sale activities through customer implementation.

  • Oversee implementation delivery across customer segments, ensuring projects meet scope, timeline, quality, and outcome expectations.

  • Use data and reporting to monitor project health, capacity, utilization, customer outcomes, and opportunities for improvement.

  • Serve as an escalation point for complex implementation challenges while leading change initiatives that strengthen team effectiveness and customer results.

USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $192,000 USD and $264,000 USD. This role is also eligible for immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $182,000 CAD and $250,000 CAD. This role is also eligible for immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.


At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.


Our culture
At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first.

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results.

How we work with AI
We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. To us, this means we do ask that you join live interviews without using AI tools so we can get to know how you communicate, solve problems, and collaborate with others.


Our approach to work
We recognize the power of both in person collaboration and remote work. Some roles are designated as remote-first, with an expectation that individuals work from their homes majority of the time, while others are designated as in-office roles, with an expectation of being on-site on a regular basis. We recognize that certain roles benefit from regular, in-person connection to support collaboration, team cohesion, and customer engagement.

For all roles, occasional travel may be required. This includes things like: department-wide offsites, quarterly department meetings and periodic customer events. These events are typically held in varying locations across Canada, USA and/or EMEA. In leadership roles, you can expect to travel once per month on average.

Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto.


What we offer
We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer:

Health and wellbeing
👶 Maternity and parental leave top-up programs
🩺 Competitive health benefits
🏝 Generous PTO policy

Growth and future
📈 RSU program for most employees
💸 Retirement matching program
🔑 Free 1Password account

Community
🤝 Paid volunteer days
🏆 Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly
🌎 Remote-first work environment
*Some roles in our GTM team are currently being hired for in-person hybrid work in Toronto and Austin. These roles will specify on the posting.

You belong here.

1Password is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace that is built on trust, support and respect. We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status. Be yourself, find your people and share the things you love.

Accommodation is available upon request at any point during our recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please speak to your talent acquisition partner or email us at nextbit@agilebits.com and we’ll work to meet your needs.

Remote work is a part of our DNA. Given that our company was founded remotely in 2005, we can safely say we're experts at building remote culture. That said, remote work at 1Password does mean working from your home country. If you've got questions or concerns about this, your talent partner would be happy to address them with you.

title: Python Backend Developer – AI & AWS
description:
CLEEVEN is a European consulting company founded on two fundamental beliefs:

  • The excellence of European engineers should be a driver of global competitiveness.
  • Our human mission is to support our consultants in their personal and professional development.

Project Context:

As part of our projects in Artificial Intelligence and enterprise software development, we are looking for a Python Backend Developer to contribute to the development of an AI-powered knowledge management platform.

The solution leverages AI agents and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to retrieve and process information from large volumes of enterprise documents.

You will join a technical team working on a defined architecture, with a strong focus on backend development, code quality and reliable cloud-based services.

Your Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain Python backend services and REST APIs using FastAPI.
  • Implement AI agent workflows and integrations using frameworks such as LangGraph.
  • Build secure communication mechanisms between services and AI agents.
  • Integrate document retrieval and search capabilities with AWS services.
  • Work with AWS technologies such as S3, DynamoDB and Bedrock.
  • Develop automated tests and contribute to Docker-based CI/CD pipelines.
  • Review and improve AI-generated code to ensure maintainability, performance and reliability.
  • Collaborate with architects and other developers to deliver production-ready solutions.

Key Skills:

  • Strong Python development experience, including clean code, asynchronous programming and automated testing.
  • Hands-on experience with FastAPI or similar backend frameworks.
  • Solid understanding of REST APIs, authentication and service-to-service communication.
  • Good knowledge of AWS, particularly IAM, S3 and NoSQL databases.
  • Experience with GitHub, pull requests, code reviews and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Familiarity with Docker and containerized applications.
  • Ability to work from technical specifications and maintain high code-quality standards.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with LangGraph, LangChain or similar AI agent frameworks.
  • Understanding of RAG architectures, embeddings and vector databases.
  • Familiarity with OpenSearch, AWS Bedrock or LangSmith.
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Kiro or GitHub Copilot.

Your Profile:

  • Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or equivalent experience.
  • Proven experience developing and maintaining backend applications in production.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals and attention to code quality.
  • Ability to work independently within an established technical architecture.
  • Interest in AI technologies and willingness to learn new frameworks.
  • Good communication skills and a collaborative mindset.

description:

About the Role

title: LCA specialist
description:
About Us

Elementis is a global specialty chemical company, with 1,300 employees operating 17 manufacturing sites across the globe. At Elementis, we bring a distinctive combination of expertise, innovation, and teamwork to every formulation challenge. We create high-value specialty additives that enhance the performance of our customers' products and make a positive change in the world. Combining our leading positions in the science of materials flow, surface modification, and formulation with access to unique natural materials, Elementis delivers unique chemistry, sustainable solutions to customers in a wide range of markets, including cosmetics, anti-perspirants, decorative and industrial coatings, automotive and ceramics.

Job Description Summary

The role is the product life-cycle analysis (LCA) and product carbon footprint (PCF) expert for Elementis. Provision of product LCA / PCF data to customers is increasingly expected as standard practice globally. Developing new products with improved LCA / PCF is crucial to maintain competitiveness.

Job Description

The role is responsible for developing, conducting, maintaining and analysing our expanding product LCA/PCF information and capabilities. An LCA relies on complex specialised methodologies to calculate environmental impacts associated with a product. Elementis currently uses a tailored Excel tool to conduct LCA. The role is the principal user for this tool, generating LCA data reports for new and existing products, maintaining the LCA results database, updating the tool with new master data in collaboration with data owners across the organisation, analysing results to provide insight into trends and priority actions, and supporting communication of LCA results to external stakeholders (principally customers). We expect to transition to a new ERP-connected solution in future, and this role will work with IT to implement that solution.

Responsibilities

  • You execute LCA/PCF calculations for our products using specialist tools. You ensure output reports are suitable for external sharing when necessary. You maintain an organised, accessible database of results.
  • You guide the R&D organisation, providing LCA / PCF impacts of proposed new product designs and indicating how improvements could be made.
  • You expand the capabilities of Elementis’ LCA tool, working with external suppliers and with internal sustainability, R&D and manufacturing teams, based on business priorities
  • You analyse the LCA / PCF data reports, highlighting our most beneficial products and tracking product and portfolio performance trends over time. You create valuable insights for the business, highlighting opportunities and actions that make the most beneficial impacts.
  • You maintain the raw data within the tool, with periodic updates of manufacturing, materials and emission factors, working with the wider business to collect relevant data.
  • You maintain our LCA / PCF results in customer-specific data collection platforms.
  • You support third party verification of our LCA / PCF results
  • You recommend how to keep our LCA knowledge and capabilities up to date, tracking LCA standards updates, calculation capabilities, market benchmarking etc. This includes working with IT to implement a next generation LCA / PCF solution integrated with our new ERP system.
  • You leverage your network to keep up with best practices and ensure continuous improvement.

Decision making

  • You decide how best to organise and deliver your work to meet deadlines.
  • You decide how best to utilise the tools at your disposal to produce results.
  • You recommend actions for others based on your results and analysis.

Job Competencies

  • Managing complexity: You make sense, for yourself and others, of large amounts of complex, sometimes ambiguous data. You can use this information effectively for internal reporting.
  • Business insight: You apply your knowledge of our business and LCA methodologies to ensure accurate insights and analysis. You are tenacious in identifying the best people to collaborate with to deliver high quality outcomes.
  • Plan and align: You execute in a structured way. You allocate time and resources against deadlines, ensuring quality to have the desired outcomes. You identify and implement improvements in relevant processes.
  • Collaboration: You build partnership with key contributors across the entire company to harness collective expertise. You benchmark practices externally. You identify and promote synergies between business aims and data processes/systems.
  • Ensures accountability: You hold yourself and others accountable to meet organisational commitments, ensuring you have the support and engagement of your network and key contributors.

Additional Job Description

Technical Knowledge and Skills

  • Intermediate / Advanced understanding of different LCA & PCF methodologies (eg ISO14040, TfS, PEF, PACT etc).
  • Basic understanding of chemical manufacturing processes and terminologies
  • Fluent with numbers / technical information

Position Requirements

  • Education: Degree-level education or equivalent years of experience. Professional qualifications / certifications / professional memberships are a bonus but not required.
  • Experience: 3+ years of experience of conducting LCA/PCF in a consultancy or industrial organisation (example relevant sectors include - but are not limited to - chemicals, food, manufacturing).
  • IT Skills: Familiarity with data collection and data management best practices; Ability to organise results archive for ease of use and updating; MSOffice, especially Excel.
  • Language Skills: Fluent in English (written and verbal).
  • Working arrangements:
  • Traveling required: Occasional

title: Elementary Director
description:
The Elementary Director owns Princeton Alliance Church's ministry to elementary-age children and the families raising them. The role exists so that every weekend, kids walk into safe, ready, joyful environments where they meet Jesus through large-group teaching, small groups, and worship. Beyond Sunday mornings, this role leads Elementary events and co-leads PACKids Summer Camp alongside the Family Life Team Leader. The Elementary Director also builds the volunteer teams behind it all, so that Sundays don't rely on any one person, and grows assistants into teachers along the way. It is one of two peer director roles in Family Life, alongside the Early Childhood Director.

Description

PRIMARILY SERVES

Elementary-Age Children | Parents & Families | Ministry Volunteers

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • Every weekend, Elementary rooms are staffed, set, and secure before the first family arrives, and parents hand over their kids with confidence.

  • Teachers and small group leaders have their lessons and materials in hand well before Sunday.

  • Volunteers are known and cared for, assistants grow into teachers, and the bench is deep enough that a last-minute call-out doesn't pull the director into the classroom.

  • PACKids Summer Camp and Elementary events run on documented systems, so each year is easier to run than the last.

  • Families move from Early Childhood into Elementary and on to Youth as one continuous ministry.

  • Parents know what their kids are learning and have practical support for discipling them at home.

  • Children with special needs are included and served well in every Elementary environment.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead weekend Elementary ministry, including large-group and small-group programming, worship, classroom readiness, and consistent implementation of all child safety and check-in procedures.

  • Recruit, approve, train, and develop the volunteer teams that staff Elementary, growing assistants into teachers and building enough depth that the ministry doesn't depend on any one person's presence.

  • Disciple and care for volunteers, leading the Sunday huddle, Elementary's kickoff training, and regular teacher, assistant, and greeter meetings, and adjusting the ministry when volunteer feedback points to a better way.

  • Lead the Elementary worship and tech team, developing the volunteers who lead kids worship and run the room's technology, and preparing alternate worship when no team is available.

  • Prepare and distribute curriculum weekly so large group and small group leaders have their lessons, supplies, and information well before Sunday, and teach large group when needed.

  • Schedule and cover every Sunday through Planning Center, following up personally when volunteers decline or don't show, and scheduling guest speakers for large group.

  • Plan and run PACKids Summer Camp alongside the Family Life Team Leader, including registration, volunteer placement and training, check-in and safety teams, rosters, vendors, and supplies.

  • Plan and execute all PAC Kids Elementary ministry events, including programming for Good Friday, Easter, Christmas, and summer large group, while sharing leadership of Family Life events with the Family Life Team Leader and the Early Childhood Director.

  • Manage ministry’s use of Planning Center Online, including check-in stations and labels, registrations, lists, and reports for Sundays, events, and camp.

  • Partner with parents through registration and check-in, classroom behavior conversations, and parent development for the elementary years, collaborating with the Family Life Team Leader and the Early Childhood Director on the Parent Handbook and monthly parent updates.

  • Meet with families about baptism for elementary-age children, in collaboration with the Family Life Team Leader.

  • Partner with the Early Childhood Director and the Youth Pastor on shared systems and transitions, so families are handed forward rather than handed off.

  • Partner with the Buddies Specialist so children with special needs are included and served well in Elementary environments.

  • Steward the Elementary budget within approved limits, including curriculum, supplies, and event expenses, and reconcile receipts in Blackbaud.

PASSIONATE ABOUT

  • Believing a second grader can know and follow Jesus, and structuring lessons accordingly.

  • Watching a nervous volunteer become a confident teacher.

  • Encouraging the kid having a hard time even when it’s challenging.

  • Building systems good enough that next summer's camp is easier than this one.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Personal, growing Christian faith and alignment with PAC's mission and beliefs.

  • 3+ years of experience in children's ministry, elementary education, or a closely related field, including direct experience leading volunteers.

  • Demonstrated ability to recruit, train, and retain a volunteer team.

  • Working understanding of how elementary-age children learn, and of age-appropriate classroom and behavior management.

  • Organization and follow-through that hold up across weekly rhythms and large seasonal events.

  • Consistent, detail-faithful implementation of child safety and check-in procedures.

  • Strong communication with parents, volunteers, and staff peers.

  • Proficiency with Google Workspace and Microsoft Office, and comfort learning church management software.

  • Successful completion of a background check and PAC's child safety training.

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Associate's degree or higher in education, child development, or a related field.

  • Experience with Planning Center Online, particularly Services, Check-Ins, and Registrations.

  • Experience planning large children's events or a day camp.

  • Experience serving children with special needs or disabilities.

title: Sr Data Scientist
description:
About Amazon Quick: Amazon Quick is an enterprise AI workspace that brings together intelligent agents, deep research, business intelligence, and workflow automation. It lets employees find answers across their company's data, apps, and the web, turn insights into action, and automate repetitive work. Organizations of every size rely on Quick to make faster, better-informed decisions with AI they can trust.

About the Team: The Quick Data team builds the high-quality datasets that power and measure Amazon Quick. Our work spans human evaluation, Responsible AI safeguards, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and benchmarking. It makes sure Quick's generative AI features are enterprise-ready, safe, and effective at scale. The team includes data scientists, engineers, language engineers, linguists, and program managers who partner closely with science, engineering, and product teams. Customer obsession and high standards drive everything the team delivers.

About the Role The Quick Data team is hiring a Data Scientist II to lead evaluation and benchmarking data development for Quick features. In this role, you will design the datasets, metrics, and evaluation frameworks that show whether Quick meets customer needs. Your insights will shape product direction and model improvements.

Key job responsibilities
Design and build evaluation and benchmark datasets
Define quality metrics and evaluation frameworks, including human evaluation, model-based evaluation (LLM-as-a-Judge), and checks on how well the two correlate
Run human annotation programs from start to finish: write guidelines, measure inter-annotator agreement, and control data quality
Analyze model and agent performance to find gaps, root causes, and the highest-impact improvements
Partner with science, engineering, and product teams to turn evaluation results into launch decisions and roadmap priorities
Present findings and recommendations to senior leadership

About the team
AWS is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

title: Senior Field Performance Partner, AI
description:
1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $500M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

The Go To Market (GTM) Performance & Strategy team helps teams turn strategy into consistent execution through targeted coaching, practice, and performance improvement. As a Senior Field Performance Partner, you’ll work with frontline Sales and Channel leaders across US and Canada to diagnose performance gaps, build focused development plans, and use data and AI to help teams improve. Your work will help 1Password’s go-to-market organization perform at its best while advancing our mission to enable a safe, productive digital future.

This is not a traditional enablement role. We don’t believe more training is always the answer. We believe enablement should start with the performance problem, use data and AI to understand what’s happening, and apply the most targeted intervention possible.

You’ll independently own the performance improvement cycle for the teams you support: diagnose → prescribe → activate → reinforce → measure → adjust.

You’ll combine business results, AI-generated coaching insights, field observations, and manager input to identify where teams and individuals need support. You’ll turn those insights into focused enablement plans, use AI to scale individualized practice and coaching, help managers reinforce the right behaviors, and measure whether performance actually changed.

As 1Password continues to scale our partner-led GTM motion, you’ll also help make channel execution part of how our field operates every day. Rather than treating channel as a separate motion or specialist skill, you’ll help managers and teams build the behaviors needed to effectively identify, engage, and sell with partners as part of their everyday work.

Your job isn’t to keep people busy with enablement. It’s to help them perform better.

How we’re using AI today

Across GTM, we’re transforming the way we work with AI. We expect every seller, CSM, and team member to become a power user, using it daily to work smarter and move faster. AI is already embedded in how we operate – from real-time coaching that sharpens how we sell and interact with customers, to surfacing insights that help us anticipate needs – creating more time for meaningful customer engagement. If you’re excited to reshape how you think, make decisions, and drive growth with AI, you’ll feel right at home here.

Expectations of this role
This is a hybrid role. You will be expected to work from 1Password's Toronto/Austin office 3 days per week, with the flexibility to work from the office up to 5 days based on business needs.

What we're looking for:

  • 7+ years of experience in a Business-to-Business (B2B) technology go-to-market (GTM) organization across Sales, Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, BDR, Enablement, frontline leadership, or a combination of these areas.

  • Experience working in a channel or partner-led GTM environment, with practical knowledge of selling with and through resellers, MSPs, distributors, and other channel partners, including partner engagement, account mapping, co-selling, and partner-led growth.

  • Experience carrying a quota, leading a frontline GTM team, or directly coaching customer-facing teams strongly preferred.

  • Strong business and analytical judgment, with the ability to diagnose performance challenges, identify root causes, and translate insights into practical, measurable plans that improve skills, behaviors, and business outcomes.

  • Understanding of sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC and their application in coaching, enablement, or field execution.

  • Credibility with frontline GTM leaders and the ability to operate independently as a coach, advisor, and constructive challenger.

  • Curiosity and fluency with AI, with experience using automation, dashboards, and performance signals to make coaching and development more individualized, scalable, and measurable.

  • A bias toward action and a commitment to experimentation, measurement, and continuous improvement.

  • Understanding of how selling practices and customer needs vary across the US and Canadian markets.

What you can expect:

  • Own the end-to-end performance improvement cycle for the frontline managers and teams you support: diagnose, prescribe, activate, reinforce, measure, and adjust.

  • Establish a consistent operating rhythm with managers, bringing data-informed insights and recommendations about where their coaching can have the greatest impact.

  • Combine business results, behavioral data, AI-generated coaching insights, field observations, and manager input to identify performance gaps and create focused development plans.

  • Create strategic enablement plans that address root causes and become part of the team’s day-to-day work.

  • Use AI-powered role-play, practice, feedback loops, manager coaching, live learning, and tools such as Hyperbound to support individualized development at scale.

  • Help managers reinforce key skills, products, messaging, partner motions, and GTM priorities through ongoing coaching and team practice.

  • Partner across Technical Enablement, Revenue Operations, Go-to-Market Engineering, and other teams to bring the right resources into identified performance challenges.

  • Facilitate workshops, webinars, and other learning experiences when appropriate, while enabling managers to lead reinforcement with their teams.

  • Measure whether interventions are changing behavior and improving outcomes, and share recurring performance patterns and field feedback with cross-functional partners.

USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $127,000 USD and $170,000 USD, and is commission-eligible. This role is also eligible for immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $114,000 CAD and $152,500 CAD and is commission-eligible. This role is also eligible for immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.


Our culture
At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first.

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results.

How we work with AI
We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. To us, this means we do ask that you join live interviews without using AI tools so we can get to know how you communicate, solve problems, and collaborate with others.


Our approach to work
We recognize the power of both in person collaboration and remote work. Some roles are designated as remote-first, with an expectation that individuals work from their homes majority of the time, while others are designated as in-office roles, with an expectation of being on-site on a regular basis. We recognize that certain roles benefit from regular, in-person connection to support collaboration, team cohesion, and customer engagement.

For all roles, occasional travel may be required. This includes things like: department-wide offsites, quarterly department meetings and periodic customer events. These events are typically held in varying locations across Canada, USA and/or EMEA. In leadership roles, you can expect to travel once per month on average.

Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto.


What we offer
We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer:

Health and wellbeing
👶 Maternity and parental leave top-up programs
🩺 Competitive health benefits
🏝 Generous PTO policy

Growth and future
📈 RSU program for most employees
💸 Retirement matching program
🔑 Free 1Password account

Community

🏆 Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly
🌎 Remote-first work environment

You belong here.

We welcome all individuals and do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity and expression, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, colour, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, citizenship, education, languages spoken or veteran status. description:

We act with integrity, and we treat customers, partners and each other with dignity and respect. We live these values every day and could not have prospered for more than 200 years without them.

POSITION SUMMARY:

The PM72 Finisher is responsible for safely handling, inspecting, labeling, and preparing finished product for shipment. This role ensures all rolls meet quality and customer specifications, maintains accurate documentation, and supports smooth finishing operations and material flow.

ROLE & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Follow all safety procedures including PPE use, hazard recognition, LOTO, and safe handling of rolls, materials, and finishing equipment.
  • Recognize and safely perform high‑risk tasks such as startup, cleaning, adjustments, and jam clearing while following proper controls and supervision requirements.
  • Operate finishing systems and computers to manage production orders, labeling, and workflow through the TIPS/barcode system.
  • Print, verify, and apply correct product labels, including small labels and master labels, ensuring accuracy and traceability.
  • Inspect finished rolls and pallets for defects, damage, proper stacking, and overall product condition prior to shipment.
  • Ensure all materials are correctly identified, tagged, and documented to maintain traceability and compliance with customer specifications.
  • Maintain consistent product quality by identifying defects, recognizing trends, and taking corrective action before shipment.
  • Apply cover sheets and complete required documentation to ensure proper product protection and order accuracy.
  • Organize rolls and materials to support efficient workflow, safe handling, and shipment readiness.
  • Use measuring tools such as tape measures to verify product dimensions and ensure compliance with specifications.
  • Coordinate with upstream and downstream operations to maintain production flow and meet delivery requirements.
  • Maintain clean and organized work areas, communicate effectively with team members, and support continuous improvement in safety and quality.

QUALIFICATIONS (EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE)

  • High School Diploma or GED preferred and/or prior training on baler.
  • Operating and monitoring machinery.
  • Knowledge of glass fiber making process.
  • Ability to establish good working relationships.
  • Computer knowledge.
  • Attention to detail.
  • Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions.
  • Lean Manufacturing Concepts preferable.

PHYSICAL REQUIRMENTS AND ENVIRONMENT:

  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear.
  • The employee is frequently required to stand, walk; sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; and taste or smell.
  • The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds.
  • Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.
  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally exposed to moving mechanical parts.
  • Hearing protection is required in specific areas.

title: Staff Engineer, Engineering-wide
description:
About Plaud Inc.

Plaud is building the real-world AI interface for professionals to amplify intelligence, elevate productivity and performance, loved by over 3,000,000 users worldwide since 2023. With a mission to amplify human intelligence, Plaud captures, structures, and compounds the intelligence generated in conversations — so humans can think better, decide faster, and execute with clarity.

Plaud Inc. is a Delaware-incorporated, San Francisco-based company. With GDPR, SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA, and EN 18031 compliance, Plaud is committed to the highest standards of data security and privacy protection.

To learn more about Plaud, please visit and follow along on Instagram, X, Facebook, LinkedIn, and YouTube.

Why You Should Join Us

Plaud is building the next generation intelligence infrastructure and interfaces to capture, extract, and utilize intelligence from what people say, hear, see, and think.

  • Plaud is a bootstrapped, skyrocketing, profitable company with a $300M revenue run rate achieved in just three years.

  • Define the next-gen paradigm for human-AI interaction.

  • Gain exposure to cutting-edge AI for Pro tools and play a direct role in our global expansion.

  • Work with passionate teammates who value innovation, collaboration, and customer success.

  • Grow your career in a culture that champions continuous learning and fast career development.

  • Market-competitive compensation, global exposure, and a vibrant, creativity-fueled work atmosphere.

This senior IC role has no fixed team. You would rotate across Plaud's product, platform and infrastructure teams, joining whichever team has the hardest problem: a migration, an on-call mess, a cross-team API or an AI quality gap. You fix it with them and leave the patterns behind. The stack runs from devices and mobile to Go/Python services and LLM pipelines, and you'd report to the head of engineering.

What you will do

  • Rotate across Plaud's product, platform and infrastructure teams based on business needs, working with whichever team has the highest-leverage engineering problem.

  • Go deep with each team on its hardest problem, such as a stalled migration, a reliability or on-call problem, a slow CI pipeline, or an AI quality gap, and ship the fix together.

  • Write production code: design, build, review and ship, not just advise.

  • Lead technical designs that cross team boundaries, including shared APIs, data contracts between teams, and handoffs between product and platform teams.

  • Raise the engineering bar in every team you join: testing, observability, runbooks, code review, and evals in CI/CD.

  • Build an end-to-end understanding of the whole system, from the device and capture pipeline to transcription, AI notes, AI agent features and the services underneath. Use it to guide architecture decisions across the org with Gene and the eng leads.

  • Mentor senior engineers in the US and Asia, and help grow the next generation of tech leads.

  • Explore and drive AI-native engineering practice, showing teams how AI-assisted development speeds up real work.

Skills, qualifications and experience we look for

  • 10+ years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years at Staff level or equivalent scope.

  • Deep expertise in more than one area, such as backend distributed systems, mobile or client, data pipelines, or ML/LLM systems, and the ability to ramp up quickly on unfamiliar code.

  • Proven track record leading technical work across teams, with design docs and migrations that other engineers adopted.

  • Strong in Go or Python, plus at least one client stack (iOS, Android, React or Electron), with cloud-native experience (AWS/GCP, Kubernetes).

  • Experience shipping LLM features in production, including retrieval, prompt pipelines, evals, and managing latency and cost.

  • Excellent written communication and comfort working across time zones and cultures.

  • Low ego and high ownership: happy to make the team look good and move on.

  • Recognized technical influence through open-source contributions, highly starred GitHub repositories, conference talks or technical publications is a plus.

  • Routinely uses AI tools in daily work and can demo usage from the last two weeks during the interview.

What we offer

  1. Meaningful Ownership An Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) that gives a real stake in Plaud’s long-term success.

  2. High-Impact Environment Work in a fast-moving, product-driven environment where your ideas directly shape the future of AI productivity.

  3. Cutting-Edge AI Tools for Productivity Access to best-in-class AI tools, including Gemini, Claude Code, and other frontier AI systems to maximize engineering and execution efficiency.

  4. Best-in-Class Equipment Choice of top-spec laptops, high-performance workstation setups, and cutting-edge Plaud devices for all new hires.

  5. Team & Culture Annual company offsites, team events, and a culture that values craftsmanship, ownership, and velocity.

Disclaimer: Plaud is and will continue to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

title: Solution Engineer - Benelux
description:
What we are all about

Do you ever have the urge to do things better than the last time? We do. And it’s this urge that drives us every day. Our environment of discovery and innovation means we’re able to create deep and valuable relationships with our customers to create real change for them and their industries. It’s what got us here – and it’s what will make our future.

At Quantexa, you will find autonomy and support in equal measures, with the freedom to grow a career that matches your ambitions. We are proud of our global culture: 41% of our colleagues come from an ethnic or religious minority background, we speak over 20 languages, and represent 50+ nationalities, creating a powerful sense of belonging across all teams.

We're heading in one direction: the future. We’d love you to join us!

The Opportunity

We are looking for an exceptional candidate to join our high-performing Field Engineering Function in Europe, specifically in Belgium, the Netherlands, and Luxembourg. You will collaborate closely with regional peers across Alliances, Sales, Marketing, Product, and Delivery to help win strategic sales opportunities and ensure our customers realise lasting value from the Quantexa platform.

We are seeking someone with strong technical and business solution expertise who can articulate complex technical concepts in a clear, compelling way. You will deliver impactful presentations, product demonstrations, and deep dives across customer engagements and industry events. As a spokesperson for Quantexa's technology, you’ll build lasting trust with stakeholders by engaging them in relevant, value-driven conversations.

This role is for someone who thrives on ownership and impact. You will work on strategic opportunities and accounts from the first conversation through to successful deployment and expansion, and your insights from the field will help shape how Quantexa evolves.

The Quantexa Field Engineering function brings together presales and postsales expertise and will work across the entire customer lifecycle from first technical touchpoint for prospective organisations and remain a trusted technical partner as customers land and expand their use of Quantexa, providing continuity across the entire customer journey. In this role, key responsibilities include:

  • Communicate the value and impact of the Quantexa Decision Intelligence Platform, helping prospects understand how it enables smarter, faster, and more confident decision-making through connected, trusted data

  • Identify and position the right Quantexa solution tailored to each prospect’s and customer’s specific needs

  • Guide prospects and customers through a clear, outcome-driven solution strategy that sets the stage for long-term value and success

  • Remain a trusted technical partner beyond the initial sale, supporting successful adoption, business value realisation, and expansion

Location

This role will be based in Belgium and remote. To best facilitate collaboration with our customers, partners, and internal teams, this role will involve travel to customer sites across the region and occasional international travel to our other offices, such as London.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Be a functional expert in Quantexa’s platform and products, with a strong understanding of its capabilities and real-world applications

  • Demonstrate a good understanding of the industry practices and regulatory environments of our customers, such as Public Sector and how the platform addresses gaps or risks

  • Articulate and present the value of our platform, demonstrating how Quantexa solves specific pain points and enables better decision-making

  • Represent Quantexa at industry events, customer meetings, and webinars, showcasing our capabilities and thought leadership

  • Support or manage the technical aspects of the sales cycle, working alongside Sales, Architects, Product, and SMEs

  • Contribute to proposals, including RFPs and RFIs

  • Take ownership of the design and execution of PoCs and trials, ensuring alignment with customer objectives

  • Collaborate on the design and iteration of tailored solutions, working with partners, customers, and internal teams to define the right approach

  • Deliver tailored product demonstrations, both in-person and remotely, that engage a range of stakeholders from users to executives

  • Facilitate discovery sessions with prospects, customers, and partners, uncovering core business challenges and technical needs

  • Understand key deployment options and decisions at an enterprise level, and steer customers and internal teams to deliver the right solution to the problem

  • Be an integral part of the account team for selected strategic customers, defining the account strategy and the vision for decision intelligence across the customer’s enterprise, and building trusted relationships with senior stakeholders

  • Work closely with Product, Delivery, and our strategic partners to ensure alignment with the customer’s goals and adherence to Blueprints, scoping and setting up projects for success, and supporting value realisation through proving and implementation stages

  • Own key customer relationships and ensure appropriate account governance is in place, including regular account reviews, customer health reporting, and early identification of renewal risk

  • Support the operational adoption of the Quantexa platform, helping customers renew and setting the foundation for their expansion with Quantexa

  • Support the growth and development of the European (with a focus on Belgium, the Netherlands, and Luxembourg) Field Engineering function

What You’ll Bring

  • Experience in a commercially focused, technical role such as Solution Engineering, Presales, Technical Sales, Value Consulting, or a customer-facing technical consulting role, working with customers in Belgium, the Netherlands, Luxembourg, and broader Europe

  • Excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills, with a track record of effective customer engagement

  • Great communicator, able to captivate audiences of all sizes with an innate ability to simplify complex concepts for diverse audiences.

  • Proven experience in at least one solution area, such as Data Management, Fraud Detection, Intelligence Investigations, or Law Enforcement, Tax/Borders/Custom Agencies, Healthcare, Security & Defense, with a good understanding of both technical and business aspects of the solution

  • Experience leading extensive proving engagements, including PoCs or early implementation phases, or alternatively, all of the following activities: technical workshops, prototypes, bespoke demonstrations, and business cases.

  • A track record of delivering measurable outcomes, such as technical wins, successful deployments, or customer expansion

  • Experience working with customers beyond the initial sale, for example through platform implementation, adoption, or account management, including helping customers define a roadmap to realise the value of their investment

  • Ability to build and nurture trusted relationships with senior business and technology stakeholders, up to executive level

  • A consultative, analytical approach: you evaluate challenges from different perspectives and work collaboratively with customers and internal teams to define and implement the most effective solution

  • Confident in delivering engaging presentations and pitches that connect functionality to business value

  • Experience building demos, templates, or sharing best practices that contribute to team enablement

  • Experience mentoring or supporting peers through knowledge sharing or guidance

  • Fluent in English and Dutch.

  • Where required for the role, eligibility and willingness to obtain and maintain the relevant national security clearance. Clearance criteria, which may include nationality or residency requirements, are set by the relevant government authority, not by Quantexa.

Desired Skills

  • Strong expertise in data-driven, analytical solutions such as Entity Resolution, Graph Generation, Advanced Analytics, and MDM

  • Domain knowledge in areas such as Tax, Borders, Customs, Law Enforcement, Security and Defense within industries such as Public Sector.

  • Experience implementing, running, or using data and technology platforms in an enterprise environment

  • Technical knowledge in data storage, processing and containerisation technology such as Cloud or On-prem Distributed File Systems, Spark, Databricks, Kubernetes, Open Search, Elastic Search.

Our perks and quirks.

What makes you Q will help you to realize your full potential, flourish and enjoy what you do, while being recognized and rewarded with our broad range of benefits.

We offer:

  • Competitive salary & Company bonus

  • 20 days annual leave (if you worked the previous year January – December), 12 compensation days, plus national holidays + your birthday off!

  • Pension scheme

  • Private Healthcare

  • Death in Service and Income Protection

  • Work from Home Allowance

  • Eco Vouchers

  • Meal Vouchers

  • Regularly bench-marked salary rates

  • Well-being days

  • Volunteer Day off

  • Work from Home Equipment

  • Free Subscription to a meditation, relaxation and sleep app

  • Continuous Training and Development

  • Spend up to 2 months working outside of your country of employment over a rolling 12-month period with our ‘Work from Anywhere’ policy

  • Team Social Budget & Company-wide Socials

Our mission.

We have one mission. To help businesses grow. To make data easier. And to make the world a better place. We’re not a start-up. Not anymore. But we’ve not been around that long either. What we are is a collection of bright, passionate minds harnessing complexities and helping our clients and their communities. One culture, made of many. Heading in one direction – the future.

It’s all about you.

We want you to feel welcome, valued, and respected - because it’s your individuality and passion that make you Q. We see that, and we celebrate it. That’s why we’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment, continuously improving to ensure everyone belongs. Our recruitment process is designed to be inclusive and accessible. If you need any reasonable adjustments or accommodations, please let our Talent Acquisition Team know - we’re happy to assist.

No matter your race, beliefs, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, neurodiversity, or abilities—whoever you are—if you're a passionate, curious, and caring human eager to push the boundaries of what’s possible, we want to hear from you.

title: Quality Assurance Engineer II
description:
Job Description

The Quality Assurance Engineer II develops and executes tests for all aspects of Ignition. Under the guidance of a Quality Assurance Group Manager, they are responsible for developing, maintaining and executing automated and manual tests, and for reporting on the progress and status of test activities. This includes validating and verifying new and improved features with a variety of testing tools and approaches, including both automated and manual execution within multiple applications (desktop, front-end (Web), back-end (API), and mobile). Additionally, the Quality Assurance Engineer II role is directly involved in building and testing production versions of the system.

This is a full-time position. Work Arrangement: Hybrid, with a regular onsite schedule at 90 Blue Ravine Rd, Folsom, CA. In-office expectations are set by each team and may change from time to time.

Responsibilities

  • Validating low to medium complexity bugs and features

  • Occasionally working on higher complexity issues with guidance from Senior Quality Assurance Engineers on medium to high complexity issues, where appropriate

  • Contributing fixes and new tests to automated test suites

  • Performing PR reviews of automated tests submitted by other team members

  • Assisting with the monitoring of nightly automation run reports

  • Participating in testing contributions within the development lifecycle (e.g. validating bug fixes, conducting regression testing, and manual/automated test case development)

  • Collaborating with the Development team in the implementation phase to ensure proper test coverage for a given issue or feature

  • Consistently meeting or exceeding regression test suite execution targets and adding manual test cases as needed

  • Designing, developing, and executing test plans that cover all functional requirements, with the ability to determine applicable test strategies for low to medium complexity bugs and features, in team-relevant product areas

  • Demonstrating sufficient proficiency in relevant Ignition product areas, and adequately testing all areas

  • Demonstrating autonomy by maintaining progress on assigned tasks and leveraging resources effectively, and prioritizing unowned or undesirable work to help with team velocity

  • Collaborating and effectively utilize senior resources to improve personal technical skills

  • Maintaining a proficient understanding of the company, our primary software deliverable and its purpose (Ignition), and our customer base

  • Collaborating with Developers and Product Managers to clarify requirements and provide feedback on functionality, usability, and performance

  • Identifying, documenting, and tracking defects using issue tracking tools, ensuring clear communication and resolution processes

  • Staying up to date with industry trends, tools, and technologies to continually enhance testing strategies

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science/Engineering OR at least 4 years experience working in a related field

  • Meet at least one of the following experience criteria:

    • 2+ years of experience in a software testing role

    • 2+ years of experience in configuring and developing Ignition applications

      OR

    • Currently hold an intermediate-level role within the inductive Automation Support Services Division (with at least 1 year in the division)

  • Strong troubleshooting skills within a complex application environment, including debugging of errors, identifying performance issues, parsing of logs and stack traces, and determining reproducible steps for issues

  • Intermediate programming knowledge with at least one language, including understanding of functions, conditional statements, and basic object oriented concepts (Python, Java/JavaScript, C++)

  • Solid understanding of the SDLC (Software Development Lifecycle) and each of the phases

  • Familiarity with source control management systems, such as Git, and common usage (clone and checkout of repositories and specific branches, commits and merge conflicts)

  • Experience with setup and querying of SQL databases (MS SQL Server, MySQL, similar)

  • Familiarity with Windows, Linux (Ubuntu), and macOS platforms, including working from the command line, and debugging issues with applications running as a service

  • Experience with deploying applications using virtualization software (VMWare, Docker Desktop), including creating images, debugging running containers, and use of persistent data (volumes)

  • Experience with bug tracking systems and writing proper bug reports

  • Familiarity with well-known protocols in the Internet protocol suite and their usage in applications (TCP/UDP, HTTP/HTTPS, IP)

Skills not required, but a plus:

  • Familiarity with writing automated test cases for Web application testing frameworks (Selenium WebDriver, QF-Test)

  • Experience with writing automated test cases within well known mobile test automation frameworks (XCTest, Espresso)

  • Experience with executing manual tests on mobile devices (iOS and Android) using actual devices or emulators

  • Familiarity with PLC programming and configuration, including ladder logic, updating firmware, and maintenance of PLC programs/exports

  • Experience with device data acquisition (OPC-UA/OPC-DA, MQTT, etc)

  • Experience with tools for quick application development and infrastructure deployment (Docker, Vagrant, Terraform, similar)

  • Debugging of Java platform and Swing/JavaFX applications using JProfiler (or similar profiling tool)

  • Experience with Maven and Gradle build tools, especially in coordinating builds with automated testing

  • Configuring continuous integration/continuous development servers (Jenkins), including creating and maintaining jobs/pipelines

  • Experience with coding in modern IDEs (Eclipse, IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm)

  • Experience with Wireshark or network analysis tools (traffic filtering, packet analysis)

  • Familiarity with manufacturing industry and HMI/SCADA software

About Us

Who are we?

Champions for industrial automation innovation and driven by a mission statement to empower our customers to swiftly turn great ideas into reality by removing all technological and economic obstacles, we create and deliver solutions that relieve pain points, bring efficiency to operations and optimize integration.

Why Choose Inductive Automation?

Our passion goes beyond customers. We celebrate your personal and professional milestones, and we support our teams with meaningful work in a collaborative environment.

We find that great work-life balance inspires teams to do their best work and empowers people to live their best lives. That's why diversity, fun, and flexibility are ingrained into our work culture.

The Inductive Automation team understands the importance of personal growth and social connection. So things like time for professional development, or company and team activities are baked right into the schedule to keep us all engaged, connected, and prospering.

Benefits and Perks

  • 100% Employee Covered Health Care: Don’t pay a dime for your medical, dental, and vision insurance

  • Paid Time Off: Receive paid holidays, vacation, and sick time

  • 401k with Match: Save for the future with our company-matching 401k program

  • World-Class Headquarters: While on-site, enjoy complimentary snacks and beverages, then challenge a friend to a game of pool, table tennis, shuffleboard, or foosball

  • Adjacent Nature Reserve: On-site employees enjoy breathtaking views and adventures that energize and inspire

Additional Information

At this time, we are unable to offer employment for individuals located outside of the United States and/or those who require sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H-1B visa status). We know you've got a lot of options when seeking an employer where your skills and talents will shine, so we really appreciate that you considered us.

Inductive Automation, LLC is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, and status as a protected veteran or individual with a disability. Verification of US employment eligibility required.

title: Head of Amazon
description:
We are looking for a Head of Amazon to take full commercial ownership of an established private-label business that has been selling on Amazon for over 10 years: several brands, mainly apparel, about 7,000 SKUs on the US, Canadian and European marketplaces.
This is not a hands-on PPC or listing role. The company already has strong functional teams with their own leaders: PPC, Catalog, Content and Product/Brand Management. As Head of Amazon, you will lead five functional leaders through KPIs, financial metrics and clear priorities, and own the sales plans and profitability (CM3) of the whole Amazon business.
You will need deep practical Amazon expertise to understand the work of every department, judge the quality of its decisions and set the right priorities, and you will make AI part of how every team works.

Requirements

  • Proven experience running an Amazon business or a large Amazon division as Head of Amazon, Director of E-commerce, Amazon Business Director, Amazon General Manager or Commercial Director. CEO/COO experience in a smaller Amazon private-label business is also relevant.

  • Personal ownership of P&L, budgets, sales and margin, with results you can show in numbers.

  • Strong understanding of unit economics and financial planning across several marketplaces.

  • Advanced understanding of Amazon PPC and advertising strategy: campaign architecture, ACOS, TACOS, ROAS, CTR and CVR.

  • Deep knowledge of Amazon A9/A10 search and ranking, catalog architecture, complex variations, SEO and indexing.

  • Experience with systematic competitor and market research using specialized tools.

  • Strong knowledge of Amazon Account Health and compliance: preventing account and listing suspensions and managing restrictions.

  • Experience managing several teams at once, including other managers, through KPIs, delegation and measurable goals.

  • Experience working with a large, complex assortment of thousands of SKUs.

  • Systematic daily use of AI, and proven experience introducing AI workflows into your teams' work with a practical business result.

  • English: B2+.

  • Readiness to complete a practical Amazon business analysis assignment and a case interview as part of the selection process.

Responsibilities
