title: Senior Capacity Intelligence Analyst, Network Strategy & Performance
description:
As Senior Capacity Intelligence Analyst, you will own end-to-end network planning for Amazon's Customer Service network, including outsourced (Global Outsourcing) sites. You will work at the intersection of data, strategy, and operations — translating complex demand signals into accurate staffing plans that protect customer experience while delivering cost efficiency.
You will operate independently, managing ambiguity with rigor and judgment. You will partner closely with CS Operations, Global Outsourcing (GO) Vendor Management, CS Finance, Service Delivery, and Planning Intelligence teams. You will present your analysis and recommendations independently to senior stakeholders (Directors), influence planning decisions through well-reasoned, data-backed arguments, and contribute to the team's AI-driven transformation agenda.
This role participates in weekly, monthly, and quarterly business reviews and directly influences outsourcing and staffing decisions across the CS network.

Core Competencies
- AI Fluency: Acts as an AI catalyst for peers. Designs automation solutions that free bandwidth at team scale. Shapes the team's AI learning agenda. Demonstrates measurable productivity improvement driven by AI adoption.
- Critical Thinking: Reframes ambiguous problems into actionable frameworks. Anticipates second-order effects. Influences leaders (Senior Managers) with well-reasoned, data-backed arguments. Identifies non-obvious connections between operational signals and strategic implications.
- Executive Presence: Leads Director level discussions. Communicates with conviction and brevity. Influences without authority. Writes and speaks in a way that makes complex ideas accessible to senior non-expert audiences.
- Problem Solving: Solves complex, cross-functional problems spanning teams and timelines. Creates repeatable frameworks that prevent entire categories of problems from recurring. Is the person others come to when a problem is genuinely hard.
- Boundaryless: Co-owns outcomes with partner teams. Build deep trust with stakeholders (Senior Managers) across CS. Drives alignment across competing priorities and organizational boundaries. Operates as a full member of the partner team, not just a vendor of planning services.
- Innovative and Experimental: Demonstrates a willingness to experiment and take calculated risks, particularly on reversible (two-way door) decisions. Proactively unblocks teams to test, iterate, and move with speed — challenging legacy boundaries and established norms to drive innovation

Key job responsibilities
- Own the development, maintenance, and execution of network capacity plans for internal and outsourced sites, covering short-term (4-week), operational (monthly/quarterly), and long-term (3-year) planning horizons.
- Proactively identify and mitigate capacity risks by mapping dependencies across internal sites and Global Outsourcing vendor partners. Communicate risks and mitigation plans to the right stakeholders clearly and with specificity. Coordinate with CS Operations and GO Vendor Management teams to ensure staffing plans are aligned with service level targets and outsourcing strategy.
- Support quarterly submissions to CS Finance, providing accurate Year-to-Go (YTG) labor cost projections and revisions versus OP targets.
- Independently apply AI tools (e.g., AgentZ, Kiro) to improve planning workflows without prompting, identifying opportunities to increase the speed, quality, and scale of planning outputs. Develop side-of-desk automation for repetitive tasks within your planning workstream, demonstrating measurable productivity improvement.
- Build repeatable frameworks that prevent entire categories of planning problems from recurring, becoming the go-to resource when a planning challenge is genuinely hard.
- Present analysis and planning recommendations to senior audiences independently, adapting your communication style for technical and non-technical, operational and strategic audiences. Write clear, concise, and compelling narratives for QBRs, MBRs, and planning reviews. Documents must meet Amazon's standard formatting guidelines, with conclusions that tie to the organization's working-backwards framework.
- Communicate complex planning ideas in a way that is accessible to senior, non-expert audiences. Align cross-functional stakeholders (Operations, Finance, HR, Training and others) to embed planning inputs into execution and operational decision making.


About the team
The Network Strategy & Performance (NP) team defines and delivers the right human-assisted support to Amazon customers under demand and labor supply volatility, by optimizing the Amazon Customer Service (CS) network for customer experience, associate experience, and cost. We are responsible for:
- Planning customer support staffing;
- Preserving the customer experience when customers contact Customer Service; and
- Ensuring best costs for providing customer support.

We analyse historical data and anticipate potential business events to accurately predict the number of Customer Service Associates (CSAs) required for a given period. Our areas of expertise span forecasting, planning, optimization, data analytics, and reporting. We deliver our vision using operations research, data science, and program management — and we continue to challenge the status quo, invent and simplify, and deliver excellence for our customers.

The Network Strategy & Performance team is on a transformation journey. We are building a future-ready team that combines analytical rigor with AI fluency, executive-level communication, and the ability to drive outcomes across organizational boundaries. We are seeking a Senior Capacity Intelligence Analyst to join this team and help shape how Amazon plans, staff, and optimizes its Customer Service network.

title: Data Center Technician, ADC InfraOps DCO
description:
The Infrastructure Operations team is looking for cleared Data Center Technicians to join our expanding Infrastructure Operations team. Data Center Technicians are the primary resolver and troubleshoot and solve a range of datacenter infrastructure issues including, but not limited to: hardware, fiber, networking, and related problems.

If you like to use IT principles like computer architecture and the OSI model (Open Systems Interconnection Model) and apply them to finding solutions to problems, we’d like to meet you. Your work will help to maintain one of the world's largest information system infrastructures.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen and must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph.

Key job responsibilities
You will be required to engage in physical data center activities with or without reasonable accommodation. This includes all tasks associated with planning and tracking capacity, rack deployment, rack cabling, hardware and software troubleshooting, and rack decommissioning.

These activities include the following:
- Lifting and moving material up to 49 pounds each
- Working in cramped and/or elevated locations
- Bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching
- Standing and walking for up to 8+ hours a day
- Ascending and descending ladders, stairs, and gangways safely and without limitation
- Work in a noisy environment
- Work shifts longer than 8 hours to support 24/7 operations (covering both night and day shifts).

A day in the life
Our Data Center Technician professionals, who have industry-leading technical abilities and demonstrate a breadth of knowledge:
- Take ownership of technical issues brought by their customer base, engaging other teams when needed to drive resolution
- Show a strong aptitude for troubleshooting and problem solving
- Solve problems at their root and step back to understand the broader context
- Maintain service level agreements through the implementation of proactive issue detection and reporting
- Are biased to act in the absence of direction or support
- Improve effectiveness through process innovation
This position will fill an opening at one of multiple separate sites. This position may include shift work that will include days/nights/weekends/holidays.

About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

title: Associate Data Engineer
description:
Associate Data Engineer

Department: Data and Analytics

Reports to: Data & Analytics Lead

Position Summary

Pogue Construction is seeking an Associate Data Engineer to help build and maintain the data pipelines, API integrations, and dashboards our teams use to make business decisions. As the third member of our data team, this role will work closely with the Data & Analytics Lead and our existing technical team member to keep data accurate, available, and useful across the company.

The Associate Data Engineer will support the data lifecycle from source onboarding and ingestion through transformation, reporting, monitoring, and retirement. The primary focus is hands-on data engineering and API management, with ongoing Power BI dashboard support. This is an opportunity to develop engineering skills while learning how project, financial, and operational information moves through a construction business.

The role will take day-to-day responsibility for assigned integrations and support tasks under established standards and technical guidance. The Data & Analytics Lead will set priorities and retain responsibility for architecture, governance, and production approval, working with IT, Information Security, and department data owners.

Experience

  • 0-2 years of relevant experience in data engineering, analytics, software development, or technical application support. Internships, co-ops, and substantial academic or personal projects will be considered.
  • Practical experience using SQL and a scripting language to retrieve, transform, validate, or troubleshoot data.

Education

  • Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical training and experience.

Primary Responsibilities

Data Engineering and Ingestion

  • Build and maintain assigned data pipelines using approved patterns to bring information from APIs, databases, and files into Pogue's data platform.
  • Support new source onboarding by profiling data, documenting field mappings and refresh requirements, and validating initial loads with the team and source owners.
  • Develop and maintain SQL transformations, notebooks, and dataflows that prepare source data for Silver and Gold tables and downstream reporting.
  • Support incremental loads, scheduling, dependencies, retries, and controlled reruns or backfills. Investigate missing records, duplicate data, schema changes, and pipeline failures.

API Management and Integration Support

  • Develop, test, and maintain API connections for business systems such as CMiC, Procore, and scheduling platforms as assigned.
  • Handle authentication, pagination, rate limits, payload mapping, and error responses using established integration and security practices.
  • Maintain an API inventory documenting endpoints, system owners, permissions, dependencies, refresh schedules, and support contacts. Track credential expiration and coordinate approved rotation with IT and system owners.
  • Monitor integration health and vendor API changes. Test version changes, troubleshoot failed requests, and support approved internal APIs that provide curated data to other applications.

Dashboard and Reporting Support

  • Maintain and enhance Power BI reports using approved semantic models, KPI definitions, report standards, and Pogue branding.
  • Investigate refresh failures, incorrect results, filter behavior, and access issues. Trace problems through the report, model, pipeline, and source system, and escalate issues outside the assigned scope.
  • Gather and document user requests, deliver small report improvements, support user acceptance testing, and create practical guidance that helps employees use reports correctly.

Data Quality and Lifecycle Support

  • Implement and maintain checks for completeness, freshness, duplicate keys, and reconciliation to source totals. Work with department data owners to investigate discrepancies.
  • Keep mappings, lineage, dependencies, runbooks, and change records current so another team member can support assigned assets.
  • Use version control, peer review, testing, and established release procedures. Document deployment and recovery steps, communicate service interruptions, and help resolve recurring problems.
  • Follow approved access, classification, and retention practices. Support archiving and retirement of unused datasets, integrations, and reports after checking dependencies and obtaining the required approval.

Required Skills

  • Working knowledge of SQL, including joins, aggregations, and troubleshooting query results.
  • Foundational Python or comparable scripting skills for data processing and automation.
  • Understanding of relational databases, data transformation, and the purpose of ETL or ELT pipelines.
  • Familiarity with REST APIs, HTTP requests, JSON, and authentication concepts.
  • Ability to troubleshoot methodically, validate results, and document work clearly.
  • Clear communication with technical colleagues and business users, sound handling of confidential information, and willingness to learn through feedback and review.

Preferred Skills

  • Exposure to Microsoft Fabric, including pipelines, notebooks, lakehouses, warehouses, or dataflows.
  • Experience with Power BI, Power Query, DAX, semantic models, and refresh troubleshooting.
  • Familiarity with Git, Azure DevOps, automated testing, monitoring, or deployment workflows.
  • Exposure to OAuth, service principals, secure credential storage, or API testing tools such as Postman.
  • Familiarity with CMiC, Procore, Primavera P6, Microsoft Project, or construction accounting and project operations.

title: Forward Deployment Engineering Manager, FDE
description:
Role Summary

A Forward Deployed Engineering Manager (FDE Manager) leads a pod of FDEs embedded within strategic enterprise customers, owning delivery execution, engineering quality, and team development for their scope. FDE Managers own pod-level outcomes — they ensure their team delivers production AI systems that meet customer expectations, develop their engineers' careers, and contribute to the broader FDE practice's engineering standards.

FDE Managers operate at pod/multi-pod scope. They lead 5–15 engineers, own technical delivery across one or more concurrent customer engagements, and define what "great" looks like for their team. They represent the FDE team to customer engineering leaders and AWS stakeholders, balancing delivery execution with people development.

Key job responsibilities
Lead FDE pod delivery. Own delivery across one or more customer engagements. Staff and structure the team for optimal customer coverage. Define execution cadences and ensure consistent engineering quality across active programs. Requires 30–50% travel.

Guide technical direction. Provide technical oversight for customer AI programs within your scope. Review architecture decisions and ensure alignment with customer needs and AWS best practices. Resolve technical blockers and escalate strategically when needed.

Own production excellence for your team. Ensure operational standards, evaluation frameworks, and production readiness criteria are met for AI systems your team builds. Drive improvements that raise the operational bar within your scope.

Build and develop the team. Hire, develop, and retain FDE talent. Coach junior FDEs toward independence and career growth. Drive performance management and create development plans. Contribute to hiring bar and calibration standards.

Accelerate customer adoption. Identify opportunities to expand AI adoption within your customer engagements. Ensure learnings are codified into reusable patterns and fed back into the broader FDE practice.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. title: General Opportunity
description:
About Zero Homes

Our mission is to rebuild American communities through healthy, affordable homes.

At Zero Homes, we operate on a simple premise: when you make contractors successful, homeowners win. The current home services industry is fragmented, complex, and opaque, which is frustrating for homeowners and exhausting for contractors. We are changing this by building a home upgrade marketplace that enables a simple, central, transparent process for homeowners and contractors to complete projects.

Through our platform we handle design, quoting, procurement, and customer service, allowing our contractor network to focus on what they do best and make them money: delivering projects. For homeowners, this delivers a predictable, high-quality, and transparent experience—transforming home upgrades from a source of anxiety into a seamless experience.Our vision is to create a world where homeowners and contractors in all 50 states can leverage our platform to execute thousands of projects every week within the next 36 months.

We work by a clear set of values:

  • Be a "can kid," not a "can’t kid": We own our outcomes and go to extraordinary lengths to solve problems.

  • Go fast, be clear: Speed is our advantage, and we sweat the details to deliver an extraordinary customer experience.

  • Customer & Contractor Obsessed: We have a deep, personal understanding of the work to be done. We stay curious about our contractors' craft and the stories of our homeowners.

  • Win, as a team: We are building an iconic business that will reinvent the industry, and will do so together.

If you are ready to build a world-class consumer experience that genuinely rebuilds American communities, come build with us.

Interested in Zero Homes but don’t see a role that fits? Send us your resume. We hire across the whole company, from tech and product to field operations and sales, and new roles open regularly. If one lines up with your background and interests, we’ll reach out.

What You Bring

Solid experience in your field, plus the habits that tend to make people successful here:

  • You own the outcome. When something breaks, you work out how to fix it instead of waiting for direction.

  • You move fast and still catch the details.

  • You’re curious about the work itself, like how a contractor runs a job or what a homeowner is anxious about.

  • You do your best work on a team.

Benefits & Perks

  • Equity: every Zero Homes employee gets a stake in the company

  • Medical, dental, and vision: we cover 100% of your premium on our base medical plan and on vision, plus most of your dental premium. Coverage starts the first of the month after you join

  • 401(k) with Roth and traditional options

  • 4 weeks PTO, paid company holidays, and unlimited sick leave

  • Paid parental leave: up to 12 weeks for primary caregivers, 6 for secondary (after 9 months with us)

  • $500 workstation stipend

Equal Opportunity Employer

Zero Homes is an equal opportunity employer committed to building an inclusive, accessible, and diverse workplace. We provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees and do not discriminate or tolerate harassment based on race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

We encourage people of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives to apply. If you require a reasonable accommodation or assistance during the application or interview process, please let us know.

Job Description:

Johnson & Johnson MedTech, Electrophysiology, is seeking an Ultrasound Clinical Account Specialist, Cardiac Imaging & Structural Heart.

At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at

Fueled by innovation at the intersection of biology and technology, we are developing the next generation of smarter, less invasive, more personalized treatments.

Are you enthusiastic about improving and expanding the possibilities of Cardiovascular? Ready to join a team that is reimagining how we heal? Our Cardiovascular team develops leading solutions for heart recovery, electrophysiology, stroke, and structural heart. You will join a proud heritage of continually elevating standards of care for stroke, heart failure, and atrial fibrillation (AFib) patients.

Your unique talents will help patients on their journey to wellness. Learn more at .

Purpose:

The Ultrasound Clinical Account Specialist (UCAS) Structural Heart is accountable to partner with the different Regional Sales Managers (RSM) and Sales Territory to achieve sales goals in the assigned territory by providing technical and clinical support of interventional cardiologists (IC) using AcuNav™ and NUVISION™ as we drive adoption of 2D and 4D intracardiac echocardiography in structural heart procedures and market share growth. The UCAS is also responsible for developing the structural heart imaging market within their territory by identifying new procedural opportunities, expanding ICE adoption into new IC programs, and driving transition from TEE-dependent workflows toward ICE-guided procedures. The UCAS is responsible for building and maintaining mutually beneficial relationships with physicians, hospital and Cath lab staff, and key opinion leaders to grow and develop business. The UCAS partners directly with the local Marketer Manager and Local EP Business Lead to ensure alignment and coordination of activities to meet business objectives.

This role is pivotal in developing and executing strategic sales plans, fostering strong customer relationships, and ensuring operational excellence. The primary focus of this role is to lead the commercial "pivot" from TEE-dependent procedures to ICE (Intracardiac Echocardiography) as the imaging modality of choice. By integrating Johnson & Johnson’s Credo and Leadership Imperatives, the Ultrasound Clinical Account Specialist will inspire the local team to deliver exceptional results, uphold the highest standards of compliance, and make a meaningful impact on patient outcomes and workflow efficiencies in the field of structural heart. This role sits adjacent to Electrophysiology and is pivotal to expanding J&J’s leadership in Interventional Cardiology and Structural Heart.


Functional Responsibilities:

  • Provide expert clinical product and technical assistance and training and case support to IC physicians and staff on the effective use of AcuNav™ and NUVISION™ catheters in structural heart procedures.
  • Educate all customers who interface with structural heart patients on the value and optimized of AcuNav™ and NUVISION™ catheters by providing technical and clinical information and in-service trainings – thus amplifying the value proposition of intracardiac echocardiography (ICE) in structural heart workflow.
  • Use consultative selling techniques to identify potential sales opportunities within the account.
  • Create awareness of Ultrasound solutions and facilitate contact with the key decision makers to drive incremental business.
  • Maximize customer case support capability through proper planning and scheduling techniques.
  • Partners with Business Managers, doctors, and Cath lab administrators to set up equipment evaluations and facilitate solutions to issues in a timely manner.
  • Drive collaboration and maintain consistent, open lines of communication across the assigned responsibilities with internal partners including regional teams/Pods (i.e., EP CAS and other ULS CAS), as well as support personnel (i.e., Marketing, EMEA).
  • Stay current on company products instructions for use (IFU), best practices, and technical troubleshooting, as well as relevant scientific clinical literature and new product information.
  • Prioritize and appropriately respond to requests in a high stress environment and maintain composure and problem-solving focus during stressful interactions.
  • Engage in diagnostic dialogue with multiple internal and external business partners and stakeholders, and formulate solutions based on dialogue and input gained during session.
  • Provide mentoring for new EP commercial team members as requested.
  • Perform other duties assigned as needed.
  • Serves as a source of information and support to pod members and internal partners in identifying trends, understanding competitive conditions, and sharing knowledge of best practices within the marketplace.
  • Leverages J&J business partners (cross functionally and across business units) within customer accounts and overlapping geographies to maximize the use of resources and increase business outcomes.
  • Responsible for communicating business related issues or opportunities to next management.
  • Adheres to all Company guidelines related to Health, Safety and Environmental practices. Ensure that all resources needed to meet Company guidelines are available and in good condition.
  • Proactively ensures personal, pod and Company compliance with all Federal, State, local and Company regulations, policies, and procedures.
  • Organizes and completes administrative responsibilities efficiently, including timely completion of compliance training, submission of expense reports, samples reporting and other requests and assignments. Meets Company quality standards and established deadlines.
  • Maintain company vehicle safety protocols (Safe Fleet) in accordance with all company guidelines.
  • Stays current in emerging technology and techniques and all aspects of company new product launches and competitive entries.
  • Responsible for communicating business-related issues or opportunities to next management level.
  • Stay current on industry best practices and emerging technologies in interventional cardiology and structural heart.
  • Actively collaborate with EP commercial team(s) on adoption plans from targeting (constructive collaboration identification) to implementation, to ensuring we cross support one another as needed.

Qualifications:

  • Minimum of a BA/BS, combined with a minimum of 5 years professional work experience.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in clinical echocardiography lab and/or experience working in support of medical devices in structural heart procedures. Notably, TAVI, LAAO, M/T TEER, TTVR, PFO, ASD) is preferred.
  • Must have and maintain advanced clinical ultrasound and echocardiography knowledge of technology, advancements, and the business landscape.
  • Maintain clinical knowledge of healthcare industry, disease states, and therapeutic and institutional trends.
  • Breadth and depth relationships within interventional cardiologists.
  • Strong analytical, project management, and communication skills.
  • Experience working in a matrixed organization and collaborating across functions. Knowledge of healthcare regulations and compliance requirements.
  • Self-starter able to solve problems in high-pressure environments.

Physical working conditions / requirements:

  • Exempt position requiring the ability to establish effective work schedule that accommodates frequent disruptions to routines and flexible work hours in accomplishing objectives.
  • Must have and maintain advanced knowledge of healthcare industry, medical device industry, disease states, and therapeutic and institutional trends.
  • Must successfully complete Company training programs.
  • Must have valid driver’s license in the state of residence, advanced computer skills, and the ability to multitask without direct oversight of manager.
  • Position requires sitting for extended periods of time, working in a hospital laboratory setting, attending live patient cases, and wearing protective gear (i.e., lead aprons), and willing to work variable hours to meet patient needs.
  • Field-based work requires driving, walking, and use of phone and computer.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines in a demanding environment.
  • Willingness to travel across EMEA as required (up to 60%).

title: Physical Design Engineer - Static Timing Analysis, Annapurna Labs, Cloud Scale Machine Learning
description:
AWS Utility Computing (UC) provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (IoT), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS, including support for customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services.

As a member of the Cloud-Scale Machine Learning Acceleration team you’ll be responsible for the design and optimization of Hardware in our data centers including technologies such as AWS Inferentia which is a machine learning inference product designed to deliver high performance at low cost.

You’ll provide leadership in the application of new technologies to large scale deployments in a continuous effort to deliver a world-class customer experience. This is a fast-paced, intellectually challenging position, and you’ll work with thought-leaders in multiple technology areas. You’ll have relentlessly high standards for yourself and everyone you work with, and you’ll be constantly looking for ways to improve our products' performance, quality and cost. We’re changing an industry, and we want individuals who are ready for this challenge and want to reach beyond what is possible today.

Key job responsibilities
• Develop & maintain flows for block and full-chip level static timing analysis
• Write, debug & validate timing constraints for blocks and full-chip.
• Run Static Timing Analysis and give frequent feedback to team members and leads.
• Provide guidance on how to fix timing issues (generate ECOs, fix constraint issues).
• Develop scripts to automate running timing analysis and generate reports.
• Be a highly-valued member of our start-up like team through excellent collaboration and teamwork with other physical design engineers as well as with the RTL/Arch. teams

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
WHO WE ARE

GridUnity is the industry leader in interconnection life cycle management, delivering cutting-edge software solutions that eliminate bottlenecks in the interconnection process and accelerate the transition to a more affordable, sustainable, and resilient energy future.

Our Mission

We unite all grid interconnection stakeholders on a single platform that converts centralized data into actionable intelligence and accelerates the transition to a reliable, sustainable, and cost-efficient electric grid.

GridUnity is a trusted partner to leading utilities, grid operators, and policymakers. Our technology solutions tackle the interconnection queue backlog by significantly reducing processing times. Whether cutting transmission interconnection timelines from years to months or enabling distribution applications to be processed within a day, we help accelerate energy projects at every scale.

Our Vision
Energizing the planet with a faster, smarter, and more sustainable grid.

What You’ll Do

As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you will play a critical role in designing, building, and scaling GridUnity’s cloud-based SaaS platform. This is not just a coding role—you will act as a technical leader, mentor, and change agent, helping drive engineering excellence across the team. Reporting to the Engineering Manager, you will own complex features end-to-end and ensure the highest levels of scalability, reliability, and security.

You will:

  • Lead the design, development, and delivery of high-scale, data-driven applications across the full stack

  • Mentor and guide engineers through code reviews, design discussions, and pairing sessions, raising the technical bar across the team

  • Champion engineering best practices, driving improvements in scalability, reliability, observability, and security

  • Collaborate closely with product managers and cross-functional teammates to translate business needs into elegant, well-architected solutions

  • Influence system architecture decisions and take the lead on high-impact technical initiatives

  • Serve as a steward of good data practices, ensuring privacy, security, and accuracy of critical datasets

  • Act as a change agent within the engineering organization—introducing new tools, workflows, and approaches that improve how we deliver software

  • Contribute thought leadership and technical expertise to support our long-term product and technology strategy

What You’ll Bring

Required Knowledge/Skills/Abilities

  • 7+ years of professional software development experience, including 3+ years in senior-level roles

  • Proven leadership skills: mentoring junior engineers, leading technical initiatives, and driving team-wide improvements

  • Strong experience building and scaling full-stack applications

  • Professional experience with several of the following technologies:

    • Backend: Node.js, TypeScript, Java, Python, or C#

    • Frontend: React or a similar modern JavaScript framework

    • Databases: PostgreSQL or another relational database

  • Demonstrated experience architecting, building, and maintaining production systems

  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence technical direction and align teams

Preferred Knowledge/Skills/Abilities

  • Experience with serverless architectures (e.g., AWS Lambda, API Gateway)

  • Production experience with GraphQL (queries, mutations, schema design)

  • Familiarity with event-driven and microservice architectures

  • Exposure to multi-tenant systems and role-based access control

  • Track record of contributing to architecture and system design in growth-stage SaaS companies

  • Daily user of AI-enhanced engineering tools (Cursor, Windsurf, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, etc.)

  • Interest or experience in integrating LLMs into production systems (prompt engineering, embeddings, structured outputs, or agent-style workflows)

OUR CULTURE

We are a lean, fast-moving team that values bold thinking, reliability, and continuous learning. We operate with radical transparency, embrace scrappiness, and build solutions that anticipate customer needs. We also believe work should be fun and fulfilling — what we call “funfillment.”

The right candidate is energized by working in a scaling, mission-driven company where they can shape processes, wear multiple hats, and grow alongside the business.

BENEFITS/PERKS

  • Competitive compensation packages that recognize your expertise and contributions

  • Remote-first culture that provides flexibility and balance

  • Professional development opportunities, including training, mentorship, and career pathing

  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance starting day one

  • Short- and long-term disability and basic life insurance at no cost to you

  • 401(k) plan with a 4% match to help secure your future

  • Flexible PTO and a supportive work culture that values balance

  • Mission-driven work with the opportunity to make a significant impact in the energy sector

ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENT

This position may involve access to data and systems subject to U.S. critical infrastructure protection regulations. Accordingly, this role is restricted to individuals who qualify as “U.S. persons,” defined by federal law as U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents (green card holders), asylees, or refugees.

OUR COMMITMENT TO APPLICANTS

GridUnity is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, arrest and conviction record, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.

We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where every team member feels valued, supported, and able to bring their authentic self to work.

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please email careers@gridunity.com.

For your security, all official communication from GridUnity will only come from email addresses ending in @.

title: Ground Worker

title: Supply Chain Product Manager, Power and Cooling
description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of supply chain professionals, operations managers, inventory managers, manufacturing experts and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) provides a highly reliable, scalable, and low-cost cloud platform that powers thousands of businesses in over 190 countries. AWS Infrastructure Service (AIS) organization works to deliver optimal solutions to source, build and maintain our socially responsible data center supply chains. We are a team of highly-motivated, engaged, and responsive professionals who enable the core sustainable infrastructure of AWS. Come join our team and be a part of history as we deliver results for the largest cloud services company on Earth!

Do you have a desire to make a major contribution to the future in the rapid growth environment of Cloud Computing? Amazon Web Services is looking for a Supply Chain Product Manager to help build a scalable, predictive, and prescriptive supply chain risk management for our AIS Power and Cooling organization. You will be part of the AIS Power and Cooling Program Management team working with Supply Chain, Procurement, Engineering, Finance, Construction and other partner teams to achieve our goals.

This role requires an individual with excellent knowledge of engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing in a fast paced ever changing environment. You will be responsible integrating across teams to maintain continuity of supply while minimizing supply chain risks. Data-driven decision-making is at the core of Amazon’s culture. You will own building solutions and administering supply chain risk management that enable senior leaders to make critical business decisions.


Key job responsibilities
• Manages cross-functional program team to implement product enhancements and design updates
• Develop and implement strategies to support and improve equipment deliveries on time
• Understand the technical requirements of our partners and work closely with the internal and external development teams to guide the direction of the supply chain activities

About the team
*Why AWS*
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

title: Solutions Architect - Japan
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

SOLUTIONS ARCHITECT - JAPAN

As a Solutions Architect, you’ll work with some of the world’s most sophisticated organizations to answer a new question: what should a company look like when AI agents become part of how work gets done?

We’re hiring Solutions Architects to help strategic customers make AI-native work real in production on the Grok platform, using Grok Bot for knowledge work and business workflows and Grok Build (Cursor) for AI-native software development.

This is a hands-on technical role within the Customer Success organization, where you’ll partner with AI Deployment Managers (ADMs) to own the technical track across architecture, workflow redesign, and enterprise security while helping organizations rethink how they operate and how they build software with AI.

You’ll help customers move from excitement to workflows teams rely on every day by discovering real job friction, integrating Grok Build into codebases, CI pipelines, and code review, and designing scoped Grok Bot workflows with human-in-the-loop judgment.

The best Solutions Architects pair technical credibility with product instincts and extreme ownership, and they are as comfortable debugging a CI workflow or leading an architecture review as helping executives, from CTOs to the CRO, CMO, CFO, and COO, understand where AI changes how the business runs and how software is built.

What You’ll Do

Help Engineering Teams Adopt AI-Native Development with Grok Build (Cursor)

  • Roll out Grok Build across strategic engineering organizations and integrate it into real codebases and production workflows rather than isolated demos.

  • Configure developer environments, repository rules, and conventions, and run hands-on enablement that drives fast, durable adoption.

  • Bring agentic SDLC practices into the customer’s delivery process, from planning and implementation through testing, CI, and code review, and clear developer workflow friction along the way.

  • Keep a strong hands-on Build baseline by shipping runnable, convention-driven work in Grok Build yourself.

Engage Customers on the Grok Bot Journey

  • Use Grok Bot to turn a business user’s problem into an accepted user story and requirements that flow into Jira and through the agentic SDLC in Grok Build.

  • Lead discovery for knowledge-work and business-process use cases and redesign high-value workflows around AI agents, enterprise tools, data, and human judgment.

  • Help customers operationalize agents with ownership, integrations, and guardrails.

Expand Across the Organization

  • Establish a data governance and security framework that lets leadership adopt the Grok platform top down across the enterprise.

  • Help engineering organizations move from isolated usage to company-wide adoption by turning successful deployments into reusable patterns and rollouts for new teams and platform groups.

  • Partner with ADMs and Account Executives to find and drive major expansion opportunities for the Grok platform.

Become a Trusted Technical Partner

  • Build multi-threaded relationships with developers, platform teams, engineering and business leaders, and executive sponsors, and turn skeptics into champions.

  • Lead architecture reviews and working sessions, and advise on what to build, developer productivity, workflow design, governance, and adoption strategy.

  • Prototype alongside customers by connecting systems, designing agents and workflows, and debugging failures until ambiguous ideas become working systems.

  • Reason about trust boundaries with CISOs and platform owners, covering identity, permissions, data access, connectors and MCPs, execution environments, network controls, auditability, and human approval, and know when to escalate to specialists.

  • Partner with ADMs from meeting prep through active participation, and coordinate with Sales, Product, and Engineering to unblock customers.

Drive Real Customer Outcomes

  • Translate adoption into measurable impact, from faster iteration, developer productivity, and engineering quality to workflow efficiency, and help customers communicate that value internally.

  • Help teams standardize on the Grok platform and embed it deeply in core workflows, and lead recovery plans when adoption slows or competing tools gain traction.

Shape the Future of the Product

  • Bring structured feedback, emerging patterns, and enterprise requirements across Grok Bot and Grok Build from strategic customers into Product and Engineering.

  • Shape new capabilities alongside lighthouse customers whose deployments set the standard for the market.

You Might Be a Fit If

  • You have deep technical foundations across APIs, software architecture, cloud infrastructure, data, identity, security, and enterprise integrations, often from a software engineering, FDE, SA, platform, developer tooling, or business-process automation background.

  • You have a strong understanding of developer workflows, SDLC tooling, continuous integration and delivery systems, code review, and enterprise engineering environments, ideally with hands-on experience in Cursor or similar AI coding tools.

  • You bring customer-facing technical experience as an SA, SE, FDE, TAM, enterprise architect, or integration consultant, working hands-on with engineering teams while operating strategically with technical leadership.

  • You bring high drive, ownership, curiosity, adaptability, and systems thinking, along with strong prep habits and comfort in fast-moving ambiguity.

  • You have experience designing workflows that span tools, data, APIs, and human processes, not only IDE-centric developer workflows.

  • You bring a working grasp of security and compliance, or a clear path to one, and can walk customers through scenario-based guardrails.

  • You have excellent communication skills across technical, executive, and business audiences and strong instincts for discovery, workflow design, and adoption strategy.

  • You bring a passion for developer tooling and for how AI will reshape software engineering and knowledge work.

  • You bring a willingness to travel to customers as needed.

  • Fluency in Japanese, business level English.

title: Sr. Program Manager, Fleet Health Coach, Global Fleet & Products
description:
Amazon is seeking a Senior Program Manager, Fleet Health Coach who will help build new business improvement paths through monitoring and accountability mechanisms.

At Amazon, we are building a last mile operation that is complimented by Delivery Service Partners (DSP). The Last Mile team is hiring a Senior Program Manager, Fleet Health Coach to develop and lead the enforcement, coaching, and proactive support for DSPs to ensure compliance against Fleet Standards and Requirements. The Senior Program Manager, Fleet Health Coach will be working with DSPs with low compliance scores to understand root causes, provide dedicated support, and to coach them to better performance and fleet readiness. This role will be responsible for executing a new or existing coaching and enforcement program, that includes developing impactful coaching plans, ensuring our DSPs understand program requirements, and taking appropriate action where needed for our safety and compliance standards. Further, this role partners regularly with internal stakeholders to improve programs, products, reporting, and experiences that lead to better safety and business outcomes.

Key job responsibilities
- Own Monitoring and Enforcement Plans (MEPs) within North America to ensure compliance and coach DSPs to improve performance around key metrics
- Develop reporting and communication processes for DSPs to drive performance for key Fleet Standards metrics
- Communicate across teams and to leadership to ensure alignment of goals, tasks, and to ensure the overall success of the program
- Monitor key quality metrics, define and implement initiatives to drive program and process improvements
- Evaluate program policies and enforcement matrix
- Create programs and processes to drive compliance
- Work within time constraints and deliver results to meet critical business needs
- Work across internal teams including Transportation Risk and Compliance, Fleet Managers, Business Coaches, and other Last Mile teams
- Create reporting and metrics to help identify root causes of low performance
- Develop action plans to address root causes and assist with implementing the changes

**Travel expectations will be approximately 10-25%.

title: Personal Care Director
description:
Personal Care Director - Senior Living

CorsoCare Personal Care at StroyPoint Wyoming

The CorsoCare Personal Care Director is responsible for the overall direction and coordination of administrative, clinical, and resident care services within a senior living community environment.

Required Experience

  • Prior supervisory experience required.
  • Compassionate towards the senior population
  • Ability to speak effectively before groups of customers or employees of organization.
  • Ability to deal with problems involving several concrete variables in standardized situations.

Primary Responsibilities

  • The CorsoCare Personal Care Director actively supports our culture – our pillars and 1440.
  • Directly manages all Wellness Staff (all shifts) to provide compassionate and competent care for residents.
  • Implement and coordinate all services for residents admitted to community.
  • Perform evaluations and ongoing assessments of residents quarterly
  • Use resident evaluation to set measurable goals and outcomes for residents that meet the physical, mental, and psychosocial needs.
  • Make necessary changes to service plan.
  • Overall responsibility for direction, coordination, and evaluation of the Personal Care Department.
  • Carrying out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with organizational policies and procedures and regulatory requirements and applicable laws.
  • Provide assistance to staff members regarding any interpretation of criteria standards.
  • Evaluate Occurrence Reports/Care Associate log submitted by staff members to determine if an assessment needs to be performed on an existing resident and report to State of Indiana if applicable.

  • Develop Care Associate assignment/update ongoing task sheets.
  • Develop, organize, implement and evaluate training for new and existing staff.
  • Interview and hire staff within budgeted guidelines.

  • Ordering of supplies

  • Attend daily stand-up meetings with department leaders to discuss community needs and support.

The employee is occasionally required to reach with hands and arms. This position requires the ability to review detailed documents and read computer screens. The employee will occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. The work environment requires appropriate interaction with others. The noise level in the work environment is moderate. Occasional travel to different locations may be required.

Equal Opportunity Employer

title: Data Scientist II - Amazon Identity Program , Amazon Identity Program (AIP)
description:
Amazon Advertising is seeking a Data Scientist II to help measure and improve one of the world's largest advertising identity platforms. You will work with massive datasets to uncover insights that directly influence how Amazon recognizes customers, connects identity signals, and enables advertisers to reach and measure audiences across the global advertising ecosystem.

The Amazon Advertising Identity Platform (AIP) powers identity resolution across Amazon's owned and operated properties, third party publishers, and the open internet. As traditional identity signals become less available and consumer behavior spans more devices and environments, understanding the accuracy, coverage, and business impact of identity resolution has become increasingly important.

As a Data Scientist II, you will develop analytical frameworks, measurement methodologies, and data driven insights to evaluate the performance of Amazon's identity graph. You will work with billions of identity signals to quantify recognition rates, graph coverage, identity accuracy, and the incremental value of deterministic and probabilistic identity resolution. Your analysis will help identify opportunities to improve advertising addressability, audience reach, campaign measurement, and revenue.

You will design experiments, develop statistical models, and establish measurement frameworks to understand how identity improvements translate into better advertising outcomes. This includes evaluating the precision and recall of identity models, measuring the incremental contribution of individual identity sources, identifying gaps in identity coverage, and quantifying the commercial impact of identity investments.

You will partner closely with applied scientists, software engineers, product managers, and business leaders to translate complex data into actionable recommendations. Your work will help shape technical priorities, guide investment decisions, and establish the metrics used to evaluate identity performance across Amazon Advertising.

The ideal candidate has strong expertise in SQL, Python, statistical analysis, experimentation, and large scale data analytics. You should be comfortable working with complex datasets, developing rigorous measurement methodologies, and communicating findings to both technical and business audiences.

This role offers the opportunity to establish how Amazon measures identity quality and business impact, influence the direction of a critical advertising platform, and apply data science to problems operating at global scale.

title: Cloud Operations Engineer - Citrix
description:
Job Description – Cloud Operations Engineer (Citirx)

Experience: 5+ Years
Function: Cloud Operations / Infrastructure

Role Overview

We are looking for a Cloud Operations Engineer III with strong hands-on experience in Microsoft Azure, Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD), Citrix, VMware, Palo Alto, Cloudflare, Networking, and Colocation/Data Center infrastructure. The role will provide L3 operational support, infrastructure administration, troubleshooting, monitoring, security remediation, and participation in cloud and infrastructure transformation initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Azure & AVD: Administer and support Azure infrastructure, Azure VMs, VNets, NSGs, Load Balancer, Application Gateway, Azure Monitor, Azure Backup, Entra ID, RBAC, and Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD). Manage AVD host pools, session hosts, application groups, workspaces, FSLogix, scaling, user access, and performance troubleshooting.
  • Citrix Administration: Provide end-to-end administration of Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops (CVAD), including Delivery Controllers, StoreFront, Citrix Studio, Director, VDAs, Citrix Gateway, Machine Catalogs, Delivery Groups, policies, applications, and user sessions. Troubleshoot VDA registration, session launch, authentication, application delivery, profile, performance, and connectivity issues.
  • Citrix – VMware & Colo: Support Citrix workloads hosted on VMware vSphere/ESXi and physical/virtual infrastructure in Colocation environments. Perform VM provisioning, resource management, patching, migration, capacity planning, and troubleshooting across the physical server → VMware → Windows → Citrix stack.
  • Networking: Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLAN, routing, switching, NAT, VPN, load balancing, firewalls, and hybrid connectivity. Troubleshoot connectivity between Azure, Citrix, VMware, on-premises, and Colo environments.
  • Palo Alto: Administer and troubleshoot Palo Alto firewalls, including security policies, NAT, VPN, routing, application connectivity, and firewall rules supporting cloud and Citrix environments.
  • Cloudflare: Support Cloudflare DNS, CDN, WAF, SSL/TLS, proxy, and traffic management. Troubleshoot DNS, certificate, routing, and web connectivity issues.
  • Colocation/Data Center: Support servers, VMware, network devices, storage, firewalls, and connectivity within Colocation/Data Center environments. Coordinate with Colo providers for hardware, remote hands, connectivity, power, maintenance, and infrastructure changes.
  • Operations & Monitoring: Perform proactive monitoring, health checks, incident/problem management, P1/P2 troubleshooting, RCA, capacity management, and 24x7/on-call support as required. Experience with SolarWinds, Azure Monitor, Citrix Director, or similar monitoring platforms.
  • Security & Lifecycle: Support vulnerability remediation, OS/Citrix/VMware patching, SSL certificate management, hardening, backup/DR, upgrades, and infrastructure lifecycle activities.
  • Automation & Documentation: Develop PowerShell/Python/Bash automation for operational tasks and maintain SOPs, runbooks, architecture documentation, and troubleshooting guides.
  • Collaborate with Cloud, Network, Security, Application, VMware, Service Desk, and global infrastructure teams and provide technical mentoring to junior engineers.

Required Skills

  • 5+ years of experience in Cloud Operations, Infrastructure, Systems Engineering, or a similar role.
  • Strong hands-on expertise in Microsoft Azure and Azure AVD.
  • Strong Citrix CVAD administration and troubleshooting experience.
  • Strong VMware vSphere, ESXi, and vCenter experience.
  • Strong Palo Alto firewall and enterprise networking experience.
  • Hands-on Cloudflare administration experience.
  • Experience supporting Colocation/Data Center infrastructure.
  • Strong Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP, VPN, routing, and load-balancing knowledge.
  • Experience with enterprise monitoring, ITIL processes, change management, incident management, and RCA.
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Relevant Azure, Citrix, VMware, Palo Alto, or networking certifications are an advantage.

title: Deal Desk Manager, APJ
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

DEAL DESK MANAGER, APJ

We're building out our Deal Desk function in APJ and looking for a high-ownership Deal Desk Manager to be one of our first people on the ground in the region. This is a hands-on individual-contributor role, sitting at the intersection of Sales, Legal, Finance, and Revenue Operations, partnering with our APJ sales team to structure, price, and close enterprise deals, and giving the region the fast, in-time-zone deal support it needs as it scales. You'll be one of the first Deal Desk hires in APJ, working closely with the global Deal Desk team while becoming the go-to deal partner for reps across the region. The function is established globally and humming with volume. Your job is to bring that same discipline to APJ and own deal support end-to-end for the region.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Own day-to-day deal desk support for the APJ sales team, pricing, deal structure, quoting, and approvals, in-region and in-time-zone

  • Serve as a strategic thought partner to reps on deal strategy: pricing guidance, competitive positioning, negotiation approach, and contract structure

  • Build and manage quotes and order forms in Salesforce CPQ / Ironclad, and keep deals moving cleanly through the approval and closing process

  • Coordinate cross-functionally with Legal, Finance, and Billing to get non-standard terms reviewed and closed without slowing deals down

  • Stand up and scale APJ deal desk processes, turning recurring rep questions and one-off asks into repeatable playbooks, approval paths, and enablement

  • Apply and help evolve our consumption-based pricing model, surfacing patterns from APJ deal flow back to the global team

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 7+ years of experience across deal desk, deal/revenue operations, commercial strategy, consulting, investing, or sales strategy

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Has owned outcomes, not just tasks

  • Experience working on enterprise B2B deals, ideally in SaaS or infrastructure, with hands-on exposure to pricing, negotiation, and contract structure

  • Experience operating in a high-volume deal environment and a track record of systematizing how you work, playbooks, processes, approval frameworks

  • Highly analytical, comfortable sizing deals, modeling pricing scenarios and ROI in Excel, and grounding recommendations in data

  • A point of view and the ownership to drive it, you don't wait to be told what to think, and you operate with urgency and little hand-holding

  • Collaborate well across Sales, Finance, and Legal, and hold the line on pricing and process without becoming a bottleneck

  • Excited to help build a function in-region rather than inherit a finished one

  • Based in Singapore and able to support the APJ region

  • Bonus: experience with consumption-based or usage-based pricing, or standing up a deal desk function in a fast-scaling environment

  • Onsite role: must be able to work in person at the Singapore office

About Acrisure


A global fintech leader, Acrisure empowers millions of ambitious businesses and individuals with the right solutions to grow boldly forward. Bringing cutting-edge technology and top-tier human support together, we connect clients with customized solutions across a range of insurance, reinsurance, payroll, benefits, cybersecurity, mortgage services – and more.

Acrisure was built on entrepreneurial spirit. Prioritizing leadership, accountability, and collaboration, we equip our teams to work at the highest levels possible.


Job Summary:


Acrisure is seeking a Vice President, HR Technology & Automation to lead the strategy and evolution of our global HR technology ecosystem. Reporting to the SVP, Human Resources, this executive will set the vision for the systems, data, automation, and AI capabilities that enable HR to operate at scale and deliver an exceptional employee experience.

This role combines strategic vision with strong operational leadership. The Vice President will build and lead a high-performing global team, modernize HR technology and ways of working, expand automation and AI, strengthen data-driven decision-making, and translate technology investments into measurable business outcomes.

As a member of the HR leadership team, this leader will partner closely with Information Technology, Finance, Cyber Security, and other enterprise leaders to align priorities, investments, architecture, and governance. The role oversees the HR technology budget and a global delivery model spanning employees, contractors, consultants, and managed service partners. Travel up to 25%, including international.


Responsibilities:


  • Strategic leadership: Set the multi-year HR technology vision and roadmap with the SVP, Human Resources and HR leadership, aligned to enterprise priorities and balancing foundational run-and-improve work with transformative investment in new technology and AI, and review it with them regularly. Translate strategy into clear investment cases and measurable outcomes, and keep senior leaders informed of progress, trade-offs, and risks.
  • Leadership and talent: Build, lead, and retain a high-performing global organization; develop leaders of leaders and a culture of accountability, ownership, and service. Shape the organization and sourcing model, across employees, contingent talent, and partners, to scale with demand, with clear roles and decision rights.
  • Driving outcomes: Establish transparent intake, prioritization, and governance so the highest-value work is done first and capacity is used well. Define success measures for every major initiative and hold the organization accountable for delivering on time, on budget, and with measurable value.
  • Process excellence and standard work: Establish standard work, playbooks, and quality standards across delivery, release, and support, so results are consistent and repeatable. Lead the twice-yearly Workday release cycle and testing, with training that drives adoption of new capabilities. Foster a culture of continuous improvement, using data to remove friction, shorten cycle times, and raise service quality.
  • Automation and AI: Set and lead the automation and AI strategy across HR, advancing our technology stack and expanding self-service and delivering measurable reductions in manual work at scale. Establish responsible AI governance with Legal, Security, and Privacy, and scale proven use cases with discipline.
  • Collaboration and partnership: Serve as a trusted advisor to HR leadership, bringing leaders into key decisions early and building shared ownership of priorities. Work in concert with Information Technology, Finance and finance systems, Cyber Security, and procurement leaders, aligning roadmaps, architecture, and standards through joint planning so HR technology advances as part of one enterprise strategy. Partner closely with HR shared services and payroll so technology supports accurate, on-time pay and a consistent employee experience.
  • Platforms, partners, and financial stewardship: Own the health, architecture, and evolution of HR’s technology platforms and their integration with enterprise systems, keeping the foundation stable while modernizing the stack for AI and scale. Lead vendor and partner strategy, selection, and performance management. Own the HR technology budget as a strong financial steward: build investment cases, manage total cost of ownership, optimize licenses and contracts, and track the return on every major investment.
  • Risk, controls, and transparency: Ensure strong controls, data privacy, and security across countries and partners, including compliance with GDPR, UK GDPR, and other data protection requirements, vendor security assurance, and data residency. Partner with Internal Audit on audit readiness. Raise risks and issues early and openly, especially those affecting pay or the employee experience, with a clear plan to resolve them.
  • Employee and manager experience: Define the end-to-end digital experience across the employee lifecycle, using journey mapping, adoption, and satisfaction measures to guide investment.
  • People data and analytics: Establish a single, trusted source of people data, with clear data ownership, quality standards, and governance, enabling self-service reporting and people analytics for leaders.
  • Acquisition integration: Build a repeatable playbook to bring acquired companies onto HR platforms quickly and consistently, with defined timelines and success measures.
  • Service management and resilience: Set service levels for HR systems support, with incident, problem, and change control practices and business continuity plans for critical HR processes.

Requirements:


Required Qualifications

  • Deep, hands-on expertise with Workday HCM, including leading it at enterprise scale, with working knowledge of integrations, reporting, and security sufficient to guide architecture decisions.
  • A proven record of leading large-scale technology transformation and delivering measurable business outcomes.
  • Experience building operating models that bring discipline to intake, prioritization, governance, and benefits measurement.
  • Experience establishing standard work and continuous improvement in a technology or shared services organization.
  • A track record of scaling automation and AI in a large organization.
  • Strong financial stewardship, including owning a technology budget, building investment cases, and managing vendors, contracts, and total cost of ownership.
  • Executive presence and the ability to influence senior leaders and build strong partnerships across organizational boundaries, including Technology, Finance, and Cyber Security.

Education and Experience:


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in information systems, business, HR, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 12 or more years in HR technology or enterprise applications, including 5 or more years leading global, multi-level organizations of people across regions and time zones.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Lean, Six Sigma, or similar process improvement experience.
  • Experience integrating acquired businesses in a high-growth or financial services environment.
  • Workday certification, or experience with Workday Extend or Prism Analytics.
  • Experience applying generative AI in HR service delivery, such as virtual agents and knowledge management.
  • ITIL, PMP, or SAFe certification.

title: Principal Software Engineer, AWS Distributed SQL
description:
AWS Databases is hiring Principal/Sr Principal Engineers to lead query processing for two of its key database engines. Amazon Redshift is a petabyte-scale cloud data warehouse used by tens of thousands of customers. Amazon Aurora DSQL is a serverless, distributed SQL database built for active-active availability and virtually unlimited scale. Both engines depend on the same discipline: turning SQL into well-optimized plans and running them fast at massive scale. Depending on your depth and interests, you'll join one of three teams: Redshift Query Optimization, the Redshift Execution Engine, or Aurora DSQL Query Processing.

Key job responsibilities
- Set and execute a multi-year technical strategy for query optimization and execution that improves price-performance against Databricks, Snowflake, Google BigQuery, and other cloud databases.
- Own core query processing architecture, including parsing and semantic analysis, query rewriting, cost-based planning, statistics and cardinality estimation, plan caching, and physical execution.
- Build high-performance execution engines (vectorized and pipelined operators, memory management, code generation, massively parallel and distributed execution) that serve analytical and transactional workloads.
- Advance optimization over open table formats and heterogeneous storage, such as Iceberg and Parquet data lakes and federated sources. Build adaptive execution that corrects plans at runtime.
- Turn ambiguous customer and business requirements into concrete projects, and personally own design, code, deployment, and operations from end to end.
- Partner across AWS Databases on product vision and integration with the broader database portfolio. Work directly with customers on adoption and roadmap.
- Raise the engineering bar through design reviews, coding standards, and operational excellence. Mentor senior engineers, and help hire and grow a strong team.
