title: Forward Deployed Engineer - India
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

FORWARD DEPLOYED ENGINEER - INDIA

You embed directly with customer teams as the engineer on the ground: own an outcome, ship a production-grade SpaceXSI system that still runs after you leave, and become the critical technical feedback loop from the field back to product engineering. The work is the project. One week you might take a messy business workflow and put a production agent on it: pick the use case, stand up the architecture, wire it into the customer's auth, data, and tools, then harden it with evals until the team actually uses it. Another week you might live in a customer's repo and delivery system and ship an agent-powered path for a migration, a PR review loop, or an incident-to-fix flow, behind tests, review, and rollout rather than in a chat sidebar.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Lead discovery with the customer: orient in their codebases and workflows, find the real bottleneck and the use case worth building, and define clear success metrics

  • Design and ship production agents, AI applications, and coding-agent workflows on Grok and our models, on live business processes and inside the customer’s engineering org

  • Get a first version live in days, then harden it over weeks with rollout, monitoring, and iteration from real usage

  • Own production quality: tracing, evals, debugging model or delivery failures, and latency and cost tradeoffs

  • Build the systems around the model (tools, MCP servers, retrieval, rules, skills, CI gates, and evals) and integrate them into the customer’s auth, data, workflow, and delivery systems; decide when prompting, architecture, data, process, or a model change is the right lever

  • Measure the outcome that matters (revenue, cost, hours saved, error rate, cycle time, escaped defects), not seat adoption

  • Work directly with Staff+, platform, and domain leaders, going deep in their systems while communicating clearly about tradeoffs and results

  • Leave the customer team able to run what you built, and turn what you learn into reusable patterns and improvements to SpaceXSI products

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • You have 5+ years of experience in software engineering, machine learning engineering, or data science

  • You’ve owned a customer or operator outcome, not just a slide or a prototype, and can turn a fuzzy problem into a scoped, shipped system

  • You’ve built and owned AI-native workflows or agents in production (using Python, JavaScript/TypeScript), and debugged real production failures (model, tool, data, pipeline, or delivery path)

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • 2+ years in a customer-facing role, leading discovery conversations and being accountable for outcomes for external stakeholders

  • Hands-on depth in several of: agents and tool-calling, eval harnesses, retrieval and context systems, CI/CD or developer platforms, and AI-native coding workflows in a real repo

  • Experience as a forward-deployed, solutions, or platform engineer embedded with customers, or as a founding engineer who owned an AI product end to end

title: Director, Research
location: Gemological Institute of America, Inc. (New York, New York)
description:
Why Join GIA?

As GIA's senior scientific leader, you will help shape the future of gemological research and innovation while advancing the Institute's mission to protect the public trust in gems and jewelry. This is a unique opportunity to lead globally recognized research programs, influence industry standards, develop the next generation of scientific talent, and contribute to discoveries that impact the worldwide gem and jewelry community.


Location: Carlsbad, CA or NY, New York


Position Overview

The Director, Research provides enterprise leadership for GIA's global Research function, the scientific foundation that underpins all of GIA's laboratory and education services. The role is accountable for research strategy, scientific programs, innovation in analytical methods and technologies, and the stewardship of research talent, budgets, facilities, and equipment across GIA locations.


The Director ensures GIA's research on gemstone identification, treatments, origin determination, and laboratory-grown materials is accurate, reproducible, and ethically conducted, and that findings are translated into improved testing procedures, instruments, and educational content. As GIA's senior scientific leader, the role advances the Institute's credibility through publications, conferences, and partnerships with universities, research institutions, and industry organizations, and builds the scientific pipeline needed to anticipate future market and technical challenges.


Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Global Research Strategy and Scientific Innovation (25%)

  • Define and execute a multi-year global research strategy and annual research plan aligned with GIA's mission, GIA FIRST priorities, and the current and future needs of laboratory and education services.
  • Lead GIA's scientific programs in gemstone identification, treatments, origin determination, and laboratory-grown materials; set research priorities and allocate resources based on scientific merit, service impact, and risk.
  • Advance analytical methods and technologies that improve gemological research and testing, including emerging techniques, data science, and advanced analytics; anticipate industry developments and new materials that require a research response.
  • Maintain a global roadmap for research capability, technology, equipment, and facilities; prioritize investments using business cases and risk analysis.

Research Programs, Quality and Scientific Integrity (20%)

  • Oversee the global portfolio of research projects; establish governance, milestones, and review processes that ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to scientific standards.
  • Ensure scientific accuracy, reproducibility, and ethical research practices; establish standards for experimental design, data management, documentation, and peer review across research teams.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable regulatory, safety, and institutional standards for research activities, laboratory operations, data, and intellectual property.
  • Review research findings for validity and readiness before publication or transfer into services, and resolve significant scientific questions or disputes.

Translation to Laboratory, Education and Instrument Development (20%)

  • Partner with Identification leaders to translate research findings into improved, validated testing procedures, and provide the scientific evidence that informs methodology decisions for GIA's identification services.
  • Provide scientific support for complex identification cases, emerging treatments, and new materials, and coordinate a rapid research response to industry developments that affect GIA's services.
  • Collaborate with GIA's Instrument Development team to define requirements and develop and validate innovative, reliable instruments that meet GIA's needs and advance the global gem and jewelry industry.
  • Partner with Education leaders to ensure GIA's curriculum and learning materials reflect current research and scientific standards.

Global Research Leadership, Talent and Resources (20%)

  • Lead research scientists and technical staff across GIA locations through research managers and principal scientists; set clear accountabilities, operating rhythms, and expectations for scientific and leadership behavior.
  • Own the global research budget, forecasts, workforce plan, and resource allocation, including laboratory facilities and equipment; explain variances and implement corrective action.
  • Build succession depth for critical scientific and leadership roles through talent reviews, development plans, mentoring, mobility, and targeted recruitment of scientific talent.
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, curiosity, and responsible innovation aligned with GIA values; lead change with clear communication and disciplined adoption planning.

External Collaboration and Scientific Communication (15%)

  • Build and maintain partnerships with universities, research institutions, and industry organizations that extend GIA's scientific capability and reputation, with appropriate agreements and protection of GIA's interests.
  • Review and approve research findings for publication; publish scientific papers and ensure GIA's research is communicated through peer-reviewed journals, GIA publications, and other appropriate channels.
  • Present research results at professional conferences, trade shows, and related events, and represent GIA with credibility in scientific, industry, and institutional forums.
  • Serve as a scientific advisor to GIA executives, Business Development, and Marketing, ensuring external claims accurately reflect GIA research and capabilities.

Job Competencies

  • Accountability: Owns decisions and outcomes, defines measurable expectations, establishes research governance, and holds leaders accountable for timely, high-quality, and sustainable results. Acts as a guardian of GIA's mission, values, scientific integrity, and culture.
  • Scientific & Technical Expertise: In-depth knowledge of gemology, mineralogy, and analytical science across multiple disciplines, with broad knowledge of related fields. Keeps current with emerging technologies, research, and trends affecting the global gem and jewelry marketplace.
  • Strategic Thinking & Insight: Applies a global and enterprise perspective to scientific, operational, financial, talent, and market decisions. Uses industry knowledge, research trends, financial indicators, business cases, and risk analysis to advance long-term priorities.
  • Innovation & Change Leadership: Creates an environment where scientists and leaders challenge existing approaches, share ideas, navigate ambiguity, and pursue responsible innovation. Leads transformation through disciplined execution, stakeholder engagement, and sustained adoption.
  • Decision Quality & Problem Solving: Makes informed and ethical decisions under ambiguity. Evaluates scientific evidence, tradeoffs, dependencies, enterprise risk, and impacts beyond the immediate function.
  • Collaborative Relationships: Builds trusted internal and external networks across academia, industry, and GIA functions, reconciles competing perspectives, and prioritizes enterprise needs to advance GIA's mission.
  • Optimizes Talent Experience: Builds scientific and leadership depth, sponsors critical talent, manages succession, and creates diverse talent pipelines while fostering an inclusive environment where people can contribute and grow.
  • Effective Communication: Communicates vision, strategy, complex scientific information, risk, and business priorities with clarity and credibility to technical and non-technical audiences. Represents GIA effectively in scientific, industry, and executive forums.
  • Service Mindset: Prioritizes GIA's mission and advocates for the Institute's role in serving the gem and jewelry industry and protecting the public trust. Ensures research remains responsive to the needs of laboratory services, education, and clients while protecting scientific integrity.

Minimum Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Ph.D. in geology, mineralogy, gemology, physics, chemistry, materials science, or a related scientific field.
  • Minimum of twelve (12) years of progressively responsible research experience in gemology, mineralogy, materials science, or a closely related scientific field.
  • Minimum of ten (10) years of people leadership experience, including demonstrated success leading scientific leaders and geographically dispersed or comparably complex research organizations.
  • Strong record of peer-reviewed publications and presentations at professional conferences, with recognized standing in the gemological or related scientific community.
  • Expertise in analytical techniques used in gem research and identification, such as spectroscopy, trace element analysis, and imaging, as well as developing and validating new methods and instruments.
  • Demonstrated accountability for a significant research budget, laboratory facilities and equipment, and a portfolio of multiple research programs.
  • Demonstrated success building partnerships with universities, research institutions, and industry organizations, and influencing senior stakeholders across Identification, Education, Instrument Development, Quality, Finance, and related functions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Graduate Gemologist (G.G.) credential, FGA diploma, or comparable recognized gemological qualification.
  • Experience leading globally distributed research teams and scientific collaborations.

Additional Requirements

  • Regular on-site presence is required, with hybrid flexibility consistent with business and leadership needs.
  • Ability to travel domestically and internationally, generally 20-30% of the time, to GIA locations, conferences, trade shows, and partner institutions.
  • Ability to work across global time zones and respond to significant scientific, operational, or stakeholder issues outside standard local business hours.
  • Must handle confidential scientific, intellectual property, employee, financial, and business information with appropriate discretion.

Work Environment / Physical Demands

  • Work is performed in research laboratory and professional office environments. Laboratory equipment may include lasers, X-ray sources, ultraviolet light sources, and cryogenic materials such as liquid nitrogen. Must follow GIA safety protocols and wear personal protective equipment as required.
  • When performing research or technical review, must be able to grasp and manipulate small objects (gems) using tweezers, stone holders, microscopes, and analytical instruments, requiring fine motor skills and eye-to-hand coordination.
  • Extensive use of computers and office equipment, including scientific software, data systems, laboratory technologies, and other business applications.
  • The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of the job.
  • The noise level in the work environment is typically moderate.

Pay Range: $150,000 – $205,000 annually

Carlsbad LabCarlsbad Lab

Other duties may also apply. Nothing in this job description changes the at-will employment relationship existing between the Company and its employees.

title: Wind Turbine Technician-Mechanical
description:
ACCIONA Energía is the biggest 100% renewable energy company with no fossil legacy in the world. With more than 30 years of experience and operations in 20 countries on five continents, ACCIONA Energía offers a wide portfolio of tailored energy solutions so that its corporate and institutional clients can meet their decarbonisation goals. This includes the development, engineering, construction, operation and maintenance of renewable power plants -mainly wind and photovoltaic technologies-, energy sales and management and marketing, energy services, self-consumption, electric mobility and new technologies such as storage and green hydrogen. ACCIONA Energía is governed by the most demanding environmental, social and corporate governance (ESG) criteria.

The Wind Turbine Technician is responsible for performing operations and maintenance (O&M) activities to ensure the safe, reliable, and efficient operation of the wind farm. The role focuses on maximising turbine availability and performance through preventative, predictive, corrective, and proactive maintenance of electrical, hydraulic, and mechanical systems. The technician provides technical support, conducts fault-finding and repairs, supervises specialist contractors during major maintenance activities, and performs authorised wind turbine switching up to 12 kV while maintaining compliance with all safety, quality, and environmental requirements.

Job Description

.Mechanical support

  • Perform relevant tasks and actions to always keep the wind farm operating optimally with maximum availability.
  • Proactive repair or component replacement to prevent complete failure or downtime.
  • Perform servicing, troubleshooting and repair of the wind turbine electrical, hydraulic and mechanical components in accordance with manufacturer’s guidelines.
  • Provide technical assistance to the Turbine Assistants.
  • Ensure efficiency of the wind turbines whilst observing the sites safety, quality and environmental rules and laws.
  • Apply troubleshooting, corrective, predictive and preventative maintenances and inspections whilst attending to every incident that could adversely affect the wind farm’s operations.
  • Supervise specialist and subcontractor activity during main component exchanges or maintenance.
  • Perform wind turbine switching with an authorization of up to 12kV

Reporting

    • Capture tasks on the O&M management systems (MAXIMO, RDO.. Etc) daily
    • Provide daily feedback to the rest of the windfarm team/stakeholders after completion of each workday.
    • Reporting of safety matters, incidents/near misses to management.

Tools and equipment

Safety, health and environmental (SHE) compliance

    • Ensure compliance with the company’s health, safety, and environmental rules and regulations and report any incidents/near misses immediately to superiors.

Other

    • Assist with ad hoc requests and projects that may reasonably be expected within the company from time to time to promote the aims of the company

Required Skills and Competencies

  • Minimum N6: Mechanical Engineering / National Diploma (S4)/ Must have completed Mechanical Trade Test
  • Must have completed Mechanical Trade Test / WTG Experience is advantageous
  • Valid Driver’s License (minimum code B)
  • Computer literate (MS Office; SAP – minimum)
  • PLC’s and Drives/ converters experience will be an advantage
  • Must have excellent written and oral communication skills
  • High accuracy and attention to detail and time management skills
  • Ability to work independently
  • Ability to prioritise and multi-task
  • Willingness to travel
  • Clear criminal record

As a company that values diversity as a source of talent, we work to foster an inclusive environment that promotes respect, belonging and engagement so that all people can participate on an equal opportunity basis. title: Total Rewards Lead
description:
About Mecka AI

Mecka AI is building the data infrastructure layer for robotics and embodied AI.
We design and operate global systems for data capture, data labeling, and hardware-enabled workflows used by leading AI labs and robotics companies to train and validate humanoid and embodied AI systems.
We work closely with frontier robotics teams to bridge real-world data, simulation, learning-based systems, and deployed hardware.

The role

We’re looking for a Total Rewards Lead to own payroll, benefits, compensation and equity administration across Mecka.

This is a hands-on role with real ownership. You’ll make sure employees are paid accurately, benefits work well, equity commitments are tracked and administered, and compensation decisions are supported by reliable data. You’ll build the processes we need as we scale and manage the details that keep them running.

You’ll work closely with People, Finance, Legal and our external partners across multiple countries and employment arrangements.

What you’ll own

Payroll

  • Own the global payroll calendar and coordinate accurate, timely payroll across employees, contractors, PEOs and employers of record.

  • Manage payroll inputs, changes, reconciliations and issue resolution with Finance and payroll providers.

  • Establish clear approvals and controls for new hires, departures, bonuses, compensation changes and deductions.

  • Coordinate local payroll requirements and filings with qualified providers and advisers.

Benefits

  • Manage benefits administration, employee enrolment, renewals and broker relationships.

  • Evaluate coverage, costs and employee needs as we enter new markets.

  • Resolve benefits issues and provide clear guidance to employees.

  • Partner with Finance on benefits budgets and cost tracking.

Equity

  • Own the administration of stock options, shares, RSUs and other equity awards as applicable.

  • Coordinate grant workflows with Legal and Finance, from approved offer commitments through formal approval, issuance and employee documentation.

  • Maintain accurate grant, vesting, exercise and departure records in Carta and related systems.

  • Track outstanding commitments and approvals, reconcile records and help employees understand their awards.

  • Support valuation, reporting and tax-related workflows with external advisers.

Compensation

  • Build and maintain salary bands and market benchmarks across roles and locations.

  • Partner with the Head of People on compensation reviews, promotions, offers and off-cycle adjustments.

  • Assess internal equity and recommend practical solutions to compensation gaps.

  • Model the cost of proposed salary, bonus, benefits and equity changes with Finance.

Systems and employee experience

  • Maintain accurate compensation data across Rippling, Deel, Carta, Pave and connected systems.

  • Build reliable workflows, reporting and documentation that reduce manual work.

  • Serve as the main point of contact for employee questions about pay, benefits and equity.

  • Use automation and AI tools thoughtfully to improve accuracy and turnaround times.

What you bring

  • Experience owning total rewards or a combination of payroll, benefits, compensation and equity administration.

  • Direct experience with Canadian and US payroll and benefits, plus exposure to international providers or employers of record.

  • Practical experience administering equity in a private company, ideally using Carta.

  • Strong spreadsheet, reconciliation and financial modelling skills.

  • Experience building processes in a startup or another rapidly changing environment.

  • Sound judgment with sensitive information and the ability to identify when specialist advice is needed.

  • Clear communication: you can explain a compensation decision or equity process without unnecessary complexity.

  • A willingness to work through the details, resolve issues and follow through to completion.

  • Experience with Rippling, Deel, Pave or similar platforms is an asset. Relevant payroll, compensation or benefits credentials are welcome.

What success looks like

Employees are paid correctly and on time. Benefits are well managed and easy to navigate. Equity commitments and grants are accurately tracked, with clear ownership and timely follow-through. Leaders have dependable compensation data, and our processes can support a much larger global team.

If you don't check every box above but believe you can do the job, we encourage you to apply — we're looking for capability and trajectory, not a perfect checklist match.

We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, we will partner with you to meet your needs.

We may use AI-assisted tools to help evaluate applications against the requirements of this role. These tools support our recruiting team in identifying qualified candidates but do not replace human judgment or limit which applications may be reviewed or considered.

title: Director, Grid Planning Product Management
description:
WHO WE ARE

GridUnity is the industry leader in interconnection life cycle management, delivering cutting-edge software solutions that eliminate bottlenecks in the interconnection process and accelerate the transition to a more affordable, sustainable, and resilient energy future.

Our Mission

We unite all grid interconnection stakeholders on a single platform that converts centralized data into actionable intelligence and accelerates the transition to a reliable, sustainable, and cost-efficient electric grid.

GridUnity is a trusted partner to leading utilities, grid operators, and policymakers. Our technology solutions tackle the interconnection queue backlog by significantly reducing processing times. Whether cutting transmission interconnection timelines from years to months or enabling distribution applications to be processed within a day, we help accelerate energy projects at every scale.

Our Vision
Energizing the planet with a faster, smarter, and more sustainable grid.

About the role

This position reports to GridUnity’s Strategic Product Officer and is a leadership role in the Product Team. You will be responsible for evolving the strategy and roadmap for the grid planning offerings that the GridUnity Intelligence Platform provides to our national customer base. You will partner with GridUnity’s larger Product team, power system engineering and customer growth, to ensure that each planning product module leverages the platform in the most efficient manner and delivers valuable and differentiated products to our customers. You will track, report on, and hold your team to product metrics to ensure customer value is maximized and product investment decisions are data-driven. Your team will continue to grow as you hit product metrics and generate company value.

You will set the vision for grid planning products and keep stakeholders aligned around it. You work with others on the larger GridUnity product and customer growth teams to understand and monitor changing customer needs. You ensure the engineering team maintains a well-defined understanding of the prioritized components, backlog and goals for each development increment, which is delivered through iterative Agile development. This is a player-coach role: you’ll set strategy and own the backlog hands-on while building the team.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy & roadmap

  • Own the multi-year strategic roadmap for grid planning product offerings and coordinate delivery timing with Product Management leadership consistent with company priorities

  • Engage with customers to understand needs, test and validate concepts, and continuously confirm that the strategy reflects real customer and market problems

  • Evaluate product enhancements to drive selection of those with extensible and / or specific strategic value, including build/buy/partner and sequencing tradeoffs

  • Set grid planning product success metrics and report against them in terms leadership cares about; course-correct or kill initiatives that aren't delivering value

Backlog & requirements

  • Define what success looks like for each feature before it’s built, and measure it after

  • Own the grid planning backlog: write user stories, acceptance criteria, and edge cases, and stay accountable for them as the team grows

  • Act as the go-to decision-maker for the development team on scope, sequencing, and acceptance; unblock engineering quickly when requirements shift

Stakeholder & cross-functional management

  • Manage competing stakeholder demands (sales, customer success, executives, engineering) ensuring your product position and the value it delivers to market participants is understood

  • Keep executive leadership and stakeholders informed on status, risk, and tradeoffs through concise, structured communication that includes any needed context

  • Build trust with engineering and customer growth teams so that prioritization calls are respected

  • Provide subject matter expertise and support as needed to GridUnity sales team (e.g., RFP support, product demonstrations, training, documentation, etc.)

Leadership & Influence

  • Operate with high autonomy: demonstrate your ability to create company value and to deeply coordinate with team members throughout the company

  • Mentor and manage a team as the function grows while also fostering growth among the entire Product Management team

  • Collaborate with Product Management leaders to improve the team's product development process itself (documentation, ceremonies, definition of ready/done, estimation)

Qualifications

  • 10+ years experience in B2B enterprise software organization(s), including 5+ years’ experience working in Product Management leading teams of product owners

  • Degree in Power Systems Engineering

  • An MBA and a PE license are a plus

  • Track record of successful SaaS based products developed and launched through your leadership

  • Solid grounding in power systems planning: load flow, contingency analysis, and familiarity with tools like PSS®E, PowerWorld, TARA, PSCAD

  • Energy/utility industry experience and knowledge, including experience in transmission planning processes and understanding of regulatory requirements that impact planning processes

  • Excellent written and verbal communicator, moving easily between technical and business audiences, including executives

  • In-depth understanding of and experience with Agile software development methodology

  • Highly organized with ability to stay on top of multiple projects, teams and deliverables; comfortable resolving competing and shifting priorities

OUR CULTURE

We are a lean, fast-moving team that values bold thinking, reliability, and continuous learning. We operate with radical transparency, embrace scrappiness, and build solutions that anticipate customer needs. We also believe work should be fun and fulfilling — what we call “funfillment.”

The right candidate is energized by working in a scaling, mission-driven company where they can shape processes, wear multiple hats, and grow alongside the business.

BENEFITS/PERKS

  • Competitive compensation packages that recognize your expertise and contributions

  • Remote-first culture that provides flexibility and balance

  • Professional development opportunities, including training, mentorship, and career pathing

  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance starting day one

  • Short- and long-term disability and basic life insurance at no cost to you

  • 401(k) plan with a 4% match to help secure your future

  • Flexible PTO and a supportive work culture that values balance

  • Mission-driven work with the opportunity to make a significant impact in the energy sector

ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENT

This position may involve access to data and systems subject to U.S. critical infrastructure protection regulations. Accordingly, this role is restricted to individuals who qualify as “U.S. persons,” defined by federal law as U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents (green card holders), asylees, or refugees.

OUR COMMITMENT TO APPLICANTS

GridUnity is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, arrest and conviction record, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.

We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where every team member feels valued, supported, and able to bring their authentic self to work.

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please email careers@gridunity.com.

For your security, all official communication from GridUnity will only come from email addresses ending in @.

title: Senior Clinical Coding Specialist
description:
Join a global Contract Resource Organization (CRO) where innovation meets purpose. At Worldwide Clinical Trials, we're driven by a shared commitment to improving lives through high-quality clinical research. Our teams are empowered to think creatively, take ownership, and deliver meaningful work that helps bring life-changing therapies to patients around the world.


With more than 4,000 professionals across the globe, we foster a collaborative and inclusive environment where diverse perspectives are valued, growth is encouraged, and every contribution makes an impact. Whether you're building your career or bringing years of experience, you'll have the opportunity to learn, grow, and help shape the future of clinical research.


Make an Impact as a Senior Clinical Coding Specialist at Worldwide


Clinical coding plays a critical role in transforming complex clinical trial data into reliable insights that support the development of new treatments. As a Senior Clinical Coding Specialist, you will help ensure the accuracy, consistency, and quality of coded clinical data across a range of studies while collaborating closely with sponsors, data management teams, and medical reviewers.

In this role, you will take ownership of coding activities throughout the study lifecycle, from start-up through database updates and ongoing coding reviews. Your expertise will help maintain data quality, support study timelines, and drive continuous improvement across coding processes and technologies.

You will also contribute as a mentor to junior team members while serving as a trusted resource on coding standards, dictionary management, and operational best practices.


Where You'll Work


This is a REMOTE role open to candidates based in Kochi/ Trivandrum. You will collaborate with global teams across multiple time zones.


What You'll Do


  • Lead clinical coding activities across multiple studies, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery of coding outputs.
  • Perform and oversee coding of adverse events, medical histories, medications, and other clinical terminology using industry-standard and sponsor-specific dictionaries.
  • Support study start-up activities, including input into Data Management Plans, User Acceptance Testing, database specifications, and CRF reviews.
  • Generate, review, and reconcile coding consistency reports to ensure data accuracy and compliance with study requirements.
  • Coordinate dictionary implementation, maintenance, and version updates throughout the study lifecycle.
  • Partner with sponsors, medical monitors, and cross-functional teams to resolve coding questions and provide coding-related guidance.
  • Identify opportunities for process and technology improvements, implement enhancements, and monitor outcomes.
  • Mentor and support junior coding staff while contributing to operational excellence and adherence to company SOPs.
  • Provide coding metrics, project updates, and operational support to management, including backup support for Clinical Coding and Data Management leadership when required.

What You'll Bring


  • Degree in Life Sciences, Nursing, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant industry experience.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in clinical data coding or a related role within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or medical device industry.
  • Hands-on experience using industry-standard coding dictionaries such as MedDRA and WHO-DD.
  • Strong understanding of clinical coding processes, dictionary maintenance, and coding quality standards.
  • Experience supporting study start-up activities, coding reviews, reporting, and database-related testing activities.
  • Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver against study timelines.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively in a global environment.
  • Proficiency in English and strong computer literacy with exceptional attention to detail and data quality.

Discover the Difference


We love knowing that someone is going to have a better life because of the work we do. Discover the Difference at Worldwide Clinical Trials. Explore additional opportunities on our careers page, visit , or connect with us on LinkedIn.

title: Software Engineer, Enterprise Platform
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

SOFTWARE ENGINEER, ENTERPRISE PLATFORM

We're hiring an Enterprise Platform Engineer to build the foundational systems that make Cursor ready for the world's largest engineering organizations. Today we have basic organizations, simple IAM primitives, early audit logs, analytics APIs, and admin APIs, but enterprise customers need much more. You will design and build the platform layer that powers organization management, access control, compliance, and administrative tooling across Cursor's product surface. This is a deeply technical IC role focused on building correct, secure, and scalable enterprise infrastructure, not gluing together vendor SDKs.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Build and evolve our organization management system, multi-level org structures, groups, roles, lifecycle, and provisioning via SCIM, so admins can manage thousands of seats without friction

  • Design and implement RBAC with fine-grained roles, permissions, and resource scopes that cover organizations, teams, agents, and other resources, balancing security with developer ergonomics

  • Extend enterprise settings and policies, org-wide defaults, security policies (allowed models, MCPs, Tools, network restrictions), and configuration inheritance across different products; deepen our audit logging infrastructure, comprehensive, queryable, tamper-evident audit trails that satisfy customer-specific compliance requirements

  • Build admin APIs and internal tooling that enterprise admins, customer success, and sales engineering depend on to manage organizations, investigate access issues, and onboard large accounts

  • Ship compliance features end-to-end, SSO enforcement, session management, allowlisting, data analytics, and the controls that procurement and security teams require before signing

  • Partner with product, security, and infrastructure teams to define enterprise platform abstractions that scale across the product without slowing down feature development

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

Experience designing and building scalable systems or shared platform infrastructure.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Opinions on permission models, role inheritance, and policy evaluation

  • Experience building multi-tenant organization or IAM systems in production and opinions on permission models, role inheritance, and policy evaluation

  • Experience shipping RBAC or ABAC systems and understand the tradeoffs between flexibility and complexity

  • Care deeply about correctness in authorization and understand why "fail closed" matters

  • Able to hold the tension between "ship enterprise features fast" and "do not create security gaps or break existing access patterns."

  • Feel comfortable shipping features end-to-end, from database schema and API design to admin UI and documentation

title: Staff Product Engineer
description:
About hyperexponential (hx)

At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry - which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.

If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

How we work

We're in the middle of a deliberate shift in how hx builds. Everyone in product development is a Builder, and the Product Engineer is the default unit of how we work.

We organise around problems, not permanent teams. Small pods, usually of two to four Product Engineers, form around the highest-value problem, own it end-to-end from discovery through to running it in production, and re-form as priorities change. Pods sit inside value streams, each owning a customer outcome and led by a Stream Lead who decides which problems the stream takes on and holds the bar for what ships. Your growth sits elsewhere: a Career Mentor owns your development and progression, so you can move to where the most important problem is without your career following the org chart.

We hire Product Engineers into hx, not into a fixed team, domain, or layer of the stack. You'll start in the stream where your strengths and our highest-value problems meet, and move as the problems move.

Product Engineers are T-shaped: deep expertise in software engineering, plus enough product and design judgement to make routine calls yourself. An embedded PM or designer raises a pod's ceiling on the hardest problems, but is never a gate between you and the customer. This is also a deliberately AI-native role, and one of the areas where we're moving fastest.

A pod of three owns its problem whole, which means going wherever it leads: front end, back end, data, or infrastructure. You don't need to be full-stack by trade, but you do need to be comfortable working outside your strongest layer.

The Product Engineer role is the same at every level. What scales is the size of the problem you own, how expensive your decisions are to reverse, and how far your judgement travels beyond your pod. At Level 4, that looks like this.

What you'll be doing

  • Taking a customer problem from discovery to production inside a pod, getting close to customers yourself, framing the problem, and shipping in small increments guided by real customer signal rather than internal opinion.

  • Directing AI agents to draft implementation, tests, and migrations, then reviewing, integrating, and hardening that work. You'll write intent precisely enough to brief both a teammate and an agent, and own correctness and maintainability regardless of how the first draft was produced.

  • Designing and delivering robust production systems where correctness, performance, and resource efficiency matter, with the tests and observability that make complex behaviour safe to evolve.

  • Working across the codebase wherever the problem leads, including areas your pod doesn't steward, with stewards looped in proportionate to the risk rather than handing work off and waiting.

  • Moving between pods, problems, and streams as priorities change, ramping fast on unfamiliar domains and leaving what you built running well behind you.

  • Taking full accountability for outcomes rather than just your code changes: raising risks early, and deciding rather than escalating.

What you'll need to have done

  • Built and shipped production systems end-to-end, from design through rollout, monitoring, and iteration, in settings where correctness, performance, and resource efficiency mattered.

  • Designed testing and observability that made complex behaviour understandable, debuggable, and safe to evolve.

  • Worked effectively in a polyglot environment, choosing the right tool for the problem and picking up unfamiliar languages, domains, and codebases fast. Strong systems experience, for example in Rust, C/C++, or Python, is valued, and we'll upskill you where there are gaps.

  • Shipped work outside your strongest layer of the stack when the problem needed it, picking up the front end, the data layer, or the infrastructure rather than waiting for someone else to.

  • Used AI tools as a serious part of how you build, with the judgement to direct, review, and stand behind what they produce.

  • Carried product and design judgement into your engineering work, shaping the solution rather than only implementing a spec and making sensible calls under ambiguity.

  • Owned outcomes beyond your immediate task, taking decisions rather than escalating them.

At Level 4 we'll also look for

  • Set technical direction on a hard problem other engineers built on, and been judged on whether you made them faster and safer rather than on the size of your team.

  • Held a quality bar across other people's work without becoming the gate they wait on.

  • Led cross-cutting or decoupling work that teams adopted because it was the best path, not because it was mandated.

You’re unlikely to thrive here if

  • You prefer following detailed instructions rather than experimenting and finding your own approach.

  • You are uncomfortable working directly with non-technical stakeholders to understand their challenges.

  • You avoid tackling ambiguous or open-ended problems where the solution isn’t obvious.

If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you’ll do your best work. We’re building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us.

Compensation

At hx, we’re committed to salary transparency. You’ll always have clarity on pay early in the process - our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations - and we’re working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally.

Because we’re building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don’t always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that’s competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make.

Benefits

  • B2B

    • 25 days of non-working + Polish bank holidays

    • £5,000 GBP budget for Learning & Development

    • Mental Health Support and Therapy via Spectrum Life

    • Optional for you: access to Private Healthcare via Luxmed + Multisport (fully funded by yourself as B2B Contractor)

    • Top-spec laptop (MacOS or Windows)

  • Contract of Employment (UoP)

    • £5,000 GBP budget for Learning & Development

    • 26 days of holiday + Polish bank holidays

    • Company pension

    • Company Sick Pay for 10 days at 100% salary

    • Mental Health Support and Therapy via Spectrum Life

    • Monthly Wellbeing allowance via Juno

    • Private Healthcare Insurance via Luxmed

    • Multisport - Classic level

    • Top-spec work equipment (MacOS, Windows + additional monitors, mechanical keyboards etc)

Interview process

  1. Initial chat with our Talent team

  2. Lead Hirer Interview

  3. Live AI Skills Assessment

  4. Values Interview with the CPTO

  5. Meet the CEO

Our commitment to Diversity

hxers are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive.

Diversity is not just the right thing to do, it is key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure.

If you're energised by complexity and motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply and join our global team.

Next steps

If this opportunity resonates with you, we encourage you to apply or share it with your connections! Our dedicated talent team reviews all applications, and we promise to provide feedback regardless of the outcome.

For more information about applying and to view other opportunities, you can visit our careers page.

We handle all background checks sensitively and in full compliance with relevant regulations. title: Applied Scientist III - Amazon Identity Program, Amazon Identity Program (AIP)
description:
Advertising identity is one of the most challenging problems in modern machine learning. Amazon Advertising is looking for an Applied Scientist III to help solve it at global scale, applying advanced AI, graph neural networks, and probabilistic modeling to connect billions of identity signals across devices, publishers, and the open internet.

The Amazon Advertising Identity Platform (AIP) powers how advertisers recognize, reach, and measure audiences across the advertising ecosystem. As traditional identity signals become less available and consumer behavior spans an increasing number of devices and environments, we are investing in new scientific approaches to build a more accurate, scalable, and privacy conscious identity graph.

As a senior scientific leader, you will develop novel approaches to probabilistic identity resolution, graph neural networks (GNNs), representation learning, and large scale entity matching. You will combine deterministic identity signals from Amazon's owned and operated properties with signals from publishers, agencies, and third party identity providers to build accurate identity models across increasingly fragmented digital environments.

You will define scientific direction, design and evaluate new models, and partner closely with engineering and product teams to bring research into production. Your work will directly influence advertising addressability, audience reach, campaign measurement, and billions of dollars in advertising revenue.

The ideal candidate has deep expertise in applied machine learning, graph algorithms, and probabilistic modeling, with a demonstrated ability to translate scientific research into production systems. You should be comfortable operating in ambiguous problem spaces, challenging existing approaches, mentoring scientists, and influencing technical strategy across organizations.

This role offers the opportunity to shape the future of identity resolution at Amazon, advance the state of the art in applied machine learning, and deliver scientific innovations with measurable impact across the global advertising industry.

title: Network Deployment Build Lead, DC Infra Capacity Delivery
description:
AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS) owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

As Amazon Web Services (AWS) continues to build upon the world’s biggest Cloud Computing Infrastructure, we are looking for Network Technicians to support the scaling and growth of our network infrastructure.

About The Role
Infrastructure Delivery (ID) Network Technicians are part of the Infrastructure Operations Team, the backbone of AWS that supports our customers and their rapidly growing businesses by operating world-class data centers. Network Technicians lead projects to deploy, maintain, and expand the physical network infrastructure at AWS data centers. At Amazon, we always aim to exceed the expectations of our customers, and we continuously raise the standards for operational performance in safety, security, availability, productivity, capacity, efficiency, and cost.

Key job responsibilities
Each day presents unique challenges, which include:

Deploying network hardware and cabling
Managing multiple projects simultaneously
Working closely with Network Engineering, Technical Program Managers, and other stakeholders to deliver projects
Designing the physical network interconnections to Amazon standards
Working with vendors on large-scale cabling deployments
Troubleshooting network and cabling infrastructure issues
Migrating networks in live environments
Coordinating operations with other Data Center teams
Seeking out ways to improve yourself and improve the processes and systems we use
The primary work location will be in Tokyo; however, 50% travel to support projects in other parts of Japan and APAC (primarily Korea) will also be required

Starting from your ‘Day One’, we provide a full on-boarding process and continuous training while you gain an understanding of data centers and our infrastructure. You will work independently and with colleagues, at the forefront of transformational technology, and will have opportunities to grow within the team and the organization.

At Amazon, everyone is a leader. You are self-motivated and can adapt in a fast-paced, constantly evolving environment. You have a passion for technology, always ask “Why?” and seek to understand how things work, are a problem solver, and may have some data center experience. You may also have networking, cabling, or project management experience. You can follow our guidelines and processes, and enjoy work that requires attention to detail.
You actively seek opportunities to make improvements in our operations and yourself.

If you enjoy working alongside a close-knit and diverse team of leaders, this is the place to be! We welcome you to work on advanced technologies in this dynamic environment.

About the team
About AWS
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Job Description:


Johnson & Johnson's Enterprise Governance & Legal Innovation group within the Global Legal Organization (GLO) is recruiting for a Senior Director, Digital Innovation & Transformation.


The Senior Director, Digital Innovation & Transformation is a global leadership role responsible for shaping and executing the digital strategy in support of the GLO. This role defines the vision for how to transform legal practices by adopting an AI-enabled, digital-first approach to position the GLO for competitive advantage. This includes digital capabilities, automation, and AI to improve speed to the business and reduce low-value work within the GLO, improving satisfaction and experience.


Reporting to the VP of Legal Innovation and Digital Transformation, the role partners closely with legal, technology, and business stakeholders to identify and prioritize high-impact opportunities, design and scale innovative solutions, and embed modern product and Agile practices across the organization. With deep expertise in digital delivery, this role oversees the development of a cohesive digital ecosystem – spanning tools, platforms, and operating models – while ensuring effective governance, risk management, and stakeholder alignment.


This role has accountability to optimize and drive efficiency through technology opportunities across the GLO resource deployment model. The Senior Director will lead a team of approximately 6 FTEs and contractors based in global J&J locations, while also overseeing the entire ecosystem of technology support, including relationships with the J&J Technology organization (JJT) and implementation partners.


The ideal candidate should bring a strong understanding of how lawyers, privacy professionals, and other legal specialists operate and the services legal and privacy teams deliver – along with deep knowledge of current and emerging digital trends, tools, and practices that can transform service delivery models.


Key Responsibilities:


Digital Strategy

• Establish and communicate the GLO digital vision, identifying target opportunities enabled by digital transformation

• Promote and implement digital strategy, change, and transformation activities with strong adherence to best practices

• Identify and prioritize use cases with sound business cases, including clear measures of financial and productivity gains

• Build alignment on technology priorities and shared roadmaps amongst GLO teams and with JJT

• Lead research and analysis on AI and generative AI trends and technologies applicable to legal and privacy fields

• Develop and implement strategy for AI adoption and scaling within the GLO, ensuring compliance with J&J policies and guidelines

• Drive AI fluency across the GLO and serve as the functional representative on enterprise AI governance forums

• Develop comprehensive data strategy for the GLO to collect, manage, utilize, and protect its data assets

• Lead the transition from a system-centric to a capability-led value delivery model aligned with strategic recommendations


Solution Design & Implementation

• Oversee design and implementation of solutions, tools, and the operational model for GLO technology

• Deploy and scale Agile practices across design, development, and service management

• Drive end-to-end product development from concept to implementation, ensuring value creation at each stage

• Manage the relationship and dynamics between business product owners (BPOs) within the GLO and technical product owners (TPOs) within JJT

• Drive rationalization of legacy products and reduction of coordination overhead across the technology portfolio

• Implement risk-based financial governance for technology investments and BPO/TPO accountability models

• Ensure integration of digital solutions with existing infrastructure, representing the GLO as customer and user in technology scoping, selection, procurement, and implementation


Client-Centric Innovation

• Drive a client-centric approach to innovation across GLO practice groups and sector expertise

• Understand customers' challenges, requirements, and desires to create exceptional digital product experiences

• Position the GLO as an innovation hub for legal professionals and J&J colleagues

• Establish a high-value product vision informed by deep understanding of industry trends and pain points

• Maintain and prioritize a backlog of product initiatives and concepts for future development

• Conduct ongoing voice-of-customer activities and leverage market insights to validate opportunities within the digital portfolio

• Foster a culture of innovation and continuous improvement within the broader GLO

• Engage as a thought leader on digital and AI issues within the external legal industry


Team Leadership & Development

• Build, lead, and develop a globally distributed digital innovation and transformation team serving the GLO

• Lead people and teams with strengths-based feedback and Objectives & Key Results (OKR)-based individual development

• Manage Agile team members and lead product development organizations

• Provide coaching, feedback, performance management, and contribute to compensation decisions

• Create and implement a communications plan to articulate vision, strategy, goals, and benefits of legal digital transformation

• Use change management techniques to promote new capabilities, prepare GLO team members for new technologies, and ensure strong adoption


Qualifications

Required:

• Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree (MBA, JD, or equivalent) preferred

• 8+ years of progressive experience in legal operations, legal technology, or digital transformation, with people leadership experience.

• Strong technical knowledge of legal tools, systems, and platforms with demonstrated experience in innovation and digital transformation

• Proven ability to develop and execute digital strategy in a large, complex, matrixed organization

• Deep understanding of Agile methodologies, product management, and modern software development practices

• Experience managing technology budgets and demonstrating ROI on digital investments

• Strong understanding of AI/ML technologies and their application in legal and business contexts

• Excellent stakeholder management skills with ability to influence at senior leadership levels

• Demonstrated ability to build, lead, and develop high-performing, globally distributed teams

• Outstanding communication, organizational, and collaboration skills to work effectively across functions and levels

• Willingness to travel up to 10% of the time


Preferred

• JD or equivalent legal degree with understanding of legal principles and practices

• Experience in legal operations within a pharmaceutical, healthcare, or similarly regulated industry

• Demonstrated experience managing digital transformation projects and AI adoption within a legal organization

• Expertise in legal data analysis, project management, and change management methodologies

• Experience with legal-specific technology platforms (e.g., matter management, e-billing, contract lifecycle management, document management)

• Experience leading BPO/TPO accountability models and technology vendor management

• Knowledge of the evolving legal technology vendor landscape and emerging solutions

https://aws.amazon.com/cloudops/

About the team

About the team
Our team sits at the intersection of technology and business strategy at Amazon, working to build partnerships that create lasting value for our customers and partners alike. Our focus in the coming years is on identifying and scaling transformative business opportunities, and you will play a central role in defining that direction. Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

title: Data Analyst
description:
About CertifyOS

CertifyOS is building the data infrastructure that powers modern healthcare.

Today, healthcare organizations rely on fragmented and outdated provider data. This creates unnecessary administrative work, regulatory risk, and higher costs across the system. We’re solving that problem.

Our API-first platform automates provider licensing, enrollment, credentialing, and network monitoring by connecting directly to hundreds of primary data sources. We help healthcare organizations maintain accurate, compliant, and reliable provider networks at scale.

Our vision is simple: One API. One provider ID. Frictionless provider data.

We’re backed by leading investors and built by a team with deep experience in provider data systems. At CertifyOS, we value authenticity, accountability, collaboration, results, and openness to feedback. We’re building a high-ownership team focused on solving real infrastructure problems that impact millions of patients.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Data Analyst to analyze large datasets, ensure data coverage, accuracy, completeness, and freshness, and drive data-driven improvements. The role involves data analysis, data readiness, quality monitoring, automation, and cross-functional collaboration to ensure reliable data delivery and successful business launches.

Key Responsibilities

  • Data Monitoring: Monitor data freshness, coverage, pipeline failures, and operational metrics; identify issues and coordinate resolutions.

  • Data Readiness: Own end-to-end data readiness activities, identify coverage gaps, and ensure data quality standards are met before go-live.

  • Data Quality & Monitoring: Perform data validation, reconciliation, and quality assessments; monitor data freshness, coverage, and pipeline failures.

  • Issue Resolution & Coordination: Investigate data issues, coordinate refreshes and corrective actions, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to resolve data gaps.

  • Dashboards & Reporting: Build and maintain dashboards, quality scorecards, and operational reports to track key metrics.

  • Automation & Improvements: Develop SQL and Python-based workflows to automate data processing, validation, reporting, and recurring analysis.

Required Skills

  • Strong proficiency in SQL (Google BigQuery) and Python (Pandas).

  • Hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), particularly BigQuery and Google Cloud Storage (GCS).

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify data patterns, trends, anomalies, and root causes.

  • Experience with data cleaning, preprocessing, validation, and reconciliation.

  • Experience with data visualization tools such as Looker , Studio, Power BI, or Tableau.

  • Strong communication skills and ability to independently manage analytical workflows.

Good to Have

  • Healthcare domain knowledge, particularly provider data, credentialing, or licensing.

  • Familiarity with ETL/ELT pipelines, data ingestion, and workflow automation.

  • Experience with Git, AI-assisted analytics, and automation tools.

Benefits of Working at Certify

  • At Certify, we’re building with intention and taking care of the people doing the work.

  • Your well-being matters to us. We provide 100% coverage of health, dental, and vision insurance premiums for employees. Our US-based team benefits from unlimited PTO, with at least two weeks off each year to recharge. In India, employees are supported with health insurance, statutory leave benefits, and additional wellness (menstrual) leave for women.

We are an equal opportunity employer committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to do their best work, and we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and experiences.

If you require reasonable accommodations during the application process, please contact recruiting@certifyos.com.

We are also committed to pay transparency and foster an open culture where compensation conversations are encouraged and respected.
