C.A. Murren and Sons is seeking a Quality Assurance Engineer that will work on implementing and be a vital part in the development of the project Quality Assurance Program for engineering, procurement, subcontracting, construction, testing, turnover, and supplier activities. This position assists in the interpretation project quality requirements, maintains the approved program, verifies effective implementation, and has influence to stop work when a significant condition adverse to quality warrants. Role boundary QA is an independent oversight function. The QA Engineer may review and observe QC and construction activities but must not become responsible for directing or controlling the work being verified.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Assist in the development, maintenance, and administer the project Quality Assurance Plan, implementing procedures, audit/surveillance program, qualification program, and quality performance in conformance with the approved CAM program and contract flow-downs.
  • Participate in the Implementation of ASME NQA-1-2019 and DOE O 414.1D graded-approach requirements across safety class, safety significant, production support, and general service work, documenting the basis and ensuring grading never negates an applicable requirement.
  • Takes part in the planning of independent audits, surveillances, and assessments of CAM, subcontractor, supplier, laboratory, and field activities; issue findings and verify timely, effective closure.
  • Review project procedures, work processes, procurement documents, quality plans, inspection/test plans, and construction records for appropriate quality requirements and objective evidence.
  • Review significant nonconformances, conditions adverse to quality, corrective actions, trends, root-cause evaluations, and effectiveness reviews; escalate adverse trends and repeat conditions.
  • Assist in the coordination of quality interfaces with the Project Quality Manager, QC Manager, NCR/CAR Manager, Field Engineering, Work Planning, Procurement Quality, Document Control, Construction, suppliers, and Company representatives.
  • Support Company access, oversight, audits, and records review, and ensure quality records remain legible, traceable, retrievable, and suitable for turnover.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering, science, quality, construction management, or a related technical field; an equivalent combination of education or directly relevant experience will be considered.
  • Must have at least 3 years of progressive quality assurance experience of which at least 1 year with DOE projects.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of ASME NQA-1 and DOE O 414.1D, including graded approach, independent assessment, corrective action, document/records control, procurement quality, and personnel qualification.
  • Experience interpreting contracts, specifications, codes, quality clauses, and supplier/subcontractor flow-downs for field construction.
  • Strong technical writing, judgment, facilitation, and issue-escalation skills; able to defend independent quality conclusions under schedule pressure.
  • Preferred knowledge of 10 CFR 830 Subpart A, 10 CFR Part 21, suspect/counterfeit items, commercial grade dedication, and DOE O 414.1E transition considerations.
  • Preferred experience on DOE capital projects involving heavy civil, reinforced concrete, underground utilities, mechanical piping, welding, tanks, and electrical duct bank scope.


Requirements:

  • Valid driver’s license
  • Must be a U.S. citizen
  • Participation in pre-employment and random drug screening program
  • Subject to background screening

title: Senior Manager, Quantum Error Correction
description:
About Sygaldry

Sygaldry Technologies is building quantum-accelerated AI servers to exponentially speed up training and inference for AI. By integrating quantum and AI, we're accelerating the path to super intelligence, and engineering the conditions for it to scale efficiently and operate affordably. Sygaldry AI servers combine multiple qubit types within a single, fault-tolerant architecture to deliver the combination of cost, scale, and speed necessary for advanced AI applications. We pioneer new domains in physics, engineering, and AI, tackling the hardest challenges with a grounded, optimistic, and rigorous culture. We're looking for individuals ready to define the intersection of quantum and AI and drive its profound global impact.

What You'll Work On

  • Build, lead, and mentor a team of quantum error correction theorists, including hiring and developing its members

  • Set the research agenda for quantum error correction and fault-tolerant logic, aligned with Sygaldry's architecture and product roadmap

  • Design and evaluate quantum error correction schemes for novel hardware architectures with multiple qubit modalities

  • Develop efficient protocols for fault tolerance, including non-Clifford logic, under hardware-specific constraints and noise models

  • Oversee the development of simulation and modeling tools for system design and analysis

  • Partner with the device theory, hardware, and software teams to turn error correction requirements into concrete system specifications and roadmap milestones

  • Lead high-impact research projects with a multidisciplinary team of experimental and theoretical physicists, engineers, and computer scientists

  • Represent Sygaldry's error correction work to the scientific community, partners, and investors

You May Be a Good Fit If You Have

  • A PhD in physics, applied physics, computer science, electrical engineering, or an equivalent degree in a similar field

  • 8+ years of experience in quantum error correction

  • A strong publication record in quantum error correction or related fields

  • Experience leading a research team, through direct people management or formal technical leadership

  • Strong programming skills in a scientific computing environment

  • A proven track record of successful cross-team collaborative projects

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including with non-specialist audiences

Strong Candidates Might Have

  • Experience translating cutting-edge R&D into commercial products or roadmap milestones

  • Experience deploying quantum error correction schemes on real quantum devices

  • Experience translating abstract models of error correction into hardware-aware protocols

  • Experience with decoding in real-time and/or on FPGAs, ASICs, or GPUs

  • Experience building a team from an early stage in a startup or industrial research setting

Why This Matters

Your work accelerates the path to quantum super intelligence. Each quantum component integrated, each AI model enhanced, each instruction set optimized brings us closer to a future where intelligence and quantum mechanics are inextricably intertwined. We're not building incremental improvements—we're creating exponential transformations that will make AI more affordable, sustainable, personalized, and fundamentally more capable.

How We’re Different

We’re building the infrastructure for quantum super intelligence and pioneering new domains at the intersection of physics, engineering, and AI. At Sygaldry, curiosity and intellectual courage drive our work. We approach ambitious challenges with a grounded, optimistic, and rigorous culture and know that kind people build the strongest teams. We prioritize mission over ego and collaborate openly with a strong sense of shared purpose. We dream big, yet we execute with a love of detail.

Culture & Benefits

  • The Best of Both Worlds: Access to industrial-scale compute and hardware resources while retaining the intellectual freedom of an academic environment.

  • Visa Sponsorship: We know what it takes to make top talent thrive here. We’re open to supporting visas whenever possible.

  • Compensation: We value your high-level expertise. This position offers a salary significantly above standard academic postdoctoral rates.

  • Benefits: Your well-being matters. We provide company-sponsored health coverage to give you and your family peace of mind.

  • Connection: Whether it’s company offsite or casual crew socials, we make time to connect, recharge, and have fun together.

  • Time Off: We trust you to take the time you need. Unlimited PTO so you can rest, recharge, and come back ready to make an impact.

We encourage applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. If you don’t think this role is right for you, but you believe that you would have something meaningful to contribute to our mission, please reach out at letsbuild@sygaldry.com.

title: Model Engineer
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

Model Engineer

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. We train frontier coding agents and scale RL on real user data to make them increasingly effective. We're looking for Research Scientists who can drive effective RL or mid-training research in a small-team setting. You'll own ambiguous, hard research problems end-to-end: forming hypotheses, designing experiments, building the training/eval/data needed to test them, and pushing results into the next model.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Design and run rigorous experiments that turn research ideas into measurable gains in model capability

  • Improve data recipes through data quality, deduplication, and mixture experiments

  • Define what makes RL data and rewards good, including grader design and preventing reward hacking

  • Advance training science, from architecture and scaling experiments to post-training recipes for coding and computer-use agents

  • Build evals and targeted tasks that expose model weaknesses and guide where the team invests next

  • Partner with engineers to take promising results from small experiments to frontier-scale training runs

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience writing production-quality code in Python, PyTorch, JAX, Rust, or C++

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Able to handle ambiguous research tasks with little guidance, and to own a research direction end to end

  • Care an unusual amount about data quality, and can dive into the data when appropriate

  • Truth seeking, aiming to learn more about the science than to prove your ideas are correct

  • Experience with RL algorithms for language models, scaling laws, or building RL environments and evals

  • Experience with distributed training at scale and debugging problems that only show up at scale

  • Experience training frontier-scale models

  • Strong background in RL and machine learning fundamentals

  • An excellent programmer and software engineer, comfortable working across the research stack in Python and PyTorch or JAX

  • Hands-on experience training large models, through pretraining, post-training or RL

  • A track record of original work in ML, such as new methods or real improvements, shown through research, open source or production impact

  • MS or PhD in CS, ML, math, physics or a related field, or equivalent research experience

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Onsite role: must be able to work in person at the Palo Alto office

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

Annual Salary:

$160,000 - $250,000 USD

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.

title: Senior User Researcher
description:
Looking for a new adventure? You’ve come to the right place.

We're an Amsterdam-based team of 100 (and counting) with 25+ nationalities amongst us! A varied bunch of “Citizens of The World” with a wide range of skills and hundreds of thousands of kilometers under our travel belts. And we have something important in common (other than our very well-worn passports): We want to change the way people travel.

And that's exactly what we're doing, with the travel app to plan, track, and relive trips in a smart and beautiful way.

Polarsteps has over 23 million users already, but, for us, this is just the beginning. We have big plans for the future, and so we need even more talented and enthusiastic people to help us on our journey.

Want to know more about us? Here you go.


Your expedition: User Research at Polarsteps

We’re a small team, doing big things.

We pride ourselves on being user-centric, providing a seamless, top-quality user experience for every one of our travelers. And it is this that has got us ratings of 4.8* and 4.7* on the app stores (where we’ve been featured multiple times).

As the company grows, we need to strengthen our ability to deliver insights to teams through User Research, a core competency of the company. Which is why we need you! We already have a User Research Lead who has been building out our processes and team, and now we are looking to increase our capacity and bring more insights to our product team.

As a Senior User Researcher, you will be part of the Design + Brand organisation, embedded directly into Product teams to ensure insights impact decision-making. You'll act as a strategic navigator, helping teams understand what insights mean for where we are taking the company. You will champion a culture of learning and listening throughout your product area(s) to enable user-centric product development.

We're at an early-mid stage of research maturity. We have good buy-in and some processes in place, but you'll be expected to own your own ResearchOps (recruiting, scheduling, tooling) without dedicated support. If you thrive in a self-directed, low-overhead environment, you'll love it here.


Your itinerary

What your journey at Polarsteps will look like day-to-day.

You will:

  • Be embedded and own relationships with 2-3 product pillars, building enough context to become the insights go-to for those teams and embedding research into their roadmaps.

  • Plan and execute all phases of a research project from planning and recruiting to analysing and sharing, for both qualitative and mixed-methods research. Part of this will be selecting the right methodology for the right question.

  • Support our product colleagues with setting up their own smaller research activities including helping with unmoderated tests and creating actionable surveys.

  • Turn research activities into appealing, actionable, and self-explanatory insights that people within the company can run with.

  • Share what you're thinking, doing, and learning while research is in progress, not just at the end. Research at Polarsteps is highly collaborative.

  • Contribute to shared research infrastructure: panel management, tooling, and team-wide initiatives.

The equipment in your backpack

What we’re hoping you’ll bring with you.

  • You already live in The Netherlands.

  • Experience as a UX or Product Researcher, ideally at a B2C technology company. What matters is depth of craft, not years on a CV. Scale-up or smaller-company experience is a strong plus.

  • Great communication skills in English, as well as the confidence to challenge assumptions, and promote and advocate for research findings with product managers, designers, and other stakeholders.

  • Leaning more on qualitative research, but great if you have mixed methods (quantitative is a bonus)

  • A portfolio of finished research that includes both evaluative work and discovery/generative work to showcase your research & analysis capabilities

  • A curious and eager mind, driven by an interest in how people use technology to plan and improve their travel experiences.

  • Understanding of how to apply research in a business setting. You know when "good enough" beats "perfect" and can scale scope to meet a deadline.

Nice to have

  • Fluency in Dutch, French, or German.

  • Experience working in a B2C context.

  • Comfortable doing research with a lean toolset and no dedicated ResearchOps support.

  • Quantitative data analysis skills (surveys, not SQL but a bonus if you have it).

1st class extras

Some cool things to make the journey extra sweet.

  • Salary range: Between EUR 80.000 - 94.000 (senior level) gross per year incl. 8% holiday allowance (based on 40 hours/week). Where you land in the range depends on your experience and skills, to be evaluated during the interview process.

  • A yearly free flight or train ride to a random location! Give our Teleporter a spin here.

  • A shiny MacBook to work your magic on.

  • Hybrid working. Split your time between the office and your home as you see fit.

  • An extensive home office set-up — everything from noise-canceling headphones to a standing desk.

  • 30 days of vacation (for adventures or sitting on the couch, it's up to you).

  • Two paid Culture Days for days that are important to you but not recognized by the official Dutch calendar.

  • The option to switch up your zoom background by working from another country for up to 8 weeks a year.

  • A personal development budget for that curious mind of yours!

  • A pension plan to help you save for those around-the-world retirement trips.

  • Delicious daily team lunches.

  • Awesome monthly parties, as well as team trips away.

  • A lively office in downtown Amsterdam, with travel costs reimbursed.

  • Free Polarsteps Travel Books to contain all your far-flung adventures.


At Polarsteps, we believe the best products are built by people as diverse as the travelers using our apps! That's why we specifically encourage people underrepresented in the tech industry to apply for a role with us. Because we believe that diversity — be it age, race, sexual orientation, physical ability, ethnicity, or gender identity — makes both the world and the workplace better.


Think this is the path for you? Find out more about how we hire.

title: Product Engineer
description:
About hyperexponential (hx)

At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry - which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.

If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

How we work

We're in the middle of a deliberate shift in how hx builds. Everyone in product development is a Builder, and the Product Engineer is the default unit of how we work.

We organise around problems, not permanent teams. Small pods, usually of two to four Product Engineers, form around the highest-value problem, own it end-to-end from discovery through to running it in production, and re-form as priorities change. Pods sit inside value streams, each owning a customer outcome and led by a Stream Lead who decides which problems the stream takes on and holds the bar for what ships. Your growth sits elsewhere: a Career Mentor owns your development and progression, so you can move to where the most important problem is without your career following the org chart.

We hire Product Engineers into hx, not into a fixed team, domain, or layer of the stack. You'll start in the stream where your strengths and our highest-value problems meet, and move as the problems move.

Product Engineers are T-shaped: deep expertise in software engineering, plus enough product and design judgement to make routine calls yourself. An embedded PM or designer raises a pod's ceiling on the hardest problems, but is never a gate between you and the customer. This is also a deliberately AI-native role, and one of the areas where we're moving fastest.

A pod of three owns its problem whole, which means going wherever it leads: front end, back end, data, or infrastructure. You don't need to be full-stack by trade, but you do need to be comfortable working outside your strongest layer.

The Product Engineer role is the same at every level. What scales is the size of the problem you own, how expensive your decisions are to reverse, and how far your judgement travels beyond your pod. At Level 2, that looks like this:

What you'll be doing

  • Taking a customer problem from discovery to production inside a pod, getting close to customers yourself, framing the problem, and shipping in small increments guided by real customer signal rather than internal opinion.

  • Directing AI agents to draft implementation, tests, and migrations, then reviewing, integrating, and hardening that work. You'll write intent precisely enough to brief both a teammate and an agent, and own correctness and maintainability regardless of how the first draft was produced.

  • Designing and delivering robust production systems where correctness, performance, and resource efficiency matter, with the tests and observability that make complex behaviour safe to evolve.

  • Working across the codebase wherever the problem leads, including areas your pod doesn't steward, with stewards looped in proportionate to the risk rather than handing work off and waiting.

  • Moving between pods, problems, and streams as priorities change, ramping fast on unfamiliar domains and leaving what you built running well behind you.

  • Taking full accountability for outcomes rather than just your code changes: raising risks early, and deciding rather than escalating.

What you'll need to have done

  • Built and shipped production systems end-to-end, from design through rollout, monitoring, and iteration, in settings where correctness, performance, and resource efficiency mattered.

  • Designed testing and observability that made complex behaviour understandable, debuggable, and safe to evolve.

  • Worked effectively in a polyglot environment, choosing the right tool for the problem and picking up unfamiliar languages, domains, and codebases fast. Strong systems experience, for example in Rust, C/C++, or Python, is valued, and we'll upskill you where there are gaps.

  • Shipped work outside your strongest layer of the stack when the problem needed it, picking up the front end, the data layer, or the infrastructure rather than waiting for someone else to.

  • Used AI tools as a serious part of how you build, with the judgement to direct, review, and stand behind what they produce.

  • Carried product and design judgement into your engineering work, shaping the solution rather than only implementing a spec and making sensible calls under ambiguity.

  • Owned outcomes beyond your immediate task, taking decisions rather than escalating them.

You’re unlikely to thrive here if

  • You prefer following detailed instructions rather than experimenting and finding your own approach.

  • You are uncomfortable working directly with non-technical stakeholders to understand their challenges.

  • You avoid tackling ambiguous or open-ended problems where the solution isn’t obvious.

If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you’ll do your best work. We’re building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us.

Compensation

At hx, we’re committed to salary transparency. You’ll always have clarity on pay early in the process - our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations - and we’re working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally.

Because we’re building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don’t always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that’s competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make.

Benefits

£5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development.

25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total).

Company pension scheme via Penfold.

Mental health support and therapy via .

Individual wellbeing allowance via Juno.

Private healthcare insurance through AXA.

Income protection and Life Insurance.

Cycle to Work Scheme.

Additional perks

Top-spec equipment (laptop, screens, adjustable desks, etc.).

Regular remote and in-person hackathons, lunch and learns, socials, and game nights.

Team breakfasts and lunches, snacks, drinks fridge, and a fun office at The Ministry.

Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together.

Interview process

  1. Initial chat with our Talent team

  2. Lead Hirer Interview

  3. Live AI Skills Assessment

  4. Values Interview with the CPTO

  5. Meet the CEO

Our commitment to Diversity

hxers are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive.

Diversity is not just the right thing to do, it is key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure.

If you're energised by complexity and motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply and join our global team.

Next steps

If this opportunity resonates with you, we encourage you to apply or share it with your connections! Our dedicated talent team reviews all applications, and we promise to provide feedback regardless of the outcome.

For more information about applying and to view other opportunities, you can visit our careers page.

description:

With a broad-based and ever-growing portfolio of market-leading, vertical-market enterprise solutions covering more than 100 industry domains in predominantly mature markets, CSI's recipe creates the perfect environment for professionals to build fulfilling, long-term careers.

What started as an R&D & Accounting back-office, has progressed into a full-service Global Centre serving all functions and departments, at the divisional as well as operating group/corporate level. Today Contour employees, located in Karachi, Lahore & Islamabad, are serving CSI divisions located in time zones spanning the globe, from Sydney to Vancouver. With the global growth of Constellation as the wind in our sails, we are only just getting started!

The Division

Constellation HomeBuilder Systems is a leading software provider focused exclusively on the homebuilding industry. Its comprehensive suite of software solutions supports production and accounting, new home sales and marketing, home warranty and service, and homebuilder website solutions. The organization provides integrated information-management solutions designed specifically for homebuilders.

NX is a modern enterprise resource planning (ERP) solution for homebuilders, designed to support production and accounting operations while helping customers scale their businesses, integrate systems, and improve business insights.


The Position

We are looking for a Senior Database Performance Engineer to join the NX R&D team.

The successful candidate will take a hands-on role in analyzing, troubleshooting, and improving the performance of enterprise applications, with a strong focus on Microsoft SQL Server. The role requires someone who can investigate performance issues across the application stack and identify whether bottlenecks originate within the database, application, IIS, or underlying Windows environment.

The ideal candidate will have strong SQL Server performance-engineering expertise and experience taking ownership of performance analysis and optimization initiatives. The hired candidate will work from the Contour Software Karachi office as an extension of the division-based R&D team, with working-hours availability until 3:00 PM Eastern Time.


Responsibilities

  • Own and drive database and application performance analysis and optimization initiatives.
  • Diagnose and resolve SQL Server performance bottlenecks involving complex queries, stored procedures, and database workloads.
  • Analyze SQL Server execution plans and recommend appropriate indexing and query optimization strategies.
  • Diagnose issues involving statistics, parameter sniffing, blocking, and deadlocks.
  • Use Query Store, Extended Events, Dynamic Management Views (DMVs), and wait statistics to identify and troubleshoot database performance problems.
  • Design, develop, and optimize complex T-SQL queries, stored procedures, functions, views, CTEs, and window functions.
  • Investigate IIS and Windows Server performance issues using application pools, worker-process CPU and memory utilization, IIS logs, failed-request tracing, and Performance Monitor.
  • Trace slow requests end-to-end using IIS logs, application logs, and Application Insights.
  • Determine whether performance bottlenecks originate within the application, database, or infrastructure layer.
  • Collaborate with developers, QA, and other technical team members to identify root causes and implement sustainable performance improvements.
  • Assist teams in establishing appropriate performance baselines and identifying opportunities for proactive optimization.
  • Document findings, recommendations, and changes resulting from performance investigations.
  • Work closely with both onshore and offshore team members to deliver high-quality solutions within agreed timelines.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • 4+ years of hands-on Microsoft SQL Server development, performance engineering, or DBA experience.
  • Hands-on experience with SQL Server 2022 or later.
  • Expert-level T-SQL, including complex queries, stored procedures, functions, views, CTEs, and window functions.
  • Strong understanding of SQL Server execution plans and query optimization.
  • Strong knowledge of indexing strategies, statistics, and database performance tuning.
  • Practical experience diagnosing parameter sniffing, blocking, and deadlocks.
  • Hands-on experience with Query Store, Extended Events, DMVs, and wait statistics.
  • Working knowledge of IIS and Windows Server diagnostics.
  • Experience with Application Insights and application-level performance troubleshooting.
  • Ability to trace an application request end-to-end and distinguish database-related bottlenecks from application-related issues.
  • Strong analytical and root-cause-analysis skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with geographically distributed development and QA teams.
  • Experience working with enterprise ERP or other large transactional systems would be an asset.
  • Homebuilding-domain experience would be an advantage.

title: SUE Technician III
description:
Overview

Colliers Engineering & Design is seeking a SUE Technician III based in our Fort Lauderdale or Miami, FL office(s)!


Subsurface Utility Engineering (SUE) is a branch of engineering that deals with mitigating risks associated with new infrastructure design and construction. We work closely with engineers and utility owners to help identify utility conflicts using an array of technologies, including electromagnetic line locators, ground penetrating radar, GPS, conventional survey and vacuum excavation. Our work requires a high level of precision and technical ability.


Help power our future! Join our Utilities/Energy team of design professionals who provide a host of services that include feasibility studies, detailed engineering design, surveying, permitting, land acquisition, asset management, SUE, construction management, and more for renewable energy, oil and gas, electric transmission and distribution, electric substations and projects. Committed to delivering safe and sustainable solutions, let Collier’s Engineering & Design accelerate YOUR success!


Responsibilities

  • Work with a team of talented individuals to help tackle a wide variety of projects.
  • Read and interpret utility records, as-built and survey drawings and highway design plans.
  • Designate existing utilities using electromagnetic and geophysical technologies.
  • Operate and drive a vacuum excavation truck and perform test holes to expose utilities.
  • Utilize appropriate maintenance of traffic.
  • Call “One-Call” tickets.
  • Coordinate survey work in relation with SUE.
  • Supervise activities of field crew.
  • Train junior crew members.
  • Represent Colliers in the field and communicate/coordinate with utility companies.

Qualifications

  • Minimum 5 year experience providing utility designating/locating services.
  • Must be able to quickly grasp new technologies.
  • Should have basic computer skills and be able to learn and understand new software.
  • Need to have a high level of reading comprehension and communication skills.
  • Should enjoy working outdoors in a variety of weather conditions.
  • Need to be able to occasionally travel out of town and work overtime.
  • Should be able to walk long distances of several miles daily.
  • Will sometimes be lifting heavy equipment up to 80 lbs.
  • Need to have good driving skills and a clean driving record.
  • Must prioritize the safety of yourself and others.
  • Ability to read, write and understand English for purposes of comprehending written job-related communications and verbal instructions and interactions.

Requires a pre-employment drug screen and will require ongoing participation in the employer's random drug and alcohol testing program.


What We Offer

At Colliers Engineering & Design, our people are our most important resource. That’s why we are committed to providing all our employees with a safe, comfortable work environment, potential for career advancement, and the ability to impact society through their projects as well as Company sponsored activities.


This dedication begins with supporting a work life balance through a generous compensation package that includes: company paid medical, dental, and vision coverage; paid pregnancy disability leave; short- and long-term disability insurance; life insurance; a company-matched 401(k)/Roth; paid time off that includes parental and military leave; employee referral and professional license bonuses and a straight time policy that compensates exempt employees for billable hours worked in excess of 40 billable hours within a work week


We have also created an internal culture that provides the resources and technology needed to encourage personal and professional growth opportunities through reimbursement for education; a free in-house resource for hundreds of educational and self-enrichment courses; mentorship program; wellness program; Women’s Organization and ongoing philanthropic opportunities.


Apply today to learn how you can join our team of professionals, so we can help you Accelerate Your Success!

title: PRN Crisis Stabilization Clinician
description:
About Paragon Behavioral Health Connections


Paragon Behavioral Health Connections is a comprehensive behavioral health organization on a mission to positively impact individuals and families through compassionate, and client-centered care. Our mission is to deliver personalized care that uplifts our clients and builds supportive connections in communities. Through community based or
in-home services, and digital solutions as needed, we meet clients where they are—both physically and emotionally—to provide the right support at the right time. Serving communities across Colorado, we deliver equitable and creative “one-stop” behavioral health services—providing in-home mental health and substance use treatment, crisis stabilization, early childhood support, intensive outpatient programs, assertive community treatment, medication management, wrap around support and more. We believe care should meet people where they are, both physically and emotionally. Our approach is rooted in understanding, respect, innovation, and community collaboration.

Our vision is to empower individuals and families with complex needs, helping them overcome challenges, build essential skills, and access the resources necessary to achieve long-term well-being. We offer a wide range of services, including step-down care from inpatient hospitalization for youth and adults, comprehensive support for children and families, and specialized treatment for adults facing depression, trauma, substance use, and other mental health needs.

Our programming includes intensive care management supports for families and adults, Crisis Stabilization programming, Assertive Community Treatment (ACT) for individuals diagnosed with serious mental illness, Child First for young children and caregivers, integrated co-occurring Intensive Outpatient treatment, individual and family therapy, medication management (including MAT), peer support, supported employment/housing, and holistic recovery services for mental health and substance use disorders.



Why Work With Paragon


  • Statewide Reach - Deliver care where it’s needed most. We’re not region-limited—serve communities across Colorado, including rural and frontier areas with limited access to care.
  • Flexibility & Work–Life Balance - Own your schedule. Partner with families to set visit times that work for them (and you), so you can enjoy Colorado’s trails, slopes, and sunshine during off-peak hours.
  • Clinical Leadership & Support - Clinicians lead here. Our executive team includes licensed providers who shape business decisions with a care-first lens. We provide licensure supervision and regular consultation to support your growth as a clinician.
  • Comprehensive, Company-Paid Benefits - We cover health, dental, vision, short- and long-term disability, and life insurance—company-paid—so there are no premium deductions from your paycheck. Keep your full salary and your peace of mind.
  • Career Growth Opportunities - Grow with us. Explore new modalities and specializations and advance into leadership as we expand statewide.



Position Overview
We are currently seeking licensed therapists and social workers, as well as those pursuing licensure in Colorado, to join our multidisciplinary crisis stabilization team. As a Crisis Stabilization Clinician at Paragon BHC, you will be responsible for providing urgent behavioral health interventions to individuals under mental health holds and those requiring support as they transition back into the community. This team will also facilitate crisis stabilization programming using an evidenced based model. This team will transition clients to ongoing services that are conducted by our in-home clinical teams as appropriate. In this position you will work as part of a multidisciplinary team and will serve as a team leader. This position will report to a licensed clinical supervisor of the acute crisis stabilization team. This position requires in-person presence, but residing in nearby towns is acceptable.


Key Responsibilities
• Assess urgent behavioral health needs, safety issues, and risk factors for clients and families.
• Develop well-integrated clinical formulations and safety plans in collaboration with the multidisciplinary team.
• Provide crisis stabilization interventions, mental health holds, substance use interventions, and other evidence-based therapies tailored to individual needs.
• Collaborate with law enforcement, emergency responders, hospitals, and community organizations to address safety and crisis response needs.
• Utilize Brief Cognitive Behavioral Therapy interventions for suicide prevention, and other evidence-based modalities.
• Ensure accurate and timely documentation for clinical accountability, patient safety, regulatory compliance, and reimbursement.
• Participate in Crisis Prevention and Intervention training and respond to behavioral health emergencies as needed.
• Engage in reflective clinical supervision and other professional development activities.


Qualifications
• Master’s degree in Counseling, Social Work, or related field.
• Colorado licensure or eligibility for licensure (LCSW, LPC, LMFT, licensed clinical psychologist, or equivalent).
• Experience working with culturally diverse individuals and families, trauma, group facilitation, and crisis stabilization supports.
• Knowledge and experience in mental health and substance use assessments and consultation.
• Ability to provide interventions within diverse home and community settings.
• Strong written and oral communication skills.
• Familiarity with HIPAA, 42 CFR, protected health information, and confidentiality.
• Commitment to the organization's mission, vision, and goals.
• Ability to speak a second language (Spanish, ASL or other), highly valued.


Education:
• Has a confirmed master’s degree in counseling, social work, or related field while working towards clinical licensure. Supervision is provided. Master’s or Doctoral level mental health provider (e.g., LCSW, LMFT, LPC, licensed clinical psychologist, other) is preferred.
Additional Requirements/Licenses/Certifications:
• Licensed or licensed-eligible (must be able to obtain a preliminary license within six months of employment)
• All licenses must stay up-to-date and valid during employment.
• A valid driver’s license and proof of automobile insurance are required.


Schedule:

  • Two 24 hour shifts as needed
  • Active working hours: 9am-9pm
  • During this time, team members are expected to actively perform their assigned duties
  • Standby hours: 9pm-9am
  • During standby hours, team members should be available to respond to crisis calls as required


Paragon is an equal opportunity employer and encourages individuals with diverse backgrounds and experiences to apply, including those with criminal records. Traveling to clients' homes and communities is a requirement of this role; please indicate your comfort level by providing in-home services in your application.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer - France
description:

The mission of Neural Concept’s Forward Deployed Engineering team is to help our customers solve their most complex engineering challenges. As a key player in the Forward Deployed Engineering Team, your mission will be to help industry leaders to redefine their product design workflow with cutting-edge technologies. Who you are

What You Get

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and we're committed to building a diverse and inclusive environment where you can thrive.

title: Senior Vice President, Business Valuation - Valuation Advisory
description:
At Stout, we’re dedicated to exceeding expectations in all we do – we call it Relentless Excellence ®. Both our client service and culture are second to none, stemming from our firmwide embrace of our core values: Positive and Team-Oriented, Accountable, Committed, Relationship-Focused, Super-Responsive, and being Great communicators. Sound like a place you can grow and succeed? Read on to learn more about an exciting opportunity to join our team.

Stout's Valuation Advisory professionals help clients gain confidence by bringing clarity to complex financial and valuation matters. As part of our Business Valuation and Litigation Support Group, you will play a leadership role in delivering sophisticated financial analyses and valuation opinions across a broad range of industries and complex disputes. This includes commercial litigation, transaction-related matters, and family law and marital dissolution engagements, where Stout operates one of the largest and most experienced practices in the country.

Impact You'll Make

As a Senior Vice President, you will lead complex valuation and litigation support engagements, serve as a trusted advisor to clients and legal counsel, and provide technical direction to engagement teams. You will oversee sophisticated financial analyses, develop defensible valuation conclusions, and contribute to expert reports and testimony preparation for matters involving mediation, arbitration, and trial.


This role offers the opportunity to take significant ownership of client relationships, engagement execution, and team development while working on high-stakes financial disputes, including commercial litigation and marital dissolution matters involving closely held businesses, high-net-worth individuals, and complex financial structures. You will also contribute to the continued growth of the practice through relationship development, business development activities, and collaboration with senior leadership.

What You'll Do

  • Lead and manage complex business valuation and litigation support engagements, overseeing technical analyses, engagement strategy, deliverables, budgets, and timelines.
  • Direct the valuation of businesses and entities using accepted methodologies, including discounted cash flow analyses, capitalization of earnings, and market-based approaches involving comparable companies and transactions.
  • Oversee analyses related to merger and acquisition transactions, purchase price allocations, stock option valuations, and complex financial instruments, including carried interest, deferred compensation, and other assets relevant to marital dissolution matters.
  • Lead valuation assignments involving closely held businesses, partnerships, and professional practices, including the evaluation of personal versus enterprise goodwill.
  • Direct sophisticated income analyses, financial tracing, and separate versus marital/community property tracing assignments in litigation contexts.
  • Oversee forensic accounting analyses involving cash flow and lifestyle, unreported income, hidden assets, asset dissipation, fraudulent transfers, and other complex financial matters.
  • Review and develop comprehensive valuation reports, expert analyses, and supporting documentation for use in settlement negotiations, mediation, arbitration, depositions, and trial proceedings.
  • Work directly with clients, attorneys, and other advisors to evaluate financial issues, develop analytical approaches, communicate findings, and support dispute resolution strategies.
  • Support expert witness engagements through the development and review of analyses, preparation of exhibits, and coordination with testifying experts. Provide deposition or trial testimony when appropriately qualified and designated.
  • Oversee company, industry, and economic research to support valuation conclusions, financial opinions, and litigation strategies.
  • Manage multiple concurrent engagements, including resource allocation, financial performance, quality control, and adherence to deadlines.
  • Provide technical guidance, coaching, and mentorship to junior professionals while promoting accountability, collaboration, and consistent work quality.
  • Build and maintain relationships with clients, family law attorneys, commercial litigators, referral sources, and other professional advisors.
  • Partner with Managing Directors and other senior leaders to identify business development opportunities, prepare proposals, expand client relationships, and support the continued growth of the practice.
  • Use AI-enabled tools and emerging technologies to improve research, analytical processes, deliverable preparation, and overall engagement efficiency while maintaining appropriate professional judgment and quality standards.

What You Bring

  • 7+ years of relevant professional experience in business valuation, litigation support, forensic accounting, financial advisory, or a related field, with demonstrated experience managing complex engagements and delivering client-facing work.
  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related discipline.
  • Advanced knowledge of financial theory, valuation methodologies, economics, and accounting principles, with the ability to apply technical concepts to complex financial disputes.
  • Demonstrated experience performing and reviewing business valuations, financial analyses, and litigation support work, including the development of defensible conclusions and written reports.
  • Strong project management capabilities, including experience overseeing multiple engagements, managing deadlines, and coordinating team resources.
  • Ability to independently evaluate complex financial information, identify relevant issues, and develop sound analytical approaches.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting complex financial concepts and findings to clients, legal counsel, and senior stakeholders.
  • Strong professional judgment, attention to detail, and commitment to technical accuracy and high-quality deliverables.
  • Proven ability to supervise, mentor, and develop junior professionals while maintaining accountability for engagement results.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional presence, with the ability to establish credibility and build lasting relationships with clients, attorneys, and internal teams.
  • Commercial awareness and an interest in contributing to business development, client relationship management, and practice growth.
  • Experience supporting litigation engagements involving business valuation, forensic accounting, economic damages, fraud analysis, or family law matters is strongly preferred.
  • Experience with marital dissolution matters involving business interests, complex compensation structures, income analysis, or marital/community property tracing is preferred.
  • Professional credentials such as ABV, CVA, CPA, CFA, or CFE are preferred.

title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Robot Evaluation Operations, Robot Evaluation Operations
description:
Fauna Robotics is building capable, safe, and delightful robots for everyday life. Before a new skill reaches a customer’s home, we need to know how well it works: how often it succeeds, how fast it is, and where it fails, across the range of homes and conditions our customers live in. We are hiring a Senior Technical Program Manager to run the operation that produces that evidence.

In this role, you will own robot evaluation operations end to end, in lab and home environments. Our scientists define what to measure; you make it happen at scale, on schedule, and with results the team can trust. You will turn evaluation requests from science and engineering into planned campaigns, keep robots, test environments, and operators ready, and deliver results that leaders use to decide what ships. You will treat evaluation as a production operation with measurable output, not a support function.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the evaluation program from intake to results: take requests from science and engineering teams, prioritize them against shared robot and lab capacity, and publish the campaign schedule

- Run evaluation campaigns in lab and home environments, with clear entry and exit criteria and standard run procedures

- Build and maintain the physical test environments: home-like lab setups, object and fixture inventories, scene resets, and versioned configurations so results stay comparable across software releases and robot hardware revisions

- Stand up in-home evaluation operations with legal, privacy, safety, and research partners, including scheduling, data handling, and on-site safety procedures

- Direct the work of evaluation operators and vendor teams: training and certification, shift coverage, and scoring standards that stay consistent across raters and sites

- Partner with hardware and fleet teams on robot availability for testing, including maintenance windows, repairs, and per-unit acceptance runs

- Enforce logging and traceability standards so every evaluation trial is reproducible and accounted for

- Deliver results as a product: standard scorecards and dashboards, triage of failures to the right owning team, and evidence that feeds launch and release go/no-go decisions

- Track throughput, valid-trial yield, cost per trial, and turnaround time, own the evaluation budget, and identify manual evaluations that are ready for automation or simulation

- Present evaluation status, risks, and tradeoffs to senior leadership, and say “not yet” when demand exceeds capacity

About the team
Fauna Robotics, an Amazon company, is building capable, safe, and genuinely delightful robots for everyday life. Our goal is simple: make robots people actually want to live and interact with in everyday human spaces.

We believe that future won’t arrive until building for robotics becomes far more accessible. Today, too much effort is spent reinventing the fundamentals. We’re changing that by developing tightly integrated hardware and software systems that make it faster, safer, and more intuitive to create real-world robotic products.

Our work spans the full stack: mechanical design, control systems, dynamic modeling, and intelligent software. The focus is not just functionality, but experience. We’re building robots that feel responsive, expressive, and genuinely useful.

At Fauna, you’ll work at the frontier of this space, helping define how robots move, manipulate, and interact with people in natural environments. It’s an opportunity to solve hard problems across hardware and software with a team focused on making robotics accessible and joyful to build.

If you care about making robotics real for everyone and building systems that are as delightful as they are capable, we’re interested in hearing from you.

This role provides leadership across the full project lifecycle, from early project development, scope definition, estimating, engineering, and contracting through construction, commissioning, turnover, and commercial operation.

The role requires demonstrated experience managing complex project organizations and leading leaders and multidisciplinary teams responsible for engineering, construction, project controls, commercial management, and project delivery.

A key focus of this position is the successful management of Engineering, Procurement and Construction (EPC) firms, engineering consultants, original equipment manufacturers (OEMs), contractors, and other major external partners. The Director will establish clear expectations for safety, schedule, cost, quality, risk, commercial performance, and project execution.

Experience delivering combined-cycle gas turbine (CCGT) generation projects or similar large-scale power generation, energy infrastructure, industrial, or utility construction projects is strongly preferred.

The Director will collaborate extensively with engineering, project controls, supply chain, environmental, regulatory, finance, operations, construction, legal, commercial, and customer-facing organizations to ensure projects meet business and customer objectives.

This position requires a highly experienced, proactive leader with strong construction, commercial, technical, and project execution capabilities who can operate effectively in a fast-paced environment with significant capital investment, executive visibility, customer commitments, and schedule requirements.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Business, Project Management, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Significant progressive experience leading major capital projects, power infrastructure, generation, utility, industrial, or large complex construction projects.
  • Demonstrated experience managing large-scale, complex capital projects and/or mega projects through multiple phases of the project lifecycle.
  • Demonstrated experience leading leaders, project managers, construction leaders, and/or multidisciplinary project organizations.
  • Significant experience managing EPC firms, engineering firms, construction contractors, and other major external partners.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage project scope, schedule, cost, risk, quality, contracts, change management, and project controls.
  • Demonstrated experience leading major capital projects generally $500 million or greater.
  • Experience managing significant capital budgets and communicating project status, risks, and recommendations to senior executives.
  • Strong commercial and contractual capability, including experience managing contractor performance, contract changes, claims, and negotiations.
  • Strong leadership, communication, business judgment, and stakeholder-management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading combined-cycle gas turbine (CCGT) projects, including new-build generation, major expansions, or similarly complex power generation projects.
  • Experience delivering power infrastructure supporting data centers, large-load customers, advanced manufacturing, or other energy-intensive customers.
  • Experience with gas turbine, steam turbine, heat recovery steam generator (HRSG), balance-of-plant, electrical infrastructure, transmission/interconnection, commissioning, and startup.
  • Experience managing projects delivered through EPC, EPCM, multi-prime, or other complex contracting models.
  • Demonstrated successful leadership of one or more $1 billion+ power generation, utility, or heavy industrial capital projects.
  • Utility or independent power producer experience.
  • Experience working in a regulated utility environment and supporting major capital project regulatory proceedings.
  • PMP certification or equivalent project/program management credential.

Leadership Expectations

The successful candidate will be an experienced major-project leader who can operate effectively at both the strategic and execution levels. This individual must be comfortable leading other leaders, challenging EPC partners, making high-value project decisions, managing competing priorities, and communicating complex project issues to executive leadership.

The Director will foster a culture of safety, accountability, disciplined execution, collaboration, transparency, and continuous improvement while developing a high-performing team capable of delivering major infrastructure investments.

title: Senior Brand Designer
description:
About Glow

Glow is on a mission to transform how enterprises proactively protect the modern endpoint with an agentic-first approach. Our platform gives security teams the visibility, context, and autonomous remediation they've never had before — across every endpoint, application, and AI tool in the environment. We move fast, we build things that matter, and we believe security should be a force multiplier for the business, not a bottleneck. Let's Glow.

About the Role …

We're looking for a Senior Brand Designer to join as the first dedicated brand hire, working directly with our Creative Director to shape how Glow looks, feels, and scales. You won't be inheriting a finished system. You'll help build it, and then help it evolve. This is a hands-on role for someone who wants real ownership and is equally comfortable setting direction and executing the details.

What You’ll Do …

  • Own brand design end to end, from concept through execution, across digital and physical touchpoints

  • Help establish Glow's design system, including tokens, components, templates, and guidelines, so the brand holds together as the company grows

  • Contribute to the evolution of Glow's visual identity: typography, color, imagery, illustration, iconography, motion

  • Play a core role in Glow's rebrand, from audit and exploration through rollout

  • Develop campaign and launch-specific graphic languages that flex within the core brand

  • Partner with marketing, product, and leadership to turn briefs into strong visual concepts

  • Use emerging tools, including AI, to prototype, iterate, and improve how we work

  • Present your thinking clearly and contribute to critique and creative direction

What you’ll bring …

  • 5+ years of brand or visual design experience, in-house or agency

  • A portfolio showing strong craft, typography, and conceptual range

  • Hands-on experience building or scaling a design system, in Figma or similar

  • Direct experience on a rebrand or major brand evolution

  • A forward-looking point of view on where brand and design are headed

  • Comfort being the first or one of the only designers, with high autonomy and little hand-holding

  • Strong communication skills and a collaborative, low-ego working style

Even better if you also bring …

  • Motion or video experience

  • Experience at a high-growth startup, ideally in tech or security

  • Familiarity with working alongside product design or front-end teams

At Glow, we believe our greatest strength is our people. We're committed to building an inclusive workplace where every team member feels welcomed, respected, and empowered to do their best work. We know that diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives make us stronger as a company and better partners to our customers.

Glow is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an environment free from discrimination and harassment. We make all employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

title: Infra Delivery Technician
description:
Transform network infrastructure by joining our dynamic team! You'll be at the forefront of developing innovative solutions that drive network stability and scalability, using your technical expertise to create automated systems that power global technological advancement.

Infra Delivery Install Technicians will collaborate with cross-functional teams, troubleshoot complex technical scenarios, and implement strategic solutions that keep our network running seamlessly. Expect to engage in hands-on technical work that requires creativity, precision, and a passion for technological innovation.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we're looking for talented people who want to help.

You'll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

Key job responsibilities
- Moving and implementing large enterprise equipment
- Installing Fiber and Copper cabling and patching cabling between equipment
- Ensuring proper safety and security standards are maintained during cabling and rack installation
- Following well established hardware installation procedures and break-fix activities
- Safely using material handling tools and equipment
- Traveling within and outside of the regional work area is required. You will be responsible for having a reliable personal vehicle and valid driver's license to travel within the regional work area, as company transportation will not be provided

Physical Requirements:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 40 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 41+ pounds
- Ability to work in an environment that operates 24/7 with an ability to participate in primary responder rotation and provide after-hours support as needed
- Working in cramped and/or elevated and/or noisy environments
- Bending, lifting, stretching, reaching, standing and walking for up to 8+ hours a day
- Ascending and descending ladders, stairs, and gangways safely and without limitation

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

About the Role

Fieldguide is looking for a Customer Data Operations Analyst to help build and operationalize the data foundation that connects how customers use Fieldguide with how we measure, understand, and communicate the value they receive from the platform.

This role will sit at the intersection of Customer Success, Product, Data Science, and GTM Operations, translating real-world customer needs into scalable data models, trusted reporting, and actionable insights. The role will combine strong SQL and analytics capabilities with hands-on data modeling and reporting, ensuring customer data is accurate, accessible, and built to scale.

While this role will participate in select customer meetings, QBRs, and onsite engagements to understand reporting requirements firsthand, the majority of the role will be hands-on—developing and customizing reports, querying and validating data, building and maintaining data models, and addressing gaps in the underlying data infrastructure. You will then partner with Product and Data Science to ensure the right information is captured, structured, validated, and surfaced consistently.

The goal is to create a trusted customer data foundation that enables Fieldguide and its customers to answer critical questions around product adoption, engagement, efficiency, time savings, ROI, value realization, and business outcomes.

What You'll Own

Customer Data Reporting & Insights

  • Own the development and customization of customer-facing reports and dashboards, translating customer requirements into accurate and actionable reporting.

  • Use SQL and existing data infrastructure to investigate customer questions, validate reported metrics, and resolve discrepancies.

  • Build scalable reporting solutions that can be reused across customers, service lines, and engagement types.

  • Partner with Customer Success to support data-driven QBRs, executive business reviews, renewals, and value realization conversations.

  • Identify where customer-specific reporting requests reveal broader gaps in Fieldguide's underlying data models or product reporting capabilities.

  • Work with Product and Data Science to move frequently requested reporting from manual/custom analysis toward standardized and productized capabilities

Data Modeling & Analytics

  • Develop and maintain scalable data models that support customer reporting, QBRs, value realization, and product analytics.

  • Write advanced SQL to extract, transform, validate, and analyze customer and product data across multiple data sources.

  • Build and maintain data models and transformations to create reliable, reusable downstream datasets.

  • Identify gaps in existing data models and address legacy data quality, modeling, and structural issues that impact reporting accuracy.

  • Translate recurring one-off reporting requirements into standardized, scalable data models and reporting infrastructure.

  • Partner with Data Science and Data Engineering to determine when customer reporting requirements should be addressed through analytics, data modeling, upstream product instrumentation, or broader infrastructure changes.

  • Establish reusable datasets and semantic definitions that enable consistent reporting across customers rather than recreating logic for individual accounts.

  • Reduce manual and one-off reporting by identifying opportunities for automation and standardized reporting.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means Fieldguide has a trusted, scalable customer data foundation rather than relying on fragmented or one-off analysis.

  • Customer-facing metrics have clear definitions, sources, methodologies, and owners.

  • Customer teams can confidently use data in QBRs and executive conversations.

  • Product usage and customer outcomes can be connected to measurable value.

  • Data discrepancies are identified and addressed at their source.

  • Customer feedback systematically informs Product and Data priorities.

  • Recurring customer data requests become standardized and automated where possible.

  • Fieldguide can increasingly demonstrate defensible ROI and value realization.

  • Customer reporting becomes consistent across QBRs, renewals, and strategic engagements.

  • Product and Data teams have a clear understanding of the information customers need from Fieldguide.

What We're Looking For

  • 2+ years of experience in Data Analytics, Analytics Engineering, Data Operations, Business Intelligence, Customer Analytics, or a related technical data role.

  • Advanced SQL skills with demonstrated experience querying, transforming, validating, and troubleshooting complex datasets.

  • Strong understanding of dimensional data modeling, data transformations, metric definitions, and analytics architecture.

  • Strong understanding of data quality, validation, governance, and operational workflows.

  • Ability to translate business and customer questions into structured data requirements.

  • Strong analytical skills and comfort working with large or complex datasets.

  • Experience creating dashboards, reports, and executive-level data narratives.

  • Excellent communication skills, particularly the ability to translate between technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to Have

  • Experience at a B2B SaaS or enterprise software company.

  • Hands-on experience with dbt, including building, maintaining, testing, and documenting scalable data models.

  • Experience supporting Customer Success, QBRs, value realization, or customer analytics.

  • Familiarity with audit, advisory, accounting, or professional services workflows.

  • Experience working with product telemetry and customer usage data.

  • Experience partnering directly with Data Science or Analytics Engineering teams.

More about Fieldguide:

Fieldguide is a values-based company. Our values are:

  • Fearless - Inspire & break down seemingly impossible walls.

  • Fast - Launch fast with excellence, iterate to perfection.

  • Lovable - Deliver happiness & 11 star experiences.

  • Owners - Execute & run the business with ownership.

  • Win-win - Create mutual value & earn trust for life.

  • Inclusive - Scale the best ideas with inclusive teams.

Some of our benefits include:

  • Competitive compensation packages with meaningful ownership

  • Flexible PTO

  • 401k

  • Wellness benefits

  • Technology & Work from Home reimbursement

  • Flexible work schedules
