title: Regional Director, Forward Deployed Engineering - Public Sector
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

REGIONAL DIRECTOR, FORWARD DEPLOYED ENGINEERING - PUBLIC SECTOR

Our Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) don't advise from the sidelines. They embed with customer teams, build production-grade AI coding workflows alongside them, and leave behind habits that keep paying off after the engagement ends. As Regional Director, you'll lead and scale this team across our most important public sector customers, own engagements from technical discovery through delivery, and build the partner track that extends this work through GSIs and consulting firms. Success is measured by what's different in a customer's org at day 30, not by what got shipped.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Build and lead a team of FDEs in your region: hire, set clear technical performance standards and career paths, and coach the team on scoping and delivery of FDE engagements

  • Own scoping for PubSec FDE projects: run discovery and architecture reviews, surface integration and infrastructure constraints, and turn ambiguous customer problems into time-boxed proposals with clear ROI for six- and seven-figure engagements.

  • Hold the delivery quality bar across your team's engagements: tight scoping, milestone tracking, technical standards, and clean handoffs to customer engineering teams.

  • Serve as executive technical sponsor and primary customer point of contact on your region's highest-priority engagements, owning delivery and the relationship from IC engineers to the C-suite, and stepping in directly where the stakes are highest.

  • Generate a product feedback loop with Product and Engineering with enough detail to drive roadmap decisions, and turn what works into reusable solutions and product surface areas for all customers.

  • Contribute to the launch and scaling of the PubSec partner FDE track: train and enable GSI and consulting partners, and hold them to the same quality bar as the in-house team.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience directly managing a team of engineers who build and ship production software

  • Professional software development experience in Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript

  • Experience building and deploying AI-powered workflows in production environments

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • U.S. citizenship required. Active security clearance (Public Trust, Secret, Top Secret, or TS/SCI) or ability to obtain one.

  • Leadership experience in forward deployed engineering, data science, machine learning engineering or software engineering

  • Debugging model failures in production AI systems

  • Scoping six- and seven-figure technical engagements with Sales and presenting them to C-suite and engineering leadership buyers

  • Enabling GSI or consulting partners to deliver technical engagements

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

Annual Salary:

$350,000 - $400,000 USD

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.

title: Junior Product Manager (UK Based)
description:
About Kyra

Kyra is an enterprise influencer marketing platform working with brands like SharkNinja, Coach, H&M, Ray-Ban, and Converse. Our platform manages the full lifecycle — creator discovery, campaign management, content review, payments, analytics, and AI-powered intelligence across TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube.

Why this role exists

To run campaigns at scale, Kyra has built its own end-to-end software. It covers everything from the brief and brand approval of creators to contracting and paying creators. This role exists to keep that software improving every day: turning input into clear specs, fixing issues quickly, and shipping features that make campaigns run better.

You'll sit in the product team and work directly with our Heads of Product and Tech, supporting several product features at once and helping build and release features on a daily basis. Focus areas change regularly. If that sounds energising rather than stressful, keep reading.

Who you are

You're early in your product career and serious about doing the work well. You have 1–2 years' hands-on experience as part of an in-house product team. Side projects are a bonus on top of that. You're AI-native: you build with Claude, Codex or similar tools every day, you know where they help and where they get it wrong, and you have something you've built with AI that you can show us.

You've done most of the following in a real team:

  • Bug reporting and issue tracking

  • User testing or UAT

  • Writing tickets (user stories and acceptance criteria)

  • Basic scope planning

  • Working in an agile team

You're comfortable building with Claude and Codex, and you write and speak English to a high professional standard.

What you'll do

💭 Turn real problems into shippable work

  • Partner with the Heads of Product and Tech to translate user needs, support signals and business goals into clear product requirements.

  • Shape well-defined problems before solutions are committed.

  • Use AI tools to prototype, spec and test ideas quickly, so the team sees working examples, not just documents.

🔍 Own the details that make delivery work

  • Triage bugs and support issues, assess impact, and drive them through to resolution.

  • Track progress and follow up until work is done. No loose ends.

🤝 Be the glue across teams

  • Work with all user types across the company, from campaign managers to legal, and from finance to client services.

  • Communicate context clearly, listen closely, and make sure decisions are understood by everyone involved.

🚀 Ship fast, without cutting corners

  • Support QA and UAT across devices, markets and use cases.

  • Flag risks and trade-offs early to avoid costly rework.

  • Help releases go out daily while holding a high quality bar.

📚 Learn from what ships

  • Follow features into production.

  • Monitor support trends, usage signals and qualitative feedback.

  • Bring insights and recommendations that shape iteration and prioritisation.

How you show up

  • Customer-first by default. You care about solving real problems.

  • Hungry to learn and grow into the role. You go and find the answer before being asked.

  • Comfortable with ambiguity and shifting priorities, and you bring structure to messy situations.

  • You think logically, communicate clearly, and see work through to completion.

Nice to have (not deal breakers)

  • Coursework or qualifications in product, design thinking, business or agile methods (e.g. Scrum).

  • Experience in fast-moving product teams, media companies or scale-ups.

How we hire

We keep the process short and practical. We read every application closely (the screening questions matter more than the CV design). Shortlisted candidates have one intro call, a short practical task where you build or spec something using AI, and a final conversation with our Heads of Product and Tech. We share feedback within 5 working days at each stage, and we tell you what we're paying upfront. The role has a standard probation period.

Benefits

  • 🌎 Remote-first: work from wherever you do your best work (within ~3 hours of UK time)

  • 🌴 25 days PTO + bank holidays, 3 wellness days and paid sick leave

  • 📚 Annual Learning and Development budget

  • 💰 Annual bonus scheme to recognise great work

AI is core to how we operate. Use it to elevate your work, but everything in your application should reflect your own judgement and experience.

📩 Sound like you? We'd love to hear from early-career product people who want to ship real work every day and grow fast with us.

💟 Support

If you have a condition or require an adjustment to our interview process - please let us know so we can make adjustments to support you. Please note that when you submit an application or resume, your data will be processed in line with our privacy policy.

title: Head of Platform Engineering
description:
About Plaud Inc.

Plaud is building the real-world AI interface for professionals to amplify intelligence, elevate productivity and performance, loved by over 3,000,000 users worldwide since 2023. With a mission to amplify human intelligence, Plaud captures, structures, and compounds the intelligence generated in conversations — so humans can think better, decide faster, and execute with clarity.

Plaud Inc. is a Delaware-incorporated, San Francisco-based company. With GDPR, SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA, and EN 18031 compliance, Plaud is committed to the highest standards of data security and privacy protection.

To learn more about Plaud, please visit and follow along on Instagram, X, Facebook, LinkedIn, and YouTube.

Why You Should Join Us

Plaud is building the next generation intelligence infrastructure and interfaces to capture, extract, and utilize intelligence from what people say, hear, see, and think.

  • Plaud is a bootstrapped, skyrocketing, profitable company with a $300M revenue run rate achieved in just three years.

  • Define the next-gen paradigm for human-AI interaction.

  • Gain exposure to cutting-edge AI for Pro tools and play a direct role in our global expansion.

  • Work with passionate teammates who value innovation, collaboration, and customer success.

  • Grow your career in a culture that champions continuous learning and fast career development.

  • Market-competitive compensation, global exposure, and a vibrant, creativity-fueled work atmosphere.

Plaud's Platform team builds the shared services every product team relies on: sign-in and enterprise single sign-on, user permissions, integrations with other apps, our public API, billing and payments, file storage and sync, the common app framework and design system, internal support tools, and search. You would lead the team across the US and Asia, and build the enterprise foundations that take a $300M consumer business upmarket.

What you will do

  • Define and drive the strategy for Plaud's Platform Engineering organization, with teams in the US and Asia. Platform builds each shared service once and runs it as a product for the teams that use it.

  • Lead the teams that own: sign-in and access control (SSO/SAML, OAuth, SCIM, MFA, roles and permissions, audit logs), integrations with third-party apps, the public API and developer tools (API, CLI, MCP), billing and payments, file storage and sync, the shared app framework (design system, release process, feature flags, experiments), internal support and admin tools, and search.

  • Build the enterprise foundations Plaud needs to move upmarket: SSO, SCIM, fine-grained permissions, audit, and regional data residency with Infrastructure.

  • Run Platform as a product: every service has clear internal customers, a documented interface, dated commitments, and regular feedback from the teams that use it.

  • Gather requests from product teams each quarter and publish one Platform roadmap with dates the company can rely on.

  • Set engineering standards for shared systems, so other teams can contribute changes themselves with your design sign-off instead of waiting on you.

  • Lead a team spread across the US and Asia through written specs, a fixed daily overlap, and a close partnership with your lead architect in Asia.

  • Own reliability, SLOs and on-call for every Platform service, working with Infrastructure on production access and deployment pipelines.

  • Hire, mentor and grow senior engineers and team leads in the US and Asia, and over time bring billing and subscription logic into Platform.

Skills, qualifications and experience we look for

  • 12+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years leading platform or infrastructure-adjacent teams of 15+ engineers.

  • Proven track record building identity, permissions or API platforms for enterprise SaaS, such as SSO/SAML, SCIM, RBAC/ABAC, multi-tenant workspace models or public APIs.

  • Experience running an internal platform as a product, with clear interfaces, SLOs and customer feedback loops.

  • Demonstrated success leading distributed teams across the US and Asia.

  • Deep backend expertise in Go, Java or similar, with strong distributed systems and cloud-native architecture skills (AWS/GCP, Kubernetes).

  • Experience building under SOC 2, GDPR and HIPAA controls and supporting audits.

  • Experience with billing and entitlement systems (Stripe, Metronome or similar) is a plus.

  • Recognized technical influence through open-source contributions, conference talks or technical publications is a plus.

  • Routinely uses AI tools in daily work and can demo recent usage during the interview.

What we offer

  1. Meaningful Ownership An Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) that gives a real stake in Plaud’s long-term success.

  2. High-Impact Environment Work in a fast-moving, product-driven environment where your ideas directly shape the future of AI productivity.

  3. Cutting-Edge AI Tools for Productivity Access to best-in-class AI tools, including Gemini, Claude Code, and other frontier AI systems to maximize engineering and execution efficiency.

  4. Best-in-Class Equipment Choice of top-spec laptops, high-performance workstation setups, and cutting-edge Plaud devices for all new hires.

  5. Team & Culture Annual company offsites, team events, and a culture that values craftsmanship, ownership, and velocity.

Disclaimer: Plaud is and will continue to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

title: Lead Engineer, Critical Facility Operations
description:
Cerebras Systems builds the world's largest AI chip, 56 times larger than GPUs. This architecture allows Cerebras to deliver industry-leading training and inference speeds; over 10 times faster than GPU-based hyperscale cloud inference services.

This order of magnitude increase in speed is transforming the user experience of AI applications, unlocking real-time iteration and increasing intelligence via additional agentic computation.

Cerebras works with the leading model labs, global enterprises, and cutting-edge AI-native startups. OpenAI recently announced a multi-year partnership with Cerebras, to deploy 750 megawatts of scale, transforming key workloads with ultra high-speed inference.

The Role

Reporting to the Director of Critical Facility Operations, the Lead Engineer, Critical Facility Operations provides technical leadership and authority for the safe, reliable operation of Cerebras’ critical environments across our global footprint. This role combines extensive data center operating and engineering experience with deep expertise in critical cooling and environmental controls, including coolant distribution units (CDUs), and strong experience with data center mechanical and electrical infrastructure. This role will immediately support operational sites and coming builds, lead complex troubleshooting and turn their experience into program development and improvements in operations, availability and liaison with our product teams for end-to-end resilience and reliability.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as a technical escalation resource for physical infrastructure operational issues, partnering with site teams, lessors, equipment manufacturers and service providers, as well as internal partners.

  • Assess and troubleshoot CDUs and associated cooling systems, including flow, pressure, temperature, water quality, heat exchange, redundancy and facility-to-equipment interfaces.

  • Evaluate environmental monitoring and controls, including building management systems, electrical power monitoring, sensors, alarms, interlocks and sequences of operation.

  • Support electrical and mechanical incident response, lead technical investigation and root cause analysis, and develop corrective actions with clear verification criteria.

  • Review maintenance strategies, operating procedures and proposed changes for technical adequacy, operational risk and effects on redundancy.

  • Support commissioning and operational acceptance of new sites through review of test evidence, maintainability, controls performance, documentation and unresolved deficiencies.

  • Translate product requirements into operating limits and influence product improvements.

  • Work in partnership with CFOps program management on program development and maturity, providing technical expertise and validation (engineering approval).

  • Perform operational engineering assessments of prospective sites and provider proposals, identifying limitations in redundancy, maintainability, controls, recovery capability and contractual operating commitments.

  • Support development and maintenance of growing operational and engineering standards, approved operating limits and equipment-interface requirements, including electrical distribution, liquid cooling, and controls.

  • Partner with Product Engineering, EPC, Build & Deploy and equipment manufacturers to validate facility-to-product interfaces, investigate coupled failure modes, and translate operating experience into product and facility improvements.

  • Develop risk-based maintenance requirements and facility-spares recommendations; assess provider maintenance scopes and completed-work evidence for technical adequacy.

  • Define and witness appropriate functional, failover and recovery testing, verifying that control sequences, alarms and redundancy behave as intended under normal and degraded conditions.

  • Establish technical baselines and maintain accurate operating documentation, including system dependencies, approved settings, procedures and engineering deviations; assess fleet exposure to recurring defects and equipment obsolescence

  • Provide technical review and approval within delegated authority, escalate unacceptable risks, and require work to stop when conditions are unsafe or outside approved operating limits during delivery and/or operations.

How the role will grow

As our portfolio expands, this role will evolve and help grow the regional engineering operations program, team and scope, and has the opportunity to grow as an individual contributor or in a leadership position: setting technical operating practices, mentoring engineers and site teams, leading reliability improvement across sites, and contributing to global standards and future facility requirements. This role will involve heavy travel to sites in the first year of the role. Travel expectations, especially long-term are negotiable.

Team environment and culture

Cerebras is scaling at a tremendous pace and requires a team player who can handle a balance between driving maturity for the future and handling near-term ambiguity with a bias toward getting things done for the good of the team, with the goal of building and maturing the program over time into a resilient, effective and efficient operations organization. The ideal candidate will strike a balance between contributing, making sound decisions when needed, and providing data, information and clarity for others to make sound decisions, and be able to navigate between the three.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of relevant data center experience, with substantial responsibility for live, mission-critical environments.

  • Deep expertise in environmental controls, including hands-on experience with Coolant Distribution Units (CDUs) and data center cooling systems.

  • Strong practical understanding of data center electrical and mechanical infrastructure and how these systems interact.

  • Ability to assess interconnected systems, recognize technical limitations, and engage qualified specialists when needed.

  • Working knowledge of data center white space, including servers, storage, networking equipment, racks, and associated data hall infrastructure.

  • Proven experience leading technical incident response, root cause analysis (RCA), commissioning, or operational acceptance activities.

  • Engineering degree, relevant technical qualification, or equivalent practical experience.


Location:

Fully remote, with up to 50% travel required.

Why Join Cerebras

People who are serious about software make their own hardware. At Cerebras, we have built a breakthrough architecture that is unlocking new opportunities for the AI industry. With dozens of model releases and rapid growth, we’ve reached an inflection point in our business. Members of our team tell us there are five main reasons they joined Cerebras:

  1. Build a breakthrough AI platform beyond the constraints of the GPU.

  2. Publish and open source their cutting-edge AI research.

  3. Work on one of the fastest AI supercomputers in the world.

  4. Enjoy job stability with startup vitality.

  5. Our simple, non-corporate work culture that respects individual beliefs.

Find out more about what it's like to work at Cerebras here!

Apply today and become part of the forefront of groundbreaking advancements in AI!

Cerebras Systems is committed to creating an equal and diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate different backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We believe inclusive teams build better products and companies. We try every day to build a work environment that empowers people to do their best work through continuous learning, growth and support of those around them.

title: Software Development Engineer, Amazon Elastic VMware Service(EVS)
description:
Are you passionate about designing and developing highly available and large-scale distributed systems? Would you like to invent and build solutions for customers that truly make a difference in their business? Are you an experienced software development engineer and a self-starter who is excited to build something new and work at cloud scale? If the answer is yes, then we have an exciting opportunity for you to work in the Amazon Elastic VMware Service (EVS) team.

A wave of innovation is bringing sweeping changes to EC2 services with new virtualization capabilities, deep platform integrations, and unimaginable scale revolutionizing traditional thinking around how we run enterprise workloads in the cloud. We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to build new capabilities to help customers run VMware-based workloads on AWS. The AWS Commercial Applications team within Amazon EC2 defines and builds integrations with external software applications running in cloud environments and helps to modernize enterprise customer workloads.

Our team continues to expand Amazon EVS and is building new capabilities for our customers migrating and running VMware-based workloads on AWS.

Key job responsibilities
As a Software Development Engineer on the Amazon Elastic VMware Service (EVS) team, you will obsess over customers, delivering first-class experiences by understanding their challenges and crafting solutions that exceed expectations. You'll take ownership of ambiguous problems, from architecting distributed systems at cloud scale to resolving complex integration issues, defining problem spaces and delivering robust solutions. Your work spans the complete software development lifecycle: requirements gathering, design, implementation, testing, deployment, and operational support. You'll use data to drive decisions, instrumenting systems with meaningful metrics and validating assumptions through experimentation. Finally, you'll contribute to building a world-class team by learning from talented engineers, mentoring teammates, and elevating the entire team's capabilities through your technical leadership.

About the team
AWS Utility Computing (UC) provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS, including support for customers who require specialized security solutions for customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services.
Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge-sharing and mentorship. Our senior members enjoy one-on-one mentoring and thorough, but kind, code reviews. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects that help our team members develop your engineering expertise so you feel empowered to take on more complex tasks in the future.
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
About AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Western Europe
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

FORWARD DEPLOYED ENGINEER - WESTERN EUROPE

You embed directly with customer teams as the engineer on the ground: own an outcome, ship a production-grade SpaceXSI system that still runs after you leave, and become the critical technical feedback loop from the field back to product engineering. The work is the project. One week you might take a messy business workflow and put a production agent on it: pick the use case, stand up the architecture, wire it into the customer's auth, data, and tools, then harden it with evals until the team actually uses it. Another week you might live in a customer's repo and delivery system and ship an agent-powered path for a migration, a PR review loop, or an incident-to-fix flow, behind tests, review, and rollout rather than in a chat sidebar.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Lead discovery with the customer: orient in their codebases and workflows, find the real bottleneck and the use case worth building, and define clear success metrics

  • Design and ship production agents, AI applications, and coding-agent workflows on Grok and our models, on live business processes and inside the customer’s engineering org

  • Get a first version live in days, then harden it over weeks with rollout, monitoring, and iteration from real usage

  • Own production quality: tracing, evals, debugging model or delivery failures, and latency and cost tradeoffs

  • Build the systems around the model (tools, MCP servers, retrieval, rules, skills, CI gates, and evals) and integrate them into the customer’s auth, data, workflow, and delivery systems; decide when prompting, architecture, data, process, or a model change is the right lever

  • Measure the outcome that matters (revenue, cost, hours saved, error rate, cycle time, escaped defects), not seat adoption

  • Work directly with Staff+, platform, and domain leaders, going deep in their systems while communicating clearly about tradeoffs and results

  • Leave the customer team able to run what you built, and turn what you learn into reusable patterns and improvements to SpaceXSI products

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • You have 5+ years of experience in software engineering, machine learning engineering, or data science

  • You’ve owned a customer or operator outcome, not just a slide or a prototype, and can turn a fuzzy problem into a scoped, shipped system

  • You’ve built and owned AI-native workflows or agents in production (using Python, JavaScript/TypeScript), and debugged real production failures (model, tool, data, pipeline, or delivery path)

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • 2+ years in a customer-facing role, leading discovery conversations and being accountable for outcomes for external stakeholders

  • Hands-on depth in several of: agents and tool-calling, eval harnesses, retrieval and context systems, CI/CD or developer platforms, and AI-native coding workflows in a real repo

  • Experience as a forward-deployed, solutions, or platform engineer embedded with customers, or as a founding engineer who owned an AI product end to end

title: Construction Project Scheduler
description:
CONSTRUCTION PROJECT SCHEDULER



ABOUT OUR COMPANY

SAM Construction Group is a development/builder specializing in apartment buildings and spec luxury homes. Our team is passionate about creating high-quality, innovative residential projects that combine style, functionality, and attention to detail. We value professionalism, collaboration, and a workplace where every team member can contribute to building something exceptional.


POSITION OVERVIEW

The Construction Project Scheduler will be responsible for developing and maintaining detailed project schedules from pre-construction through project completion. This individual will work closely with company leadership, project managers, superintendents, subcontractors, vendors, and other key project participants to ensure project activities are properly sequenced, resources are coordinated, milestones are achieved, and deadlines are maintained. The ideal candidate will have demonstrated experience in construction scheduling and be highly proficient in Microsoft Project Professional and Project Scheduler. They must be comfortable developing detailed schedules, managing dependencies, tracking critical paths, identifying potential delays, and providing accurate scheduling information to leadership.

This position requires a proactive, analytical, detail-oriented professional who can manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining a high level of accuracy, organization, and accountability.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Construction Scheduling & Project Planning

  • Develop, manage, and maintain detailed construction schedules for multiple active projects.
  • Create comprehensive project schedules from pre-construction through substantial completion and final turnover.
  • Establish project milestones, activity durations, sequencing, dependencies, and critical path timelines.
  • Coordinate construction activities, subcontractor schedules, material deliveries, procurement timelines, inspections, and project milestones.
  • Develop realistic project timelines in coordination with project managers and field superintendents.
  • Maintain baseline schedules and track actual progress against approved project timelines.
  • Identify scheduling conflicts, delays, and potential disruptions before they negatively impact project performance.
  • Continuously update and revise schedules based on actual field conditions, project progress, and approved changes.

Advanced Scheduling Software & Reporting

  • Demonstrate proficient, hands-on use of Microsoft Project Professional.
  • Demonstrate proficient use of Project Scheduler for developing, managing, and maintaining construction project schedules.
  • Develop and maintain detailed Gantt charts, critical path schedules, project timelines, and milestone tracking reports.
  • Manage activity relationships, predecessors, successors, dependencies, constraints, and schedule logic.
  • Track baseline versus actual performance and identify schedule variances.
  • Generate clear, accurate, and professional scheduling reports for company leadership and project teams.
  • Maintain organized electronic scheduling documentation and historical project schedule records.
  • Identify opportunities to improve scheduling systems, reporting methods, and overall project controls.


Subcontractor & Trade Partner Coordination

  • Coordinate subcontractor scheduling and ensure proper sequencing of all construction trades.
  • Communicate upcoming work activities, scheduling requirements, and anticipated start dates.
  • Confirm subcontractor availability, manpower commitments, and scheduling expectations.
  • Monitor trade partner performance against established project schedules.
  • Proactively address scheduling conflicts and coordinate solutions with project management and field personnel.
  • Maintain accountability for schedule commitments and follow up on outstanding items.

Project Monitoring & Schedule Management

  • Monitor project progress and identify activities that may impact critical path milestones.
  • Work directly with project managers and superintendents to verify field progress and scheduling accuracy.
  • Identify potential delays related to labor, materials, subcontractors, inspections, or other project constraints.
  • Develop and communicate recovery schedule recommendations when projects fall behind.
  • Track long-lead materials, procurement schedules, and delivery commitments.
  • Provide leadership with timely updates regarding schedule performance, upcoming milestones, and potential risks.
  • Maintain visibility across all active projects to assist with resource planning and workload coordination.

Communication & Operational Excellence

  • Maintain consistent, professional communication with leadership, project managers, superintendents, subcontractors, and vendors.
  • Lead or participate in project scheduling meetings and distribute updated schedules and action items.
  • Ensure all relevant team members have access to current and accurate project schedules.
  • Follow up on commitments, deadlines, and outstanding scheduling items.
  • Establish and maintain consistent scheduling procedures and reporting standards.
  • Help develop scalable scheduling processes to support the company's continued growth.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

  • Minimum of 5 years of construction industry experience, with significant experience in project scheduling or project controls.
  • Demonstrated experience scheduling and coordinating multiple construction projects simultaneously.
  • Proficient, hands-on working knowledge of Microsoft Project Professional is required.
  • Proficient working knowledge of Project Scheduler is required.
  • Strong understanding of construction sequencing, trade coordination, project milestones, and critical path scheduling.
  • Experience developing, maintaining, and analyzing detailed construction schedules.
  • Ability to establish and manage baseline schedules and monitor schedule variances.
  • Advanced organizational, analytical, and time-management skills.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Outlook, and other Microsoft Office applications.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to interpret project information, identify scheduling risks, and develop practical solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, prioritize responsibilities, and meet deadlines.


THE IDEAL CANDIDATE

We are looking for someone who is:

  • Highly organized, extremely detail-oriented, and exceptionally thorough.
  • Proactive and capable of anticipating issues before they become problems.
  • Confident managing multiple projects, priorities, and competing deadlines.
  • Analytical and comfortable working with complex schedules and project data.
  • A strong communicator who can coordinate effectively with all levels of the organization.
  • Accountable, dependable, and committed to following through on responsibilities.
  • Comfortable establishing expectations and holding trade partners and team members accountable.
  • Solutions-oriented and able to remain composed in a fast-paced construction environment.
  • Professional in presentation, communication, and work ethic.

title: Solutions Architect - Western Europe
description:

Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

SOLUTIONS ARCHITECT - WESTERN EUROPE

We're hiring Solution Architects to help the world's best engineering organizations figure out what AI-native software development actually looks like in production. This is a deeply technical, post-sale role embedded inside SpaceXSI's most strategic enterprise accounts. You'll work directly with engineering teams to roll out high-impact workflows, accelerate adoption, and help organizations fundamentally rethink how software gets built with AI. Solution Architects sit at the center of long-term customer transformation.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Help Engineering Teams Adopt AI-Native Development: Roll out SpaceXSI across strategic engineering organizations; configure environments, design workflows, and run hands-on enablement sessions; help developers integrate SpaceXSI into real production workflows, not isolated demos; drive fast time-to-value and durable adoption across teams; identify workflow friction and solve problems quickly

  • Expand SpaceXSI Across the Organization: Identify where SpaceXSI should expand next inside the customer environment; help engineering organizations evolve from isolated usage to company-wide adoption; design rollout strategies for new workflows, teams, and platform groups; partner with customers to operationalize AI-assisted development at scale; work closely with Account Executives during major expansion moments

  • Become a Trusted Technical Partner: Build deep relationships with developers, platform teams, engineering leadership, and executive stakeholders; lead architecture reviews, technical working sessions, and strategic planning discussions; advise customers on developer productivity, workflow design, governance, and AI adoption strategy; coordinate across Sales, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to unblock customer progress; help organizations navigate workflow and operational change as AI-native development evolves

  • Drive Real Customer Outcomes: Help customers translate adoption into measurable engineering impact; connect SpaceXSI usage to outcomes like faster iteration cycles, improved developer productivity, workflow efficiency, and engineering quality; help customers communicate the value of SpaceXSI internally and build momentum for broader adoption; turn successful deployments into repeatable workflow patterns across the organization

  • Help Make SpaceXSI Indispensable: Deepen workflow adoption and long-term product stickiness; monitor competitive risk and help customers standardize on SpaceXSI over time; support recovery plans when adoption slows or competing tools gain traction; help customers build workflows they can't imagine operating without

  • Shape the Future of the Product: Bring structured feedback from strategic customers into Product and Engineering; identify emerging workflow patterns, friction points, and enterprise requirements; help shape new capabilities through lighthouse customers and design partnerships; turn successful customer workflows into reusable playbooks and reference patterns

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Technical background in software engineering, infrastructure, DevOps, platform engineering, or developer tooling

  • Experience in a customer-facing technical role such as Solutions Architect, Solutions Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, Technical Account Manager, Enterprise Architect, or similar

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • The ability to work hands-on with engineering teams while also operating strategically with technical leadership

  • A strong understanding of developer workflows, SDLC tooling, integrations, CI/CD systems, governance, and enterprise engineering environments

  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly across both technical and executive audiences

  • Strong instincts around workflow design, adoption strategy, and driving workflow change across engineering teams

  • High ownership, strong execution skills, and comfort operating in fast-moving environments with ambiguity

  • A passion for developer tooling and strong conviction around how AI will reshape software engineering

Team Collaboration

title: Security Engineer II, Security Incident Response Team (SIRT)
description:
Amazon is seeking qualified Security Engineers to join our innovative, high energy Information Security team. In this role you will work within the Amazon Security Incident Response Team (SIRT).

SIRT Security Engineers respond to security events, conduct analysis of threats such as malware and intrusion attempts, and provide security services to safeguard highly sensitive data. They work hands-on with detection systems and vulnerability analysis tools to respond to potential threats to Amazon systems. SIRT Security Engineers are unique individuals prepared to relentlessly resolve security issues by gathering and analyzing event data and conducting root-cause analysis.

With your technical expertise, you will be solving security challenges at scale, working to protect the applications powering the most sophisticated e-commerce platform ever built. We value broad and deep technical knowledge, specifically in the fields of forensics, malware analysis, network security, application security, threat hunting, and threat intelligence.

Key job responsibilities
- Responding to security incidents, and coordinating a cohesive response involving multiple teams across Amazon.
- Providing security engineering solutions and support during customer-facing incidents, proactively considering the prevention of similar incidents from occurring in the future.
- Assisting in the development of pragmatic solutions that achieve business requirements while maintaining an acceptable level of risk.
- Identifying and recommending solutions that improve or expand Amazon’s incident response capabilities.
- Working alongside and mentoring Information Security engineers to improve security, reduce and quickly address risk.
- Evaluating the impact of current security trends, advisories, publications, and academic research to Amazon, coordinating response as necessary across affected teams.
- Keeping your knowledge and skills current with the rapidly changing threat landscape.
- Participating in a follow-the-sun on-call rotation.

We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Inclusive Team Culture
In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

title: Land & Project Development Manager
description:
ACCIONA Energía is the biggest 100% renewable energy company with no fossil legacy in the world. With more than 30 years of experience and operations in 20 countries on five continents, ACCIONA Energía offers a wide portfolio of tailored energy solutions so that its corporate and institutional clients can meet their decarbonisation goals. This includes the development, engineering, construction, operation and maintenance of renewable power plants -mainly wind and photovoltaic technologies-, energy sales and management and marketing, energy services, self-consumption, electric mobility and new technologies such as storage and green hydrogen. ACCIONA Energía is governed by the most demanding environmental, social and corporate governance (ESG) criteria.

Job Description

We are looking for an independent and highly communicative professional to development of onshore wind projects (and other types of RES projects), from land identification and securing land rights, through local stakeholder engagement, to coordinating subsequent stages of project development. Project-based role requiring frequent business travel, typically 3–4 days per week. The company is headquartered in Warsaw, however due to the nature of the position, there is no requirement to be permanently based in Warsaw.

Key Responsibilities:

  • identify and secure land primarily for onshore wind projects, as well as for other types of renewable energy projects,
  • negotiate with landowners,
  • build and maintain relationships with municipalities, local authorities, communities and subcontractors,
  • manage assigned projects and coordinate development activities,
  • work closely with other departments across the company,
  • monitor project schedules, risks, and progress.

Required Skills and Competencies

Candidate Profile:

We are looking for someone with experience in renewable energy, the energy sector, real estate, or infrastructure development who:

  • works independently and takes ownership of results,
  • communicates and negotiates effectively,
  • builds strong, long-term relationships with landowners and local authorities,
  • is well organised and able to manage multiple processes in parallel,
  • is willing to travel frequently and work primarily in the field,
  • holds a valid Category B driving licence,
  • has a basic working knowledge of English (not necessary).

Previous experience in onshore wind project development will be a strong advantage.



Experience: At least 3 years of relevant experience in onshore wind, covering responsibilities similar to those described in the job description, or at least 7 years of relevant experience in other sectors.

As a company that values diversity as a source of talent, we work to foster an inclusive environment that promotes respect, belonging and engagement so that all people can participate on an equal opportunity basis. We invite everyone to apply regardless of origin, circumstances, background or condition.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Operations (f/m/d)
description:
As a Senior Software Engineer – Operations (f/m/d), you will build and improve the integrations that connect KoRo's internal systems with external partners and platforms. You will take ownership of critical backend services and data flows across ERP, logistics, finance, and e-commerce, ensuring they are reliable, secure, and scalable. Working closely with Engineering and business teams, you will drive technical improvements and contribute to high engineering standards.

What you will do:

  • Backend Development & Integrations: You design, build, and maintain scalable backend services, APIs, and integrations connecting internal systems with external partners and platforms.

  • Technical Ownership: You take end-to-end responsibility for selected integration domains, ensuring reliable performance, maintainability, and continuous improvement.

  • Architecture & Standards: You improve system architecture, automate critical workflows, and contribute to clean, scalable, and maintainable engineering solutions.

  • Code Quality & Best Practices: You conduct code reviews, ensure high coding standards, and identify potential issues related to performance, security, and maintainability.

  • System Reliability: You troubleshoot complex production issues, identify root causes, and improve monitoring, alerting, and automated testing to prevent recurring problems.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: You work closely with engineering and business teams to translate requirements into technical solutions and share knowledge with junior and mid-level engineers.

What you bring:

  • 5+ years of experience in backend software engineering, with strong expertise in PHP, Symfony, REST and GraphQL APIs, system integrations, and asynchronous processing using message queues (e.g. RabbitMQ).

  • Hands-on experience with Docker, Docker Compose, GitHub Actions, GitHub Container Registry, and automated testing frameworks such as PHPUnit or Pest.

  • Strong understanding of software architecture, clean code principles, and distributed systems, with experience building reliable, scalable applications.

  • Strong problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to take technical ownership, collaborate across teams, and support other engineers.

  • Experience with high-volume data processing, asynchronous message queues, and building and maintaining data pipelines and event-driven systems.

  • Excellent written and spoken English skills

Nice to have:

  • Experience with Temporal, RoadRunner, Testcontainers, or OpenTelemetry.

  • Familiarity with OAuth 2.0 and e-commerce platforms such as Shopware

What's in it for you:

  • Smart Working & Flexibility: Flexible working hours, hybrid work, and 20 days of workation. We trust you to take ownership: you deliver on our shared goals and structure your day in the way that works best for you. You’ll also start with 28 days of vacation, increasing by one additional day per year of tenure (capped at 30 days), so you always have time to recharge.

  • Growth & Setup: A structured onboarding plan to get you started, plus a dedicated development budget for your personal and professional growth. You’ll also receive your own MacBook and a fully equipped office setup with monitors and height-adjustable desks.

  • KoRo Life & Extras: Free snacks and barista coffee in the office, 20% discount in the KoRo Online-Shop, and exclusive perks with partner companies. On top of that, a fully funded BVG ticket (Jobticket), a subsidy for your fitness membership (Urban Sports Club, Hansefit, or FitX), and a company pension scheme (bAV) via Ginkgo.

  • Shared Moments: Regular team events and company parties to celebrate milestones and successes together.

We're looking for People who share our Mindset

For us, it's not just about the what, but above all about the how. You'll be a perfect fit for us if you have the following mindset:

  • You take initiative and ownership. You don't wait for a perfect brief or a mandate to get started. When you see an opportunity, a risk, or something that can be improved - you act. When things don't go as planned, you look at your own contribution first and step up, without waiting to be asked.

  • You thrive in change. Shifting priorities and evolving processes don't slow you down. You adapt fast and keep moving.

  • You build, you don't wait. When something is missing - a tool, a process, a solution - you create it. You prefer a working MVP over a perfect plan and iterate from there.

  • You think in leverage. You question how things are done, prioritize ruthlessly, and find smarter paths to better outcomes. You don't mistake effort for impact.

  • You're a team player, humble and genuinely kind. You collaborate in and across teams, care about the people around you, and bring sparkles to the room. You speak up when you disagree, commit fully once a decision is made, and actively make the people around you better.

Own it – Move fast – Build it – Create impact – Lift others

Sounds good?

Then we’d love to hear from you! Send us your CV and tell us a little about yourself in a few introductory sentences – who you are, what drives you, and why you’d like to become part of KoRo. After all, we’re looking for team members, not just co-workers!

The KoRo team is just as diverse as our product range! We want to keep it that way as our nut-loving team grows. That’s why we welcome all applicants regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic or social background, religion or belief, disability, age, sexual orientation, or identity.

Ready to join KoRo? We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Senior Data Platform Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
At Statista, we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions.

Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees.

We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters – keep writing it as part of our team.

Are you ready to join us?

Your Role

  • Own the platform architecture. Shape and evolve the target architecture across infrastructure utilities, data product experience and federated governance, together with Data Architecture and Product.

  • Build the Platform-as-a-Product. A standard ingestion framework, roles and permissions, cost monitoring per product and team, and agent/AI readiness.

  • Make governance computational. Data contracts, quality gates, lineage and policies as code, enforced in the pipeline instead of by review. Monitoring, alerting, SLAs and incident handling.

  • Deliver data assets to consumers. Standard output ports (API, MCP server, A2A, Kafka events) and a OpenMetaData catalogue for humans and agents.

  • Work with domain teams and stakeholders. Reference products, onboarding playbook and hands-on support for data domain teams. Bring the technical view into stakeholder discussions.

Your Skills

  • 5+ years in data or platform engineering

  • Hands-on depth in Snowflake and AWS

  • Built Infrastructure as code and CI/CD for data workloads with Terraform

  • Built self-serve capabilities other teams use without hand-holding: templates, config-driven onboarding, clear docs, policies as code and cost governance

  • Data governance in practice: data contracts, quality checks, lineage, access management, data catalogues

  • Strong communication with non-engineers; comfortable defending architecture decisions in cross-team steering

What we offer

In addition to our great team, culture, and our shared goal of empowering people with data, there are many other things that make Statista a great place to work! Join us and benefit from:

  • Work from abroad up to 30 calendar days a year

  • Hybrid work and flex-time

  • International team and social events

  • Subsidized urban mobility and access to fitness and wellness options

  • Free access to Langdock and all its amazing functionalities

  • Career & training opportunities

  • Attractive locations and modern offices

  • Mental health support with OpenUp

Some of the benefits listed here apply only to the German entity and to Junior-level roles or above.

title: Middle Java Engineer
description:
About Patrianna
Patrianna is a fast-scaling product development company headquartered in Gibraltar, with a dynamic, global team powering our growth. We operate at the intersection of technology and entertainment, building innovative solutions that shape the future of social gaming and deliver outstanding experiences to millions of players worldwide.

We're driven by speed, ambition, and bold ideas. At our core, we're product creators and problem-solvers who thrive in a high-performance environment. We're looking for exceptional talent-smart, adaptable, and motivated individuals eager to make an impact, scale business functions at pace, and continuously improve.

AI-Driven Engineering Culture

We are actively building an AI-driven engineering organization with a clear and deliberate stance: artificial intelligence is a core part of how we build and deliver software — not an experiment, not a trend, and not an optional add-on.

AI is embedded into our engineering workflows, from system design and prototyping to refactoring, testing, and code review. We rely on AI to significantly influence how work is done and to accelerate delivery, while maintaining a high bar for code quality, system reliability, and architectural clarity.

We expect engineers to be fully comfortable working in AI-driven environments and to treat AI as a primary productivity multiplier. Preference for AI-free workflows or resistance to AI-assisted development is NOT aligned with how we operate.

Strong engineering judgment, architectural ownership, and accountability remain essential. AI amplifies our engineers — it does not replace responsibility for technical decisions.

What you will be doing
• Design and deliver clean, scalable, and testable Java-based backend systems with minimal supervision
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams including backend, web, mobile, QA, and product teams
• Take ownership of specific services or functional areas within our large-scale architecture
• Leverage AI tools and assistants as integral parts of your development workflow—from system design to code review
• Contribute to maintaining high test coverage, predictable production behavior, and seamless scalability
• Drive engineering excellence through modern practices and continuous improvement


What we are looking for
• Extensive production experience with Java and its ecosystem
• Solid understanding of relational database principles (preferably PostgreSQL) and messaging concepts (preferably Kafka)
• Strong system design, troubleshooting and debugging capabilities
• Comfortable and proactive in using AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, etc.) as productivity multipliers
• Practical experience validating, refining, and taking ownership of AI-generated output
• Upper-intermediate or higher level of English

Why you will love it
You'll be at the forefront of AI-driven engineering in a fast-scaling environment where your code directly impacts millions of users. Work with cutting-edge technology (latest Java, Spring Boot, GCP, Kubernetes) while enjoying full remote flexibility, generous leave, and real opportunities for growth. Join a team that treats AI as a core engineering tool—not an experiment—and where engineering excellence, speed, and meaningful impact are part of everyday work.

title: Robotics SDE, Safe Autonomy, Compass
description:
We are seeking a robotics Software Dev Engineer to join Compass. In this role, you will own the integration of the Compass software into various platforms, including mobile robots, mobile manipulators, and legged robots. You will interface with motion planning, sensing and perception, and safety firmware and create abstractions that enable the Compass software to be easily deployed across millions of robots.

Key job responsibilities
• Design, implement, and maintain the software integration layer that enables Compass safety modules to interface with diverse robot platforms (mobile robots, manipulators, dynamically stable robots)
• Build robust abstractions and APIs that decouple safety logic from platform-specific hardware, enabling rapid deployment across new robot form factors
• Collaborate with motion planning, perception, and controls teams to ensure seamless data flow and real-time performance between safety systems and autonomy stacks
• Develop and maintain interfaces to safety-rated firmware and hardware, ensuring compliance with functional safety requirements
• Architect scalable, production-grade software that can operate reliably across millions of deployed robots
• Write high-quality, well-tested, and maintainable code in C++ and/or Python for real-time robotics applications
• Define integration testing strategies and build simulation-based validation pipelines to verify safety behavior across platforms
• Contribute to system design reviews, technical documentation, and cross-team alignment on interface contracts
• Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks in real-time safety-critical software paths
• Mentor junior engineers and raise the bar on software engineering practices within the team



A day in the life
Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment. The benefits that generally apply to regular, full-time employees include:

1. Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
2. Maternity and Parental Leave Options
3. Paid Time Off (PTO)
4. 401(k) Plan

If you are not sure that every qualification on the list above describes you exactly, we'd still love to hear from you! At Amazon, we value people with unique backgrounds, experiences, and skillsets. If you’re passionate about this role and want to make an impact on a global scale, please apply!

About the team
Work with the inventors of control barrier functions on a novel, universal approach to safe autonomy: one that scales across mobile robots, manipulators, mobile manipulators, and future robot platforms with dynamic stability. You'll push the boundary of safe performance by integrating safety with motion planning, RL, and foundation models, ensuring that safety is never a blocker to robot performance. Your work will underpin robots operating alongside people at Amazon's unprecedented scale.

title: Software Engineer, Developer Productivity
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

SOFTWARE ENGINEER, DEVELOPER PRODUCTIVITY

You will be a core contributor on the Developer Productivity team, designing and building the systems, tools, and workflows that make every SpaceXSI developer incredibly productive. Your mission is to create a world-class developer experience inside SpaceXSI: fast builds, intuitive tooling, reliable environments, and seamless CI/CD. You'll architect, implement, and operate the foundations that power our engineering organization, from local development to global deployments. You'll set technical direction within the team, write and review code, and collaborate across engineering to make it effortless for developers to build, test, and ship quickly.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Build a multi-platform development environment that works seamlessly across macOS, Windows, and Linux

  • Design and maintain CI/CD systems, merge queues, build caching, flaky test quarantine, observability, and safe rollout pipelines

  • Automate developer machine provisioning, from laptop setup and reset automation to interview and onboarding workflows

  • Partner with backend and infrastructure teams to ensure local testing and debugging just work, with near-perfect parity between development and CI environments

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience working on developer productivity, internal platform, infrastructure, or build/test systems

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Experience building or maintaining tooling or infrastructure for large-scale or multi-language codebases

  • Regularly write and review code, and enjoy improving build systems, scripting CI pipelines, and refining developer tooling

  • Care deeply about developer velocity, reliability, and maintainability, and apply sound technical judgment to improve them

  • Are energized by tightening feedback loops and making development feel effortless, fast, and enjoyable

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach out to schedule 2-3 short technicals. After, we'll schedule an onsite in our office, where you'll work on a small project, discuss ideas, and meet the team

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

Annual Salary:

$140,000 - $225,000 USD

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.

title: Meat 3rd
description:
PAQ, Inc. is committed to building a workplace where employees feel valued, supported, and empowered to do their best work. We believe diverse perspectives and experiences strengthen our organization and drive better outcomes for our customers and communities.

The Meat 3rd serves in the crucial capacity of supporting the meat department management team in effectively directing and supervising all functions and activities of Meat department team members to achieve the sales and profit goals established for the department while maintaining a positive team-oriented environment.

Essential Functions of the Position:

  • Assist with daily operations of the meat department.
  • Supervise and train Meat Clerks and Cutters.
  • Ensure proper stocking, rotation, and presentation of products.
  • Monitor inventory levels and assist with ordering supplies.
  • Handle customer inquiries and resolve issues promptly.
  • Maintain compliance with health and safety regulations.
  • Perform duties of Meat Cutter and Clerk as needed.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Knowledge:

  • Comprehensive understanding of meat products and department operations.
  • Familiarity with retail stocking procedures and inventory management.
  • Knowledge of health and safety regulations related to food handling.

Skills:

  • Strong leadership, supervisory, and training skills.
  • Skillful in inventory management.
  • Proficient in using meat-cutting equipment and excellent knife skills.
  • Basic math skills for weighing and pricing.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Effective verbal communication skills for interacting with customers and team members.

Abilities:

  • Ability to resolve conflicts.
  • Ability to ensure high standards of quality and service.
  • Ability to motivate and lead a team.
  • Attention to detail to ensure accuracy in stocking and labeling.

  • Capability to adjust to changing situations, handle multiple demands, and work with diverse personalities.
  • Aptitude for making informed decisions quickly, often in high-pressure situations.
  • A genuine desire to meet and exceed customer expectations, creating a positive shopping experience.
  • Ability to perform physical tasks, including stocking, lifting boxes, and standing for extended periods.

Physical Requirements:

  • Stand and walk for extended periods, typically 8-hour shifts.
  • Lift and carry items up to 25 pounds frequently and up to 50 pounds occasionally.
  • Perform repetitive motions such as reaching, bending, stooping, squatting, and handling products.
  • Ability to perform tasks that require fine motor skills in handling small objects.
  • Maintain clear communication with customers and team members.
  • Move quickly and efficiently to assist customers and manage workload.
  • Maintain physical stamina to work in a fast-paced environment.

Work Conditions:

  • Work Hours: Vary, with availability required on weekends, evenings, and holidays; typically, 8-hour shifts for full-time employees.
  • Environment: Indoor, climate-controlled, with adequate lighting and ventilation. Relatively damp or humid conditions, including wet or slippery floor surfaces.
  • Primary Work Stations: Work within the grocery store environments, which include various sections such as the sales floor, backrooms, and refrigerated storage areas.
  • Dress Code: Professional and presentable attire as determined by store management, including a name tag, company-issued shirts, hats, jackets, or personal shirts that are black, burgundy, or blue, in good repair, and not faded.
  • Exposure: May be exposed to moving mechanical parts and cleaning chemicals.
  • Noise Level: Usually low to moderate, with occasional loud periods from customers, store announcements, and equipment.
  • Interaction: Constant interaction with customers and team members in a fast-paced retail environment.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Education: High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Experience: Over five years of meat-cutting experience is preferred. Supervisory experience is a plus.

Company Employment Policies:

  • PAQ, Inc is an “At-Will” employer.
  • PAQ, Inc is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE).
