title: Seasonal Brand Specialist, Tommy Hilfiger - John Lewis Cardiff
description:
Be part of an iconic story.

TOMMY HILFIGER is one of the world’s most recognized global lifestyle brands, confidently welcoming and inspiring consumers since 1985. Originally established in New York City and infused with the vibrant spirit of Americana, to create the modern uniform of accessible luxury. The TOMMY HILFIGER brands consist of TOMMY HILFIGER and TOMMY JEANS, complemented by a range of licensed product categories that extend the brand lifestyle across generations, geographies, activities and occasions. Tommy Hilfiger’s global marketing approach and communications strategy taps into culture through the world of F.A.M.E.S.: the people, organizations and ideas boldly driving the future of Fashion, Art, Music, Entertainment and Sport. Major global campaigns, sponsorship platforms, and disruptive activations with world-class athletes, musicians and entertainers bring a constant source of energy and inspiration to the brand. Immerse yourself in TOMMY HILFIGER here! (YouTube, Instagram, TikTok)

About THE ROLE

Our stores are the life and soul of our business. They act as our main touch points with our ever-evolving consumer base. As the world of retail evolves, we, as a business, believe that for all other parts of the chain to work, our stores must set the tone of what our two brands are all about. Irrespective of where our consumers eventually make a purchase, our stores, are always a window to our great brands. As a result, our locations are paramount, first-class experience must be a given and our in-store standards should never be questionable. To deliver this, we strive to hire the individuals who live and breathe the values of our business; who are obsessed with delivering great service to our customers and who truly believe that to remain relevant in today’s world, we must be nimble and adapt to change and evolution. The Sales Associate plays a key role in achieving these high standards.

Responsibilities include:


• Ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction through excellent service
• First point of contact for authorizing discounts and resolving customer queries
• Being a brand ambassador, demonstrating in-depth product knowledge.
• Building and maintaining professional relationships with our customers.
• Outfit building for customers and making further product recommendations.
• Assessing customers’ needs and providing assistance and information on product features.
• Driving store KPIs and suggesting ways to improve.
• Ensuring shop and stock room maintenance, presentation and organization issues are addressed in an appropriate manner.

About YOU

• You'll connect to consumers and have a previous track record within hospitality or retail.
• You'll be an effective communicator with the collaborate to win.
• You'll inspire trust and recognize and celebrate the contributions and achievements of others.
• You’ll adapt fast.
• You’ll act with purpose, showing a clear presence on the shop floor.
• You'll take ownership and make informed decisions to find in-store solutions.

About PVH:

We are brand builders who focus our passion and creativity to build Calvin Klein and TOMMY HILFIGER into the most desirable lifestyle brands in the world and at the same time position PVH as one of the best-performing brand groups in our sector. Guided by our values and enabled by our scale and global reach, we are driving fashion forward for good, as one team with one vision and one plan. That’s the Power of Us, that’s the Power of PVH+.

One of PVH’s greatest strengths is our people. Our collective desire is to create a workplace environment where every individual is valued, and every voice is heard, and we are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse community of associates with a strong sense of belonging. Learn more about Inclusion & Diversity at PVH here.

PVH Corp. or its subsidiary ("PVH") is an equal opportunity employer and considers all applicants for employment on the basis of their individual capabilities and qualifications without regard to race, ethnicity, color, sex, gender identity or expression, age, religion, national origin, citizenship status, sexual orientation, genetic information, physical or mental disability, military status or any other characteristic protected under federal, state or local law. In addition to complying with all applicable laws, PVH is also committed to ensuring that all current and future PVH associates are compensated solely on job-related factors such as skill, ability, educational background, work quality, experience and potential.

title: Benefits Manager
description:
AppFolio is more than a company. We’re a community of dreamers, big thinkers, problem solvers, active listeners, and multipliers. At every opportunity, we set the pace while delivering innovation built to carry real estate into the future. One in which every experience feels effortless, yet meaningful. Where customers are empowered to take on any opportunity. We show up as one team, connected by our values to be a force for good. Because together, we have the power to create extraordinary outcomes for our customers, our communities, and ourselves.

The Benefits Manager is the trusted expert behind one of the most personal aspects of life at AppFolio — the health, financial, and well-being programs that show up for our employees and their families. In this role, you will lead the strategy, administration, and continuous improvement of our full suite of benefits programs, ensuring they are competitive, compliant, and genuinely valued by the people they serve.

This is a high-trust role. Every employee interacts with what you build. You will be the SME leadership turns to on the most sensitive questions, the project leader behind one of the biggest cross-functional efforts on our annual calendar (Open Enrollment), and the partner who keeps our broker and vendor relationships sharp. This role reports to the Sr. Director, Total Rewards.

What You'll Do

  • Be the subject matter expert. Serve as the primary technical authority on health, welfare, retirement, and well-being programs. Provide thoughtful guidance to leadership on plan design, market positioning, and program decisions. Resolve complex employee escalations with care and judgment.

  • Own compliance end to end. Ensure all programs remain in strict compliance with federal and state regulations, including ERISA, HIPAA, ACA, COBRA, Section 125, and state-specific requirements. Lead annual 5500 filings, non-discrimination testing, and audit-readiness. Partner with Legal where needed; carry the function as the primary owner.

  • Lead Open Enrollment as a true project. Own end-to-end planning, execution, and communications for the annual Open Enrollment process — typically AppFolio's largest cross-functional People team initiative of the year. Bring real project management discipline: timelines, dependencies, stakeholder management, post-mortem learning.

  • Drive benefits strategy. Monitor market trends, peer SaaS benchmarks, and employee feedback to keep AppFolio's benefits competitive and aligned with our culture. Bring forward recommendations grounded in data, employee experience, and cost discipline.

  • Manage broker and vendor relationships. Hold partners accountable to high service standards, competitive renewals, and optimal plan performance. Lead vendor evaluations and RFPs as needed.

  • Design employee-facing education and communication. Build communication strategies that empower employees to actually understand and use their benefits. Partner with the broader People team, HRBPs, and Marketing/Comms where relevant.

  • Use data to make the function smarter. Analyze benefit utilization, cost trends, and program effectiveness. Translate findings into recommendations that improve employee experience and steward AppFolio's investment well.

  • Support scaling and M&A. Lead benefits integration during acquisitions or significant scaling events, partnering closely with Total Rewards leadership, Legal, and Finance.

  • Steward documentation and operational rigor. Maintain plan documents, SPDs, internal knowledge bases, and process documentation that allow the function to scale and audit cleanly.

What We're Looking For

  • Trusted advisor. People come to you with their most sensitive benefits questions — leadership and employees alike — because you bring expertise, discretion, and judgment. You make complex topics feel approachable.

  • Project management strength. You don't just know benefits; you run the work. You build timelines, manage stakeholders, communicate proactively, and deliver on the date you committed to.

  • Deep attention to detail. Benefits is a function where small errors create large consequences. You catch what others miss, and you build processes that catch what people miss.

  • Vendor partnership. You know how to get the best from brokers and vendors — partnership when it works, accountability when it doesn't.

  • Strong communication. You can speak the technical language of benefits with brokers and Legal, and translate it into plain, warm communication for employees.

  • Dot connector. You see how benefits decisions connect to comp strategy, talent acquisition, total rewards philosophy, and employee experience. You bring that systems view to your work.

Must Have

  • 5+ years of progressive experience in benefits management, including ownership of plan administration, compliance, and Open Enrollment.

  • Experience in a high-growth public SaaS or tech environment strongly preferred.

title: Senior Satellite GNC Engineer, Amazon Leo
description:
Amazon Leo is building a constellation of thousands of low Earth orbit satellites. It will bring fast, reliable internet to customers beyond the reach of existing networks.

On the Guidance, Navigation and Control (GNC) team, you will design the algorithms, simulations and onboard autonomy that keep every satellite precisely pointed and stable. Your work lets the payload serve customers on the ground, and it keeps the fleet flying safely.

This is satellite GNC at constellation scale. The constellation is launching and growing today, so you will see your work go from concept to orbit, and then fly on many satellites.

In this role, you will:

- Take your GNC algorithms from concept to orbit, and stay with them through integration, test and on-orbit operations.
- Write the production C++ flight code for your own algorithms. The code that flies is the code you write.
- Solve hard problems in precise pointing, payload cueing and fleet autonomy.
- Work across design, simulation, test and flight operations, not a narrow slice of the lifecycle.

**Export Control Requirement:** Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and analyze algorithms for state estimation, attitude determination and control, precise pointing and payload cueing against demanding performance requirements.
- Implement these algorithms in production C++ flight software. Our GNC engineers own their algorithms all the way into flight, and partner with our embedded software engineers to integrate and test them.
- Write concepts of operations for each phase of a satellite's life, from launch and orbit raising to service and deorbit, including failures and recovery. Balance what the payload needs against momentum, power, thermal and ground-contact limits.
- Develop momentum management strategies with reaction wheels and magnetic torquers. Help select, size and place the GNC sensors and actuators for future satellites, and design the algorithms that use them. These include star trackers, magnetometers, sun sensors, IMUs and GNSS receivers.
- Develop onboard autonomy, including Fault Detection, Isolation and Recovery (FDIR), so that the fleet operates safely at scale with minimal ground intervention.
- Build and validate satellite and constellation models and simulations at several levels of fidelity, including 6-DOF simulation and Monte Carlo analysis. Verify closed-loop performance in hardware-in-the-loop (HITL) tests.
- Support component environmental tests, functional and performance checkout, and subsystem and satellite integration in our labs.
- Analyze telemetry from the whole fleet. Build the metrics, dashboards and tools that track pointing performance and payload operations time as the constellation grows, and use them to improve the fleet.
- Operate the GNC system on orbit and take part in the team's on-call rotation. Review fleet data, support maneuvers, and resolve anomalies when on-orbit behavior differs from the ground model.
- Review designs and code with the team, and document your algorithms, analyses and results clearly.

A day in the life
This role covers a wide range of problems across the spacecraft and the network. You will derive and prototype estimation and control algorithms, and then turn them into production flight code. You will prove them in 6-DOF and Monte Carlo simulation and in hardware-in-the-loop tests in the lab. You will support satellite integration. When a satellite does not behave as the ground model predicted, you will dig into fleet telemetry, find the cause and drive the fix. You will own each problem end to end, with the focus to go deep on it.

GNC is at the center of safe flight, so you will work across the whole program. The payload, power, thermal and operations teams all depend on GNC, and you will balance their needs against the pointing and momentum budgets. You will partner closely with avionics, flight software and embedded software engineers to make your algorithms run reliably on the spacecraft. You will help the mechanical teams shape the next generation of satellite hardware, from reaction wheels to star trackers. As satellites move from design through manufacturing into orbit, you will work with systems engineering and Assembly, Integration and Test.

The problems are hard: tight pointing requirements, a large constellation to keep flying safely, and the chance to invent capabilities that do not exist yet. Constant work with other teams makes this a place where you keep learning and growing.

About the team
You will join the Satellite Attitude Determination and Control team. We own GNC for our satellites end to end: algorithm design, flight software, lab integration, and flight operations of our own satellites on orbit. Our engineers bring deep experience from many satellite programs and other flight vehicles, with real strength in both our mission and the core GNC disciplines. We design, prototype, test, iterate and learn together. Because GNC is central to safe flight, we drive the concepts of operations and many of the system-level analyses on the program.

We also have a lot of freedom. We trust our engineers to choose their own tools and approaches for the problems they face, and to own the results. If you want the autonomy to solve hard problems your way, with a team of strong engineers, you will feel at home here.

title: Wealth Planning Analyst
description:
The Wealth Planning Analyst is an essential member of the wealth management team and serves as the starting point in the advisor career path. This role supports licensed advisors by coordinating client meetings, conducting research, preparing financial plans, and assisting with follow-up activities necessary for effective client wealth management. The Wealth Planning Analyst builds strong technical, analytical, and client service skills as part of their professional development toward becoming a licensed advisor.

Responsibilities:

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint) and ability to quickly learn new systems and processes.

  • Collaborative mindset with enthusiasm for learning and contributing as part of an advisor team.

title: Senior Solution Architect (Salesforce)
description:
An exciting career awaits you


At MPC, we’re committed to being a great place to work – one that welcomes new ideas, encourages diverse perspectives, develops our people, and fosters a collaborative team environment.

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced and strategic Salesforce Solution Architect to lead the design and implementation of robust, scalable Salesforce solutions. This high-profile role combines technical expertise with strategic thinking to align technology with business goals and Salesforce best practices. This role will serve as a trusted advisor to internal teams and external clients, collaborating closely with stakeholders to define requirements and shape solutions. As a key member of the Digital Product Delivery organization, this role influences enterprise architecture and gains exposure to the latest Salesforce technologies across a range of industries and domains.

The ideal candidate has a strong background in Salesforce architecture and development, proven leadership skills, and the ability to effectively communicate complex ideas to diverse audiences.

This role offers broad exposure and influence across the organization, providing opportunities to shape Salesforce strategy and contribute to innovation. This role will work on enterprise-scale solutions and enjoy continuous learning through advanced training, collaboration, and access to the newest Salesforce features and tools. The Solution Architect will play a vital role in transforming how the business operates through technology-driven customer engagement and operational excellence.

This position belongs to a family of jobs with increasing responsibility, competency, and skill level. Actual position title and pay grade will be based on the selected candidate’s experience and qualifications.


Key Responsibilities

· Define and drive the overall solution architecture strategy and roadmap for business initiatives.

· Serve as a coordinating architectural advisor for cross-functional solution delivery, collaborating with business stakeholders, Enterprise and System Architects to ensure cohesive, value-driven designs.

· Ensure solutions are scalable, maintainable, and aligned with business and architecture strategies.

· Mentor and guide teams in solution architecture best practices across applicable Architecture Domains (Business, Application, Technology. Information and Security architecture).

· Resolve complex integration and alignment challenges across systems.

· Represent solution architecture in business and IT strategy discussions.

· Bridge business needs and technical implementation, ensuring solutions solve the core business problem

· Supports architectural governance and compliance, and contributes to defining principles, guidelines, and standards. Participates and contributes to solution architecture reviews and ensures architecture adherence.

· Evaluate and select appropriate technologies, frameworks, and platforms.

· Takes a more active role in analyzing technology trends and impacts and contributes to vendor assessments.

· Leads the design and development of end-to-end solutions that meet business requirements.

· Analyzes and translates business and technical requirements into solution designs.

· Leads the translation of business and technical requirements into architectural blueprints, collaborating with product owners and managers. Defines system integration approaches and ensures interoperability of components.

· Provides guidance and support to development teams during solution implementation. Manages the architecture for a broader scope of projects and develops roadmaps for portfolio evolution.

· Lead the architecture and design of Salesforce implementations across multiple projects or large, complex initiatives.

· Serve as a trusted advisor for clients and internal teams, providing strategic guidance and mentorship to Salesforce professionals.

· Conduct discovery sessions and assessments of clients’ current Salesforce use; develop findings reports, solution roadmaps, and actionable recommendations.

· Collaborate with stakeholders to ensure solution alignment with business objectives and elicit, define, and prioritize business and functional requirements.

· Create prototypes and proofs of concept to validate solutions and inform project design.

· Design and document robust data models and secure, scalable solutions across Salesforce clouds, including Sales, Service, Experience, and Manufacturing Cloud.

· Oversee configuration, testing, quality assurance, deployment, and release management activities.

Supports architectural governance and compliance, and contributes to defining principles, guidelines, and standards. Participates and contributes to solution architecture reviews and ensures architecture adherence.

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology, related field or equivalent experience required.
  • Five (5) or more years of relevant IT experience, including two (2) or more years of relevant architecture experience required.

Skills

  • Agile Methodology – Agile management is an iterative approach to delivering a project throughout its life cycle, taking incremental steps towards project the completion of a project.
  • Analytical Thinking – Strong problem-solving skills to identify architectural challenges, analyze requirements, evaluate options, and propose effective solutions.
  • Artificial Intelligence (AI) – Artificial Intelligence (AI) refers to the simulation of human intelligence processes by machines, especially computer systems. These processes include learning (the acquisition of information and rules for using the information), reasoning (using rules to reach approximate or definite conclusions), and self-correction. AI encompasses a broad range of techniques and approaches, including machine learning, neural networks, natural language processing, computer vision, robotics, and expert systems, among others. The ultimate goal of AI is to create machines that can perform tasks that typically require human intelligence, such as understanding natural language, recognizing patterns, making decisions, and solving problems.
  • Authentic Communicator – Expresses ideas and information, both verbally and in writing, clearly and credibly. Listens to understand and fosters constructive dialogue.
  • Big Data Analytics – Knowledge of data analytics frameworks and technologies, such as data lakes, data warehouses, and machine learning, to design architectures that effectively handle large volumes of data and enable advanced analytics.
  • Business Acumen – Applies knowledge of MPC’s business, industry and the marketplace to advance the organization’s goals. Makes decisions and recommendations clearly linked to MPC’s strategy.
  • Cloud Computing – Knowing how to manage cloud services, develop cloud applications and use cloud architecture to meet customer needs.
  • Continuous Improvement Mindset – Identifies and leads opportunities for continuous improvement and value creation, both incremental and large-scale.
  • DevSecOps – A set of practices that automates the integration of security at every phase of the software development lifecycle, from initial design through integration, testing, deployment, and software delivery, with an aim towards shortening the systems development life cycle and as well as continuous delivery and a security-first approach.
  • Functional Expertise – A strong understanding of various technologies, platforms, and systems relevant to the organization's architecture, such as networking, databases, cloud computing, and security.
  • Internet of Things (IoT) – Familiarity with IoT concepts and protocols, as well as experience designing architectures that incorporate IoT devices and enable seamless connectivity and data exchange.
  • Machine Learning – Machine learning is a branch of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and computer science that involves the development of algorithms and statistical models that enable computers to progressively improve their performance on a specific task through learning from data, without being explicitly programmed. In essence, machine learning algorithms learn from patterns and relationships in data to make predictions, decisions, or identify patterns, often with the goal of optimizing some objective function or improving performance over time.
  • Process Orchestration – Process orchestration refers to the coordination and management of various tasks, activities, and resources within a workflow or business process. It involves organizing, sequencing, and automating individual tasks or sub-processes to ensure that the overall process operates smoothly and efficiently. Process orchestration typically involves integrating disparate systems, applications, and services to streamline operations and improve collaboration across different parts of an organization. It often employs workflow management tools, automation software, and integration platforms to facilitate communication, data exchange, and decision-making among different components of the process. The goal of process orchestration is to optimize the flow of work, minimize delays and bottlenecks, and enhance overall productivity and performance.
  • Solution Architecture – Solution architecture is the process of designing and describing the structure and behavior of a comprehensive solution to meet specific business needs. It involves integrating various components, technologies, and processes to create a coherent and efficient system that addresses the identified challenges or requirements.
  • Strategic Outlook – Examines issues, generate ideas creates future scenarios and develops plans with a long-term perspective. Ensures short-term goals support long-term strategy and that organizational/functional strategy aligns with and supports MPC’s overall business strategy.
  • Systems Thinking – The process of testing conducted on a complete integrated system to evaluate the system's compliance with its specified requirements.
MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS: • Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology, related field or equivalent experience. • 5+ years of relevant IT experience, including 2+ years of relevant architecture experience.

title: Senior Staff Product Engineer
description:
About hyperexponential (hx)

At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry - which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.

If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

About the Engineering team

At hyperexponential, engineering is at the heart of our mission to transform the insurance industry. Our engineers build and scale, enabling insurers to model complex risks and make smarter pricing decisions at speed. By combining deep technical expertise with creativity, the team pushes the boundaries of what’s possible in insurance technology.

Within engineering, our product teams are cross-functional, pairing frontend and backend engineers with designers and product managers. This enables end-to-end ownership of features, with engineers contributing across design, architecture, implementation, and testing. Collaboration is a core part of how we work, ensuring that every release is both technically sound and valuable to our users.

How we work

We're in the middle of a deliberate shift in how hx builds. Everyone in product development is a Builder, and the Product Engineer is the default unit of how we work.

We organise around problems, not permanent teams. Small pods, usually of two to four Product Engineers, form around the highest-value problem, own it end-to-end from discovery through to running it in production, and re-form as priorities change. Pods sit inside value streams, each owning a customer outcome and led by a Stream Lead who decides which problems the stream takes on and holds the bar for what ships. Your growth sits elsewhere: a Career Mentor owns your development and progression, so you can move to where the most important problem is without your career following the org chart.

We hire Product Engineers into hx, not into a fixed team, domain, or layer of the stack. You'll start in the stream where your strengths and our highest-value problems meet, and move as the problems move.

Product Engineers are T-shaped: deep expertise in software engineering, plus enough product and design judgement to make routine calls yourself. An embedded PM or designer raises a pod's ceiling on the hardest problems, but is never a gate between you and the customer. This is also a deliberately AI-native role, and one of the areas where we're moving fastest.

A pod of three owns its problem whole, which means going wherever it leads: front end, back end, data, or infrastructure. You don't need to be full-stack by trade, but you do need to be comfortable working outside your strongest layer.

The Product Engineer role is the same at every level. What scales is the size of the problem you own, how expensive your decisions are to reverse, and how far your judgement travels beyond your pod. At Level 5, that looks like this.

What you'll be doing

  • Taking a customer problem from discovery to production inside a pod, getting close to customers yourself, framing the problem, and shipping in small increments guided by real customer signal rather than internal opinion.

  • Directing AI agents to draft implementation, tests, and migrations, then reviewing, integrating, and hardening that work. You'll write intent precisely enough to brief both a teammate and an agent, and own correctness and maintainability regardless of how the first draft was produced.

  • Designing and delivering robust production systems where correctness, performance, and resource efficiency matter, with the tests and observability that make complex behaviour safe to evolve.

  • Working across the codebase wherever the problem leads, including areas your pod doesn't steward, with stewards looped in proportionate to the risk rather than handing work off and waiting.

  • Moving between pods, problems, and streams as priorities change, ramping fast on unfamiliar domains and leaving what you built running well behind you.

  • Taking full accountability for outcomes rather than just your code changes: raising risks early, and deciding rather than escalating.

What you'll need to have done

  • Built and shipped production systems end-to-end, from design through rollout, monitoring, and iteration, in settings where correctness, performance, and resource efficiency mattered.

  • Designed testing and observability that made complex behaviour understandable, debuggable, and safe to evolve.

  • Worked effectively in a polyglot environment, choosing the right tool for the problem and picking up unfamiliar languages, domains, and codebases fast. Strong systems experience, for example in Rust, C/C++, or Python, is valued, and we'll upskill you where there are gaps.

  • Shipped work outside your strongest layer of the stack when the problem needed it, picking up the front end, the data layer, or the infrastructure rather than waiting for someone else to.

  • Used AI tools as a serious part of how you build, with the judgement to direct, review, and stand behind what they produce.

  • Carried product and design judgement into your engineering work, shaping the solution rather than only implementing a spec and making sensible calls under ambiguity.

  • Owned outcomes beyond your immediate task, taking decisions rather than escalating them.

At Level 5 we'll also look for

  • Set technical direction on a hard problem other engineers built on, and been judged on whether you made them faster and safer rather than on the size of your team.

  • Held a quality bar across other people's work without becoming the gate they wait on.

  • Led cross-cutting or decoupling work that teams adopted because it was the best path, not because it was mandated.

You’re unlikely to thrive here if

title: Senior Commercial Counsel UK/EU
description:
WHO WE ARE

At Trustly, we're building a smarter, faster, and more secure financial future by revolutionizing the world of payments. As a global leader in Open Banking Payments, we are establishing Pay by Bank as the new standard at checkout, providing unparalleled freedom, speed, and ease to millions of consumers and merchants worldwide.

Our Ambition: To build the world’s most disruptive payment network and redefine what the payment experience should feel like.

Trustly is a global team of innovators, collaborators, and doers. If you are driven by a strong sense of purpose and thrive in a dynamic, entrepreneurial, and high-growth environment, join us and be part of a team that’s transforming the way the world pays.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking an experienced Senior Commercial Counsel with substantial experience in consumer-facing technology businesses to join our global Legal & Corporate Affairs team at an exciting period in Trustly's growth. You will be responsible for partnering with our commercial teams to draft, negotiate, and close a wide variety of transactions across the EU and UK. This role will work cross-functionally with product, go-to-market, consumer partnerships, compliance, and operations teams at Trustly to support the sustainable growth of a hyper-scale business across the EU and UK. You will manage multiple simultaneous complex negotiations, requiring the ability to prioritise effectively and deliver high-quality work under tight deadlines.

You will be a highly commercial and pragmatic individual who thrives on closing deals and enjoys partnering closely with business teams, to speak with "one voice" to external counterparties whilst launching and scaling products and services. You will possess strong experience working from counterparty's terms and templates, with strong commercial judgment and the ability to efficiently negotiate and close deals whilst protecting Trustly's interests. You will be comfortable pushing back strongly on firm redlines when required - including with internal stakeholders - whilst remaining creative and solutions-oriented when finding paths forward through complex negotiations. You will take pride in being proactive, extremely responsive to the business teams, protecting the business, and enabling innovation through creative legal solutions.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Lead the negotiation, drafting, and review of large, complex commercial agreements with merchants, partners, and financial institutions, including payment processing agreements, merchant services agreements, API agreement, IP licences, data processing agreements, procurement agreements, and third-party provider (TPP) relationships.

  • Draft, review, and negotiate consumer terms and conditions, privacy policies, and other consumer-facing legal documentation in compliance with EU and UK consumer protection regulations.

  • Demonstrate strong expertise in working from counterparty's terms and templates, efficiently identifying and negotiating key commercial and legal issues to close deals quickly whilst protecting Trustly's interests.

  • Proactively manage and lead negotiations and build strong alliances with our commercial team in order to do so, managing multiple high-priority negotiations simultaneously with a focus on getting deals across the line.

  • Partner closely with the Sales team to ensure alignment on negotiation strategy and present a unified voice to external parties, whilst maintaining appropriate independence to push back on Trustly's firm redlines when necessary.

  • Quickly understand Trustly's payment products, technology platform, and integration methods to provide informed, practical legal advice that accounts for technical realities and business objectives.

  • Advise product, marketing, and business teams on consumer protection requirements, marketing and advertising regulations, and regulatory compliance for consumer-facing initiatives, reviewing and approving consumer communications and marketing materials.

  • Partner with Privacy and Compliance teams to ensure consumer-facing products and services meet data protection and privacy requirements, including consent management, transparency obligations, and data subject rights.

  • Develop and maintain Trustly's standard form agreements, playbooks, and contracting processes to streamline efficiency, maintain compliance, and mitigate risk.

  • Support the launch of new consumer-focused product initiatives in partnership with Product Counsel, coordinating with Risk and Compliance teams to ensure commercial agreements comply with applicable laws and regulations.

  • Provide strategic legal advice on contract interpretation and dispute resolution.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Law degree (LLB, LLM, or equivalent) and qualified solicitor, barrister, avocat, or equivalent legal qualification in the UK or another EU member state, with experience at a consumer-facing technology business (strong private practice background is required).

  • Strong technical aptitude to quickly understand complex technology products and payment systems, with a proven track record of successfully partnering with Sales and business teams.

  • Comfortable and confident pushing back strongly on firm legal and commercial redlines, including with internal teams, whilst maintaining collaborative relationships and demonstrating creativity and resourcefulness in finding solutions to complex negotiation roadblocks.

  • Proactive, highly responsive, and service-oriented approach to supporting business teams, with genuine enjoyment of closing deals and getting transactions across the line, demonstrating a results-driven mindset and entrepreneurial nature with a bias for action.

  • Experience drafting and negotiating large commercial contracts, consumer terms and conditions, privacy policies, and other legal documentation for digital products and services. Experience in FinTech, payments, or financial services strongly preferred. Experience in gaming is a plus.

  • Knowledge of marketing and advertising regulations, distance selling regulations, and e-commerce requirements.

  • Strong ability to balance regulatory compliance and consumer protection with business objectives, with excellent written and verbal communication skills to explain complex legal issues in simple terms.

  • Experience managing consumer complaints, disputes, or regulatory inquiries, and familiarity with consumer product compliance across multiple EU jurisdictions is desirable

  • Fluency in French highly desirable.

WHAT WE OFFER

At Trustly, you will have the chance to solve meaningful challenges alongside some of the brightest minds in FinTech. Together, we are shaping the future of payments in an environment that celebrates curiosity, collaboration, and innovation. You will be challenged and empowered to grow, making a real impact every step of the way.

Our team is as diverse as the global footprint we serve. At Trustly, we foster a workplace where everyone feels they belong—a place where teamwork thrives, ideas flourish, and we never forget to have fun along the way. We are proud and committed to being an Equal Opportunity Employer and believe an open and inclusive environment enables people to do their best work.

Our Fantastic Benefits (varies by location)

🌴 20 to 30 days of holiday to support a healthy work-life balance

🥳 Monthly team outing allowance to enjoy social events with your colleagues

👶 Parental leave top-up additional support for new parents

☕ On-site perks to make your workday smoother

💚 Well being support our health allowance covers gym memberships, massages, and much more to help you feel your best

PLUS additional benefits designed to enhance your work-life experience!

Shape Your Role and Make an Impact

Join a dynamic environment where you can take ownership, drive change, and continuously embrace new challenges. We’re looking for dedicated and highly motivated individuals who thrive in a fast-paced environment and enjoy collaborating across different areas of the organisation.

  • Familiarity with computer usage and office communication tools

title: System Development Engineer, Amazon Leo, Amazon Leo
description:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations with or without reliable connectivity. Our Payload Integration and Testing (PIT) team validates the end-to-end network interface communication system both on the ground prior to launch and in-orbit to ensure we are providing customers a best-in-class experience. We're the final software quality gate, ensuring what customers experience on-orbit matches our design intent.

As a System Development Engineer, you'll design and build the test automation framework and procedures that validate our satellite network end to end -- and the full stack it runs on, from the device-interface layer that drives physical hardware up through the infrastructure and operational tooling that keep our hardware-in-the-loop (HILT) test venues running reliably at scale. You'll write the automation frameworks and test harnesses that exercise the system, the low-level interface code and device drivers that let those harnesses command and read back from lab hardware over protocols like serial/UART, I2C/SPI, USB, Ethernet, and instrument-control interfaces, and the compute, networking, provisioning, and observability underneath that keep it all healthy. The technical scope is broad and systems-oriented: you'll build test-orchestration and automation software, architect and automate cloud and on-premise infrastructure, integrate and bring up lab hardware down to the register and command level, and drive the operational excellence practices that keep a high-stakes, 24/7 test environment reliable. If you love building test automation, enjoy working at the intersection of software, networking, and physical hardware, and want to solve unique operational challenges in the space domain, this is an exceptional opportunity.

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, build, and maintain test automation frameworks, test harnesses, and orchestration software that validate the satellite network end to end

- Develop automated test suites and the tooling engineers use to author, run, schedule, and debug tests across distributed HITL venues

- Write and maintain the low-level interface code and device drivers that let test systems command and read back from lab hardware over protocols such as serial/UART, I2C/SPI, USB, Ethernet, and instrument-control interfaces (e.g., SCPI)

- Perform device bring-up and integration: understand hardware command sets and register maps, debug at the protocol level, and build the abstraction layers that expose hardware to higher-level test automation

- Design, build, and operate the infrastructure and networking that connects distributed hardware-in-the-loop test venues to cloud services

- Automate provisioning, configuration, and deployment of test environments using infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD pipelines

- Build and own monitoring, alarming, dashboards, and observability for test orchestration systems and the infrastructure they depend on

- Drive operational excellence: on-call response, incident management, root-cause analysis, and systemic fixes that prevent recurrence

- Identify and resolve systemic reliability, scaling, and performance issues across the test stack -- automation, compute, network, and storage

- Collaborate with software engineers, applied scientists, systems engineers, and test teams to translate test and operational requirements into robust automation and infrastructure

- Write clean, maintainable, well-documented software following engineering best practices, and participate in design and code reviews

title: Software Engineer, Storage
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

SOFTWARE ENGINEER, STORAGE

As a Software Engineer on the Storage team at SpaceXSI, you'll own the data layer that underpins every product surface: the databases, caches, and the strategy for how teams provision, query, and scale their data stores. Millions of developers depend on Cursor every day, and the future of our storage architecture is one of the highest-leverage problems at the company: get it right, and every team ships faster, every product surface gets more reliable, and SpaceXSI can scale to meet explosive demand. You'll design and execute the path to a robust, multi-database topology built for that growth.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Design the next-generation data architecture: evolving our storage layer into a partitioned, resilient topology that keeps pace with SpaceXSI's rapid growth

  • Build query attribution and guardrails: instrumenting every database query by service, catching bad patterns before they hit production, and making it impossible to ship problematic queries without review

  • Define the "when to use what" strategy for data stores: creating clear guidance and golden pathways so every team picks the right engine for their workload without second-guessing

  • Own cache infrastructure end-to-end: reliability, capacity planning, and patterns that let product teams move fast without worrying about cache correctness

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience with relational databases at scale (e.g., Postgres, MySQL, or similar OLTP systems). Experience building and scaling databases or data infrastructure. Understanding of database performance, reliability, and caching.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Experience tackling database sharding, migration, or decomposition problems in production environments

  • Understand the tradeoffs between different storage engines and can help teams make the right choices for their workloads

  • Care about operational excellence: backups, monitoring, query performance, and capacity planning are things you think about proactively

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals and enjoying building systems that other engineers depend on

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach out to schedule 2-3 short technicals. After, we'll schedule an onsite in our office, where you'll work on a small project, discuss ideas, and meet the team

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

Annual Salary:

$140,000 - $225,000 USD

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.

title:
Senior Technical Program Manager, Ground
Amazon Leo, D2D Software
description:
Amazon Leo is building a low Earth orbit satellite constellation to bring fast, affordable connectivity to customers around the world. Direct to Device (D2D) extends Leo to standard mobile phones and devices: a fully regenerative fifth-generation (5G) mobile base station on each satellite, delivering service to standard handsets through mobile network operators (MNOs). D2D Software builds the embedded software that flies, the cloud and ground software that runs the service, and the platform that connects them. Our target is under a day from a defect being found to the fix deployed across the entire constellation, achieved by automating everything that a person would otherwise do by hand.

This role leads ground in Software Delivery & Business Ops, reporting to the Director, Software Delivery & Business Ops. It owns handovers and supplier delivery for the ground domain and the commercial core program. Before anything is handed on, the bar is: every ground and core milestone in the integrated schedule. It hands off to its customers as follows: integrated schedule to Ground Software Development and the program.

What the team needs to achieve
• Every ground and core milestone in the integrated schedule.
• Hand-offs that meet their service level: integrated schedule to Ground Software
Development and the program.
• Measured, rising capability and efficiency of the team, with manual work falling release over release.

How the team is measured
• Ground and core milestones in the integrated schedule and landing on forecast.
• Supplier deliveries for the ground domain on schedule.
• Handovers between Ground SW and the program accepted on time.

Key job responsibilities
• Own handovers and supplier delivery for the ground domain and the commercial core program.
• Meet the bar before every hand-off: every ground and core milestone in the integrated schedule.
• Work directly with engineers in the boundary teams as partners, through agreed contracts and service levels.
• Automate everything a person would otherwise do twice.
• Run the program's mechanisms, metrics, and reviews, and clear blockers with the right people, escalating when needed.
• Identify and mitigate program risks early, build consensus across teams, and mentor other program managers.

This role runs the handovers and supplier delivery for the ground domain and the commercial core network program: core supplier delivery, ground milestones, and the integration with partner networks. Supplier delivery is part of the role: drop schedules, supplier service levels, delivery commitments, and escalations, while the engineering team owns the technical relationship and Software Integration, Verification & Reliability gives the acceptance verdict. It matters because the ground is where operators connect and where the service runs around the clock. Without it, core and ground milestones drift apart from the satellite plan, and operator integrations start without the ground being ready.

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.


About the team
D2D Software is an evolving organization of many teams: Software Architecture & Specifications; Software Delivery & Business Ops; Software Integration, Verification & Reliability; DevOps & Release; Satellite Software Development; Ground Software Development; and Customer Software Engineering & Support. Each Director owns business outcomes: delivering the commitments, and the capability and efficiency of their teams. Teams work as internal customers and suppliers with agreed service levels, interfaces are agreed centrally while designs stay local, and engineers are expected to work directly with engineers across every boundary. Milestones are committed deadlines for delivery with quality, not gates to wait on, and every team runs on one toolchain and one system of record. Every measure is derived from the systems of record, never self-reported, and we improve release over release with a target of perfection.

title: HV Substation Foreman
description:
Somos una compañía global, líder en el desarrollo de infraestructuras regenerativas que generan un impacto positivo en la sociedad. ACCIONA is looking to hire a HV Substation Foreman for our Industry area, within the ACCIONA Netherlands division.

Descripción del puesto

Mission: Coordinate, organize, and supervise electromechanical works in substation construction projects, ensuring compliance with technical standards, deadlines, and established quality requirements.

The position is responsible for the overall follow-up of electromechanical and electrical work contracts on site, ensuring that all activities — including equipment erection, structural assemblies, busbars, transformers, auxiliary systems and electrical and Fiber Optic cabling — are executed in accordance with project engineering, technical specifications and applicable regulations.

He/she works in close coordination with other disciplines (civil works, protection and control, HSE, testing and commissioning), providing technical and operational support to facilitate effective decision-making and proper project execution.

Functions: The position will have the following key responsibilities.

• Act as the main point of contact between site crews and project management.

• Participate in site meetings and technical discussions.

• Supervise and coordinate all electrical and electromechanical works on site, including installation, termination and routing of power, control and auxiliary cables.

• Organize and plan daily and weekly activities of subcontractors and site personnel.

• Monitor physical progress of the works, ensuring compliance with the project schedule and reporting any deviations.

• Prepare and issue periodic progress reports, including work status, incidents and technical issues.

• Coordinate interfaces between electromechanical works and other project disciplines.

• Ensure correct interpretation and implementation of drawings, electrical schematics and technical documentation.

Verify quality of executed works and compliance with technical specifications and applicable standards.

• Control scope, schedule and resources assigned to electromechanical activities.

• Support testing, pre commissioning, and commissioning activities.

• Identify technical and construction risks or non-conformities and proposing corrective and preventive actions.

• Ensure compliance with Health, Safety and Environmental (HSE) regulations during site activities.

• Ensure proper use of PPE, permits to work, lock out/tag out (LOTO), and safety procedures.

Requisitos del candidato

Academic Background
Basic electricity courses.

Languages and Required Level
High level of English required.
Knowledge of Dutch and Spanish will be considered an advantage.

Additional Skills / Complementary Knowledge

  • Proven experience in substation construction projects, supervising electrical and electromechanical works.
  • Experience coordinating subcontractors and managing on-site construction activities.
  • Electromechanical erection of substations.
  • Power, control, and protection cable installation and termination.
  • Ability to interpret electrical drawings and single-line diagrams.
  • Knowledge of applicable codes, standards, and regulations for substation projects.
  • Knowledge and experience in civil works would be a plus.
  • Experience working for TenneT would be a plus.

Willingness to Travel
Not required.

description:

· Develop and communicate comprehensive spare parts inventory strategies and processes in alignment with multiple channels, department plans, key inventory targets, and business goals.

· Communicate ideas concisely to a wide variety of stakeholders for purposes ranging from informative to need for approvals from executives.

· Clearly define data requirements and metrics, working with teams to implement the entire data flow from capture to presentation and management
· High attention to detail and proven ability to manage multiple, competing priorities simultaneously

Come armed with your knowledge for a position where you will own, build, and run spare parts supply chain and engage with multiple stakeholders to drive plans and execution to satisfy the demanding needs of a high growth industry, impacting markets worldwide.

title: Institutional Communications
description:
What is Kalshi?

Kalshi has defined a new category: prediction markets. Kalshi allows people to trade on the outcome of any events and turn any question about the future into a financial asset. Kalshi fought for years and legalized prediction markets in the US for the first time in history, is currently the fastest growing financial market in America, and has thousands of markets across politics, economics, financials, weather, tech, AI, culture and more.

We believe prediction markets have the potential to be the largest financial market because they turn anything into a financial position.

  • Our vision: well… build the largest financial market on the planet.

  • Our mission: bring more truth to the world through the power of markets.

Our culture is simple: we hire really talented people, work really hard, and enjoy the climb. We are looking for ambitious and exceptional people to join our (relatively small) team to help us build the next generation of financial markets.

Role Roadmap

We are looking for someone to own institutional communications as Kalshi expands its presence with institutional investors.

You’ll develop our communications strategy, build relationships with financial and industry reporters, and drive media coverage alongside our institutional team and agency. We’re looking for a strong writer who understands exchanges, clearing, or derivatives trading and brings creative ideas, sound judgment, and the drive to own strategy through execution.

What You'll Do

  • Own Kalshi’s institutional communications strategy, identifying the audiences, outlets, and stories that matter most

  • Build relationships with reporters covering institutional markets, derivatives, exchanges, clearing, and trading

  • Proactively pitch stories that build Kalshi’s visibility and credibility with institutional audiences

  • Write press releases, media pitches, executive talking points, bylines, and other communications materials

  • Work closely with our institutional team to turn business developments and complex market topics into compelling stories

  • Partner with our agency to develop campaigns, coordinate outreach, and secure meaningful coverage

  • Use feedback from reporters and institutional audiences to sharpen our messaging and approach

What We're Looking For

  • Based in New York City

  • Mid-level communications or public relations experience in exchanges, clearing, trading, or financial market infrastructure, either in-house or at an agency

  • Strong understanding of financial markets and derivatives trading

  • Excellent writing skills and the ability to make complex financial topics clear and compelling

  • Strong financial media relationships and a track record of securing coverage

  • Creative instincts, thoughtful judgment, and the confidence to challenge conventional approaches to financial communications

  • The ability to build trust with executives, colleagues, reporters, and agency teams

  • A willingness to take responsibility and independently own work from strategy through execution

Bonus Points

  • Experience building a communications program for a new business or audience

  • Experience developing executive thought leadership and securing coverage in both institutional trade publications and broader financial media

  • Familiarity with prediction markets and their applications for institutional participants

NYC Pay Transparency Disclosure

Salary Range: $130,000 to $220,000 annually, plus equity and benefits. This range reflects current market data for this role. Kalshi has minimal hierarchy and broad variance in experience levels within each title; if your compensation expectations exceed this range, we encourage you to reach out - we’re always happy to discuss.

Our Culture

Meritocracy is at our core, and we value people who take ownership and figure (usually hard) things out. We dream big. We love our craft deeply and are proud of what we put out in the world. We are committed to our vision of building something big… but also useful: a product that brings more truth through the power of markets.

Kalshians are Kalshi’s most important asset: we pick Kalshians carefully, so we trust them fully on day 1.

Commitment to Equal Opportunity

Kalshi is committed to creating a culture of inclusion and belonging, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe it is our collective responsibility to uphold these values and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to join us in our mission. All qualified applicants will be treated with respect and receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, uniform service, veteran status, age, or any other protected characteristic per federal, state, or local law. If you are passionate about what you do and want to use your talents to support our mission and values, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Director Business and Digital Product Development (m/w/d): win business and drive platform building
description:
Vicoland gives the professional services market a new dimension: Virtual Companies – “Vicos”. We invented Vicos as a new type of supplier, more efficient than traditional professional services firms (consultancies, system integrators, agencies etc.). We have received 20 million € in round A financing.

Vicos may consist of freelancers, SMEs and AI agents. They organize through our AI-driven SaaS platform to act like real companies, competing successfully for large enterprise projects, e. g. ERP introductions or AI transformations. Vicos have proven to be more cost-efficient and to deliver better quality than traditional companies.

Already, 120+ Vicos with thousands of freelancers work on projects for enterprise clients like BASF, Miele, Siemens or Daimler and many SMEs. They also serve leading professional services firms as subcontractors, including Accenture, Infosys and Capgemini. Forbes and Forrester have named Vicoland as a leading force transforming the market.

Our certified platform is key to our success. It provides the full digital infrastructure which makes Vicos come true as a new form to organize human labor and human-agentic interaction. It covers end-to-end all essential areas: marketing, finance, legal, and organization.

Given its ambitious and transformative purpose, our platform is highly complex (though easy to use). Developing it further takes people who understand what the entrepreneurs on our platform, the Vico Leads, need: they must be able to run their Vico end-to-end without overhead and with minimal effort.

We are scaling our go-to-market and need a leader who wins new business for our Vicos and makes sure our platform does what Vico Leads need.

Our offer to you

As Director Business and Digital Product Development you combine three capabilities:

• Business development: you win new clients and business for our Vicos

• Digital product development: you turn user needs into requirements that our engineers turn into platform capabilities

• Entrepreneurial drive in building a hyper-scaling business: this is about continuously driving the perfection of our product, go-to-market, processes and tools

You join our go-to-market team and work closely with our platform building team. Your work directly affects how well thousands of freelance experts can run their own companies on our platform.

Tasks

Shape the market

• Position Vicoland with enterprise clients as the strategic alternative to traditional professional services models.

• Question established sourcing models and demonstrate why Vicos deliver better outcomes.

• Develop go-to-market strategies tailored to specific client contexts.

• Build thought leadership through events and LinkedIn presence.

Win and grow clients

• Develop and own a portfolio of enterprise clients and partners – from strategic outreach through close to long-term expansion.

• Win new business together with Vico Leads, and learn from every deal what the platform must do better.

Lead and enable Vico Leads

• Be the go-to person for Vico Leads on the platform: help them solve problems, and bring in engineering where needed.

• Supervise and coach Vico Leads in your client group – hold them accountable for delivery quality and commercial performance.

• Activate new Vico Leads and help them grow their own marketplace business on the platform.

Continuously define the platform and shape the company

• Translate the real problems, needs and workflows of Vico Leads into concrete requirements and feature requests for our engineering team.

• Prioritize features by impact on business and shape the platform roadmap.

• Follow each feature to release, check whether it works for Vico Leads, and drive our NPS.

• Bring market intelligence, client feedback, and competitive insight into the organization and our product.

• Help define how we scale: processes, tools, talent, culture.

Requirements

title: EDA Silicon Infrastructure Manager, Annapurna ML
description:
Annapurna Labs is looking for an experienced Engineering Manager to think big in defining the strategic direction, roadmap, and execution for EDA infrastructure supporting SoC, IP, physical design, and verification teams. This is first and foremost a leadership and people management role: you will build, inspire, mentor, and grow a team of 6–10 engineers, set a high performance bar, develop the next generation of engineering leaders, and create a team culture rooted in operational excellence and customer obsession. You will own the team’s vision and success metrics, drive organizational alignment across globally distributed silicon development environments, and be accountable for the compute infrastructure, design-data-management methodologies, and automation your team delivers. While this role carries full management responsibility, it equally demands a hands-on technical leader. You will roll up your sleeves alongside your team, participating in architecture reviews, deep dives, on-call rotations, and incident response to maintain technical credibility and unblock engineers. You will guide the team in architecting scalable infrastructure including Linux-based compute clusters, storage, networking, HPC, and cloud-enabled hybrid platforms while optimizing silicon development flows spanning synthesis, place-and-route, STA, DFT, verification, emulation, and signoff. You will champion standardization, automation, and engineering productivity through self-service platforms, CI/CD workflows, and tooling that eliminates operational overhead, partnering with CAD methodology teams, silicon engineering teams, and AWS services teams to deliver infrastructure that is scalable, reliable, and globally supportable.

Key job responsibilities
• Build, inspire, and develop a high-performing, globally distributed team of 6–10 software development engineers and systems engineers; set clear expectations, conduct regular performance reviews, and foster a culture of ownership, operational excellence, and customer obsession.
• Recruit, hire, and retain top engineering talent; own the hiring bar for your team and actively build a diverse pipeline of candidates who strengthen the organization.
• Coach and develop engineers at all levels; create individualized growth plans, identify future leaders, and invest in the career development of every team member to build the next generation of engineering leaders.
• Define the team’s vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap for EDA infrastructure; align priorities with organizational goals and communicate the strategy clearly to stakeholders at all levels.
• Define and track success metrics for the team and the services it provides, using data-driven dashboards and AI-assisted analytics to inform priorities, measure impact, and hold the team accountable to results.
• Drive strategic infrastructure decisions that support customer needs across systems, pre-silicon, and post-silicon teams, balancing immediate delivery with long-term scalability and technical excellence.
• Partner directly with silicon design, verification, emulation, software, and AWS service teams to understand their workflows, pain points, and iteration cycles; align infrastructure roadmaps with program milestones, establish continuous feedback mechanisms, and drive unified outcomes across organizational boundaries.
• Present technical documents, weekly reports, and program status updates to senior leadership, clearly communicating progress, risks, trade-offs, and resource needs.
• Maintain hands-on technical credibility by participating in deep dives, architecture reviews, on-call rotations, and incident response; lead by example to unblock the team and make sound technical decisions.
• Guide the team in architecting and evolving the compute, storage, networking, and scheduling infrastructure (LSF, Slurm, Kubernetes) that underpins all phases of silicon development, from RTL through GDSII signoff, ensuring it scales across global sites.
• Own end-to-end platform delivery for cloud infrastructure (AWS) and high-performance computing clusters that support EDA workloads including simulation, synthesis, place-and-route, and verification.
• Own platform reliability, performance, and cost efficiency end-to-end; define and enforce SLOs, lead capacity planning, and drive cost optimization that maximizes engineering throughput.
• Establish incident management frameworks, lead postmortems, and codify operational excellence standards; create runbooks and preventive automation that improve system resilience and reduce mean time to recovery.
• Drive standardization and automation through self-service platforms, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure-as-code to eliminate manual toil in project onboarding, workspace provisioning, and infrastructure deployment.


A day in the life
As an EDA Silicon Infrastructure Manager at Annapurna Labs, your day is defined by leadership. You start the morning reviewing overnight job/ticket metrics and platform health dashboards, then lead a team standup to triage incidents, remove blockers, and align on sprint priorities. You hold a 1:1 with engineers to discuss their career growth trajectory and coach them on preparing for a promotion. Mid-morning, you lead a capacity planning review for an upcoming tape-out, guiding your engineers through compute and storage modeling while making resource allocation decisions. After lunch, you roll up your sleeves and join a hands-on deep dive into a production incident, working side-by-side with your team to diagnose root cause and define corrective actions. Later, you lead a design review for a new automation service, coaching team members through architecture trade-offs and ensuring alignment with the broader infrastructure strategy. You then meet with a partner team in silicon verification to understand their evolving workflow needs and translate those into infrastructure priorities for your team’s roadmap. You close the day by reviewing a weekly report for senior leadership, clearly communicating your team’s progress on key operational metrics, risks, and upcoming milestones. Throughout it all, you balance the demands of people leadership, including hiring, performance management, and team development, with the technical depth that keeps you credible and effective as a hands-on engineering leader. Your leadership directly impacts the productivity of hundreds of engineers building breakthrough AWS silicon.

About the team
At Annapurna Labs, you will be at the heart of the infrastructure that powers breakthrough innovations in custom silicon for AWS. The ML Infrastructure team builds and operates the compute, storage, networking, CI/CD, and developer platforms that hundreds of chip designers and verification engineers depend on daily. We offer the resources and scale of AWS with the innovation culture and technical depth of a focused silicon team.
If you are passionate about leading high-performing engineering teams, thrive on solving complex infrastructure challenges at scale, and want to combine hands-on technical leadership with people management to accelerate the next generation of AWS silicon, we want to hear from you.

title: Sr. Program Manager - Technology Deployment, Central Deployment Operations
description:
The Central Deployment Operations team under RME Central (RP3) is seeking an experienced and highly organized Program Manager to lead the deployment of software and hardware across Amazon's fulfillment and logistics network. The Deployment team serves as a scalable execution function for technology programs across the network, partnering with product, engineering, operations, and other global teams to plan, execute, and scale deployments, including emerging technologies as they evolve.
