title: DSP Engineer - Audio Tech
description:
At Bose Corporation, we believe sound is the most powerful force on earth — and for over 60 years, we have been a company built on innovation, excellence, and independence. Privately owned, fiercely customer-focused, and driven by our values, we continue to lead industries and transform lives through sound.

Today, Bose Corporation is entering an exciting new era. Across multiple global Business Units and Global Functions, we are shaping the future of audio technology, automotive, luxury, and premium experiences. We invite you to join us in this transformation.

Job Description

Bose Corporation is dedicated to developing breakthrough audio technologies that enrich people’s lives. While Bose is well known for its first-party consumer and automotive products, an increasingly important part of our future is enabling partners around the world to deliver differentiated audio experiences through licensed Bose technologies.


The Audio Tech organization focuses on developing scalable, portable, and high-performance audio technologies that can be deployed across a wide range of partner platforms and products.


Role Overview

We are looking for a hands-on DSP engineer to join our Audio Technology engineering team. This role is well suited for a junior-to-mid level engineer who enjoys applying strong DSP fundamentals while learning how to design algorithms that must scale across multiple platforms, partners, and use cases.

Success for the Audio Tech DSP team emphasizes algorithm robustness, portability, and partner enablement, while still offering deep technical ownership and exposure to real-world production systems. You will work closely with senior DSP engineers, platform teams, and external partners to deliver licensable audio technologies that meet demanding quality and performance requirements.


DSP Engineer Role

DSP engineers in the Audio Technology Licensing group work in cross-disciplinary, highly collaborative teams to develop and deploy signal processing algorithms that improve audio experiences for our technology partners and their customers.


You will contribute to a broad set of technologies including audio signal processing, speech and voice processing, noise reduction, and microphone array systems, and gain experience adapting algorithms to different hardware and software environments. This role provides strong opportunities for technical growth while maintaining clear ownership of deliverables.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and test DSP algorithms to solve technical challenges for licensable audio technologies.
  • Contribute to delivering new customer and partner benefits using technologies such as active noise reduction, voice pickup, spatial audio, and speech enhancement.
  • Work with senior engineers to ensure algorithms are robust, portable, and scalable across multiple platforms and partner products.
  • Support the integration and validation of DSP algorithms on embedded, real-time systems.
  • Assist in adapting and tuning algorithms for different hardware, software, and system constraints encountered in a licensing environment.
  • Participate in technical evaluations of third-party technologies and contribute to make-vs-buy analyses when appropriate.
  • Collaborate with internal teams across engineering, systems, software and product management to support partner delivery and long-term platform goals.


Skills & Qualifications

The ideal candidate will have a strong subset of the following:

Technical Skills

  • Solid foundation in digital signal processing, with experience in audio and/or speech processing.
  • Experience developing DSP algorithms for embedded or real-time systems.
  • Proficiency programming signal processing algorithms using C, Python, and Matlab; exposure to fixed-point or optimized implementations is a plus.
  • Familiarity with acoustics and acoustic measurements, including microphones and audio transducers.
  • Experience debugging embedded systems and working with audio lab equipment.
  • Ability to evaluate and integrate third-party algorithms and libraries.

Desirable (Not Required)

  • Exposure to applied machine learning techniques for audio systems, such as ML-assisted noise reduction, speech enhancement, or audio classification.
  • Familiarity with Bluetooth audio systems and their constraints.
  • Interest in understanding how DSP algorithms scale across different platforms and partner implementations.

Collaboration & Communication

  • Effective communication skills, with the ability to discuss technical topics with engineers from different disciplines.
  • A collaborative, self-directed working style suited to small, highly technical teams.

Education & Experience

  • BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a signal-processing-related field; MS preferred.
  • 3+ years of relevant industry experience in DSP, audio, or related embedded systems development.

At Bose, you're inspired to be and do your best and are rewarded for your unique talents! Our compensation is thoughtfully tailored to your skills, experience, education, and location, and goes beyond base salary. The hiring range for this position in the primary work location of Framingham, Massachusetts is: $97,600-$134,200.The hiring range for other Bose work locations may vary.

In addition to competitive base pay we offer rewards including bonus programs, comprehensive health and welfare benefits, a 401(k) plan, plus exclusive perks designed to support your wellbeing, and a generous employee discount where you can immerse yourself in our products and experiences. We are a proudly independent company—driven by purpose, guided by our values, and united by a belief in the power of sound. As the world leader in audio experiences, we’re creating what’s next—pushing boundaries and delivering transformative sound experiences for people everywhere. Join us and make your next career move a mic-drop. Let’s Make Waves.

title: Regional Director, Geo Enterprise
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

REGIONAL DIRECTOR, GEO ENTERPRISE

As a Regional Director, Geo Enterprise at SpaceXSI, you'll build and lead a team of Account Executives driving revenue growth across new and existing business. You'll be a hands-on leader, coaching your team through complex sales cycles, building the processes and playbooks that scale our go-to-market motion, and serving as a senior voice for the enterprise customer inside SpaceXSI. This is an early and foundational sales leadership role. You'll help define what great enterprise sales looks like at SpaceXSI, working closely with GTM, Product, and Engineering to land and expand the Grok platform across the world's most sophisticated teams, based out of our downtown Austin office.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Hire, develop, and coach a high-performing team of Enterprise Account Executives to meet and exceed revenue targets; build and execute a sales strategy, owning pipeline generation, forecast accuracy, and overall territory performance

  • Get into deals - support your team on complex, high-stakes opportunities by engaging directly with engineering leaders, CTOs, and other executive stakeholders across the region

  • Drive operational rigor: maintain accurate forecasting, pipeline inspection, and CRM hygiene across the team

  • Partner with Enablement to accelerate AE ramp time and build training programs tailored to SpaceXSI's enterprise sales motion

  • Work closely with Product and Field Engineering to shape how we position SpaceXSI to engineering organizations at scale

  • Gather and synthesize customer and market feedback to inform product direction and go-to-market strategy; build the playbooks, processes, and institutional knowledge that will scale the enterprise sales organization as we continue to grow

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 10+ years of sales experience

  • 3+ years leading AE teams

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Track record leading high-performing AE teams

  • Experience selling developer tools, technical SaaS, or emerging technologies to technical stakeholders, from ICs to CTOs

  • Are based in the Austin, Texas area and have an established network across the enterprise technology market

  • A track record of building teams from the ground up and developing AEs into top performers

  • A hands-on leader who stays close to deals. You coach through live opportunities, not just pipeline reviews

  • Strong operational discipline: you know how to run a forecast, inspect a pipeline, and build repeatable sales processes

  • Technically fluent enough to hold credible conversations with senior engineers and CTOs

  • Thrive in an early-stage environment and are excited to build the systems and culture of a sales organization, not just manage one

  • Help define what great enterprise sales looks like at SpaceXSI, working closely with GTM, Product, and Engineering to land and expand across the world's most sophisticated software teams

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Onsite role: must be able to work in person at the Austin office 5 days/week

title: Cloud Operations Engineer - Linux
description:
Job Description – Linux & AWS Cloud Operations Engineer III

Experience: 5–7 Years | Level: Engineer III | Function: Cloud Operations / Infrastructure

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Linux & AWS Cloud Operations Engineer III with strong hands-on expertise in Linux administration, AWS infrastructure, networking, security, monitoring, automation, and production operations. The role will provide L2/L3 support for enterprise cloud environments and contribute to infrastructure transformation and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

  • AWS Administration: Manage and support EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, EBS, ELB/ALB/NLB, Auto Scaling, Route 53, CloudWatch, RDS, and related AWS services.
  • Linux Administration: Administer RHEL, CentOS/Rocky Linux, and Ubuntu environments, including OS configuration, patching, upgrades, hardening, package management, users/permissions, filesystems, services, and performance management.
  • Production Support: Provide L2/L3 support, troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues, handle P1/P2 incidents, perform RCA, and ensure SLA compliance.
  • Linux Troubleshooting: Troubleshoot CPU, memory, disk, filesystem, process, kernel, service, boot, SSH, authentication, DNS, and network issues.
  • AWS Networking: Strong understanding of VPC, subnets, route tables, Security Groups, NACLs, NAT Gateway, Transit Gateway, VPN, DNS, and load balancing.
  • Security: Manage IAM, security groups, encryption, access controls, OS hardening, vulnerability remediation, and security patching.
  • Monitoring & Performance: Use CloudWatch, SolarWinds, or similar tools for monitoring, alerting, capacity planning, and proactive issue detection.
  • Backup & DR: Support AWS backups, snapshots, recovery, replication, and disaster recovery testing.
  • Automation: Develop scripts using Bash/Shell and Python and support automation using Terraform, CloudFormation, or Ansible.
  • Change & Incident Management: Execute production changes following ITIL processes, including risk assessment, implementation, validation, rollback, and change closure.
  • Documentation: Maintain SOPs, runbooks, architecture documentation, troubleshooting guides, and operational procedures.
  • Collaborate with Network, Security, Database, Application, DevOps, and Infrastructure teams and participate in 24x7/on-call support as required.

Required Skills

  • 5–7 years of experience in Linux Administration, AWS Cloud Operations, or Infrastructure Engineering.
  • Strong hands-on experience with AWS and enterprise Linux.
  • Strong knowledge of Linux system administration, networking, storage, security, and performance troubleshooting.
  • Strong AWS knowledge covering EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, EBS, ELB, Auto Scaling, Route 53, CloudWatch, and RDS.
  • Strong understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, VPN, routing, NAT, firewalls, and load balancing.
  • Strong scripting skills in Shell/Bash and Python.
  • Experience with monitoring, incident/problem management, change management, RCA, backup, and DR.
  • Good understanding of cloud security and vulnerability management.

Preferred Skills

  • Terraform / CloudFormation / Ansible
  • AWS Systems Manager and Patch Manager
  • Docker / container technologies
  • CI/CD and DevOps practices
  • Git
  • AWS multi-account and hybrid environments
  • AWS or Linux certifications such as AWS Solutions Architect/SysOps/DevOps or RHCSA/RHCE
  • Experience with enterprise monitoring and security tools.

Key Success Criteria

  • Maintain high availability, security, and performance of AWS and Linux environments.
  • Resolve L2/L3 incidents within SLA and provide effective RCA.
  • Improve operational efficiency through automation and standardization.
  • Successfully execute production changes with appropriate validation and rollback plans.
  • Contribute to cloud modernization, security, monitoring, automation, and cost optimization initiatives.

title: Partnerships Lead
description:
About Us

Lorikeet is redefining what customer support looks like — and we're just getting started.

We build AI that handles complex, high-volume support for fintechs, healthtechs, marketplaces, and delivery services. Not chatbot-tier AI. The kind that actually resolves tickets, gives support teams their time back, and raises the bar for what software can do.

We're backed by over $50M USD from QED, Blackbird, and Square Peg, with backing from operators like Claire Hughes Johnson (ex-Stripe COO) and Cristina Cordova (Linear COO), plus founders of Canva, Atlassian, and Airwallex. We're the first company since Canva to be funded at early stage by all three of Australia's top VC funds — which tells you something about the calibre of people who've looked closely at what we're building and said yes.

Our customers include some of the largest telehealth, fintech, and marketplace companies in the US and Australia — many handling over a million support tickets a year. The problems are real, the scale is real, and the work matters.

If you want to build something that genuinely changes how businesses and customers interact — this is the place.

About the role

Partners already bring Lorikeet deals. Zendesk referrals, helpdesk and CCaaS platforms, and PE/VC portfolio networks have all brought us customers. But the program is still early: there's no tiering, no playbook, and no repeatable engine behind what's working. You'll turn those early wins into a partner channel that drives a real share of our pipeline, starting in the US and scaling across EMEA and APAC.

You'll report to our CRO and work closely with our AEs, Marketing and Forward Deployed teams. You'll own the partner program end to end, from design to signed partners to sourced revenue.

About you

You're a builder. You've stood up a partner program before, with tiers, terms, recruitment and attribution, at a company where nobody handed you a playbook. You have strong commercial instincts. You can tell a partner that will drive deals from one that just wants a logo swap, and you'd rather go deep with five good partners than collect fifty.

You have deep experience in partnerships, channel or alliances at B2B startups. AI or customer support and CX tech experience is a big plus. Partnering on AI products works differently from traditional SaaS, and knowing the helpdesk, CCaaS, SI and BPO landscape will get you moving faster.

What you'll do

  • Design the program. Define partner tiers across referral partners, helpdesk and CCaaS platforms, consultancies and SIs, and PE/VC portfolio networks. Set what each tier gets and owes: referral fees or margins, enablement, co-marketing and certification.

  • Double down on what's working. Turn our Zendesk referral motion, platform partners and investor portfolio networks into repeatable channels. Build the data to show which partners add value, and wind down the ones that don't.

  • Make marketplaces a growth lever. Own our presence on the Zendesk, Salesforce and HubSpot marketplaces, including listings, reviews and co-marketing, so buyers find Lorikeet where they already shop for support tools.

  • Co-sell with our AEs. Set the rules of engagement for deal registration, account mapping and handoffs, so partner deals speed up our sales cycle instead of slowing it down.

  • Build the engine and own the number. Stand up the playbook, contracts, enablement kit and CRM attribution. Own a partner-sourced pipeline target of $2M–$3M in your first 12 months, and report on it to leadership every month.

You might be a fit if you:

  • Bring 5+ years in partnerships, channel or alliances at B2B SaaS companies, including at least 2 years owning a partner program or a partner-sourced revenue target

  • Have built a partnerships program from the ground up

  • Thrive at early-stage companies, and would rather build the system yourself than inherit a big partner team at an established software company

  • Know the customer support ecosystem, including helpdesks, CCaaS platforms, SIs, BPOs and marketplaces, or have partnered on AI products and want to go deeper

  • Are comfortable making strategic calls with data, even when it means saying no to partners that won't move the needle

  • Have negotiated partner agreements yourself: referral fees, reseller margins, revenue share and co-sell terms

  • Have launched or grown an app marketplace listing on Zendesk, Salesforce AppExchange, HubSpot or a similar platform, and know what makes buyers install

  • Have co-sold alongside an AE team, using deal registration, account mapping (Crossbeam, Reveal or similar) and clean handoffs that sellers actually trust

  • Can enable a partner's team to sell and deliver a technical AI product, through pitch materials, certification and joint customer calls

  • Are hands-on with CRM: you've built partner attribution and reporting in Salesforce or HubSpot, not just consumed it

  • Can earn credibility with senior stakeholders: platform partner leaders, consultancy principals and PE/VC operating partners

  • Have run partners across more than one region, or are excited to build a program that spans the US, EMEA and APAC

What's unique about this opportunity?


A culture that's genuinely different. Low ego, high trust, no tolerance for talented jerks. We work efficiently, keep hours flexible, and actually mean it — because life outside work matters. We're committed to building a diverse team and actively encourage applicants from underrepresented backgrounds. We care far more about user obsession and eagerness to learn than traditional credentials.

A front-row seat to building something meaningful. We're Series A and moving fast. You'll have real scope to shape the product and the company — not just execute someone else's vision.

Performance recognized in real time, not on a calendar. Promotions happen when you're ready — leadership meets every six weeks specifically to identify and recognize strong performers, so you're never waiting for an arbitrary review window to move up.

We're AI-native, and we'll make you AI-native too. Every person at Lorikeet uses AI in their day-to-day work (current favourite: Claude Code), with unrestricted access and no usage limits. You'll leave with skills that matter for the next decade of work.

Twice a year, the whole company flies to Hawaii. Headquartered in Sydney, with teams spanning the US and UK — which means getting everyone in the same place is something we invest in seriously. We spend the time hacking on ideas, building things together that wouldn't otherwise exist, and making memories that remind you why you joined a startup in the first place.

A recruitment process built on respect, not hoops. We keep it simple: a couple of informal chats to share our story and hear yours, followed by a paid ~two-day work trial. The work trial is genuinely the best part — you'll work on real problems alongside the actual team, get a true feel for how we operate, and we'll both come out of it knowing whether this is the right fit. No trick questions, no take-homes that disappear into a void. Just real work, done together.

If you're from an underrepresented background and don't tick every box, please reach out anyway. We know firsthand that diverse teams perform better, and we're proud that our team reflects a broad spectrum of identities and lived experiences.

description:
Are you someone who doesn't let unjustified claims go unchallenged? Do you enjoy investigating discrepancies, negotiating with major retail customers, and turning disputed amounts into recovered cash?

As our Senior Claims Specialist (m/f/d), you will take ownership of complex retailer claims, deductions, and payment discrepancies. You will investigate cases, challenge unjustified deductions, and work closely with Sales, Finance, and Logistics to find solutions.

Your mission: Recover outstanding receivables, protect our profitability, and prevent recurring claims.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own retail claims: Independently manage claims, deductions, penalties, and disputed payments from investigation through to resolution.
  • Recover outstanding receivables: Challenge unjustified deductions, negotiate with retail customers, and ensure timely follow-up on open balances.
  • Investigate discrepancies: Analyse contracts, invoices, delivery documents, payment records, and logistics data to identify the root causes of claims.
  • Collaborate across departments: Work closely with Sales, Finance, Accounting, and Logistics to resolve disputes and ensure accurate documentation.
  • Prevent recurring claims: Identify patterns in retailer deductions and develop solutions to reduce future financial losses.
  • Improve processes: Establish structured claims tracking, reporting, and documentation while supporting automation and digitalisation initiatives.
  • Ensure transparency: Maintain accurate case records, monitor deadlines, and report on outstanding claims, recoveries, and recurring issues.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Relevant experience: Several years of experience in Claims Management, Accounts Receivable Disputes, Deduction Management, or a comparable commercial finance role.
  • Retail understanding: Ideally, experience working with FMCG companies, major retailers, grocery chains, discounters, or drugstores.
  • Strong analytical skills: Ability to investigate complex discrepancies, interpret customer agreements, and identify unjustified deductions.
  • Negotiation skills: Confident, persistent, and professional when challenging claims and communicating with external customers.
  • Systems expertise: Advanced Excel skills and experience working with ERP systems; SAP Business One is an advantage.
  • Ownership mentality: Highly structured, detail-oriented, and determined to resolve cases rather than simply process them.
  • Collaborative approach: Comfortable working across departments and driving solutions in a fast-paced environment.
  • Language skills: Strong German communication skills, both written and spoken; English is an advantage.

WHY IRONMAXX?

At IronMaxx, you will join a fast-growing company where your work has a direct impact on business performance. You will take ownership of commercially significant cases, collaborate with multiple departments, and actively contribute to building more efficient and scalable processes.
If you combine analytical thinking with commercial determination and enjoy turning complex challenges into measurable results, we want to hear from you.
Ready to make an impact? #BEcomeMAXX and apply now!

title: (Associate) Product Manager - Customer Lifecycle (f/m/x)
description:
About lemon.markets 🍋

We enable anyone to be an investor. Our mission is to grow investing opportunities for all European customers and businesses. By empowering FinTechs, banks, and wealth managers to offer investment products, we help create financial well-being for their customers.

lemon.markets is a Brokerage-as-a-Service platform: simple digital access to capital markets through a single API. Our API-first infrastructure abstracts brokerage complexity with a well-documented API, a self-service customer operations portal, and a clear regulatory framework, so partners can launch customer-centric, compliant products in weeks, not months.

As part of the dwpbank Group, we share a clear goal: we enable anyone to be an investor by making investing in capital markets more accessible. By combining dwpbank’s long-standing expertise and stability with lemon.markets’ technology-first mindset and speed, we are building a modern, modular securities services ecosystem. Together, we offer faster time-to-market, modular services, and a modern customer experience that helps financial service providers stay competitive and respond more flexibly in a changing market.

Your Mission

As an Associate Product Manager in the Customer Lifecycle domain, you will support the engine which makes sure our already onboarded customers have a positive experience on lifecycle events like re-KYC, account termination and customer service. Furthermore, you will be responsible for making sure lemon.markets delivers on its ongoing regulatory commitments. Your remit also covers owning the tooling which our operations colleagues use every day and making sure these evolve in sync with evolving regulatory landscape as well as business growth.

Reporting to the domain's Senior PM, you'll drive complex, multi-stakeholder commitments end-to-end. You'll work cross-functionally at lemon.markets and regularly interface with stakeholders from varying functional backgrounds. To be successful in this role, you should be able to bring stakeholders on the same page and drive a coherent product strategy aimed at improving the efficiency of processes which kick-in during the lifecycle of a customer with lemon.markets while making sure lemon.markets adheres to its regulatory obligations.

In this role you will:

  • Own the roadmap for the problem space end-to-end - i.e. from problem framing through to release, adoption and iteration.

  • Be embedded in a cross-functional team including operations and engineering, while engaging with other product teams, solutions engineering, and your colleagues in functions such as finance, risk and compliance.

  • Prioritise commitments against the domain strategy using quantitative and qualitative evidence, and share your trade-offs.

  • Propose forward-looking solutions that outlive the immediate ask, rather than one-off tactical fixes.

  • Interface regularly with your immediate customers and stakeholders to understand their pain points, capture feedback and use this information to shape your roadmap and product strategy.

  • Track market and regulatory developments in your problem space, and bring the insights back to the team and introduce informed iterations of your product strategy.

  • Write clearly and often - decision records, partner-facing specs, internal narratives. Writing is how decisions get made here.

You’ll be successful in this role if:

  • You have at least 1-2 years of product experience, including independently shipping complex products. You take ownership of outcomes, not just features.

  • You are comfortable with ambiguity. You can define an unclear problem space, structure it, and move forward without waiting for someone to hand you a spec.

  • You are comfortable working through legal text. You form your own preliminary view on a legal or regulatory question before discussing it with experts, and you know which questions to bring to them.

  • You argue your position based on data and evidence, and you iterate when the evidence changes.

  • You write clearly. Decisions, specs, and partner communication are a core part of this job, and you can make complex topics easy to follow on paper.

  • You use AI tools in your day-to-day work and actively explore how far they can take your output.

  • You are professionally fluent in English. However, German speakers would be preferred.

How we take care of you:

  • 🚀 Compensation package: We offer you a competitive salary, based on your experience and the value-add you bring to lemon.markets.

  • 🕑 Flexible working hours: We trust people to choose when they work best and avoid a rigid 9 to 5 mindset. You decide on the rhythm that helps you do your best work, with only shared core hours from 12:00 to 16:00 to support collaboration.

  • 🏢 Hybrid work setup: You can work from anywhere in Germany within a hybrid model. At the same time, in-person collaboration is a key part of our culture. That being said, individual contributor lemoneers work 4 or more days per month on-site in our Berlin office, spending quality time together with the team at events, onsites/offsites or over team dinners.

  • 📈 Grow with us: We take your personal development seriously! You’ll get regular mentorship and stretch opportunities, a clear career development framework with frequent feedback conversations as well as an annual learning budget.

  • 🌱 People & culture: You’ll feel our culture in the small things, like Polaroids from our lemoneers’ first day and our monthly new-joiner breakfasts. But also in the bigger things, like celebrating the onboarding of new partners or our annual offsites, where the whole company comes together to connect, reflect, and celebrate.

  • 💛 Perks & benefits: We choose benefits that add actual value. We sponsor a Deutschlandticket for employees on unlimited contracts, plus 50% off on Beatvest - our partner for financial education and investing.

  • 🏝 Workation: Get out of here! At lemon.markets you can work remotely from anywhere in the EU for up to 10 consecutive days at a time, and up to 60 days per year in total.

As an equal opportunity employer, lemon.markets is committed to building an inclusive workplace. The company welcomes people from all different backgrounds, including age, citizenship, ethnic and racial origins, gender identities, individuals with disabilities, marital status, religions and ideologies, and sexual orientations to apply.

If you feel this role could be a great match for you even if you don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you, please apply.

You have any questions? Feel free to contact us via talent@lemon.markets

title: Area Manager II - Chester, VA
description:
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Area Manager. In this role, you will lead a team of hourly workforce and will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.

Key job responsibilities

* Manage safety, quality, productivity, and customer delivery promises
* Collaborate with all support teams including Safety, Engineering, Loss Prevention, Quality Assurance, Human Resources to develop plans to meet business objectives
* Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
* Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
* Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud
* Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
* Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)

Our fulfillment network launches new Operations sites every year, providing various opportunities for your professional growth. We hire Area Managers based on location preference and the business’ current openings.

title: Software Development Engineer I, Inference models optimization, AWS Neuron Inference
description:
The Annapurna Labs team at Amazon Web Services (AWS) builds the AWS Neuron SDK, the software development kit used to accelerate deep learning and GenAI workloads on AWS Trainium machine learning accelerators.

The Neuron Inference organization is at the forefront of optimizing inference performance for a wide range of ML models and model architectures on AWS's custom ML accelerators. We are working across the stack from PyTorch to the hardware-software boundary, our engineers build systematic infrastructure, develop high-performance kernels for ML functions, ensuring every compute unit is fine-tuned for optimal performance for our customers' demanding workloads. We combine deep hardware knowledge with ML expertise to push the boundaries of what's possible in AI acceleration.

As part of the broader Neuron organization, our team works across multiple technology layers — from frameworks and kernels through to compiler, runtime, and collectives. We not only optimize performance on open weight models but also contribute to future architecture designs and work closely with customers to enable optimal performance on their models. This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of machine learning, high-performance computing, and distributed architectures, where you'll help shape the future of AI acceleration technology.

As a Software Engineer I, you will design and implement business-critical features and contribute to optimizing the performance of models on AWS Trainium end to end. We operate in spaces that are very large, yet our teams remain small and agile. There is no blueprint. We're inventing. We're experimenting. It is a very unique learning culture. The team works closely with customers on their model enablement, providing direct support and optimization expertise to ensure their machine learning workloads achieve optimal performance on AWS ML accelerators. The team also collaborates with open source ecosystems to provide seamless integration and bring peak performance at scale for customers and developers.

This role is responsible for development, enablement, and performance tuning of a wide variety of LLM model families, including massive-scale large language models like GLM, Kimi, and beyond. The Model Enablement team works side by side with compiler engineers and runtime engineers to create, build, and tune distributed inference solutions with AWS Trainium.

You can learn more about Neuron:

* https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/compiler/index.html
* https://aws.amazon.com/machine-learning/neuron/
* https://github.com/aws/aws-neuron-sdk
* https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-neuron
* https://www.amazon.science/how-silicon-innovation-became-the-secret-sauce-behind-awss-success

If this sounds exciting to you - come build the future with us!

Key job responsibilities
* Optimize open models to run best on Trainium, including optimizing sharding, developing NKI kernels and ensuring accuracy. This provides ready-to-serve models to our customers and also gives them a starting point to optimize their own.
* Collaborate with cross-disciplinary teams that may include hardware design, firmware, compiler, runtime, and ML engineers to develop software that enables and optimizes custom ML accelerator silicon
* Write clean, maintainable code (C/C++, Python, or Rust) following best practices for systems-level and performance-critical development
* Participate in code reviews, contribute to technical documentation, and help deploy agentic tools to accelerate the enablement of new models on Trainium
* Demonstrate operational excellence through monitoring, debugging, and resolving issues across hardware-software integration boundaries, including on-call responsibilities
* Keep learning emerging technologies in ML accelerators, compiler optimization, computer architecture, and cloud-scale distributed systems

About the team
The Model Enablement team fosters a builder's culture where experimentation is encouraged and impact is measurable. We emphasize collaboration, technical ownership, and continuous learning.
Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we're building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects that help our team members develop their engineering expertise so they feel empowered to take on more complex tasks in the future. Join us to solve some of the most interesting and impactful infrastructure challenges in AI/ML today.
Our team builds and operates software that powers key experiences for Amazon customers. We value technical excellence, collaboration, and a commitment to continuous improvement. Every engineer on the team has a voice in shaping our technical direction and the opportunity to mentor others.
We are focused on building reliable, scalable systems while creating an inclusive environment where engineers at all levels can learn, grow, and do their best work. If you want to solve meaningful problems alongside a supportive and motivated group of engineers, this is the place for you.

title: Intimate Apparel Design Internship
location: New York, New York, United States
description:
Internship Overview

Dana-co offers a supervised educational internship for students interested in intimate apparel and loungewear design. Through observation, guided practice, and regular feedback from experienced designers, participants will explore the design process from concept development through sample review.


The program is designed to complement classroom learning and develop skills applicable across the fashion industry. Interns will follow an individualized learning plan, with activities tailored to their academic background and educational goals.


Learning Activities

Under the close supervision of a design mentor, interns will have opportunities to:

  • Observe model fittings and practice recording fit observations for discussion and feedback.
  • Learn how style summaries, features and benefits pages, and presentation boards communicate design concepts.
  • Explore how designers organize and reference garment samples throughout development.
  • Review sample technical packages and practice preparing selected components as educational exercises.
  • Learn garment measurement techniques using practice samples and compare findings with a mentor.
  • Observe pattern reviews and discuss how construction and fit concerns translate into pattern corrections.
  • Follow a style’s development to understand sample stages, approval processes, and collaboration among design, technical design, and product development teams.
  • Complete a supervised learning project demonstrating the concepts explored during the internship.


Educational Background and Interests

  • Currently enrolled in Fashion Design, Intimate Apparel Design, or a related educational program.
  • Interest in lingerie, loungewear, or swimwear design.
  • Foundational coursework in garment construction, patternmaking, or textiles.
  • Basic familiarity with Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, and Microsoft Excel.
  • Curiosity, attention to detail, and willingness to ask questions and incorporate feedback.
  • Interest in learning about patternmaking software, including Lectra; prior experience is not required.
  • Prior professional experience is not required. Selection will focus on educational goals, relevant coursework, and alignment with the program’s learning opportunities.


Mentorship and Learning Outcomes

Participants will receive:

  • A designated design mentor and scheduled learning discussions.
  • Guided instruction and feedback on practice exercises.
  • Exposure to intimate apparel construction, fit, and development methods.
  • Opportunities to connect classroom concepts with professional design practices.
  • A final review of progress toward agreed learning objectives.


Program Structure

  • Duration: A defined educational term, with start and end dates established before participation.
  • Schedule: Coordinated with the student’s academic calendar and coursework.
  • Academic coordination: Learning objectives and any credit requirements will be coordinated with the student’s educational institution. Academic credit is subject to the institution’s approval.
  • Compensation: This is an unpaid educational internship; no wages are offered.
  • Nature of participation: Activities center on observation and closely supervised educational exercises. Interns do not replace paid employees or assume responsibility for routine administrative tasks, production deliverables, or business deadlines.
  • Future employment: Participation does not guarantee or create an entitlement to employment with Dana-co.

title: SDE (Rust or C/C++) , Device Cloud Core Services
description:
Application deadline: Nov 16, 2026

Join Device Cloud Core Services (DCCS), the team building the foundational platform that powers millions of Amazon devices worldwide. We create critical customer experiences, from the moment a customer unboxes their device to every interaction after that. Our engineers work across the full technology stack, from backend web services and mobile SDKs to device software, and solve hard problems in device onboarding, connectivity, enterprise device management, and data synchronization. In this role you will help build Aries, Amazon's platform for managing and securing Amazon devices for enterprise customers. If you like building scalable, reliable systems that change how customers and businesses use Amazon devices, from Echo to Kindle to Ring, this is your chance to shape the future of connected devices at Amazon scale.

Core Technical Requirements:

- Strong programming skills in Rust or C/C++
- Experience building integrations across device software and backend services
- Understanding of distributed systems, APIs, and service integration
- Familiarity with device management, security, or compliance concepts is a plus
- Ability to write efficient, secure, and maintainable code

Key job responsibilities
- Build and maintain on-device software for Amazon's enterprise device management platform (Aries)
- Develop integrations between on-device agents and backend management services
- Implement device policy, compliance, and security capabilities for enterprise customers
- Work across the device and cloud boundary to deliver reliable, scalable enterprise features
- Partner with platform, security, and product teams to land features end to end

A day in the life
As an SDE on the Aries enterprise device management team, you'll build and maintain the on-device software that lets Amazon manage devices for enterprise customers. Daily activities include developing integrations between on-device agents and backend management services, implementing device policy, compliance, and security capabilities, and debugging across the device and cloud boundary. You'll collaborate with platform, security, and product partners to land features end to end, and work with teams across Amazon's device portfolio. Success means delivering reliable, scalable enterprise management capabilities that customers can trust to control and secure their fleets at scale.

About the team
The Aries team builds Amazon's enterprise device management platform. We own the device software and cloud services that let enterprise customers set up, manage, and secure their Amazon device fleets, including device policy, compliance, and security capabilities. Our work spans the device and the cloud, and we partner closely with platform, security, and product teams across Amazon Devices to bring enterprise grade management to Amazon hardware.

title: Combo Clerk

description:
PAQ, Inc. is committed to building a workplace where employees feel valued, supported, and empowered to do their best work. We believe diverse perspectives and experiences strengthen our organization and drive better outcomes for our customers and communities.


Combo Clerks are crucial in in-store operations, often being customers' final point of contact. They are responsible for accurately processing various forms of payment for store merchandise. At the start of their shift, each Combo Clerk is assigned a cash drawer, which they must reconcile accurately by the end of their shift. Additionally, Combo Clerks assist with responsibilities in other departments as needed.

Essential Functions of the Position:

  • Provide friendly and helpful customer service, including handling difficult situations and resolving customer concerns, with supervisor assistance as needed.
  • Accurately identify produce items and process produce codes.
  • Process all forms of transactions, including cash, checks, coupons, and electronic payments (debit, credit, gift cards, EFS, EBT, and WIC).
  • Utilize knowledge of store layout and products to assist customers with inquiries and problem-solving.
  • Follow detailed payment acceptance processes to ensure accuracy and minimize losses for the company and customers.
  • Efficiently and accurately process all store merchandise at the register, maintaining a sufficient scan rate to minimize customer wait times.
  • Prepare and maintain accurate records for cash drops and cash and coin needs for the register throughout the shift.
  • Adhere to all company policies, including accounting for items at the bottom of the basket.
  • Comply with California Department of Alcoholic Beverage Control and Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms, and Explosives regulations, such as selling alcohol only during appropriate hours, not selling to visibly intoxicated persons, and adequately checking IDs to prevent sales to minors.
  • Utilize supervisor assistance to void items or transactions and resolve technical issues at the check stand.
  • Supervise and operate self-checkout (SCO) stations, ensuring customer accuracy in scanning items, processing payments, and troubleshooting as needed.
  • Reconcile the assigned till at the end of the shift, accurately balancing each form of payment and the total amount processed for the day.
  • Process customer transactions accurately and efficiently through the Point of Sale (POS) system.
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of ongoing promotions and store policies to provide accurate information to customers.

  • Proficiency in basic math and cash handling procedures.
  • Understanding of customer service best practices and strategies to enhance customer engagement.

Skills:

  • Strong communication skills to interact effectively with customers and team members.
  • Ability to operate POS systems and other cashier equipment.
  • Attention to detail to ensure accuracy in transactions and handling of cash.
  • Basic computer skills for operating the POS system.

Abilities:

  • Ability to adapt to changing situations, manage multiple demands, and work effectively with diverse personalities.

  • Lift and carry items up to 25 pounds frequently and up to 50 pounds occasionally.
  • Perform repetitive motions such as reaching, bending, stooping, squatting, and handling products.
  • Exhibit manual dexterity for handling money and operating POS systems, including 10-key adding machines and self-checkout (SCO) systems.
  • Maintain clear communication with customers and team members.
  • Move quickly and efficiently to assist customers and manage workload.

Work Conditions:

title: Product Education Engineer
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

PRODUCT EDUCATION ENGINEER

SpaceXSI ships fast: new models, new agentic capabilities, and new workflows every week. The gap between what our product can do and what developers know how to build with it grows with every release. As a Product Education Engineer, you'll close that gap through hands-on labs, workshops, and tutorials, using our product as part of your own development process.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Build our technical learning library, including code walkthroughs, tutorials, labs, workshops, reference implementations, and instructor-led training

  • Lead large-format workshops, technical deep dives, and hands-on enablement sessions that help engineering organizations adopt AI coding tools and drive measurable outcomes

  • Partner with Product, Engineering, DevRel, and Go-to-Market ahead of major launches so new capabilities ship with clear educational framing, practical examples, and adoption paths on day one

  • Get Field Engineers, AI Deployment Managers, and Solutions Architects up to speed quickly on new capabilities

  • Design learning experiences for both developers and non-technical users (e.g. engineering leaders evaluating rollout, PMs pairing with agents)

  • Measure what works, tracking adoption and fluency gains rather than completion rates, and share insights with Product and Engineering on where developers get stuck

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 5+ years of experience in Field Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Consulting, or software engineering at a developer tools or platform company

  • Experience delivering technical training, workshops, or enablement sessions to engineering audiences

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Hands-on experience across the software development lifecycle, with an understanding of how modern engineering organizations build software

  • Daily use of AI coding tools, with customized personal development workflows

  • Experience building demo environments, sample repos, content-freshness automation, or self-service enablement tooling

  • Experience designing technical curriculum or learning programs for both developer and non-technical audiences

  • Experience presenting complex technical concepts to engineering leaders and executives to support decisions on tool adoption

  • Experience with interactive or AI-native learning formats such as in-product learning, hands-on labs, or live teaching

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

Annual Salary:

$130,000 - $210,000 USD

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.

This is a full-stack product-engineering role: you'll work directly with researchers and engineers to understand their workflows, identify bottlenecks, and rapidly ship solutions that multiply their productivity. Whether you're creating platforms for experiment orchestration, developing novel visualization tools for model evaluation, or building abstractions for understanding model behavior at scale, your work will directly accelerate our mission of building frontier AI models.   • Experience building dense, data-facing tools such as transcript viewers, diffing systems, review queues, observability products, or operational dashboards, with strong opinions about how structured data should be rendered

  • Product instincts: identifying the right problems to solve and moving from concept to working prototype with ease

  • Ability to move quickly under ambiguity, collaborate closely with researchers and domain experts, and take open-ended problems from rough need to reliable product

title: Manager Corporate Tax
description:
Company :

Highmark Health

Job Description :

JOB SUMMARY


The Manager, Corporate Tax manages the tax compliance function for Highmark Health, Allegheny Health Network (AHN), affiliated tax-exempt entities, and related partnerships, joint ventures, employee benefit plans, limited liability companies, trusts, and other structures. The role oversees the preparation and filing of Forms 990, 990-T, and other federal, state, and local filings, ensuring compliance with applicable requirements for tax-exempt organizations.


The Manager, Corporate Tax supervises tax compliance processes and staff, ensuring activities are completed accurately and on time and that positions taken are well supported and documented. This includes coordinating with external auditors and tax advisors, supporting audits and regulatory inquiries, and managing responses to tax notices.


In addition, the Manager, Corporate Tax evaluates business activities, investments, and joint venture arrangements to identify and address tax-exempt compliance considerations, including unrelated business income (UBIT) and protection of exempt status. The role partners with Finance, Legal, and operational leadership to communicate tax implications and support business initiatives. This position also coordinates the resolution of tax controversies and leads the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of tax processes, controls, and compliance procedures.


ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES:
1. Communicate effectively. This position displays effective communication skills while performing the following functions:

  • Identify senior management’s business objectives and identify tax strategies that will accomplish those objectives.
  • Coordinate activities, make recommendations, and support decisions to ensure projects that require tax planning services can proceed to a resolution as quickly as possible.
  • Defend existing tax strategies and positions against challenge or make appropriate and timely revisions to our tax positions when necessary.
  • Coordinate the communication, education and implementation on all tax matters associated with evaluating business opportunities.

2. Manage the tax function for the Company and its Affiliates.

  • The Highmark Group must file a significant number of Federal, state and local returns, registrations, licenses and other filings. The Manager is expected to independently make the majority of decisions regarding recurring matters of tax and regulatory compliance. The incumbent must bring matters to the attention of the Director that have a major impact upon the tax liability of the company, that would impact corporate policy, or that would impact Highmark business strategies. However, the incumbent is expected to provide a detailed analysis of the business alternatives, the impacts of the alternatives, and a recommendation as to the best alternative. The Manager must integrate tax, statutory and GAAP knowledge bases in directing the Corporate Tax Department functions.
  • his includes thousands of documents covering many different types of taxes (income, excise, sales and use, capital stock/franchise, property, international, business privilege, etc.) and many different varieties of each of those taxes from many different jurisdictions (federal, all states, a wide range of municipalities and international).
  • Ensure the accurate calculation and preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual tax accruals for the financial statements of the Highmark Group
  • Research and integrate tax, statutory, and GAAP issues, to identify available alternatives, and to communicate the results.

3. Ensure the Highmark Group’s business transactions are structured to take advantage of opportunities and avoid the pitfalls inherent in tax law so that liability associated with all types of taxes is minimized.

  • This means continuous assessment of all current tax positions assigned by the Director, Corporate Tax, which involves staying abreast of legislation, regulations, rulings and court cases affecting all types of taxation in a wide range of U.S. tax jurisdictions and certain international jurisdictions.

4. Coordinate the communication, education and implementation on all tax matters associated with evaluating business opportunities.

  • This includes determining the tax implications then developing and possibly implementing tax planning strategies on all types of prospective business transactions for the Highmark Group.
  • It involves consulting with all levels of management, supporting the operational staff, engaging and guiding the appropriate internal resources and directing outside counsel (when employed).

5. Coordinate the settlement of tax controversies, including management of activities related to tax litigation.

  • This includes defending our tax positions on audit from a variety of taxing authorities, regulatory agencies, internal auditors and our external auditing firm

6. Coordinate the development, implementation and refinement of departmental processes and procedures.

  • This includes documentation of major processes, risk assessments, design of adequate internal controls and compliance with testing procedures required under Sarbanes-Oxley Act - Section 404 and related auditing standards.

7. Other duties as assigned or requested.


QUALIFICATIONS:

Minimum

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting or related field, or relevant experience and/or education as determined by the company in lieu of bachelor's degree
  • 7 years of tax compliance, planning and ASC 740 experience either in a corporate tax department or public accounting firm
  • 3 years in a management or leadership role

Preferred

  • Experience with tax-exempt organizations, including preparation and review of Forms 990 and 990-T, and analysis of unrelated business income (UBIT)
  • Familiarity with healthcare systems, including tax-exempt compliance considerations related to hospitals, affiliates, and joint ventures
  • Knowledge of federal, state, and local tax requirements impacting tax-exempt entities and partnerships
  • Experience coordinating with external auditors, tax advisors, and regulatory agencies on compliance and audit matters
  • Ability to assess business activities and transactions and communicate related tax implications to finance, legal, and operational leadership
  • Understanding of Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) and the ability to partner effectively with accounting teams
  • CPA, Master’s Degree in Taxation, MBA, JD, or relevant advanced certification preferred


SKILLS

  • Proven leadership skills – ability to motivate others to quickly achieve results in a matrixed environment.
  • Uses knowledge of industry and market trends to develop and champion long-term strategies.
  • Demonstrates the ability to effectively persuade others to listen, commit, and act on a new approach.
  • Self-confident with an ability to accept and respond to challenges in a positive manner.
  • Strong and effective verbal and written communication skills.
  • Effectively presents complex topics in a concise manner to audiences at various levels and in various sizes.
  • Broad understanding of business issues, metrics, organizational linkages and customer value.
  • Successful experience in achieving results through people in a complex environment.
  • Strong organizational and analytical skills in addition to project leadership and management skills.

title: Assoc/AVP, Business Analyst, Technology Group
description:
GIC is one of the world’s largest sovereign wealth funds. With over 2,000 employees across 11 locations around the world, we invest in more than 40 countries globally across asset classes and businesses. Working at GIC gives you exposure to an extraordinary network of the world’s industry leaders. As a leading global long-term investor, we Work at the Point of Impact for Singapore’s financial future, and the communities we invest in worldwide.

Enterprise and Data Technology
Enterprise & Data Technology builds and advances the technology that underpins our enterprise and data capabilities. It brings together our core technology and data experts to design and deliver platforms for integration, analytics, and innovation. By combining these strengths into one coordinated group, we create seamless solutions that connect systems, improve data accessibility, and leverage AI at the platform level to enable smarter decision-making. Through modern, scalable, and secure technology, the team empowers the organisation with tools that drive insight, collaboration, and operational excellence.

Enterprise Data & Analytics (EDA)

Enterprise Data & Analytics (EDA) harnesses one of GIC’s most valuable assets — data — to generate insights, drive outcomes and solve complex business challenges. We ingest, analyse and contextualise data across industries and asset classes to support investment decision-making and enhance investment processes. Together, we are building a high-performance enterprise data infrastructure, developing outcome-oriented data products and enabling GIC’s transformation into a data-driven organisation.

What will you do in this role?

As a risk-focused business analyst, you will partner with GIC’s top-of-the-house investment and risk professionals, shaping transformational capabilities that power critical investment data and analytics. You will collaborate across teams to build out impactful solutions and build new risk capabilities with significant room to grow as the capability scales out. This role supports GIC’s vision of being a data- and technology-driven global long-term investment firm.

Be part of an ambitious technology team supporting top-of-the-house investment activities, where data and analytics capabilities directly influence the long-term risk and reward profile of GIC’s total portfolio.

  • Play a pivotal role in the design, build and adoption of technology solutions consumed by investment and risk professionals across the firm, working closely with solution architects and subject matter experts to build robust, scalable and impactful data products.
  • Engage senior business stakeholders, data management teams and technology partners to align priorities, manage trade-offs and drive tangible, high-impact business outcomes.
  • Develop domain understanding of investment risk processes and technology capabilities, and apply this knowledge to shape data strategy, solution design and delivery execution.
  • Communicate and translate complex investment and risk questions into implementable requirements, contributing to model design, implementation, validation.
  • Manage the delivery of business solutions by applying strong analytical judgement, shaping delivery requirements, and priorities, as well as guiding teams to create measurable data and technology value for the business.
  • Proactively share learnings and provide guidance to team members to uplift service levels and deepen business knowledge across the team.
  • Streamline processes effectively to leverage on platforms, technology and artificial intelligence (AI) tools, applying AI to accelerate workstreams while continuously assessing improvements and innovations.

What impact can you make in this role?


You will lead strategic outcomes for GIC’s top-of-the-house investment and risk professionals, shaping transformational capabilities that power critical investment data and analytics. This role supports GIC’s vision of being a data- and technology-driven global long-term investment firm.

What makes you a successful candidate?

Join us if you are passionate about data and technology, and are motivated to lead the development of GIC’s enterprise data foundation, infrastructure and analytics capabilities.

  • 4-8 years of relevant data and technology experience, preferably in financial services, risk or asset management, including collaborating with cross-functional business analysis, data and engineering teams to deliver impactful outcomes.
  • Good experience in the following:
    • Developing structured plans for the execution of data and technology solutions to uplift processes in relation to business analytics.
    • Defining business and functional specifications, and operationalizing it to unlock business value
    • Engaging senior stakeholders to influence adoption of data solutions
    • Working with SQL and Python, relational database queries, and modern data platforms such as Databricks and Snowflake
    • Preferred experience with application of AI and agentic workflows to business and technology transformation
  • Agility to learn with attention to detail, with the ability to operate effectively across data, technology and finance domains.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills across technical and non-technical audiences, with the ability to translate complex data and technology concepts into clear business implications.
  • Good people leadership, with the ability to engage data engineers, business analysts and data stewards while staying connected to the day-to-day realities of delivery teams.
  • Strong business leadership, with the ability to engage stakeholders across functions and seniority levels, and to collaborate with and influence cross-department business and technology partners in the development and execution of data and technology strategies.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification in a Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM) discipline is advantageous.

Work at the Point of Impact
We need to be forward-looking to attract the right people to help us become the Leading Global Long-term Investor. Join our ambitious, agile, and diverse teams - be empowered to push boundaries and pursue innovative ideas, share your views, and be heard. Be anchored on our PRIME Values: Prudence, Respect, Integrity, Merit and Excellence, which guides us in how we make our day-to-day decisions. We strive to inspire. To make an impact.

Flexibility at GIC
At GIC, our offices are vibrant hubs for ideation, professional growth, and interpersonal connection. At the same time, we believe that flexibility allows us to do our best work and be our best selves. Thus, our teams come into the office four days per week to harness the benefits of in-person collaboration, but have the flexibility to choose which days they work from home and adjust this arrangement as situational needs arise.

title: (Senior) Consultant – Healthcare Data & Strategy (m/f/d)

In addition, you will actively support the development of high-impact proposals and pitch documents for prospective clients.

You will collaborate closely with internal teams, particularly the Data Science and Analysis teams, to ensure scalable, high-quality solutions for our clients. The position offers a clear development path toward leadership responsibilities within Statista Healthcare.

  • Co-develop project methodologies, KPI frameworks, and scoring logic in close coordination with the Analysis and Data Science teams

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, including confidence in working with senior stakeholders

  • Experience supporting pitches, RFP responses, and business development activities

  • Willingness to travel internationally as required for client engagements

Why Statista Healthcare?

  • Strategic and hands-on role within a dynamic and growing healthcare vertical

  • Direct contribution to international client engagements and product development

  • Collaboration with interdisciplinary teams across consulting, product, and data science

description:

Under the direction of the Manager of Patient Transport and Visitor Services, the Patient Transporter will function within the guidelines of South Shore Health’s policies and procedures. The Patient Transporter provides prompt, courteous, customer service to patients, visitors, and co-workers. He/ She works in collaboration with other team members and ancillary departments by providing excellent service. Responsible for safe transport of patients, specimens, and equipment. He/ She is responsible for the safe transport of patients using a wheelchair or stretcher. This may also include the transport of patients with oxygen, IV poles and other equipment. He/ She may also be responsible for carrying out dispatch services and the appropriate documentation of such services when needed.

Compensation Pay Range:

$19.10 - $27.30

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

1. Safety/Quality - Fosters a “Culture of Safety” through personal ownership and commitment to a safe environment.
a. Verifies patient identification prior to the start of any transport.
b. Safely transports patients between departments (radiology, PACU, medical surgical units, and emergency department) using stretchers, wheelchairs, and beds.
c. Follows proper hand hygiene to support patient and staff safety.
d. Picks up patients and transports them to the designated areas within 18–20 minutes.
e. Assists with maintaining a safe, clean, and orderly patient environment.
f. Responsible for following Infection Prevention guidelines in cleaning and maintaining stretchers, wheelchairs, and other applicable equipment.
g. Monitors the safety of the behavior management patient. Checks for Blue for Behavior bar on patient room placard.

2. Patient Care/ Clinical Support Responsibilities
a. Assisting with patient transfers using specialized equipment such as slide boards, gait belts, etc.
b. Monitor patient comfort and condition during transport.
c. Monitor O2 & IV lines during transport for safety and changes.
d. Report any changes or concerns to nursing staff.
e. Assist in patient repositioning and hygiene support.
f. Discharges patients following proper procedures. Upon notification of discharge, the patient is safely brought to the main entrance or departure lounge.
g. Transports lab specimens from all areas (inpatient units, ambulatory, etc.) to the Laboratory using universal precautions carried out.
h. Transports x–ray reports, medical records and all other equipment necessary, O2, etc.
i. Safely handles gas cylinders and safely applies patient oxygen administration devices under direct Nursing supervision.
j. In time of emergency, bring a code cart to the designated unit.

3. Communication and Coordination
a. Communicate clearly with nursing and clinical staff.
b. Accurately inform departments of patient departure and return to unit as soon as possible.
c. Communicate and engage with patients in a positive style/ technique providing reassurance and emotional support.
d. Communicate any concerns or observations to clinical staff.
e. Maintains awareness of patient belongings and coordinates with clinical staff to ensure proper labeling is present.
f. Considers the individual needs of each person with whom they interact.
g. Interacts with sensitivity in the delivery of services of diverse populations as needed.
h. Maintain a professional, courteous attitude toward patients, co–workers, and all departments daily.
i. Clarifies instructions and asks guidance when necessary to maintain patient safety.
j. Maintains on–going communication with the nurse assigned to the patient.

4. Technology
a. Utilizes software applications required by department and unit standards.
b. Accountable to understand how to operate SSH issued device to receive transport orders and document completion of services.
c. Answers the phone and dispatches services when needed, prioritizing needs of the nursing department. If covering the Dispatcher, logs calls appropriately, as they come in over the computer.

5. Professional Development
a. Attends mandatory in–services as required by South Shore Health.
b. Biannual attendance at in–service mandatory; i.e., CPR.
c. Completes annual education as assigned through Healthstream or other learning management systems by CPDS in a timely manner.
d. Accountable for being informed about changes in hospital policy and procedures.

6. Compliance
a. Complies with applicable policies and procedures.
b. Safeguards the privacy and security of patient information. The employee complies with policies and procedures relating to SSH’s privacy and security programs.
c. Brings potential compliance issues to a manager, supervisor, executive director, or VP.
d. Complies with the mandatory education requirements of compliance, privacy, and security programs.
