title: Founder's Associate (f/m/x)
description:
About lemon.markets 🍋

We enable anyone to be an investor. Our mission is to grow investing opportunities for all European customers and businesses. By empowering FinTechs, banks, and wealth managers to offer investment products, we help create financial well-being for their customers.

lemon.markets is a Brokerage-as-a-Service platform: simple digital access to capital markets through a single API. Our API-first infrastructure abstracts brokerage complexity with a well-documented API, a self-service customer operations portal, and a clear regulatory framework, so partners can launch customer-centric, compliant products in weeks, not months.

As part of the dwpbank group, we’re adding a layer of resources and expertise to benefit from, while continuing to operate as an independent fintech with our own team, product, and start-up identity under the dwpbank umbrella.

Your Mission:

As a Founder’s Associate, you will work closely with the Founder and CEO and leadership team to help drive the company’s strategic priorities and operational execution.

In this role, you will take ownership of high-impact, cross-functional projects across the business. These may range from supporting strategic initiatives in commercial, product, and operations teams to improving internal processes, building organisational structures, and helping ensure alignment as the company scales.

This role is ideal for someone who is excited by our mission of enabling anyone to invest in capital markets. You will be close to many strategic initiatives and interact beyond lemon.markets towards our parent company, dwpbank. You will get the best of both worlds: the opportunity to work closely with experienced experts across functions while taking on meaningful ownership in a dynamic and ambitious environment.

This is going to be the ride of a lifetime for someone, who thrives in a fast-moving environment, enjoys solving ambiguous problems, and wants to gain first-hand experience in how a high-growth fintech infrastructure company is built.

You will:

  • Support the Founder and CEO on strategic and operational projects that drive company goals and priorities.

  • Own and lead projects with a deep focus on brokerage, custody and capital markets, this is where you will spend a significant part of your time and where domain knowledge is essential.

  • Analyse market developments, competitor dynamics, and trends across the European brokerage, wealth, and investment infrastructure landscape.

  • Take ownership of special projects that support the next stage of lemon.markets’ growth.

  • Lead and mentor the Founder’s Associate Intern team, providing structure, guidance, and prioritisation across projects while helping develop their skills and ensuring high-quality execution.

  • Contribute to refining and scaling internal processes, documentation, and operating structures across the company, especially in light of what becomes possible with AI.

  • Help develop, structure, and execute cross-functional initiatives across teams.

  • Act as a connector across the organisation by understanding team priorities, spotting gaps and blockers early, and helping drive effective cross-functional collaboration.

You’ll be successful in this role if you:

  • You have a background (bachelor and master degree) in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Computer science or a similar area.

  • You are an entrepreneurial problem solver. You strive to take ownership of the tasks you get and apply your analytical skills, structured thinking, and independent working style towards solving them.

  • You have gained 2 years or more of hands-on experience in a fast-paced environment. Ideally, you have worked in an early-stage startup, fintech, consulting, tech company or similar.

  • You bring hands-on experience in brokerage, trading, custody, or capital markets infrastructure, or a track record in strategic roles (e.g. CEO office, executive board office, in-house consulting) working on company-level topics with senior leadership.

  • You cope well with frequent change and ambiguity. Changing tasks & requirements excite you. You are able to think logically, break down complex problems and prioritise between multiple tasks on your table.

  • You are a team player. Working together as a team and sharing knowledge comes naturally to you.

  • You never let anything fall down your plate. Being on top of things is what you are known for. Having no hesitation to follow up on people until the job gets done.

  • You are ready and willing to take ownership. “This is not my job!” is not part of your vocabulary - you identify problems, take initiative to take them on, and challenge the status quo.

How we take care of you:

  • 🚀 Compensation package: We offer you a competitive salary, based on your experience and the value-add you bring to lemon.markets.

  • 🕑 Flexible working hours: We trust people to choose when they work best and avoid a rigid 9 to 5 mindset. You decide on the rhythm that helps you do your best work, with only shared core hours from 12:00 to 16:00 to support collaboration.

  • 🏢 Hybrid work setup: You can work from anywhere in Germany within a hybrid model. At the same time, in-person collaboration is a key part of our culture. That being said, individual contributer lemoneers work 4 days or more per month on-site in our Berlin office, spending quality time together with the team at events, onsites/offsites or over team dinners.

  • 📈 Grow with us: We take your personal development seriously! You’ll get regular mentorship and stretch opportunities, a clear career development framework with frequent feedback conversations as well as an annual learning budget.

  • 🌱 People & culture: You’ll feel our culture in the small things, like Polaroids from our lemoneers’ first day and our monthly new-joiner breakfasts. But also in the bigger things, like celebrating the onboarding of new partners or our annual offsites, where the whole company comes together to connect, reflect, and celebrate.

  • 💛 Perks & benefits: We choose benefits that add actual value. We sponsor a Deutschlandticket for employees on unlimited contracts, plus 50% off on Beatvest - our partner for financial education and investing.

  • 🏝 Workation: Get out of here! At lemon.markets you can work remotely from anywhere in the EU for up to 10 consecutive days at a time, and up to 60 days per year in total.

As an equal opportunity employer, lemon.markets is committed to building an inclusive workplace. The company welcomes people from all different backgrounds, including age, citizenship, ethnic and racial origins, gender identities, individuals with disabilities, marital status, religions and ideologies, and sexual orientations to apply.

If you feel this role could be a great match for you even if you don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you, please apply.

You have any questions? Feel free to contact us via talent@lemon.markets

title: Sr. Data Engineer
description:
Whether you’re an experienced professional or just getting started, your contributions matter at Fortra. If you’re passionate about tackling meaningful challenges alongside talented team members committed to helping each other succeed, all while having lots of fun, we want to hear from you. We offer competitive benefits and salaries, personal and professional development opportunities, flexibility, and much more!

The Senior Data Engineer will own the design, development, and operation of reliable data pipelines and reusable datasets that support Fortra’s cybersecurity and Machine Learning (ML) products. Embedded within the Data Science team, the role will turn diverse source data into documented, versioned, and quality-controlled datasets for experimentation, evaluation, and production workflows. Working with Data Scientists, ML Engineers, and Product Managers, this engineer will lead data engineering design, improve pipeline reliability and efficiency, and establish practical standards for data quality, lineage, and governance.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Lead highly complex data engineering projects with extensive latitude for independent judgment.
  • Own dataset management, including schemas, data dictionaries, source provenance, data lineage, and reproducible dataset versions, ensuring datasets remain current, accurate, and fit for purpose.
  • Own all aspects of the Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) process, including reliable ingestion, retries, backfills, and recovery from partial failures.
  • Identify and resolve data quality issues through automated schema validation, deduplication, and missing-data checks.
  • Implement monitoring, testing, and CI/CD processes in collaboration with ML engineers to ensure high data quality and system reliability.
  • Collaborate closely with data scientists to: Assemble high-quality datasets that meet product requirements. Perform data analysis and feature engineering. Develop pipelines that support ML development and evaluation.
  • Engineer ontologies for various Knowledge Graph (KG) applications.
  • Partner with product managers to define and expand taxonomies.
  • Address data compliance and governance requirements, ensuring applicable regulatory standards are met.
  • Produce reports and actionable insights using dashboards and analytical tools.
  • Support the integration of AI/ML tools into security product and service workflows.




QUALIFICATIONS

  • At least 7 years of relevant experience in data engineering, software engineering, or related roles, including 3 years of experience building and maintaining production data pipelines. Relevant advanced academic experience may substitute for part of the overall experience requirement.
  • Strong Python and SQL skills, including the ability to write maintainable, tested, and well-documented code.
  • Experience designing reliable ETL pipelines and working with large, heterogeneous datasets, including structured and unstructured data.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS, particularly S3, relational databases such as PostgreSQL, and NoSQL databases such as MongoDB.
  • Experience with data modeling, schema management, dataset versioning, and automated data quality checks.
  • Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes-based environments, Git, and CI/CD workflows.
  • Understanding of data security, access controls, and governance.
  • Strong problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with data scientists, ML engineers, and product managers.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience supporting ML datasets, annotation workflows, and reproducible training and evaluation splits.
  • Familiarity with Jenkins, ArgoCD, and MLflow.
  • Experience with knowledge graphs and ontology engineering.
  • Interest in cybersecurity applications.

Ready to join us? Visit our website to learn more about why employees choose to work for Fortra. Remember to connect with us on LinkedIn.


All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran or disability status.

title: Senior Product Owner, AI Platform
description:
WHO WE ARE

GridUnity is the industry leader in interconnection life cycle management, delivering cutting-edge software solutions that eliminate bottlenecks in the interconnection process and accelerate the transition to a more affordable, sustainable, and resilient energy future.

Our Mission

We unite all grid interconnection stakeholders on a single platform that converts centralized data into actionable intelligence and accelerates the transition to a reliable, sustainable, and cost-efficient electric grid.

GridUnity is a trusted partner to leading utilities, grid operators, and policymakers. Our technology solutions tackle the interconnection queue backlog by significantly reducing processing times. Whether cutting transmission interconnection timelines from years to months or enabling distribution applications to be processed within a day, we help accelerate energy projects at every scale.

Our Vision
Energizing the planet with a faster, smarter, and more sustainable grid.

About the role

Our Senior Product Owner, AI Platform position reports to the Director of Platform Product Management and is a core member of the product team that sets the strategy and roadmap for the technical capabilities the GridUnity Intelligence Platform provides to our national customer base. You help set the vision for GridUnity’s proprietary AI capabilities (GALE AI) and work with the Director to align with overall platform strategy and keep stakeholders clear on the vision. You innovate how AI creates value for grid operators, utilities, and developers.

You will partner with GridUnity’s product owners and designers to ensure new and existing applications or capabilities apply AI in a way that delights customers, addresses important use cases, and is efficient. You bring hands-on data science experience that lets you judge model tradeoffs, push back on technical assumptions, and make sure AI features are accurate, explainable, and trusted by utility customers; this includes discernment about when AI is not the right answer for delivering customer outcomes.

You represent customers’ needs and product approach to the engineering team to ensure they maintain a clear understanding of the prioritized product backlog and goals for each product increment, which is delivered through iterative Agile development. You work with others on the larger GridUnity product and customer growth teams to understand and monitor changing market and customer needs. You track on-going product metrics, at both the model and business levels, to ensure customer value is maximized and product investment decisions are data-driven.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy & discovery

  • Drive the translation of company/product strategy into a prioritized, outcome-based roadmap for the deployment of AI in GridUnity products

  • Engage with customers to understand needs, test and validate concepts, and continuously validate that the backlog reflects problems that AI can actually solve

  • Define and describe AI use cases to drive selection of those with extensible and / or specific strategic value, including driving build/buy/partner and sequencing tradeoffs

  • Work with the growth team, strategic operations and engineering to define AI pricing models

  • Use data science to assess whether an AI use case is feasible, ready, and of high value, and to support effective communication with data science and AI engineers

  • Report on product area health (adoption, satisfaction, delivery predictability) in terms leadership cares about; course-correct or kill initiatives that aren't delivering value

Backlog & requirements

  • Lead product solutioning in coordination with customer success, product design, and other team members to deliver customer needs with scalable, configurable product

  • Own the experiment-to-production path, including pilots, A/B tests, and phased rollouts, validating assumptions efficiently (prototypes, pilots, spikes) before committing engineering time

  • Write and refine user stories, acceptance criteria, and edge cases that hold up under implementation and meet model performance thresholds

  • Assess data availability, quality, and labeling needs when defining and prioritizing work; creatively solve for data needs and quality improvements

  • Own the AI backlog and share grooming of the larger backlog with other Product Owners so engineering always has a clear, well-specified next set of work

Delivery & execution

  • Act as the go-to decision-maker for the development team on scope, sequencing, and acceptance; unblock engineering quickly when requirements shift

  • Manage scope creep during a release without derailing the sprint or quarter's commitments

  • Own release readiness — confirm feature solves for the defined need before it ships

Responsible AI and governance

  • Make sure product meet standards for explainability, auditability, bias, and data privacy and controls

  • Work with security and operations on AI risk, customer data use, and model policies

  • Set requirements for monitoring, human-in-the-loop review, and fallback behavior

Stakeholder & cross-functional management

  • Manage competing stakeholder demands (sales, customer success, executives, engineering) without becoming a bottleneck or a pushover

  • Provide subject matter expertise and support as needed to GridUnity sales team (e.g., RFP support, product demonstrations, product training, documentation, etc.)

  • Keep leadership and stakeholders informed on status, risk, and tradeoffs through concise, structured communication that includes any needed context

Team & process leadership

  • Mentor or set the bar for less experienced product owners, bringing best practices and continuous improvement into the Product Team’s overall way of working

  • Collaborate with the Director of Platform Product Management to inspire the organization in use of AI to improve customer experience and product quality

Qualifications

  • Degree in data science, computer science, statistics, engineering, or a related STEM field, or equivalent experience

  • 7+ years experience in B2B SaaS software organization(s), with 4+ years experience working in a Product Owner role and 2+ years on AI or data-heavy products that require data science or analytics experience

  • Track record of shipping products and feature sets that real customers used, with measurable outcomes

  • Solid grasp of the ML lifecycle: data prep, training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, drift

  • Practical experience with LLMs and generative AI: prompting, RAG, evaluation approaches, cost and latency tradeoffs, and agentic workflows

  • Energy/utility industry experience and knowledge is preferred, including experience in transmission planning and/or interconnection processes

  • Operate with autonomy and comfort with ambiguity commensurate with a senior-level product owner

  • Skilled in both written and verbal communication with the ability to transition seamlessly between technical and business content areas

  • Experienced in communicating effectively with executive-level stakeholders, identifying, synthesizing, and proposing risk-mitigation and opportunity-securing pathways

  • In-depth understanding of and experience with Agile software development methodology

  • Highly organized with ability to stay on top of multiple projects and deliverables, including changing internal and external priorities

OUR CULTURE

We are a lean, fast-moving team that values bold thinking, reliability, and continuous learning. We operate with radical transparency, embrace scrappiness, and build solutions that anticipate customer needs. We also believe work should be fun and fulfilling — what we call “funfillment.”

The right candidate is energized by working in a scaling, mission-driven company where they can shape processes, wear multiple hats, and grow alongside the business.

BENEFITS/PERKS

  • Competitive compensation packages that recognize your expertise and contributions

  • Remote-first culture that provides flexibility and balance

  • Professional development opportunities, including training, mentorship, and career pathing

  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance starting day one

  • Short- and long-term disability and basic life insurance at no cost to you

  • 401(k) plan with a 4% match to help secure your future

  • Flexible PTO and a supportive work culture that values balance

  • Mission-driven work with the opportunity to make a significant impact in the energy sector

ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENT

This position may involve access to data and systems subject to U.S. critical infrastructure protection regulations. Accordingly, this role is restricted to individuals who qualify as “U.S. persons,” defined by federal law as U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents (green card holders), asylees, or refugees.

OUR COMMITMENT TO APPLICANTS

GridUnity is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, arrest and conviction record, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.

We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where every team member feels valued, supported, and able to bring their authentic self to work.

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please email careers@gridunity.com.

For your security, all official communication from GridUnity will only come from email addresses ending in @.

title: Senior Director, IT Enterprise Applications
description:
Summary

We are seeking a Senior Director, Enterprise Applications to build and lead the systems, processes, and technology foundation that enables our company to scale in the AI era.

You will define our systems roadmap, build a high-performing team, improve core enterprise platforms, drive automation and AI adoption, and partner closely with business leaders across Finance, Legal, and HR to translate operational needs into durable systems and processes.

You will own the business application portfolio that Immunic runs on: Enterprise collaboration and productivity platforms, Service Management, ERP, HRIS, and our SaaS estate across Finance, Legal, and HR systems. You will own the full lifecycle of those platforms, from architecture and selection through configuration, integration, vendor management, and process design.

A key part of this role will be defining how we embrace AI into the broader enterprise technology ecosystem.

Reporting to the Chief Data and Digital Officer, you will build and lead the team responsible for enterprise applications and partner closely with Finance, Legal, and HR.

You will join us at an exciting time before Phase 3 data readout and help shape the systems foundation for the enterprise. The ideal candidate is someone who can operate at both the strategic and execution level.

Responsibilities

  • Own the portfolio of critical business systems supporting Finance, Accounting, Legal, Human Resources, and corporate operations.

  • Define and execute the enterprise applications strategy and multi-year roadmap aligned with company objectives.

  • Lead strategy, governance, and operations for enterprise collaboration and productivity platforms.

  • Partner with business leaders to identify opportunities for process improvement, automation, and AI-enabled transformation with AI assistants and agentic solutions.

  • Establish KPIs to measure platform adoption, business value, employee experience, operational efficiency, and service quality.

  • Build and lead a high-performing team of business systems and application professionals.

  • Establish metrics for operational efficiency, AI adoption and impact, and execution quality.

  • Build audit-ready systems by designing and operating IT general controls and partnering with Finance.

  • Expand self-service and improve employee collaboration across the company.

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to executive leadership on enterprise technology investments, risks, and opportunities.

title: Sr. Project Manager - AGT
description:
About Us

Since 1989, SHI International Corp. has helped organizations change the world through technology. We’ve grown every year since, and today we’re proud to be a $16 billion global provider of IT solutions and services.

Job Summary

The Sr. Project Manager leads customer-facing projects from kickoff through delivery and closeout, coordinating cross-functional teams, managing timelines, budgets, and risks, and ensuring customers achieve their intended business outcomes. This role is ideal for a proactive, detail-oriented professional who builds trusted customer relationships and leads through influence and collaboration rather than direct supervision. As a senior-level contributor, this position combines strong execution with deep stakeholder engagement, data-driven decision making, and adaptive problem-solving.

The Sr. Project Manager independently manages large or high-visibility customer engagements, serving as the primary liaison among customers, internal business partners, technical teams, and leadership to ensure clear communication and transparent progress reporting. The role is proficient in Asana for planning, tracking, and reporting, and balances strategic thinking with execution rigor, structured planning, risk mitigation, and clear customer outcomes.

Role Description

• Lead end-to-end delivery of complex customer-facing projects from kickoff and planning through execution, go-live, and closeout
• Serve as the primary customer contact, managing expectations, communications, escalations, and relationships throughout the engagement
• Define scope, timelines, deliverables, and success metrics aligned to customer requirements and business goals
• Build and maintain project plans, schedules, and task dependencies in Asana, keeping boards, timelines, and status reporting current and visible to customers and stakeholders
• Lead cross-functional internal teams, vendors, and subcontractors, coordinating dependencies in a matrixed environment
• Manage project budgets, resources, change requests, and statements of work to protect margin and ensure high-quality outcomes
• Identify risks and issues, implement mitigation strategies, and escalate when necessary
• Facilitate customer kickoff meetings, status calls, and executive business reviews with clear, concise reporting
• Ensure adherence to project management methodologies, governance standards, and documentation practices
• Track performance against KPIs, milestones, and customer satisfaction, providing insights to improve outcomes
• Partner with sales, technical, and operations teams to ensure smooth handoffs and identify follow-on opportunities
• Act as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert, mentoring others on project management and Asana best practices


Behaviors and Competencies

• Customer Focus – Anticipates customer needs, builds trust, and delivers a consistently strong customer experience.
• Collaboration and Influence – Builds partnerships across internal teams and customers to achieve shared outcomes without positional authority.
• Strategic Orientation – Connects project work to customer and organizational priorities and anticipates downstream impacts.
• Execution Discipline – Maintains structure, organization, and precision across multiple simultaneous projects.
• Communication Excellence – Delivers information clearly, concisely, and appropriately for customers, executives, and technical audiences.
• Adaptability and Resilience – Quickly adjusts to shifting priorities or constraints while maintaining a positive approach.
• Accountability and Ownership – Delivers on commitments and upholds high standards of integrity, reliability, and quality.


Skill Level Requirements

• 5+ years of experience holding a direct project or program management or equivalent role, including managing customer-facing projects in a fast-paced, cross-functional setting.
• Experience managing customer facing projects required.

• Proven experience managing complex technical projects end-to-end required within data center, IT Operations, or software development specialties.
• Advanced proficiency in Asana (projects, timelines, dependencies, workflows, dashboards, and reporting)
• Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to influence outcomes without authority.
• Experience managing scope, budgets, change control, and vendor or subcontractor relationships.
• Excellent problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.
• Skilled in balancing multiple priorities and adapting to evolving customer and business needs.
• PMP Certification required


Other Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Project Management, Information Systems, or related field required.

• Knowledge of change management and process improvement practices (Lean, Six Sigma).

• Familiarity with business analytics or performance measurement frameworks preferred

The estimated annual pay range for this position is $100,000 - $150,000 which includes a base salary and bonus. The compensation for this position is dependent on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and market location and, therefore, will vary from individual to individual. Benefits may include, but are not limited to, medical, vision, dental, 401K, and flexible spending.

title: Sys Development Engineer II, AWS Cross Domain Services (CDS)
description:
The AWS Cross Domain Services team is seeking a Systems Development Engineer who is passionate about operational excellence. This engineer will help to operate and scale the services that connect AWS regions of differing security requirements.

An Amazon Dedicated Cloud (ADC) is a collection of AWS regions provided for a customer with specific security requirements. The AWS Cross Domain Services team provides solutions for customers to move data between regions with differing security requirements. We are obsessed with earning and maintaining customer trust. AWS is building some of the largest and most complex distributed systems in the world and the AWS Cross Domain Services team is essential to AWS’s dedicated cloud expansion. We need talented, adaptable engineers to help us implement and operate these complex systems.

As a Systems Development Engineer on the AWS Cross Domain Services team, you will:

- Have the opportunity to leverage the latest cloud computing technologies.
- Improve the availability of cross domain services to better serve U.S. Government agencies.
- Use your strong background in Linux, networking, and cloud services to raise our already high operational excellence bar.
- Operate, automate, and troubleshoot complex systems in partnership with software developer peers.
- Be given opportunities to grow your automation skills and gain a deeper understanding of cloud computing design patterns.

You'll be part of a world-class team in a fast-paced environment that has the entrepreneurial feel of a start-up. This is an opportunity to operate and engineer systems on a massive scale and to gain top-notch experience in cloud computing. You'll be surrounded by people who are smart, passionate about cloud computing, and believe that world class service is critical to customer success. You will be able to measure your success by its visible impact on the efficiency and effectiveness of government services for our nation.

This position requires that the candidate selected must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph. The position further requires the candidate to opt into a commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.


Key job responsibilities
It is “day one” for Amazon’s Dedicated Cloud offerings. We are seeking a talented and motivated Systems Development Engineer eager to: shape the development of infrastructure foundational services, write tools and services to improve automation for deployment and releases, build and maintain test fleets, perform functional and regression testing on software, define and perform stress testing, and monitor production software. We are looking for someone who can build on existing services and architectures and is excited to create new automated solutions.

We are not constrained by how “things are usually done.” You will be encouraged to dive deep into issues and then reinvent systems, processes, and tools as needed to drive continuous improvement for our customers.

A day in the life
Amazon has a fast-paced environment where we “Work Hard, Have Fun, Make History.” On a “typical” day engineers might deep dive to root cause a customer issue, investigate why a metric is trending the wrong way, consult with the top engineers at Amazon, or discuss radical new approaches to automate operational issues.

We’re an agile, innovative team that is dedicated to supporting our new team members. Our team has a broad mix of experience levels and Amazon tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship.

About the team
About AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Why AWS?

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge-sharing and mentorship. Our senior members enjoy one-on-one mentoring and thorough, but kind, code reviews. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects that help our team members develop your engineering expertise so you feel empowered to take on more complex tasks in the future.

AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS)

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

title: Director, Diamond Identification
location: Gemological Institute of America, Inc. (New York, New York)
description:
Why Join GIA?

At GIA, you'll be part of the world's foremost authority in gemology, helping protect consumer confidence and advance scientific excellence across the global gem and jewelry industry. Join a mission-driven organization where integrity, innovation, and expertise come together to make a lasting impact worldwide.


Location: Carlsbad, California or New York, New York


Make a global impact. Advance scientific excellence. Help protect public trust.


Position Overview

The Global Director, Diamond Identification provides enterprise leadership for GIA's global diamond identification operations and is accountable for strategy, scientific and technical capability, service delivery, financial stewardship, and organizational performance across all locations. The role converts GIA research, quality standards, and institutional priorities into a scalable global operating model that delivers accurate, consistent, timely, and sustainable laboratory services. As the senior functional leader, the Director establishes priorities, allocates resources, governs performance and risk, and holds regional and site leaders accountable for results. The role also builds the leadership and technical pipeline needed to protect public trust, advance gemological capability, and position the function for future market and operational requirements.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Global Strategy and Functional Governance (25%)

  • Define and execute a multi-year global strategy, operating model, and annual plan for diamond identification aligned with GIA priorities and mission.
  • Establish global governance, decision rights, service standards, policies, and performance expectations while enabling appropriate local execution.
  • Maintain an enterprise roadmap for capability, capacity, technology, facilities, and service evolution; prioritize investments using business cases and risk analysis.

Operational and Financial Performance (25%)

  • Own the global operating budget, forecasts, workforce plan, capacity strategy, and resource allocation for the function; explain variances and implement corrective action.
  • Monitor a global performance framework covering quality, turnaround, productivity, cost, capacity utilization, service, and risk.
  • Hold site and regional leaders accountable through structured business reviews and transparent metrics.
  • Lead cross-location process standardization and continuous improvement that produces measurable gains without compromising scientific integrity or quality.

Scientific Quality and Technical Capability (20%)

  • Partner with Research, Analytics, Quality, and laboratory experts to translate proprietary scientific methods into validated, scalable, and consistently executed operating practices.
  • Maintain global technical standards, qualification requirements, escalation paths, and proficiency mechanisms appropriate to the complexity and risk of diamond identification services.
  • Ensure significant technical, quality, and service risks are identified, escalated, investigated, and resolved with sustainable corrective and preventive actions.

Global Leadership, Talent and Culture (20%)

  • Lead a geographically dispersed organization through regional and/or site leaders; set clear accountabilities, operating rhythms, and expectations for leadership behavior.
  • Build succession depth for critical leadership and technical roles through talent reviews, development plans, mobility, mentoring, and targeted recruitment.
  • Foster high-performing local cultures. Set global leadership expectations and support local leaders in building engaged, collaborative, accountable, and adaptable teams aligned with GIA values.
  • Align organization design, roles, spans of control, and capabilities with strategy; lead change with clear communication and disciplined adoption planning.

Stakeholder Commercial and Enterprise Partnership (10%)

  • Serve as the diamond identification subject-matter expert and operational partner to Business Development and Marketing. Ensure the function's capabilities, value, and service requirements are represented accurately in the market.
  • Evaluate proposed services, market commitments, and growth opportunities for scientific, operational, financial, reputational, and resource feasibility before commitment.
  • Represent the function with credibility in appropriate industry, client, and institutional forums, ensuring claims accurately reflect GIA standards and capabilities.
  • Strengthen end-to-end stakeholder alignment, resolve competing priorities, and ensure operational readiness for launches, changes, and enterprise initiatives while serving as a trusted partner across stakeholders.

Job Competencies (Skills & Abilities)

  • Accountability: Owns decisions and outcomes, defines measurable expectations, establishes governance, and holds leaders accountable for timely and sustainable performance. Acts as a guardian of GIA's mission, values, integrity, and culture.
  • Strategic Thinking & Insight: Applies a global and enterprise perspective to scientific, operational, financial, talent, and market decisions. Uses industry knowledge, financial indicators, operational data, and risk analysis to advance long-term priorities.
  • Innovation & Change: Creates an environment where employees and leaders challenge existing approaches, share ideas, navigate ambiguity, and pursue responsible innovation. Leads transformation through disciplined execution, stakeholder engagement, and sustained adoption.
  • Decision Quality & Problem-Solving: Makes informed and ethical decisions under ambiguity. Evaluates evidence, tradeoffs, dependencies, enterprise risk, and impacts beyond the immediate function.
  • Collaborative Relationships: Builds trusted internal and external networks, reconcile competing perspectives, and prioritizes enterprise needs over individual site or team interests to advance GIA's mission.
  • Optimizes Talent Experience: Builds leadership and technical depth, sponsors critical talent, manages succession, and creates diverse internal and external talent pipelines and an inclusive environment where people can contribute and grow.
  • Effective Communication: Communicates vision, strategy, technical information, risk, and business priorities with clarity and credibility, gains commitment across functions, locations, and seniority levels and represents GIA effectively.
  • Service Mindset: Prioritizes GIA's mission and advocates for the Institute's role in serving the gem and jewelry industry.
  • Ensures global operations remain responsive to internal and external customer needs while protecting integrity sustainability.

Minimum Qualifications (Knowledge & Experience)

  • Bachelor's degree in geology, earth sciences, gemology, business, operations, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience. Advanced degree preferred.
  • Graduate Gemologist credential, FGA diploma, or a comparable recognized gemological qualification required.
  • At least twelve years of progressively responsible experience in gemology, laboratory operations, scientific operations, or a closely related technical environment.
  • At least seven years of people leadership experience, including demonstrated success leading leaders and geographically dispersed or comparably complex operations.
  • Demonstrated accountability for a material operating budget, workforce and capacity planning, operational performance, and multi-site improvement or transformation.
  • Experience converting scientific or technical standards into repeatable operating processes and measurable service outcomes.
  • Demonstrated success influencing senior stakeholders and partnering across Research, Quality, Operations, Finance, HR, Technology, Business Development, Marketing, and related functions.
  • Strong analytical & digital fluency, Laboratory systems, reporting tools, operational data, & Microsoft Office applications to guide.

Additional Requirements

  • Regular on-site presence is required, with hybrid flexibility consistent with business and leadership needs.
  • Ability to travel domestically and internationally, generally 15–25% of the time, travel during significant initiatives or operational events.
  • Ability to work across global time zones and respond to material operational, quality, or stakeholder issues outside standard local hours.
  • Must handle confidential scientific, employee, financial, and business information with appropriate discretion.

Work Environment / Physical Demands

  • This is a production-oriented position; must be able to collect data using multiple instruments simultaneously. The employee must constantly grasp, grip and/or turn small objects (gems) with tweezers or a stone holder and concurrently view and analyze the object using a microscope, while intermittently and repetitively using a computer mouse to plot inclusions on computerized diagrams of gems.
  • Must periodically adjust the microscope, requiring fine hand manipulation and eye-to-hand coordination.
  • Work is performed in a designated professional office workstation and environment. Extensive use of office equipment, including computer, calculator, copier, fax, and other business-related machines and software.
  • The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

title: Director - AGT PMO
description:
About Us

Since 1989, SHI International Corp. has helped organizations change the world through technology. We’ve grown every year since, and today we’re proud to be a $16 billion global provider of IT solutions and services.

Over 17,000 organizations worldwide rely on SHI’s concierge approach to help them solve what’s next. But the heartbeat of SHI is our employees – all 7,000 of them. If you join our team, you’ll enjoy:

  • Our commitment to diversity, as the largest minority- and woman-owned enterprise in the U.S.

  • Continuous professional growth and leadership opportunities.

  • Health, wellness, and financial benefits to offer peace of mind to you and your family.

  • World-class facilities and the technology you need to thrive – in our offices or yours.

Job Summary

The Director – PMO leads the Project Management Office for SHI’s Advanced Growth Technologies (AGT), the full-stack AI solutions pillar, providing governance and oversight for AGT’s AI, data center, IT operations, and software development portfolio. Partnering with AGT sales, technical, and go-to-market teams and strategic partners such as NVIDIA, this people leader builds a high-performing team of project and program managers and ensures customer initiatives are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned to business priorities.

Role Description

• Lead, mentor, and develop a team of project and program managers.
• Define and maintain PMO standards, frameworks, and methodologies (waterfall, agile, hybrid), and lead adoption of Planview or Asana.
• Oversee portfolio planning, prioritization, and governance; monitor scope, schedule, budget, quality, risks, and benefits realization.
• Own end-to-end delivery of customer-facing projects, from intake, requirements, and SOW through execution, go-live, handoff, and post-implementation review.
• Serve as senior customer contact for expectations, scope and change management, status reporting, escalations, and executive business reviews.
• Lead delivery of AGT’s full-stack AI solutions, including AI factory and lab builds, GPU infrastructure, AI workshops, and agentic AI engagements, in partnership with AGT sales, technical, and go-to-market teams and partners such as NVIDIA.
• Own AGT operational governance, including CRM and data integrity, billing, KPI and pipeline reporting, and intake processes.
• Drive continuous improvement and a culture of collaboration, accountability, and transparent communication.


Behaviors and Competencies

• Strategic Leadership – Aligns the portfolio to strategy and prioritizes work that delivers the greatest business value.
• Inclusive People Leadership – Builds a supportive environment where diverse perspectives are welcomed and team members grow.
• Execution Excellence – Drives disciplined planning and delivery, and addresses issues proactively.
• Collaboration & Influence – Builds cross-functional alignment and influences without authority.
• Adaptability & Change Agility – Navigates ambiguity and evolving priorities with resilience.


Skill Level Requirements

• 10+ years in project and program management, including 3–5+ years in people leadership and experience leading a PMO or large, complex portfolios.
• Proven customer-facing, end-to-end project delivery, from requirements gathering through customer acceptance.
• Technical program and project management experience in AI/ML and agentic AI (GPU compute, data pipelines, model deployment, AI readiness); data center projects (greenfield, retrofit, modular, power and cooling, networking, infrastructure deployment); IT operations (infrastructure and cloud migrations, ITSM/ITIL, change and release management, operational readiness); and software development (SDLC, agile/DevOps, release planning, engineering dependencies).
• Ability to engage credibly with engineers and architects and assess technical risk and critical path across multi-vendor solutions.
• Expert-level skill in Planview or Asana for portfolio planning, resource management, workflow automation, and reporting.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, including with senior executives, and strong data-driven analytical skills.
Preferred Skills and Experience
• Familiarity with scaled agile and hybrid delivery models; experience in complex, cross-functional technology initiatives.
• Certifications such as PMP, PgMP, PMI-ACP, SAFe, or equivalent.
• Experience with organizational change management and benefits realization.


Other Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Project Management, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field.
• Preferred: Master’s degree (e.g., MBA) or advanced studies in project management.

The estimated annual pay range for this position is $150,000 - $190,000 which includes a base salary and bonus. title: Spacecraft Hardware Development Specialist, Amazon Leo DevOps
description:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

This role is for a highly dynamic and motivated individual that will work on development hardware to meet the needs of Amazon Leo. We are looking for an individual who works well with engineering teams under minimal oversight to take hardware from concept to production. You'll partner directly with design engineers to iterate hardware quickly and qualify it for space, following that hardware through the full arc of development — initial prototyping, development builds, testing, and rigorous qualification testing. You'll also help shape the lab spaces themselves, adapting layout and equipment as designs change to keep labs clean, well-organized, and set up to serve their engineering customers. This will be an R&D focused position, and the work covers the full range of hardware development lab support — assembly, troubleshooting, testing, equipment upkeep, and documentation — so expect the day-to-day to shift as project needs change.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
- Able to work with minimal guidance and instruction
- Partner directly with design engineers to iterate hardware quickly, optimize manufacturability, and qualify hardware for space
- Support hardware through the full development arc — initial prototyping, development builds, testing, and rigorous qualification testing
- Mechanical and electrical assembly of various spacecraft mechanisms
- Troubleshoot hardware and test setup issues, working through problems to root cause
- Engineer and adapt lab spaces and equipment to meet evolving customer needs, keeping labs clean, organized, and functioning well for their intended purpose, including tracking equipment calibrations
- Develop custom automation equipment to support test and build needs
- Maintain clear work documentation, including build notes and test records
- Accurately estimate time required to complete tasks, and meet deadlines as assigned
- Participate constructively and take ownership in the success of interdisciplinary projects
- Familiarity with aerospace/space quality standards for mechanical and electrical components

About the team
The Amazon Leo Development Operations (DevOps) team builds and maintains the labs and hardware infrastructure that let engineering teams design, prototype, and test satellite hardware quickly. We support projects from first prototype through qualification testing, and our team members cross-train across assembly, test, and lab equipment so we can flex to wherever the work is needed. Priorities shift fast as designs evolve, and you'll often move between projects to keep pace with what engineering teams need next. We take pride in keeping our labs and equipment in excellent shape, and we hold ourselves to a high standard because the hardware we build and test directly impacts what makes it to space.

title: Onboarding Intern, Beauty & Wellness
description:
Why qlub

The end of a great meal shouldn't be the slow part. Waiting for the check, finding someone to take payment, splitting a bill by hand. qlub removes that friction. Guests scan a QR code and pay in seconds. No app, no download, no waiting.

From Pay-at-Table and Digital Menus to Order-and-Pay, Payment Links, and SoftPOS terminals, we handle the full payment experience so restaurants can focus on what they do best: great hospitality. Less friction means faster table turnover, smoother operations, and higher profit.

We're a fast-scaling fintech backed by Mastercard, Mubadala, e& and Shorooq. $72M raised, live across multiple markets worldwide, and headcount doubled in the past year. We're building the teams that take us to the next stage.

The role

As our Beauty Onboarding Intern, you’ll help turn a signed partner into a live, high-performing one. Working alongside our Onboarding team, you’ll support the handoff from Sales to go-live. That means helping set up outlets, training receptionists, stylists and therapists, and checking that qlub keeps getting used after the launch excitement fades. This is a hands-on, in-the-field internship. It suits someone who wants to learn how a fast-scaling fintech launches partners and likes seeing their work make a difference the same week.

What you'll own

  • Help take new salons, spas and clinics from signed to live. Support account setup, system configuration and launch checklists. Keep Sales, Tech, Integrations and Account Management updated so nothing stalls.

  • Train salon teams in person and remotely. After shadowing the team, run sessions for front desk and floor staff, from receptionists and stylists to therapists, nail technicians and barbers. Join refresher and performance visits once staff use qlub day to day.

  • Track adoption after go-live. Monitor QR adoption, tipping and transaction trends outlet by outlet. Flag underperforming outlets early and help find out why.

  • Capture what partners tell you. Log feedback from salon owners and teams and share it with Account Management. Help turn recurring questions into better training materials and guides.

Who you are

  • You’re curious, quick to learn and comfortable asking questions when something isn’t clear.

  • You take ownership of your tasks and follow through without being chased.

  • You’re confident with people. That includes talking to a busy salon team between appointments.

  • You’re interested in beauty, wellness or customer experience, and why a smooth checkout matters to the people working the floor.

  • You want to learn how payments and fintech work in the real world.

What you'll need

  • A current student or recent graduate (within the last 12 months) in Business, Hospitality, Marketing or a related field. No prior work experience required; part-time jobs, internships or customer-facing roles are a plus.

  • Fluent English.

  • Clear communication and the confidence to present to small groups.

  • Good organization, attention to detail and basic comfort with Google Workspace and spreadsheets.

  • A valid UAE residence visa (own, family or student sponsorship).

Nice to have

  • Arabic language.

  • Experience working in or with salons, spas or clinics, or familiarity with booking tools such as Fresha, Phorest or Zenoti.

  • An interest in payments, fintech or startups.

What we offer

• Real ownership over products that impact millions of diners and thousands of restaurants globally

• The opportunity to solve challenging problems in payments, hospitality, and customer experience

• A fast-moving environment where great ideas quickly become reality

• Close collaboration with experienced operators, builders, and industry experts

• A chance to leave a visible mark on one of the fastest-growing restaurant technology companies globally

Ready to build? Join us and help shape how the world pays at the table. If that excites you, apply now.

title: Software Engineer, ML Platform
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

SOFTWARE ENGINEER, ML PLATFORM

As a Software Engineer on ML Platform at SpaceXSI, you'll build the infrastructure that turns real product usage into better models, and keeps research moving fast on large GPU fleets. ML Platform is organized into four teams. Depending on your background, you may join any of them. We're looking for strong distributed-systems and infrastructure engineers who want to sit next to research and ship platform primitives that move the product.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Design, build, and operate core platform systems used daily by ML researchers and product engineers

  • Partner closely with research to turn recurring pain into durable infrastructure

  • Own reliability, performance, and developer experience for the systems in your lane

  • Ship iteratively in a flat, high-ownership environment. Measure impact, then raise the bar

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in computer science, machine learning, or another quantitative discipline; OR equivalent work experience

  • 5+ years of industry experience working with production distributed systems (e.g., infrastructure, ingestion, data pipelines, or scheduling/orchestration, etc.)

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Experience owning production distributed systems at meaningful scale (ingestion, data pipelines, scheduling/orchestration, or similar)

  • Experience partnering and building platforms for ML researchers and product engineers

  • Thrive where ownership is high and the feedback loop is short

  • Telemetry: event ingestion, product analytics pipelines, OpenTelemetry / tracing, reliable data APIs

  • Product Data Platform: data frameworks, Spark / Flink / Ray, ML dataset and training-data infrastructure

  • Observability: experiment / run monitoring, debug and eval tooling, agent-friendly observability UX

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

Annual Salary:

$140,000 - $225,000 USD

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.

title: Instructional Design Associate
description:
Huron helps its clients drive growth, enhance performance and sustain leadership in the markets they serve. We help healthcare organizations build innovation capabilities and accelerate key growth initiatives, enabling organizations to own the future, instead of being disrupted by it. Together, we empower clients to create sustainable growth, optimize internal processes and deliver better consumer outcomes.

Joining the Huron team means you’ll help our clients evolve and adapt to the rapidly changing healthcare environment and optimize existing business operations, improve clinical outcomes, create a more consumer-centric healthcare experience, and drive physician, patient and employee engagement across the enterprise.

Join our team as the expert you are now and create your future.

title: Data Center Technician
description:
Join our dynamic AWS team and become a critical guardian of global cloud infrastructure! You'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of the world's most innovative technology platform, ensuring seamless data center operations that power millions of businesses and services worldwide.

Data Center Technicians should be willing to work both independently and with a team. Work prioritization, organizational skills, effective communication, and the ability to react quickly are critical to success. In addition to hardware and network repair, candidates will install equipment, create documentation, innovate solutions, and fix problems within the data center space. This team works in an environment that operates 24/7. Traveling within and outside of the regional work area is required.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.



NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.



NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

Key job responsibilities
Performing server rack installations, hardware break-fix on various components, troubleshooting network issues, and responding to operational incidents that impact service availability, escalating to senior technicians and management as needed/required

Serving as a primary contact point for both internal and external stakeholders, including engineers, software developers, vendors, and contractors

Performing on-call duties and participating in scheduled maintenance and change management activities

Contributing to documentation and process improvement initiatives based on your analysis of operational issues

Helping to train and onboard new team members

Physical requirements:

Regularly lift and/or move up to 40 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 41+ pounds

Working in cramped and/or elevated locations

Bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching

Standing and walking for up to 8+ hours a day

Ascending and descending ladders, stairs, and gangways safely and without limitation

Work in a noisy environment

Work shifts longer than 8 hours to support 24/7 operations (covering both night and day shifts).

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:

Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed

Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational

Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

A day in the life
As a Data Center Technician professional, you have industry-leading technical abilities and demonstrate a breadth of knowledge while you:

Take ownership of technical issues brought by their customer base, engaging other teams when needed to drive resolution

Solve problems at their root and step back to understand the broader context

Maintain service level agreements through the implementation of proactive issue detection and reporting

You will be required to work shift work that will include days/nights/weekends/holidays. Traveling within and outside of the regional work area is required. You will be responsible for having a reliable personal vehicle and valid driver's license to travel within the regional work area, as company transportation will not be provided.

title: Research Engineer - Flexibles
description:
TOPPAN Packaging Americas specializes in designing and manufacturing sustainable, high-performance flexible and thermoformed packaging solutions for the food, beverage, medical and consumer goods industries. We offer products like transparent high barrier films, pouches, clamshells and trays, utilizing advanced technology to enhance product safety, visibility and environmental sustainability.

TOPPAN Packaging Americas operates as part of the global TOPPAN group, with 22 manufacturing facilities across North America, Latin America and Europe.

Want to learn more? Visit us at packaging.toppan.com


Summary Description:


As a Flexibles Research Engineer, you will accelerate the company’s growth objectives by building the technical knowledge, research platforms, and external technology pipeline that enable the R&D and Account Development Engineers to move faster and make better-informed decisions. In this role, you will investigate fundamental material and package performance questions, identify emerging technologies and adjacent solutions, design efficient screening methods, and translate findings into actionable guidance for the Technology Team. Reporting into the Flexibles R&D Manager, you will also partner closely with internal and external resources to reduce technical uncertainty, shorten learning cycles, and create differentiated growth opportunities.


This position is remote with an expected travel of 15%. This is a progression position with the level being based on candidate experience and business needs.


What you'll be doing:

  • Plan and execute research programs that address fundamental technical questions behind priority growth platforms, customer needs, and technology roadmaps.
  • Provide backend scientific and engineering support through literature reviews, hypothesis development, experimental design, material characterization, data interpretation, failure analysis, and technical recommendations.
  • Convert research findings into design rules, test methods, reference datasets, and decision tools that can be applied across multiple projects.
  • Monitor emerging materials, processes, equipment, analytical methods, and adjacent market technologies and identify options with potential strategic value.
  • Create laboratory and benchtop screening approaches that help teams compare technologies before committing resources to pilot or production work.
  • Build productive relationships with suppliers, universities, startups, contract laboratories, government organizations, and technical consortia to extend internal capability and access specialized expertise.
  • Prepare technical reports, presentations, and training that translate complex findings into practical guidance for R&D, operations, commercial, and leadership audiences.
  • Collaborate across various internal functions to connect research with business needs.
  • Travel to visit suppliers, research partners, conferences, and tradeshows to advance research and learning objectives.

We’d love to hear from you if:

  • Bachelor of Science, preferably in Engineering, Science, Packaging, Plastics, or Chemistry; an advanced degree is preferred
  • Experience in applied or fundamental research with an ability to frame complex problems, design efficient experiments, interpret data, and translate results into practical technical recommendations
  • Working knowledge of flexible packaging materials, such as OPP, PET, PE, Nylon, paper, foil, coatings, adhesives, and barrier materials
  • Experience working with external innovation partners
  • Strong technical writing and verbal communication skills
  • Use of design of experiments, statistical analysis, modeling, or structured innovation methods

Compensation:

The annual base salary range for this role is from $XX to $YY, plus an annual target bonus of ZZ% of base salary.

title: Robotics Maintenance Specialist, Frontier AI & Robotics (FAR)
description:
Amazon's Frontier AI & Robotics (FAR) team is building advanced robotic systems that will transform autonomous operations. Our mission is to push the boundaries of what's possible in robotics, developing next-generation AI models that operate on numerous hardware embodiments in complex, real-world environments.

FAR is seeking a Robotics Maintenance Specialist with high ownership and an R&D mindset. You will tackle maintenance, repair, and operational readiness of our robotic hardware platforms, test systems, and lab infrastructure. This hands-on role focuses on keeping our robots running at peak performance through expert troubleshooting, custom fabrication, and preventive maintenance. You will help the team through process standardization and knowledge sharing. You'll work shoulder to shoulder with the engineers and researchers who design and build cutting-edge robotic systems.

This role may serve as a technical lead depending on the candidate's experience.

Key job responsibilities
Maintenance, Fabrication & Repair
- Maintain, troubleshoot, and improve a diverse fleet of robotic and electromechanical systems, including manipulators, humanoid robots, and hardware subsystems
- Troubleshoot humanoid robot software issues via Linux CLI, Python and log analysis, including sensor/actuator faults, communication dropouts, outdated firmware, and runtime errors
- Design, build, and improve custom electrical harnesses, cable assemblies, and robotic modifications with emphasis on proper cable routing, strain relief, and system reliability
- Replace and repair electrical components (motor drivers, relays, sensors, power distribution) and mechanical components (bearings, gears, actuators, drivetrain assemblies, end-effectors)
- Troubleshoot and repair control systems including EtherCAT, CAN bus, motor controllers, embedded electronics, and sensor arrays; read and interpret electrical, mechanical, and pneumatic schematics
- Develop and execute preventive and corrective maintenance processes, SOPs, and maintenance plans for robotic systems
- Develop and implement failure-tracking systems to capture failures, identify trends, perform root-cause analysis, and proactively reduce recurring issues
- Coordinate with robotics vendors for technical support, repairs, and replacement strategies
- Track spare-parts needs and maintain inventory records

Lab, Fleet & Researcher Support
- Maintain laboratory and testing environments in a clean, organized, safe, and ready-to-use condition
- Support lab reconfiguration, hardware integration, and prototype bring-up activities
- Serve as a maintenance point of contact for researchers, interns, and project teams; establish strong communication to understand requirements and develop practical solutions
- Review incoming requests, define scope and execution plans, establish timelines, and provide hands-on technical support

Continuous Improvement
- Cross-train peers on common failures, troubleshooting methodologies, and maintenance best practices; author and refine training documentation
- Analyze maintenance and failure data to identify improvement opportunities; partner with engineering teams to drive design changes that improve reliability
- Identify recurring failures and develop standardized troubleshooting procedures and SOPs

title: Acoustical Engineer  - Wearables
description:
At Bose Corporation, we believe sound is the most powerful force on earth — and for over 60 years, we have been a company built on innovation, excellence, and independence. Privately owned, fiercely customer-focused, and driven by our values, we continue to lead industries and transform lives through sound.

Today, Bose Corporation is entering an exciting new era. Across multiple global Business Units and Global Functions, we are shaping the future of audio technology, automotive, luxury, and premium experiences. We invite you to join us in this transformation.

Job Description

Be a part of the growing Audio Engineering team that seeks to deliver experiences to every place where audio matters! The Bose Audio Technology Licensing group is seeking a passionate, hands-on Acoustical Engineer to take part in supporting our dynamic needs as we develop partnerships across many industries – all with the goal of finding new opportunities to widely deploy Bose technologies. You will be a key member of our cross functional team, working closely with your Bose colleagues and external partners to successfully develop and deliver our technologies to end consumers.

Hybrid Working Environment: 3-days/week on-site presence is required, 5 days is preferable.


Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate with engineering team members to design, build, and test headphone products with audio playback, active noise cancellation, and voice pickup features
  • Investigate and develop acoustic system design concepts to achieve product performance requirements
  • Use simulation tools to predict acoustic system behavior
  • Define, build, and characterize physical prototypes of acoustic systems
  • Conduct acoustic measurements of components, subsystems, and full assemblies and perform analysis of results
  • Define and develop novel acoustic test methods as needed to improve understanding of system behaviors
  • Work directly with DSP and controls engineers to tune and optimize system performance
  • Clearly communicate results through informal peer reviews and at formal design reviews
  • Collaborate with teammates to define, specify, and validate production test equipment and processes
  • Support prototype and production system builds both on-location at the factory and remotely
  • Root cause acoustic failures and recommend design changes to prevent recurrence
  • Travel (domestic and international) required, approximately 4-8 weeks per year under normal circumstances

Qualifications:

  • BS required in Acoustical, Mechanical or Electrical Engineering, MS Preferred
  • 2+ years of direct acoustic design experience of high performance portable audio products
  • 2+ years of hands-on acoustic test experience
  • Knowledge of headphone acoustic structures and enclosure/porting design
  • Critical Listening skills with a passion for music and audio quality
  • Knowledge of psychoacoustics and speech quality evaluation
  • Experience with active noise cancellation technology is highly desirable
  • Strong understanding of acoustic test and measurement systems and techniques
  • Experience using and selecting acoustic test equipment from B&K, GRAS, Audio Precision, National Instruments, Listen Inc. (SoundCheck), and others
  • Experience specifying requirements for acoustic component including drivers, microphones, and acoustic meshes
  • Familiarity with acoustic array design for communications mic systems, beamforming, speech processing, acoustic echo cancellation, and voice activity detection
  • Basic understanding of transducer design, lumped parameter models, micro drivers, ECM, and MEMS microphones
  • Familiar with lumped element or FEA acoustic modeling using PSpice, Comsol, or other tools
  • Competent using Matlab for data analysis and visualization
  • Experience developing products with Bluetooth and/or other wireless technologies is desirable
  • Ability to work collaboratively with other disciplines such as: Mechanical/Electrical Engineering, DSP, Industrial Design, and JDM Partners
  • Exceptional technical problem solver, with ability to scope out, plan, and lead others to investigate and solve challenging problems
  • Excellent verbal & written communication skills
  • Comfortable with reading and writing detailed technical specifications
  • Ability to adapt to rapidly changing constraints and requirements, while maintaining the highest performance standards

#Li-hybrid

At Bose, you're inspired to be and do your best and are rewarded for your unique talents! Our compensation is thoughtfully tailored to your skills, experience, education, and location, and goes beyond base salary. The hiring range for this position in the primary work location of Framingham, Massachusetts is: $88,500-$121,650.The hiring range for other Bose work locations may vary.

In addition to competitive base pay we offer rewards including bonus programs, comprehensive health and welfare benefits, a 401(k) plan, plus exclusive perks designed to support your wellbeing, and a generous employee discount where you can immerse yourself in our products and experiences. We are a proudly independent company—driven by purpose, guided by our values, and united by a belief in the power of sound. As the world leader in audio experiences, we’re creating what’s next—pushing boundaries and delivering transformative sound experiences for people everywhere. Join us and make your next career move a mic-drop. Let’s Make Waves.
