title: TransOut Area Manager, FC
description:
Amazon is looking for high-potential leaders, who are ready to own their impact in Amazon Operations as an entry-level manager. We promise you will have your leadership capacity stretched to its full potential. As a front-line leader, you will have an opportunity to truly invest in others and develop a people-focused leadership style, while mastering the tools, processes, and operations that have created the most customer-centric company on Earth. If you want to be involved in continuing to define the future of online retail, and are dynamic and an organized self-starter, join our team in Amazon Operations as an Area Manager.

Key job responsibilities
As an Area Manager, you will have the opportunity to lead and develop your own team of Amazon Associates in a distribution warehouse environment. Your main focus will be motivating, mentoring and coaching your team. As a servant leader, the Area Manager will ensure that their team of Amazon Associates have all the tools needed to succeed for any task during a shift. Engaging with your team during a shift to ensure that the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance performance and engagement are maintained are core functions of the role. Come learn how the largest online retailer in the world runs its fulfillment and delivery networks!

What is fulfillment you ask? Fulfillment is how we refer to completing or fulfilling a customer's Amazon.com order and the acts of picking, packing, shipping and delivering their order to meet or exceed their expectations! And also works as a Crossdock Hub for the MX network

A day in the life
As the Transfer Out Manager, you land the load plan on time and at LQ360 quality. At shift start, you adjust DICE based on the IB volume % in NVF and allocate pickers to the Pick plan. During the shift you govern Q by Q —productivity, quality, and safety—, verify Standard Work (Safety, Operations, PXT) on the floor, and rebalance labor as volume shifts. At close, you confirm all CPTs are met, review results with your PAs, and submit the EOS report.

About the team
Inclusive team culture
At Amazon we embrace our differences and we are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We host annual and ongoing learning experiences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 14 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

Work Life Balance
We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.

Mentorship & Career Growth
Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional.

title: Senior Manager, Device and AMO Theory
description:
About Sygaldry

Sygaldry Technologies is building quantum-accelerated AI servers to exponentially speed up training and inference for AI. By integrating quantum and AI, we're accelerating the path to super intelligence, and engineering the conditions for it to scale efficiently and operate affordably. Sygaldry AI servers combine multiple qubit types within a single, fault-tolerant architecture to deliver the combination of cost, scale, and speed necessary for advanced AI applications. We pioneer new domains in physics, engineering, and AI, tackling the hardest challenges with a grounded, optimistic, and rigorous culture. We're looking for individuals ready to define the intersection of quantum and AI and drive its profound global impact.

What You'll Work On

  • Build, lead, and mentor a team of device and architecture theorists, including hiring and developing its members

  • Set the research agenda for device theory, aligned with Sygaldry's architecture and product roadmap

  • Develop theoretical and numerical models of qubit devices, gate operations, and physical-layer processes to guide next-generation processor design

  • Design and evaluate system architectures under hardware-specific constraints and realistic noise models

  • Translate device-level physics into architecture-level requirements, and architecture-level goals into concrete device specifications

  • Own error budgets and gate fidelity requirements derived from architecture-level targets

  • Oversee the development of simulation and modeling tools for system design, performance analysis, and roadmap planning

  • Partner directly with the hardware team to inform device design and validate models against experiment

  • Lead high-impact research projects with a multidisciplinary team of experimental and theoretical physicists, engineers, and computer scientists

  • Represent Sygaldry's device theory work to the scientific community, partners, and investors

You May Be a Good Fit If You Have

  • A PhD in physics, applied physics, computer science, electrical engineering, or an equivalent degree in a similar field

  • 8+ years of experience in the theory and modeling of quantum computing hardware

  • A strong publication record in quantum device physics, quantum architecture, or related fields

  • Experience leading a research team, through direct people management or formal technical leadership

  • Strong programming skills in a scientific computing environment

  • A proven track record of successful cross-team collaborative projects

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including with non-specialist audiences

Strong Candidates May Have

  • Experience translating cutting-edge R&D into commercial products or roadmap milestones

  • Experience modeling multiple or heterogeneous qubit platforms

  • Experience translating abstract models into hardware-aware protocols

  • Experience bridging theory and experiment on real quantum hardware

  • Familiarity with quantum error correction and fault-tolerant architecture

  • Experience building a team from an early stage in a startup or industrial research setting

Why This Matters

Your work accelerates the path to quantum super intelligence. Each quantum component integrated, each AI model enhanced, each instruction set optimized brings us closer to a future where intelligence and quantum mechanics are inextricably intertwined. We're not building incremental improvements—we're creating exponential transformations that will make AI more affordable, sustainable, personalized, and fundamentally more capable.

How We’re Different

We’re building the infrastructure for quantum super intelligence and pioneering new domains at the intersection of physics, engineering, and AI. At Sygaldry, curiosity and intellectual courage drive our work. We approach ambitious challenges with a grounded, optimistic, and rigorous culture and know that kind people build the strongest teams. We prioritize mission over ego and collaborate openly with a strong sense of shared purpose. We dream big, yet we execute with a love of detail.

Culture & Benefits

  • The Best of Both Worlds: Access to industrial-scale compute and hardware resources

  • while retaining the intellectual freedom of an academic environment.

  • Visa Sponsorship: We know what it takes to make top talent thrive here. We’re open to supporting visas whenever possible.

  • Compensation: We value your high-level expertise. This position offers a salary significantly above standard academic postdoctoral rates.

  • Benefits: Your well-being matters. We provide company-sponsored health coverage to give you and your family peace of mind.

  • Connection: Whether it’s company offsite or casual crew socials, we make time to connect, recharge, and have fun together.

  • Time Off: We trust you to take the time you need. Unlimited PTO so you can rest, recharge, and come back ready to make an impact.

We encourage applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. If you don’t think this role is right for you, but you believe that you would have something meaningful to contribute to our mission, please reach out at letsbuild@sygaldry.com.

title: Senior Business Analyst

Nice to haves

What We Offer

You will join a proud heritage of continually elevating standards of care for stroke, heart failure, and atrial fibrillation (AFib) patients.

Your unique talents will help patients on their journey to wellness. Learn more at .

Purpose:

The Ultrasound Clinical Account Specialist (UCAS) Structural Heart is accountable to partner with the different Regional Sales Managers (RSM) and Sales Territory to achieve sales goals in the assigned territory by providing technical and clinical support of interventional cardiologists (IC) using AcuNav™ and NUVISION™ as we drive adoption of 2D and 4D intracardiac echocardiography in structural heart procedures and market share growth. The UCAS is also responsible for developing the structural heart imaging market within their territory by identifying new procedural opportunities, expanding ICE adoption into new IC programs, and driving transition from TEE-dependent workflows toward ICE-guided procedures. The UCAS is responsible for building and maintaining mutually beneficial relationships with physicians, hospital and Cath lab staff, and key opinion leaders to grow and develop business. The UCAS partners directly with the local Marketer Manager and Local EP Business Lead to ensure alignment and coordination of activities to meet business objectives.

This role is pivotal in developing and executing strategic sales plans, fostering strong customer relationships, and ensuring operational excellence. The primary focus of this role is to lead the commercial "pivot" from TEE-dependent procedures to ICE (Intracardiac Echocardiography) as the imaging modality of choice. By integrating Johnson & Johnson’s Credo and Leadership Imperatives, the Ultrasound Clinical Account Specialist will inspire the local team to deliver exceptional results, uphold the highest standards of compliance, and make a meaningful impact on patient outcomes and workflow efficiencies in the field of structural heart. This role sits adjacent to Electrophysiology and is pivotal to expanding J&J’s leadership in Interventional Cardiology and Structural Heart.

  • Provide expert clinical product and technical assistance and training and case support to IC physicians and staff on the effective use of AcuNav™ and NUVISION™ catheters in structural heart procedures.

title: Administrative Project Coordinator
description:
We invite you to review our current business services professionals openings to learn about the opportunities available across the firm.

About Us

Skadden, Arps, Slate, Meagher & Flom LLP has forged a reputation as one of the most prestigious law firms in the world. Relying on innovation, intellect, teamwork and tenacity, our lawyers deliver the highest quality advice and novel solutions to our clients’ legal issues. We are known for handling the most complex transactions, litigation/controversy issues, and regulatory matters, as well as for the strong partnerships we build with clients and each other. Our attorneys, who reflect a broad range of experiences and perspectives, work together seamlessly across 50-plus practices and 21 offices in the world’s major financial centers.


The Opportunity

We are seeking an Administrative Project Coordinator to join our Firm. This position will be based in our Palo Alto office (hybrid).

Position Overview

Provides high-level, concierge-style assigned or project-based support to attorneys, Global Directors and Assistant Directors. Responsibilities include handling administrative tasks, coordinating travel arrangements, handling document management, supporting business development efforts and executing other complex tasks and projects. Collaborates closely with other Firm departments and business services professionals to ensure exceptional client service.

Responsibilities


Administrative Tasks

  • Performs various, complex assignments while under time-sensitive deadlines.
  • Coordinates complex travel requests including, but not limited to, the procurement of visa-related materials and passport renewal applications.
  • Troubleshoots software and hardware concerns for attorneys, in consultation with technology business services professionals.
  • Assists with document management and records retention for administrative files.
  • Develops project strategies to ensure efficient completion of tasks.
  • Consults with the Firm's internal business services departments and professionals at all levels to verify the accuracy of completed work.
  • Acquires and deploys an understanding of all practice areas of the Firm along with knowledge of practice-specific tasks.
  • Coordinates with other Firm offices, both domestic and international, as required.
  • Assists with Department initiatives and special projects.
  • Assures that all completed projects adhere to accepted professional standards.
  • Assists with preparing materials for presentations and conferences.
  • Enters attorneys' time records and submits attorneys' expense reports.
  • Assists with attorneys' calendaring and scheduling requests.
  • Assists with attorneys' administrative requests.
  • Performs responsibilities of other support services, when needed, including printing, scanning, duplicating, quality control, faxing and hand-delivering packages.
  • Organizes and facilitates conference and video calls.
  • Answers, screens, places phone calls, and takes detailed messages.
  • Assists with processing and payment of vendor invoices.
  • Opens, reads and routes mail, as directed.
  • Demonstrates strong interpersonal, written and verbal communication skills to facilitate effective work relationships with others.
  • Manages Firm resources responsibly.
  • Complies with and understands Firm operations, policies and procedures.
  • Regular and reliable physical presence to (ex: work as part of a team, meet with clients, use on-site equipment, etc.).
  • Assists with client bills, coordinating review of bills with Client Accounting and assigned Partner(s).
  • Provides coverage for Reception as needed.
  • Plans heritage month, employee group lunches and events, engagement, and retention events.
  • Obtains vendor certificates of insurance and W-9s, and complete RAFTS for signature.
  • Submits requests and ensuring adherence to the contracts process.
  • Uploads resumes and schedule virtual recruiting meetings for the West Coast regions.
  • Oversees Summer Associates program expense reimbursements.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned.

Business Development

  • Prepares engagement letters and new matter memos for new clients and matters.
  • Assists with new-business conflicts process.
  • Assists in promoting business development, entering contacts and business activities in InterAction and coordinating with Business Development & Marketing department as required.

Client Relations

  • Coordinates with Conference Services for internal and client meeting requests, including but not limited to audio-visual, catering services and external vendors.
  • Coordinates client-related business meals and maintains up-to-date knowledge of Firm-and attorney-preferred restaurants.
  • Receives and interacts with incoming clients and visitors.

Qualifications

  • Ability to provide excellent customer service
  • Demonstrates high level of professionalism
  • Ability to read, interpret, convey and follow instructions
  • Ability to synthesize information in order to prioritize and organize tasks
  • Flexibility and willingness to perform a wide range of tasks extending beyond routine expectations
  • Demonstrates initiative and confidence to assume a high level of responsibility in a fast-paced environment
  • Thorough working knowledge of relevant Firm computer software programs (e.g., Outlook, Word, Excel (including, but not limited to, PivotTables, Filters, Conditional Formatting) and PowerPoint) with the ability to learn new software and operating systems
  • Demonstrates effective interpersonal and communication skills, both verbally and in writing and maintains a calm and professional demeanor
  • Demonstrates close attention to detail
  • Ability to handle multiple projects with shifting responsibilities and deadlines
  • Ability to handle sensitive matters and maintain confidentiality
  • Ability to work well under pressure
  • Ability to work well in a demanding and fast-paced environment
  • Ability to work well independently as well as effectively within a team
  • Flexibility to adjust hours and work the hours necessary to meet operating and business needs

Education and Experience Required

  • Bachelor's degree
  • Minimum of two years of related experience in a law firm or professional services environment
  • Must be a Notary Public licensed in California or able to obtain a commission within six months of joining the Firm

Culture & Life at Skadden

What makes Skadden special is our people and the culture, community and spirit of collaboration we have created. We believe in teamwork and inspiring each other to be our best in an atmosphere that promotes professionalism and excellence in all that we do. We know that inclusion and drawing on the strength of a wide spectrum of talent only make us better and is vital to the firm's success. Our goal is for everyone at the firm to enjoy a challenging career with opportunities for development and growth and to support the well-being of our attorneys and business services professionals.


Benefits

The overall well-being of our team is important to us. We offer generous benefits to help you achieve wellness in all areas of your life.

  • Competitive salaries and year-end discretionary bonuses.
  • Comprehensive health care (medical, dental, vision), savings plan/401(k) and voluntary benefits.
  • Generous paid time off.
  • Paid leave options, including parental.
  • In-classroom, remote, and on-demand learning and professional development opportunities.
  • Robust well-being classes and programs.
  • Opportunities to give back and make an impact in local communities.

For further details, please visit:

The starting base salary for this position is expected to be within the range listed under Salary Details. Actual salary will be determined based on skills, experience (to the extent relevant) and other-job related factors, consistent with applicable law. This position is eligible for overtime pay and may be eligible for a discretionary year-end bonus.

Salary Details

$90,000 - $105,000

title: Innovation Consultant
description:
The Innovation Consultant will play a key role in delivering Plexal-led innovation programmes and working with our consulting team. We are currently recruiting in all competency areas, and so are interested to hear from Researchers, Management Consultants, Programme Delivery experts, Ecosystem convenors, Technology enthusiasts, Data Scientists and Solution Architects.

We are a rapidly growing team and are actively looking to recruit exceptional individuals who want to work in an adaptive, fast moving, collaborative environment.
  • Shape insights about the future of technology sectors,
  • Lead the creation of high impact deliverables,
  • Help clients make decisions on their technology strategy,
  • Define and manage solutions that work including pilots and new venture design,
  • Engage with innovators to understand their needs, challenges and the interventions that will support their growth,
  • Pull together consortiums of world-leading talent to better solve mission-critical challenges,
  • Work on the design and delivery of world-class innovation and challenge-led programmes,
  • Manage inputs across several workstreams,
  • Proactively manage regular interaction, communication, and collaboration with external stakeholders,
  • Lead specific areas of business development by responding to public sector bids and leading bespoke proposals.
  • Highly organised with a good understanding of innovation, collaboration and project management practices, tools, and methodologies,
  • Analytical, with the ability to think critically and to understand, interpret and articulate complex concepts,
  • A structured, concise communicator who can confidently use key tools including Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint, as well as project management and brainstorming tools,
  • Competent at taking responsibility for producing high-quality deliverables and presentations for senior external audiences
  • Experienced working within two or more of the following: a large innovation function, a leading consultancy, tech startup or accelerator,
  • Able to demonstrate strategic awareness across technology markets and sectors and provide an outside-in perspective to clients when it comes to emerging market needs, trends, opportunities, and technologies,
  • Personally resilient, with the ability to stay focused on the overall objective, responding to challenges in a calm and measured way,
  • Energised by the challenges and opportunities presented by working for a high-growth company,
  • Passionate about the development of cybersecurity and other areas of emerging technology.
  • This role may require some national travel for delivery of projects and travel to all Plexal sites.
  • Educated to a Bachelor-degree level or equivalent
  • SC or DV clearance desired
  • Due to the nature of this position, our work, and our client engagements, you must be willing and eligible to achieve a minimum of SC clearance. To qualify for SC clearance, you must be a British Citizen or have resided in the UK for the last 5 years with no extensive periods outside of the UK. Pre-existing SC welcome. For more information about clearance eligibility, please see https://www.gov.uk/government/organisations/united-kingdom-security-vetting

As a start-up, we thrive in a dynamic and fast-paced work environment dedicated to empowering innovators. We embrace individuals who leverage technology and creativity to tackle our greatest challenges head-on. We strongly advocate for maintaining a harmonious work-life balance, our goal is to ensure every member of our team can authentically be themselves and live their best lives. We firmly believe that innovation and creativity flourish when we cultivate a diverse workforce, comprising highly skilled individuals with a wide range of perspectives to contribute.

In return we will offer you:

  • Salary: Circa £55,000 depending on skills and experience
  • Annual bonus scheme
  • A generous pension scheme (with a company contribution of up to 10%)
  • Private healthcare, life assurance and critical illness cover
  • 25 days holiday plus bank holidays
  • Volunteering day
Plexal is an equal opportunities employer and we actively encourage applicants from individuals from all backgrounds. We are a Disability Committed employer and are willing to make reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process.

title: Manager, VELYS Clinical Utilization (South Central)
location: Warsaw, Indiana, United States of America
description:
At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at

As guided by Our Credo, Johnson & Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson & Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.

Job Function:

Sales Enablement

Job Sub Function:

Customer Success Management

Job Category:

People Leader

All Job Posting Locations:

Arizona (Any City), Arkansas (Any City), Colorado (Any City), Iowa (Any City), Kansas (Any City), Louisiana (Any City), Missouri (Any City), Nebraska (Any City), Oklahoma (Any City), Remote (US), Texas (Any City), Warsaw, Indiana, United States of America

Job Description:

We are searching for the best talent to join our DePuy Synthes team as a Manager, VELYS Clinical Utilization to support the South Central Region (TX, OK, KS, NE, IA, MO, CO, AZ, AR, LA). This is a field-based role available in the United States. While specific cities are listed in the Locations section for reference, please note that they are examples only and do not limit your application.


Purpose:

DePuy Synthes is shaping the future of digital surgery. As the VELYS ecosystem continues to expand, our competitive advantage is our ability to turn every installation into a successful, growing robotic program that delivers lasting value for surgeons, health systems, and patients. That advantage is built in the field, one launch, one surgeon, and one clinical team at a time.

The Manager, VELYS Clinical Utilization, is a hands-on player-coach responsible for clinical excellence, launch execution, and leading VELYS Clinical Specialists (VCSs) within an assigned region. The role drives account activation, not coverage: every launch should change how a surgeon operates and leave the account more capable than when it started.

Reporting to the Sr. Manager, VELYS Clinical Utilization, this leader owns day-to-day clinical operations from pre-launch readiness through sustained adoption, connecting clinical execution with account strategy and turning field activity into insights that help the region operate proactively.


Key Responsibilities:

Lead Clinical Excellence & Launch Execution

  • Serve as the senior clinical expert in the region and model the standard for exceptional VELYS execution.
  • Maintain an active launch workload, personally leading assigned account launches and stepping in on strategic, complex, and escalated surgeon launches.
  • Engage early in pre-launch planning to understand the surgeon pipeline, implementation requirements, and expectations established during capital acquisition.
  • Translate regional priorities into clinical execution plans, ensuring the right VCS is deployed to the right account at the right time.
  • Run every LEEP Launch on a disciplined six-week rhythm, from installation and VELYS Core Activation Training through first cases and handoff to Field Sales.
  • Lead advanced troubleshooting, workflow optimization, and LOOP interventions for accounts requiring additional support.
  • Maintain expert-level proficiency across VELYS Robotic-Assisted Solution (VRAS) TKA and UKA, VELYS Hip Navigation AI (VHN), and future digital applications, and uphold Instructions for Use (IFU), surgical technique, and clinical standards.

Lead & Develop VELYS Clinical Specialists

  • Directly manage and develop a regional team of VCSs, providing timely performance feedback, career development discussions, and individualized development plans.
  • Coach through field observations, launch participation, and procedural feedback, building the judgment and end-to-end ownership each launch requires.
  • Lead onboarding, simulation, and advanced clinical training to a consistent national standard, accelerating readiness for independent launch execution.
  • Own day-to-day clinical operations for the region, ensuring workflows, performance metrics, and compliance requirements are met within established timelines and budgets.
  • Lead Airtable CRM activity within your Area.
  • Identify and prepare high-potential VCSs for expanded responsibility, building the next generation of VELYS leaders.
  • Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, curiosity, continuous improvement, and customer focus.

Accelerate Surgeon Adoption & Utilization

  • Use procedural trends, log file reviews, and field observations to identify early adoption risk, explain why performance is changing, and determine the right clinical intervention.
  • Help surgeons progress from initial adoption toward confident, independent robotic proficiency.
  • Partner with the Sr. Manager and Utilization teams to execute plans for utilization recovery, surgeon conversion, and sustained adoption.
  • Maintain surgeon-level visibility into active users and non-users, surfacing barriers and conversion opportunities before they become escalations.
  • Identify growth opportunities through additional surgeons, VELYS applications, and technology upgrades, and bring them to the Sr. Manager and commercial partners early.

Strengthen ISO Clinical Capability

  • Equip qualified ISO partners to independently support appropriate workflows while maintaining DePuy Synthes clinical standards, serving as their trusted clinical resource.
  • Transition mature accounts toward appropriate local self-sufficiency, deploying clinical resources where expertise is needed and avoiding long-term dependency.

Partner with Customers & Across the Business

  • Build trusted relationships with surgeons, operating room teams, and hospital stakeholders, and provide the clinical perspective for executive business reviews and strategic account planning.
  • Resolve clinical escalations at the regional level wherever possible, engaging the Sr. Manager early on complex account challenges.
  • Collaborate with Sales, Education, Marketing, Field Service, Utilization, and Commercial Operations from pre-launch planning through sustained adoption, so customers experience one DePuy Synthes.
  • Provide a forward view of launch readiness, account health, VCS capacity, and capability gaps to inform launch prioritization and resource allocation.
  • Give leadership a clear read from the field: what is happening, why it matters, what is likely to happen next, and what action is recommended.
  • Solve what can be solved at the Manager and VCS level, and surface systemic barriers with evidence and a recommended path forward.
  • Communicate changes in customer support strategy, process, and technology to the team, ensuring VCSs understand what is changing and why.

Qualifications / Requirements:

What You’ll Bring

  • Demonstrated expertise supporting complex robotic-assisted orthopedic procedures, with expert-level knowledge across robotic and digital surgery workflows and the VELYS ecosystem.
  • Experience coaching and developing high-performing clinical professionals.
  • Ability to balance direct customer engagement with people leadership and regional execution.
  • Ability to influence surgeons, commercial partners, and hospital stakeholders without direct authority.
  • Proficient at managing relationships and expectations with our Independent Sales Organization (ISO) network.
  • Strong business acumen and understanding of capital technology adoption.
  • Proactive ownership of log file reviews and platform adoption, translating procedural data into clear priorities and actions for your team.
  • Proficiency with CRM, analytics, and automation, and curiosity about emerging technologies.
  • Clear, direct communication that balances empathy with high accountability.

Travel Requirements

  • Ability to travel up to 50% within the assigned region, driven by active LEEP Launch, LOOP, and VCS field responsibilities, and up to 60% overall in support of strategic launches, field coaching, surgeon education, utilization initiatives, and cross-regional clinical support.

How We Lead

  • Move with Heart: Bring safety, stability, and trusted guidance to your accounts. Lead with empathy and integrity, protect patients, and elevate surgeons.
  • Move as One: Stay calm when variables shift in the operating room. Communicate openly, seek out others’ expertise, and succeed and learn together as one DePuy Synthes.
  • Move to Win: Take full ownership of your outcomes. Eliminate ambiguity, prioritize resources intentionally, and navigate high-stakes environments with conviction.
  • Move the Future: Exercise patience for mastery, because true mastery takes repetition. Technology is the engine; hospitality, expertise, and trust are what win.

The Impact

The Manager, VELYS Clinical Utilization, is more than a people leader. This role is the region's clinical multiplier, developing stronger VCSs, building more capable commercial partners, accelerating surgeon independence, and ensuring every strategic launch lays the foundation for sustained adoption and lasting value from the customer’s capital investment. By turning exceptional individual execution into a repeatable standard, this leader builds the capacity and insight that let the business shift from reactive to proactive.


Remote work options may be considered on a case-by-case basis and if approved by the Company.

About DePuy Synthes (DS)

Fueled by innovation at the intersection of biology and technology, we’re developing the next generation of smarter, less invasive, more personalized treatments.

Are you passionate about improving and expanding the possibilities of DS? Ready to join a team that’s reimagining how we heal? Our DS teams help keep more than 6 million people moving each year while delivering clinical and economic value to surgeons and healthcare systems. Our teams build solutions for joint reconstruction; trauma and craniomaxillofacial; sports, extremities, and elective foot and ankle; spine; and robotics and digital surgery.

Your unique talents will help patients on their journey to wellness. Learn more at

Johnson & Johnson announced plans to separate our Orthopaedics business to establish a standalone orthopaedics company, operating as DePuy Synthes. The process of the planned separation is anticipated to be completed within 18 to 24 months, subject to legal requirements, including consultation with works councils and other employee representative bodies, as may be required, regulatory approvals and other customary conditions and approvals. Should you accept this position, it is anticipated that, following conclusion of the transaction, you would be an employee of DePuy Synthes and your employment would be governed by DePuy Synthes employment processes, programs, policies, and benefit plans. In that case, details of any planned changes would be provided to you by DePuy Synthes at an appropriate time and subject to any necessary consultation processes.

We actively seek qualified candidates who are protected veterans and individuals with disabilities as defined under VEVRAA and Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act.

title: Sr. Software Engineer, Pretraining Data
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

SR. SOFTWARE ENGINEER, PRETRAINING DATA

We're looking for Senior Software Engineers to build and own the data systems behind our frontier models' initial training. You'll work on large-scale crawling, data platform, and pipeline infrastructure, turning raw dumps into the datasets our models train on, and making iteration with researchers fast and reliable. As a senior engineer, you'll set technical direction for these systems, lead projects across teams, and mentor other engineers as our pretraining data scales.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Data Platform: Design, build, and scale the distributed infrastructure that transforms raw web, code, multimodal, and acquired data into training-ready datasets for frontier model pretraining. Own high-throughput data pipelines, orchestration systems, and tooling that enable fast, reliable, observable, and reproducible data processing at massive scale, with end-to-end visibility into data lineage, freshness, and pipeline health.

  • Data Quality: Build and deploy high-performance models and algorithms to classify, rank, deduplicate, filter, and clean training data at extreme throughput. Design and execute rigorous experiments across data mixtures, sampling strategies, and quality thresholds to quantify their impact on training loss, downstream evaluations, and model capabilities, translating research findings into production systems.

  • Crawling: Build and optimize large-scale web crawling infrastructure spanning URL discovery, prioritization, host scheduling, fetching, parsing, and content extraction. Improve crawl coverage, efficiency, and reliability through intelligent scheduling, anti-bot resilience, robust extraction systems, and automated recovery, ensuring high-quality web data flows seamlessly into downstream training pipelines.

  • Technical Leadership & Collaboration: Lead complex engineering initiatives across Data Platform, Data Quality, Crawling, Acquisition, and model training teams. Influence technical direction, drive architectural decisions, mentor engineers, and translate improvements in data infrastructure, coverage, and quality into measurable gains in model performance.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience building distributed systems and/or large-scale data infrastructure

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Strong infrastructure or data platform background, ideally with a spike of outlier depth

  • High-slope engineer who has moved unusually fast (e.g., staff-level ownership within a few years) or brings relevant domain experience

  • Able to architect and ship end-to-end with high ownership, debug complex systems independently, and work alongside AI agents

  • Strong intuitions about large-scale distributed systems, including running them reliably at frontier scale

  • Track record of leading technical projects across teams and mentoring other engineers

  • Excited to learn how pre-training data shapes model quality, and want the ownership and visibility that comes with building systems that feed frontier training runs

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Onsite role: must be able to work in person at the Palo Alto office

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

Annual Salary:

$220,000 - $357,000 USD

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.

title: Document Controls Manager
description:
ATCS’s Construction Services group is expanding in Virginia! We are seeking an experienced Document Control Manager to support large-scale infrastructure projects and programs at the federal and state levels.

This is a key project leadership role requiring strong experience in document control, records management, electronic document management systems, and project administration. The ideal candidate will have experience supporting complex infrastructure or transportation projects and be comfortable establishing document control processes, managing project records and workflows, and coordinating with multidisciplinary teams, clients, and stakeholders.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree and 5+ years of related document control, records management, or project administration experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education
  • Experience supporting large-scale infrastructure, environmental, transportation, water, aviation, or similar disciplined projects
  • Advanced proficiency with electronic document management systems (EDMS), records management software including Trimble e-Builder, Bentley ProjectWise, Oracle Unifier, Procore, Microsoft Office applications, and Adobe Acrobat
  • Demonstrated experience overseeing and managing workflows for drawings, specifications, submittals, correspondence and other project records and coordinate with various discipline leads
  • Demonstrated experience developing and implementing document control procedures and quality management processes
  • Experience managing administrative reporting functions
  • Knowledge of federal records retention requirements, quality assurance procedures, and contractual documentation standards
  • Strong leadership, organizational, communication, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to coordinate across multiple project teams and locations

Responsibilities:

  • This position is critical in ensuring the accuracy, integrity, security, and accessibility of project documentation across all phases of project procurement and delivery
  • The ideal candidate will lead document control operations, establish and maintain records management processes, oversee administrative functions, and support multidisciplinary project teams for the satisfaction of client, contractual, and regulatory requirements
  • Establish and oversee document management systems, ensuring proper document storage, version control, retention, and retrieval practices
  • Direct and supervise document control personnel, providing guidance, training, and performance oversight
  • Coordinate administrative activities across project teams, ensuring efficient workload distribution and resource allocation
  • Manage time effectively by prioritizing competing requests, meeting transmittal and submittal deadlines, and keeping multiple project workstreams on schedule
  • Interface with project managers, technical staff, clients, subcontractors, and vendors regarding document control processes and deliverables
  • Monitor and manage document transmittals, correspondence logs, submittal logs, records inventories, project e-mails, and project closeout documentation
  • Identify process improvement opportunities and implement best practices to enhance document management efficiency and quality
  • Support audits, quality assurance reviews, and records management compliance assessments
  • Resolve document control issues, administrative challenges, and workflow bottlenecks to maintain project schedules and deliverables
  • Prepare and deliver regular status metrics and administrative reports to project leadership and stakeholders
  • Support configuration and administration or document workflows, metadata, permissions and notifications within the EDMS

Our employees are the most critical part of ATCS. For this position, we offer a competitive salary range of $80,000 to $110,000 per year, commensurate with experience and qualifications. The role is also eligible for an annual bonus, with a target 5% of the employee's annualized salary. In addition to compensation, ATCS offers outstanding, employee-focused benefits for you and your family. Full-time employees are eligible for benefits coverage on the first day of the month following their start date. Including, but not limited to: generous personal PTO, inclusive holiday PTO, community involvement PTO, highly customizable medical plan options, excellent dental & vision plans, 401K match up to 3% with immediate vesting, parental leave, STD & LTD, tuition reimbursement, employee assistance program and more.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information. ATCS is committed to providing equal opportunities and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. title: Senior Sales Engineer, Commercial/Enterprise-Sydney, AUS
description:
1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $500M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

As a Senior Solutions Engineer, you’ll act as a strategic technical advisor and trusted partner to our Commercial & Enterprise sales team and customers. You’ll elevate sales efficiency and customer engagement by delivering deep technical expertise, tailored demos, and customer-specific insights throughout the sales cycle.

Working closely with the Account Executive, you’ll craft solutions that align 1Password’s capabilities with customer challenges and goals, navigating complex requirements, influencing technical stakeholders, and clearly articulating value from discovery to close. Experience with frameworks like MEDDPICC is a strong plus, as you’ll help qualify opportunities, define technical success criteria, and drive alignment within deals.

This role requires agility and foresight, identifying opportunities, positioning our product suite, and ensuring proposed solutions meet technical needs. You’ll also collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Marketing, Sales Enablement, and Support to strengthen customer-facing resources.

As a senior team member, you’ll mentor peers, sharing knowledge to uplevel both technical expertise and soft skills across the Solutions Engineering team.

This role is a remote hybrid opportunity based within Sydney.

How we’re using AI today
Across GTM, we’re transforming the way we work with AI. We expect every seller, CSM, and team member to become a power user, using it daily to work smarter and move faster. AI is already embedded in how we operate – from real-time coaching that sharpens how we sell and interact with customers, to surfacing insights that help us anticipate needs – creating more time for meaningful customer engagement. If you’re excited to reshape how you think, make decisions, and drive growth with AI, you’ll feel right at home here.

What we're looking for:

  • 6+ years of experience in customer-facing technical sales roles within a B2B environment.

  • Proven track record of selling into Global 1000 customers.

  • Experience in a multi-product SaaS environment.

  • Proven track record in enterprise sales, with the ability to build relationships, influence stakeholders, and support closing complex deals.

  • Skilled at translating technical concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Strong presentation, communication, and collaboration skills across sales, product, marketing, and support teams.

  • Ability to quickly learn, adapt, and navigate dynamic customer conversations and requirements.

  • Experienced with modern sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC for opportunity qualification and deal progression.

  • High degree of autonomy with the ability to manage multiple projects, maintain quality, and meet deadlines.

  • Willingness to mentor colleagues and share best practices to support team growth.

  • Ability to travel up to 25%.

  • Familiarity with SaaS, security concepts, and developer technologies such as SCIM, CLI, SAML/SSO/OAuth, AD, API, SSH and AI (MCP).

What you can expect:

  • Serve as the primary technical advisor/resource within 1Password’s Go-to-Market team.

  • Proactively scope and recommend tailored technical solutions and support that address both expressed and unspoken customer needs—aligning with use cases, business goals, and decision criteria for a variety of Enterprise customers including those on the higher end of the segment.

  • Build strong relationships & deliver technical coaching to Account Executives, Partner Sellers and Sales Engineers, empowering them to speak confidently about product capabilities and align messaging with customer challenges, use cases, and requirements.

  • Provide technical education to customers and partners regarding the 1Password suite of products.

USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $124,000 USD and $180,000 USD, and is commission-eligible. This role is also immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $127,000 CAD and $184,000 CAD, and is commission-eligible. This role is also eligible for immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.


At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.


Our culture
At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first.

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results.

How we work with AI
We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process.


Our approach to work
We recognize the power of both in person collaboration and remote work. Some roles are designated as remote-first, with an expectation that individuals work from their homes majority of the time, while others are designated as in-office roles, with an expectation of being on-site on a regular basis. We recognize that certain roles benefit from regular, in-person connection to support collaboration, team cohesion, and customer engagement.

For all roles, occasional travel may be required. This includes things like: department-wide offsites, quarterly department meetings and periodic customer events. These events are typically held in varying locations across Canada, USA and/or EMEA. In leadership roles, you can expect to travel once per month on average.

Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto.


What we offer
We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer:

You belong here.

title: Software Engineer (3-4y of exp)
description:
Job Description


Real estate runs on some of the most valuable and least modernized software in the world. MRI is rebuilding its foundations as a unified platform of services, data and AI. Your job is to build the layer people actually touch: the applications, workflows and AI-native interfaces built on top of it.

You will not be handed a ticket queue. You will be handed a real problem, a strong team around you, and the room to decide how it gets built. The platform services are being built so that you can move fast on top of them, and the best engineers will grow into technical leaders quickly.


What you will do


  • Design, build and ship customer-facing web applications and workflows, from architecture to production.

  • Own the quality of what you ship: frontend, APIs, data access, performance, security, accessibility and reliability.

  • Build AI-native experiences: conversational interfaces, agent-driven workflows and copilots that act on real customer data.

  • Help set engineering standards: design system, code review, testing, CI/CD and observability.

  • Contribute to architecture decisions and write down the trade-offs so others can build on them.

  • Learn from senior engineers, mentor those who join after you, and take on technical leadership as you grow.

  • Work directly with product, design and domain experts, so the thing you ship is the thing customers need.

  • Prototype fast, then harden turn a promising idea into a product that runs at global scale.


What you bring


Required


  • Bachelor's, Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics or a related field.

  • 0 to 5 years of experience building software. Experience is not the bar: we welcome freshers with exceptional academics and a portfolio to show for it.

  • Solid full stack fundamentals: modern TypeScript and React (or equivalent) on the frontend, and at least one strong Back-end language and framework (Node, Python, Java or .NET).

  • Strong computer science foundations: data structures, algorithms, databases, networking and operating systems.

  • Good instincts for API and system design, and a habit of testing and measuring your work.

  • Evidence of building real things: shipped products, internships, open-source work, hackathon or competition results, or substantial personal projects (a GitHub or portfolio link is expected).

  • Clear communication and sound judgment, including the ability to explain a trade-off to a non-engineer.


Strong plus


  • Hands-on experience integrating LLMs: retrieval, tool use, agents, evaluation and guardrails.

  • Cloud-native experience (Azure or AWS), containers and CI/CD.

  • Experience with enterprise SaaS, identity and security, or regulated data.

  • Design-system or micro-frontend experience.

  • Domain interest in Real estate, finance or proptech.


What great looks like


You care about the pixel and the query plan. You would rather delete code than defend it. You learn faster than the job description expects, and you want to build something that lasts.


Why join


  • Real ownership: take on meaningful product areas early, not a corner of someone else's roadmap.

  • A greenfield foundation: build on a modern platform and AI stack instead of working around legacy.

  • Global scale: your work reaches customers across the world's real estate portfolios.

  • Access to leadership: work close to the architecture and innovation team and see your decisions land.

  • A senior peer group: strong engineers, data scientists and product leaders who expect your best thinking, and who will help you grow.

About Us

From the day we opened our doors, MRI Software has built flexible, game-changing real estate software that powers thriving communities and helps make the world a better place to live, work and play. Fulfilling that mission is only possible because of one thing: exceptional people. People like you!

Our people-first approach to PropTech is defining a new industry standard for client experiences that, quite frankly, can’t be duplicated. Experiences that deliver real value every day. And we know those experiences begin with our people.

We believe MRI is more than just a workplace; it’s a connected community of people who truly feel they belong. Whether we’re investing in employee resource groups or providing tailored resources for each person to reach their full potential, we’re passionate about creating a work environment that makes you excited to show up every single day.

At MRI, one of our core values is to strive to amaze. From the intelligent solutions we create to the culture we cultivate, that’s our goal every day. Because that’s what industry leaders do. Whether you’re joining as a new Pride member or rejoining us after a short time away, your talent is vital to us, our partners and our clients.

Amazing growth requires amazing employees. Are you up to the challenge?

We know confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting remarkable candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply. We’d love to hear from you!

MRI is proud to be an inclusive employer. We welcome and celebrate diversity across all backgrounds, including ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, age, military, veteran status and more.

We believe that Belonging is a direct result of Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion. Those values are woven into the fabric of who we are and are foundational to our continued success. Come and see for yourself!

title: CyberSecurity Senior Consultant
description:
NCS is a leading AI Tech Services company. The Cyber Security consultant will design, implement, test, document, and hand over security solutions with a focus on Security by Design principles. The role includes deploying and managing SIEM, SOAR, UEBA, TIPs, DAM, and cloud security across AWS and Azure environments. Additionally, the engineer will use Terraform and other IaC tools to automate security infrastructure, conduct various security tests (SSAT, OSAT, IAT, UAT), and perform system hardening to safeguard systems against vulnerabilities.

Implementation & Automation: Deploy SIEM, SOAR, UEBA, and cloud security solutions. Automate security infrastructure with Terraform and maintain consistent security deployments.

Testing & Hardening: Conduct System Security Acceptance Testing (SSAT), Operational Security Acceptance Testing (OSAT), Integration Acceptance Testing (IAT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and system hardening to ensure secure configurations.

Documentation & Handover: Create detailed documentation for security controls and processes. Provide training and handover to the operations team, with operational guides for security management.

Log Management & Monitoring: Implement log management systems to centralize security event data and monitor cloud environments with AWS and Azure tools.

The ideal candidate should possess:

7 years in cybersecurity engineering/consulting with hands-on SIEM/SOAR deployments, strong AWS/Azure security expertise, Terraform automation experience, and proven experience conducting security testing, threat modelling, and system hardening activities.

SIEM/SOAR implementation experience (Splunk, Sentinel, QRadar, ArcSight, Cortex XSOAR, etc.)

AWS/Azure cloud security + Terraform

Security architecture / Security by Design / Threat Modelling / System Hardening

Senior Manager
MedTech CLM Strategy & Delivery

About Johnson & Johnson

At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured; where treatments are smarter and less invasive; and where solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions and profoundly impact health for humanity. Guided by Our Credo, we provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. We respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.

Position Summary

Johnson & Johnson MedTech is seeking a durational to serve as the directly responsible individual for MedTech’s partnership with Global Simplification and Innovation in Contracting (GSINC). This role will provide GSINC with one accountable MedTech point of contact and help shape a coherent MedTech contracting strategy across business units, functions, regions, and commercial value streams.

The Senior Manager will lead development of a sequenced MedTech roadmap, facilitate alignment across competing priorities, establish practical governance and decision processes, and drive accountability for MedTech readiness and delivery. The role will prepare clear recommendations for sponsor decisions, communicate credibly with senior leaders, and remain sufficiently close to execution to resolve dependencies and move implementation forward.

Initial priorities include PR&O contracting and the Ottava quote-to-contract journey. The role will coordinate business, Legal, Compliance, HCC, Finance, Procurement, data, architecture, technology, change, and regional stakeholders to create an integrated MedTech response rather than requiring GSINC to navigate multiple disconnected MedTech teams.


GSINC currently leads the enterprise platform direction and development sourcing. The role will lead through influence within the current model and, if formally assigned, assume broader MedTech delivery, vendor, budget, or operational responsibilities as the enterprise operating model evolves.

Key Accountabilities

1. MedTech CLM strategy and enterprise partnership

· Serve as MedTech’s DRI and primary interface to GSINC for CLM strategy, roadmap, priorities, decisions, risks, and execution.

· Lead development and maintenance of an integrated MedTech CLM strategy, in partnership with MedTech business and technology leaders and aligned with GSINC enterprise direction.

· Translate the GSINC target state into a sequenced MedTech roadmap across PR&O, Sales and CPQ, Ottava, and future business-unit or functional deployments.

· Frame enterprise-versus-MedTech trade-offs, develop recommendations for sponsor and governance decisions, and help prevent local urgency from creating unnecessary fragmentation or permanent divergence.

· Represent MedTech in GSINC governance and ensure enterprise decisions and dependencies are understood and actioned within MedTech.

2. Leadership alignment, governance and decisions

· Act as the primary MedTech coordination lead for sponsors, business leaders, technology leaders, Legal, Compliance, HCC, Finance, Procurement, GSINC, and implementation partners.

· Establish practical governance, decision rights, escalation paths, and operating cadences that clarify accountability across MedTech stakeholders.

· Facilitate alignment where business-unit priorities, incentives, funding, timelines, or preferred solutions are not naturally aligned, and escalate unresolved trade-offs for sponsor decision.

· Prepare concise recommendations, decision papers, roadmap updates, investment requests, risk assessments, and progress readouts for senior leaders.

· Drive timely decisions and document unresolved trade-offs, owners, actions, and consequences of delay.

3. Roadmap, prioritization and value management

· Create a transparent portfolio view of MedTech contracting demand, current platforms, in-flight initiatives, dependencies, and investment needs.

· Develop and facilitate cross-MedTech prioritization recommendations using business value, risk, readiness, strategic alignment, user impact, data availability, and implementation feasibility for sponsor and governance approval.

· Coordinate MedTech input into enterprise planning across process, templates, integration, migration, data, testing, change, and operational readiness.

· Define measurable deployment outcomes including cycle time, automation, adoption, process consistency, data quality, compliance, user experience, and legacy retirement.

· Identify and challenge parallel CLM investments that create avoidable duplication, integration burden, or long-term technical debt.

4. PR&O and Ottava execution leadership

· Provide day-to-day MedTech leadership for the initial PR&O and Ottava implementations.

· Drive scope, requirements, readiness, process and template decisions, integrations, data, testing, deployment, hypercare, adoption, and value realization.

· Ensure PR&O contracting aligns with enterprise policy, templates, playbooks, controls, and platform capabilities.

· Ensure the Ottava implementation connects CRM, CPQ, CLM, pricing, approvals, document generation, ERP, and Finance in a coherent quote-to-contract experience.

· Maintain an integrated plan, RAID log, decision register, dependency map, milestone view, and leadership status.

5. Operating model, vendor and delivery accountability

· Clarify accountability among GSINC, MedTech business and technology teams, Legal, control functions, architects, data teams, and implementation partners.

· Track workstream commitments, surface missed dependencies, drive corrective actions, and escalate unresolved accountability gaps through governance.

· Partner with GSINC on vendor selection, onboarding, scope, plans, deliverables, quality, risks, and performance where MedTech input is required.

· If formally assigned, assume broader MedTech delivery, vendor management, financial management, or operational responsibilities as the enterprise operating model evolves.

· Establish a sustainable MedTech support and product operating model, including business administration, release management, incident ownership, enhancement intake, and lifecycle governance.

6. Change, adoption and readiness

· Partner with change and communications leaders on adoption across processes, roles, policies, templates, platform use, and legacy retirement.

· Identify and secure participation from business owners, SMEs, administrators, testers, champions, and regional representatives.

· Ensure training, communications, UAT, support, and transition are integrated with delivery rather than treated as downstream tasks.

· Use adoption, user feedback, operational metrics, and control results to drive continuous improvement.

· Build the MedTech capability needed to sustain the contracting model after the durational assignment ends.

Measures of Success

· GSINC has one clear and reliable point of contact for MedTech priorities, decisions, risks, and execution.

· MedTech leaders align around a sequenced CLM roadmap rather than competing or disconnected solutions.

· PR&O and Ottava progress through readiness, design, build, testing, launch, stabilization, and value realization with clear ownership and timely decisions.

· Enterprise standards are adopted where appropriate while justified MedTech integration and experience needs are incorporated without fragmenting the core platform.

· Senior leaders receive concise, decision-oriented reporting with transparent milestones, investment needs, risks, dependencies, and accountabilities.

· Delivery partners and workstream owners meet commitments, and underperformance is addressed quickly.

· A durable MedTech CLM operating model, ownership structure, roadmap, and transition plan are established before the assignment concludes.

Required Qualifications

· Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in business, information technology, engineering, operations, law, supply chain, or a related field.

· 8 or more years of progressive experience leading complex technology, product, transformation, program, or platform initiatives.

· Demonstrated success serving as an accountable lead for a cross-functional transformation spanning strategy, governance, and execution.

· Experience shaping roadmaps, portfolio priorities, operating models, investment cases, and leadership decisions across organizational boundaries.

· Experience with contracting, CLM, CPQ, CRM, sourcing, procurement, ERP, legal operations, professional relations, or comparable regulated workflows.

· Strong technology product management and program leadership skills across scope, milestones, dependencies, risks, decisions, resources, vendors, financials, readiness, testing, deployment, and adoption.

· Ability to influence senior leaders in a matrixed organization where authority, funding, ownership, and priorities are distributed.

· Demonstrated ability to simplify complex issues and communicate credibly with business, legal, and technical audiences.

· Experience managing systems integrators or technology vendors and holding partners accountable for outcomes and commitments.

· Experience operating in a regulated, security-conscious, or highly controlled enterprise environment.

Preferred Qualifications

· Experience in MedTech, pharmaceutical, healthcare, or another regulated industry.

· Direct experience with CLM and platforms such as Sirion, Icertis, Conga, Ironclad, or comparable solutions.

· Experience with sell-side contracting across CRM, CPQ, pricing, approval, document, ERP, Finance, and revenue workflows.

· Experience with healthcare professional contracting, professional relations, grants, events, or compliance-sensitive engagement processes.

· Experience establishing global standards while enabling controlled business-unit or regional variation.

· Working knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics 365, enterprise integration, data architecture, analytics, workflow automation, and AI-enabled contracting capabilities.

· Experience in a durational transformation assignment and transitioning ownership into a sustainable operating model.
