title: Software Development Engineer, NetOS Observability
description:
AWS runs one of the largest networks in the world. We design and implement its network devices and their operating system, NetOS. Every AWS service runs on this network, and every packet in the cloud touches our code! Nobody notices a healthy network. Operators need to know within seconds when a link degrades in one data center, and the first signal comes from software on the device. We write that software.

Our team, NetOS Observability, builds the agent that collects metrics, events, and logs from every NetOS device and publishes them to the network telemetry platform. Fleet health systems, SDN controllers, and network operators consume what we ship.

We are moving the fleet off a legacy daemon and onto a brand new Rust agent. In 2027, we take it to every supported platform, retire the legacy collectors, and let builders publish a new metric fleet-wide in two weeks. You will own that agent end to end, from its design to its release across the fleet to its behavior in production. The decisions that shape the next decade of network telemetry are open now. We need your help to craft the future.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and implement the NetOS observability agent in Rust on Linux (ARM64).
- Own the telemetry pipeline from device to gateway, including transport, authentication, schema, backpressure, and fleet-scale correctness.
- Migrate consumers off the legacy daemon with adapters that preserve their data shape, then retire the daemon.
- Build the test and release machinery that ships the component to the fleet on its own cadence. Every release passes its test gate.
- Instrument your own systems, define their SLOs, and carry the on-call rotation for them.
- Write design documents and review other engineers' designs. Name the dependency early when another team's roadmap gates yours, and negotiate the date.

A day in the life
You write Rust and test on real routers in our lab. You build for the component teams who define their telemetry in a schema we own, and for the fleet health systems, controllers, and operators who consume it. Every two weeks you settle the device-to-cloud contract with the telemetry platform team. You add a metric to the schema, bring a legacy consumer onto the new pipeline, and run the result on a router under its memory budget. AI agents draft, review, and test alongside you. You ship the component every few weeks and carry its on-call.

About the team
Our team sits inside NetOS Managed Fleet, which delivers health, observability, and management services for the NetOS fleet. We are growing the team in Raleigh, NC. You work directly with senior engineers and leadership across AWS Networking, and you give technical guidance as the team grows. We own what we ship, and we carry the on-call for the agent in production. We value clear design writing, incremental delivery, and property-based tests.

title: Tech Infra Program Manager II, Network Design and Deployment Team (NIDD)
description:
The Network Design and Deployment Team (NIDD) team oversees the design and deployment of cable infrastructure within ADC regions. This includes milestone review, comment issuance, and ensuring accuracy and efficiency. NIDD planning also assesses partner team designs to ensure compliance with AWS and customer requirements, focusing on cabling pathways, sizing, location, type, classification, and installation. The team provides telecom room designs, including sizing and power for various rooms, as well as user-outlet designs. The role involves coordinating meetings with partner teams to clarify ownership for delivering connectivity, working with multiple design/construction teams from pre-permit to hand-off to operations.

The AWS Network Design and Deployment Team (NIDD) team is searching for a passionate and talented Technical Infrastructure Program Manager (TIPM) to drive Data Center and Network Capacity planning in N. America. You will assess the demand requirements along with available network resources to determine and drive prime solutions for our customers. You will work with stakeholders to complete pre-requisites necessary to deliver critical networking capacity. You will lead programs with goals to improve infrastructure resource utilization and availability. You will work with teams across the ADC Organization to effectively plan and deliver data center capacity.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US citizen and obtain and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph. This position requires the candidate to opt into a commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work

Key job responsibilities
- Monitor the network health, customer demand, anticipate risks, resolve issues and initiate corrective action as appropriate.
- Work with stakeholders (networking engineers/tech program managers/senior management) to define requirements and processes.
- Manage the dependencies and the interfaces between projects and negotiate the trade-offs needed.
- Provide program progress reporting on a regular basis.
- End to end responsibility for the program’s execution and success.
- Manage multiple competing projects/programs simultaneously.
- Develop and implement scalable, data-driven process improvement/automated solutions.
- Keep the customer experience as the primary focus.
- Meets/exceeds Amazon’s leadership principles requirements for this role


A day in the life
The day to day activities will include: project update meetings, report building; program and goal tracking; site visits, project kick off meetings, and manage priorities across multiple regions to ensure resources are appropriately applied,.

About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

title: Staff Developer, Authentication Enablement
description:
1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $500M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

We're looking for a Staff Developer to join our Authentication Enablement team. Our mission is to help people, families and businesses unlock 1Password and access their information safely and simply, with authentication that stays in the background. Every 1Password app establishes its session with our servers through the service this team owns, whether the user signs in with a password and Secret Key, SSO, a passkey, MFA or a trusted device.

As a Staff Developer, you’ll help move authentication out of the monolith and into an independent service with its own data, so sign-in can scale and stay available independently of the rest of the platform. The service continues to handle production traffic throughout the migration, so we’re moving endpoint by endpoint and table by table, with weighted rollouts, consistency checks and tested rollback procedures. You'll help set the technical direction for the migration and for new authentication services, as 1Password extends trusted access to AI agents.

How we’re using AI today

Our Engineering, Product, and Design teams are thoughtfully integrating AI across the full software and product development lifecycle to move faster without sacrificing quality or security. In practice, that looks like engineers using AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate reviews and catch bugs earlier, product managers synthesizing user research at scale, and designers rapidly prototyping and iterating with AI-generated mockups. We approach AI the same way we approach security: with clear principles, human accountability at every consequential decision point, and rigorous evaluation before anything ships to customers.

This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.

What we're looking for:

  • Significant experience building and operating backend services.

  • Deep expertise with distributed systems and data: moving live traffic or data between systems without downtime, event streaming or change data capture, and keeping two sources of truth consistent through a cutover.

  • Strong experience designing asynchronous workflows and migrating synchronous processes that depend on large atomic transactions to eventually consistent designs, while preserving correctness, clarifying tradeoffs, and improving performance.

  • Working knowledge of authentication and authorization technologies such as OAuth, OIDC, WebAuthn, passkeys, or MFA, including common implementation pitfalls and security risks.

  • A track record of setting technical direction for a team: owning large, multi-quarter projects, writing the designs others build from, and explaining tradeoffs to engineers and leadership alike.

  • You raise the engineers around you through reviews, design feedback and mentoring, and you work to hand off ownership rather than holding on.

Bonus points for:

  • Extensive experience with Go or another backend language such as Java, C#, Rust, C++, or Python.

  • Experience extracting services from a monolith.

  • Experience with MySQL, Redis, Kafka, and DynamoDB at scale.

  • Familiarity with Secure Remote Password protocol.

  • Owning services with strict availability targets, including SLOs, on-call and incident response.

What you can expect:

  • Lead a portion of the authentication service's roadmap for the next 12 months, and work closely with leadership to ensure that planning reflects the full scope of requirements.

  • Hold AI-assisted work on security-critical code to the same bar as everything else: human judgment, careful validation and small, reviewable changes.

  • Participate in the 24/7 on-call rotation for tier-one services.

title: Senior Program Manager, Redeployment, Global Fleet and Products
description:
We are seeking a Sr. Program Manager to lead fleet expansion initiatives that enable Amazon's last-mile delivery network to scale efficiently and sustainably. This role requires a strategic operator who can own end-to-end expansion programs from concept through execution, balancing innovation with operational excellence. You will develop expansion strategies, manage pilot programs, build partnerships with external vendors, and coordinate across multiple internal teams to deliver vehicles and infrastructure that meet growing delivery demand. Success in this role requires strong analytical skills, cross-functional leadership, and the ability to drive results in ambiguous, fast-paced environments.


Key job responsibilities
Fleet Expansion Strategy & Execution
-Own expansion strategy and execution for assigned fleet segments, including vehicle selection, vendor partnerships, and operational readiness
-Develop multi-year expansion roadmaps that align with business growth projections and strategic priorities
-Build business cases that evaluate market readiness, infrastructure requirements, financial impact, and customer experience
-Define success metrics for new programs and track performance against targets
-Identify and mitigate risks to program timelines, budgets, and outcomes

Pilot Program Management
-Lead pilot programs to evaluate new vehicle types, operational models, and vendor partnerships
-Coordinate across product, operations, procurement, and Delivery Service Partner (DSP) teams to ensure successful launches
-Analyze pilot performance data to inform expansion decisions and scaling strategies
-Manage pilot timelines, budgets, and stakeholder expectations
-Document lessons learned and best practices for future programs

Cross-Functional Leadership
-Partner with procurement teams on vehicle sourcing, vendor negotiations, and contract management
-Collaborate with operations teams to ensure fleet readiness and DSP enablement
-Work with safety and compliance teams to meet regulatory requirements and establish safety standards
-Coordinate with real estate teams on parking capacity and infrastructure needs
-Provide strategic guidance to leadership on expansion opportunities, risks, and trade-offs

Ecosystem Development
-Identify infrastructure gaps that prevent fleet scaling and develop solutions to address them
-Build processes, systems, and tools that enable efficient fleet operations
-Partner with technology teams to automate manual processes and improve data visibility
-Establish standards and best practices that can scale across regions and vehicle types

Stakeholder Communication
-Ensure leadership visibility into program status, risks, and opportunities through regular updates and business reviews
-Present business cases and recommendations to senior leadership for decision-making
-Manage stakeholder expectations and align cross-functional teams on priorities
-Document program details and decisions for organizational knowledge sharing


A day in the life
Your day will be a dynamic blend of strategic planning, pilot program management, and cross-functional collaboration. You'll analyze expansion performance data, build business cases for new vehicle types or markets, and partner with operations and procurement teams to solve complex scaling challenges. From building a cohesive fleet strategy and evaluating pilot results to developing fleet ecosystem solutions that enable growth, you'll be the critical link ensuring Amazon's fleet expands efficiently to meet customer demand while advancing sustainability goals.


About the team
The Redeployment team keeps Amazon's last-mile delivery fleet moving by getting branded vehicles to where they're needed most. As part of Fleet Planning & Capacity, we manage each vehicle's path between Delivery Service Partners, including transport, repair, and reassignment, so every vehicle is road-ready and in use. We work with operations, finance, tech, and outside fleet management, repair and transport vendors to shorten cycle times, lower costs and cut waste. We take on unclear problems from start to finish, use data to make decisions and build processes that scale. We value curiosity, bold ideas and solving problems together.

title: CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE SPECIALIST(Cst, Est, Mst)
description:
CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE SPECIALIST

Allied Roofing Partners

Remote | Full-Time | Hourly
$18.00–$21.00 per hour, based on experience plus a Incentive Bonus Plan

Overtime opportunities available based on business needs


ABOUT THE ROLE

A Customer Experience (CX) Specialist is often the first person a homeowner talks to—whether they've called, filled out a web form, or clicked a social ad.

The CX Specialist role is designed to make sure customers hear back in minutes, not hours. CX will also help existing customers with questions and/or basic information as needed.

This role blends customer service and appointment setting. You'll work from proven scripts and playbooks while bringing real listening and judgment to every call.

You'll start by supporting Capstone Roofing, with room to grow into other brands and tools as our CX team expands.

Our goal is simple: Homeowners feel supported, not processed.


POSITION DETAILS

• Location: Remote – United States(Central, Est, or Mst only)
• Employment Type: Full-Time, Hourly
• Compensation: $18.00–$21.00 per hour, based on experience
• Schedule: Daytime business hours, with evening and Saturday coverage during peak season
• Overtime available
• Reports to: Assistant Director, Customer Experience


WHAT YOU'LL DO

Outbound – Appointment Setting & Recovery

• Call back homeowners who reached out but haven't booked and get them scheduled.
• Work our recovery list of missed calls and unworked web leads. These are a high priority because they are leads we've already paid for.
• When time allows, re-engage past quotes, older estimates, and past customers to help fill the calendar further out.

Inbound Customer Experience

• Answer inbound calls from homeowners requesting to book an inspection or estimate.
• Assist existing customers with job-related or basic questions.
• Respond to new website and social media leads within minutes.
• Log every interaction in the CRM.
• Transfer billing questions finance team.


Expectations

• Follow our calling cadence, scripts, and playbooks while adapting with good judgment when a situation calls for it.
• Meet daily and weekly targets for response speed, contact rate, and appointments booked.
• Provide a professional, friendly, and helpful experience during every customer interaction.


WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Required

• Phone-based customer service, appointment setting, inside sales, or call-center experience, including experience working with scripts or playbooks.
• Clear, confident, and friendly phone presence.
• Persistent without being pushy.
• Empathy, patience, and quick thinking with the ability to respond thoughtfully rather than react.
• Strong comfort with technology and the ability to learn and move between a CRM, dialer or softphone, and other tools as they evolve.
• Self-discipline and the ability to work productively from home.
• Quiet, professional home workspace with reliable high-speed internet.
• Coachable and goal-driven mindset.
• Authorization to work in the United States.


NICE TO HAVE

• Experience in roofing, home services, or another trades or contractor business.
• Bilingual with conversational Spanish.
• Previous lead-recovery calling experience.


YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS

Weeks 1–2

• Learn Capstone's scripts and systems.
• Shadow live calls.
• Begin handling inbound calls with support.

By Day 30

• Handle inbound calls independently.
• Begin working the recovery list.

By Day 90

• Consistently meet contact-rate and appointment-setting targets across inbound, recovery, and re-engagement work.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

• $18.00–$21.00 per hour, based on experience plus a incentive bonus plan
• Medical insurance and company sponsored life insurance
• Dental insurance
• Vision insurance• 401(k)
• Paid time off
• Paid holidays
• Equipment and software provided

title: Data Center Logistics Specialist, DCC Communities
description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Be a part of operating the world’s largest cloud computing infrastructure. Amazon Web Services is seeking bright, motivated, hardworking individuals to fill Data Center Logistics Specialist. The ideal candidate will have a solid background in procurement and / or supply chain operations. You must possesses a strong work ethic, attention to detail, the ability to multitask and operate in a very fast paced complex environment, meet deadlines, and a commitment to Operational Excellence.

The Logistics Specialist reviews Data Center inventory, in-bound shipments, and ongoing demand to ensure that proper stock levels are maintained in the all locations to support build and repair activities. Working with peers and management, you create plans to optimize the flow of parts through their lifecycle; tracking inventory location, movement, age, and turns. You work closely with Data Center Operations Technicians and Data Center Engineers to fulfill parts quickly and accurately. You work with Procurement and Hardware Engineering to purchase new parts and interface directly with vendors to process RMAs and receive replacements. Regular and ongoing communications with vendors to resolve issues and help them understand our business requirements necessitates a high level communicator.

You are responsible for accurate data entry and resolving questions from peer organizations. Additionally, the Logistics Specialist will ensure that all billing associated with the Inventory supply chain is accurate, validated and ready for processing. You will work with AP to reconcile invoice discrepancies. An understanding of general business accounting and finance is strongly desired.

Responsibilities can include manual tasks, such as assembling, addressing, stamping and arranging for the shipment of merchandise and materials. They may also assist in daily scheduling of deliveries and pick-ups to and from production locations. In handling incoming shipments, he or she may have to unpack boxes and verify contents. The Logistic Specialist will be required to keep precise records of all commodities going in and out of company.

Logistics Specialists are expected to understand all aspects of production, adhere to strict safety standards, maintain very high quality, and be willing and able to work on powered equipment (i.e forklift or cherry picker).

- May participate in group lifts of 41 pounds or more.
- Push or pull heavy objects into position

Physical demands are expected with reasonable accommodations

About the team
Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. title: Product Manager, Core
description:
About Agentio

Agentio enables marketers to buy creator led ads as easily and scalably as Meta or Google ads—automating sourcing, pricing, contracting, delivery, and measurement—so work that took months now happens in minutes.

We're on a mission to transform a $800B digital ad ecosystem by shifting digital ad spend into the hands of creators. That means better outcomes for marketers and enabling creators to live off their work—finally being paid in proportion to the value they create. That shift is accelerating: Unilever's CEO has said the company will move roughly half of its ad budget into social and creators—Unilever is among the world's largest advertisers, spending around $9–10B annually. As these dollars move, they need performance-grade pipes; Agentio is how those dollars flow to creators with the speed, control, and measurement marketers expect. We enable brands like Uber, DoorDash, and Bombas to run creator campaigns with the same rigor, control, and accountability as their core performance channels.

Our AI-Native platform enables real-time content understanding at scale, simultaneous reasoning across hundreds of thousands of pieces of content, and intelligent allocation of multi-million dollar budgets. Our models apply more cross-platform performance signal than anyone else in the world, compounding with every campaign through a high-trust marketplace with accelerating network effects. The result is a flywheel: brands get the performance they've been chasing, creators get the intelligence and income they deserve, and Agentio becomes the infrastructure powering a generational shift in where media dollars flow.

The market agrees. Agentio has raised $56M at a $340M valuation, including a Series B led by Forerunner that followed our Series A within a calendar year. Backed by Benchmark, Craft, and AlleyCorp. Named to Forbes' Next Billion Dollar Startups, 2025. Named to Inc.'s Best Places to Work 2026, one of 10 companies nationally recognized in the "On the Rise: 0–4 Years in Business" category.

An $800B market. A once-in-a-generation technology shift. This is the moment. This is the team. Come build something generational with us.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Core Product Manager to own and evolve the product experience for brands on Agentio. You’ll help customers get more value from our platform, building products that drive adoption, retention, and growth as our business scales.

You’ll work directly with our founders, Engineering, Design, and commercial teams to set product direction, identify the most important customer problems, and bring new solutions to market. This role combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution, with meaningful ownership over the customer experience and business outcomes.

This is an opportunity to get in early at a company redefining how advertising works for brands and creators. If you’re excited by ownership, fast execution, and measurable customer impact, this could be a great fit.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the strategy and roadmap for Agentio’s core brand experience.

  • Understand customer needs and turn them into products that deliver measurable value.

  • Identify opportunities to improve product adoption, customer retention, and revenue growth.

  • Partner with commercial teams to bring new solutions to market and drive their success.

  • Work closely with Engineering and Design to ship, learn, and iterate.

  • Set clear priorities and make thoughtful tradeoffs as the product and business evolve.

Key Metrics You’ll Own

  • Product adoption and engagement

  • Brand health and retention

  • Brand ad spend growth

What You Need

  • A desire to own a number and get fired up about hitting it.

  • Experience owning and shipping products that solve customer problems and drive business results.

  • A commercial mindset, with experience bringing solutions to market that drive measurable business impact.

  • Strong product execution: you can turn an ambiguous customer problem into a clear plan and a shipped product.

  • Strong data literacy: you know the right question to ask and can work with AI to answer it.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in advertising, ad tech, or advertiser-facing products.

  • Experience building marketplace products.

About You

  • You care about customer outcomes and want to understand what makes customers retain and grow.

  • You can connect individual product decisions to a cohesive customer experience and a broader product vision.

  • You appreciate good design and can make complex workflows feel intuitive.

  • You’re nimble, hungry, humble, and adaptive to change.

  • You’re a problem-solver and self-starter who takes ownership and follows through.

  • You’re comfortable moving quickly, making tradeoffs, and learning from what you ship.

  • You’re a fun, honest, empathetic, and curious teammate.

  • You understand that Agentio is building in person, five days a week.

What You’ll Get

  • The opportunity to help build a first-of-its-kind business and make a meaningful impact on how brands share their stories and creators earn a living.

  • Firsthand exposure to the decisions and business drivers involved in scaling a startup.

  • The chance to work closely with an exceptional team and help shape our product culture.

  • A collaborative, transparent, and engaging work environment.

If you’re energized by building performance-grade products that put more dollars in creators’ hands—and you’re ready to roll up your sleeves—let’s talk.

Benefits & Perks

  • Flexible PTO – Take the time you need to recharge

  • Comprehensive Health Coverage – Top medical plan through Aetna

  • Dental & Vision Plans – Protect your smile and your sight with coverage from Guardian

  • 401(k) Retirement Plan – Invest in your future while you build your career

  • $100 Monthly Lifestyle Credit – Use it to shop with our amazing Agentio Brand Partners

  • Daily lunches and snacks in the office to keep you at your best

  • Dinner provided Monday - Thursday

  • Fully subsidized gold tier access on Wellhub (Includes LifeTime, Barry's, Solidcore, Headspace, etc)

  • Gym in the building! – Your workout, right downstairs

The estimated base compensation for this role is between $225,000 & $350,000. Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, and experience. In addition, this role is eligible for equity and competitive benefits.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Requirements , Amazon LEO, D2D Software
description:
Amazon Leo is building a low Earth orbit satellite constellation to bring fast, affordable connectivity to customers around the world. Direct to Device (D2D) extends Leo to standard mobile phones and devices: a fully regenerative fifth-generation (5G) mobile base station on each satellite, delivering service to standard handsets through mobile network operators (MNOs). D2D Software builds the embedded software that flies, the cloud and ground software that runs the service, and the platform that connects them. Our target is under a day from a defect being found to the fix deployed across the entire constellation, achieved by automating everything that a person would otherwise do by hand.

This role leads requirements in Software Architecture & Specifications, reporting to the Chief Software Architect, Software Architecture & Specifications. It owns the requirements baseline, the requirement-writing standard, requirements as code, and the architecture and requirements leg of the COE. Before anything is handed on, the bar is: every requirement allocated, testable, and written to the standard. It hands off to its customers as follows: requirements baseline to the development teams and IVR.

What the team needs to achieve
• Every requirement allocated, testable, and written to the standard.
• Hand-offs that meet their service level: requirements baseline to the development teams and IVR.
• Measured, rising capability and efficiency of the team, with manual work falling release over release.

How the team is measured
• Requirements with a verification method.
• Requirements passing the automated quality checks.
• Requirements allocated to a block.


D2D Software is an evolving organization of many teams: Software Architecture & Specifications; Software Delivery & Business Ops; Software Integration, Verification & Reliability; DevOps & Release; Satellite Software Development; Ground Software Development; and Customer Software Engineering & Support. Each Director owns business outcomes: delivering the commitments, and the capability and efficiency of their teams. Teams work as internal customers and suppliers with agreed service levels, interfaces are agreed centrally while designs stay local, and engineers are expected to work directly with engineers across every boundary. Milestones are committed deadlines for delivery with quality, not gates to wait on, and every team runs on one toolchain and one system of record. Every measure is derived from the systems of record, never self-reported, and we improve release over release with a target of perfection.

Export Control Requirement:

title: Integrated Campaigns Manager, AMER
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

INTEGRATED CAMPAIGNS MANAGER, AMER

SpaceXSI is hiring an Integrated Campaigns Manager focused on building demand generation and account-based marketing (ABM) programs to help us win and expand our most strategic accounts.

You'll help run the campaigns that create demand for our products among enterprise buyers building programs for priority accounts, crafting stories that land with our target audiences, and executing the webinars, offers, nurture, and campaign deliverables that turn engagement into pipeline.

This is an execution-heavy role with plenty of room to grow. You'll write the copy and execute the programs that carry each campaign, and bring a data-driven mindset to drive continuous optimization. It's a high-agency position for someone who loves to ship, wants to learn fast, and wants a direct line to revenue.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Build and run programs for priority accounts and segments.

  • Design and run ABM programs for clusters of strategic accounts grouped by vertical, tech stack, use case, or buying-group pattern, with messaging, content, and offers tailored to each cluster, in partnership with sales, SDRs, and field marketing.

  • Scale what works into 1:many programmatic plays across a broader target list of prospects and customers, using intent, enrichment, and ad targeting to reach the right buying groups without hand-building every touch.

  • Map buying centers inside each account (VP Eng, CTO, platform and developer experience leads, security and procurement) and build multithreaded plays that reach each of them.

  • Turn account intelligence, intent, and usage signals into tailored campaign treatments, from personalized outreach and executive programs to events, direct mail, and sales plays.

  • Tell stories that land with technical buyers.

  • Shape the narrative, messaging, and offers for each campaign, and write the copy that carries it: briefs, emails, landing pages, ads, and account-specific content.

  • Develop engaging concepts and formats for virtual events (webinars, workshops, and exec roundtables), owning all aspects of production from idea to follow-up: select relevant topics, line up speakers from internal leaders and our customers, and make sure everyone is prepared.

  • Brief design and creative partners clearly and keep the story consistent across every channel and touchpoint.

  • Conceptualize and deploy creative demand gen offers

  • Come up with offers that give target accounts a reason to engage, like meeting makers, direct mail, digital engagement programs, and gifting.

  • Work with sales and SDRs on who gets each offer and how they follow up, and manage vendors on fulfillment, shipping, and budget.

  • Track every offer from send to meeting to pipeline so we know what to repeat.

  • Build thoughtful email campaigns and nurture programs

  • Develop and improve nurture sequences for prospects and customers, segmented by persona, account tier, and where they are in the journey.

  • Write and edit email copy, analyze performance, and come up with new ideas for content angles and CTAs that improve engagement.

  • Partner with our lifecycle and email owners to keep lists clean, segments accurate, and every send on brand.

  • Execute the deliverables that bring campaigns to life.

  • Turn campaign plans into finished work: write briefs for design, and build landing pages, emails, ads, and sales one-pagers.

  • Own launch checklists and timelines, coordinate with design, web, ops, and sales, and ship on time.

  • Report on how each campaign performed, share what you learned with the team and sales, and suggest what to try next.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 3 to 5 years in B2B marketing, demand generation, or marketing operations, with hands-on time supporting ABM or integrated campaigns for enterprise or technical audiences.

  • Hands-on experience supporting ABM or integrated campaigns for B2B enterprise or technical audiences

  • Experience writing and executing email nurture campaigns in a marketing automation platform

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • You're both left-brained and right-brained: as comfortable debating pipeline math as you are coming up with a creative campaign idea.

  • You write well. You can tell a compelling story, write copy that makes a busy engineering leader keep reading, and you have strong instincts for what good looks like.

  • You've supported ABM or integrated campaigns and understand the basics of account selection, buying groups, and multithreading in enterprise deals.

  • You're organized and detail-oriented, and you can juggle many deliverables and deadlines without dropping any.

  • You like working closely with sales, and you know how to earn trust with sellers.

  • You want ownership and high agency, and you'd rather ship and learn than wait for perfect information.

  • You can take a loose plan, bring structure to it, and get it shipped.

  • You're curious about AI and developer tools, and you use AI in your own workflow every day.

  • Hands-on experience running webinars, direct mail or meeting-maker programs, and email nurture.

  • Familiarity with tools like Salesforce, a marketing automation platform, webinar platforms, direct mail or gifting platforms, and Clay or ABM and intent platforms. Bonus if you've used AI coding tools to query data yourself.

  • Experience with verticalized or persona-specific go-to-market motions.

  • A track record of campaigns you can point to with real results, and the writing samples to back it up.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Onsite role: must be able to work in person at the San Francisco office

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

Annual Salary:

$144,000 - $176,000 USD

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.

title: Product Director
description:
Agency :

Havas London

Job Description :

Product Director, Havas Creative Network & Havas Lynx

Product Director, Havas Creative Network & Havas Lynx


This role is working across both Havas Creative and Havas Health networks, so somebody whos had a foot in both camps before would be wonderful for us.


Who We Are


Havas Creative and Havas Lynx (part of the Health Network) bring together creativity, intelligence, strategy, data and technology to help brands build desire and drive growth and positive impact.


Havas Creative Network operates at the intersection of creativity, data, culture and technology, built around our Village model and united by a single ambition: growth, powered by desire. Our global network spans 23,000+ people across 72 Villages, with an operating model that connects intelligence, creativity and technology.


Havas Lynx is a leading healthcare communications agency with a full-service global offering and almost 500 multidisciplinary specialists. For 40 years, we’ve brought together fresh perspectives, creative thinking and a progressive approach to partner with our clients, healthcare professionals and patients in finding solutions for the modern-day healthcare landscape.


This role sits across both networks, helping us build the next generation of AI-powered intelligence products, tools and capabilities for Creative and Health.


The role


We are looking for a Product Director to lead the development and evolution of a portfolio of AI-powered intelligence products and tools across Havas Creative Network and Havas

Lynx.


This is a highly autonomous, entrepreneurial role for someone who knows how to take an idea from opportunity and product vision through discovery, prototyping, build, testing and readiness for launch.


You will own the product development roadmap across both networks, identify what we should build next, and manage products through different stages of development and maturity.


You will work closely with senior Intelligence, Strategy and Innovation leadership across Havas Creative Network and Havas Health Network, alongside agentic engineers, product designers, strategists and subject-matter experts to bring products to life.


Our products sit at the intersection of strategic thinking, proprietary intelligence, AI and technology.


You will own the product development workstream end-to-end, from identifying user needs and defining the opportunity through to product requirements, rapid prototyping, development, testing and iteration. You will also support proposition development and commercialisation, helping turn strong ideas and IP into scalable products that create value for our teams and clients.


What we’re looking for


We are looking for a product-minded, entrepreneurial leader who can operate with significant autonomy and bring structure, pace and ambition to a growing portfolio of AI-powered products.


You will bring:

  • Strong experience in product management or product development, ideally within technology, AI, digital or innovation-led businesses
  • A track record of taking products from idea and opportunity through discovery, prototyping, development, testing and launch
  • The ability to rapidly prototype product concepts and user experiences, using tools such as Figma/Figma AI or equivalent
  • Strong commercial and strategic thinking, with the ability to identify where proprietary thinking, intelligence or technology can become a valuable product
  • Experience owning product roadmaps, prioritisation, requirements and delivery plans
  • Excellent project management skills, with the ability to build and own clear timelines, manage dependencies and keep multidisciplinary teams moving
  • Strong understanding of AI-powered products, agentic technologies and emerging technologies, without needing to be a technical engineer
  • The ability to translate complex strategic, scientific or technical thinking into clear product requirements, user needs and development priorities
  • A strong understanding of user experience and intuitive product design
  • Strong collaboration skills, with experience working across product, design, engineering, strategy and specialist teams
  • An understanding of, or genuine interest in, the creative, communications and health environments, and how products can support strategists, creatives, specialists, clients and new business
  • A proactive, entrepreneurial mindset, with the confidence to identify opportunities, make decisions and move things forward without constant direction
  • The ability to balance long-term product vision with the practical detail required to get products built and working
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to work with senior leadership and teams across global markets
  • Genuine curiosity about strategy, intelligence, creativity, health, AI and technology, and how they can come together to create new ways of working

Responsibilities


Product Strategy & Roadmap


  • Own the product roadmap across the portfolio of AI-powered intelligence products and tools spanning Havas Creative Network and Havas Lynx
  • Work with senior Intelligence, Strategy and Innovation leadership across both networks to shape product vision, priorities and future opportunities
  • Identify opportunities to turn proprietary intelligence, strategic thinking, specialist expertise and emerging technology into scalable products and tools
  • Assess and prioritise opportunities with support from the wider teams
  • Develop and maintain clear product plans, milestones and development timelines
  • Balance shared product opportunities across the two networks with specific Creative or Health use cases where appropriate

Product Discovery, Prototyping & UX/UI


  • Rapidly prototype product concepts, wireframes and user journeys using tools such as Figma/Figma AI to demonstrate how products should function, look and feel before significant technical development begins
  • Lead product discovery, including workshops, user research and design sprints, to identify genuine user needs, interrogate ideas and validate concepts early
  • Turn discovery into clear user journeys, product requirements and MVP definitions
  • Champion strong UX and UI principles, including accessibility, ensuring products are intuitive, useful and engaging rather than simply technically sophisticated
  • Test prototypes with users across Creative, Health, markets and relevant client teams, translating feedback into tangible product improvements
  • Bridge product vision, design and engineering, ensuring the intent and user experience of the product is maintained through technical development

Product Development & Delivery


  • Own the product development journey from validated opportunity and requirements through build, testing, launch and iteration
  • Develop clear product requirements and briefs in partnership with strategists, subject-matter experts, designers and engineers
  • Work closely with AI/agentic engineers and product designers to translate requirements and prototypes into effective working products
  • Define MVP scope and make clear prioritisation decisions around what is needed now, next and later
  • Coordinate multidisciplinary teams, manage dependencies and ensure products progress against agreed timelines
  • Lead product testing with strategists, specialist teams, markets and clients, gathering feedback and translating it into improvements
  • Inherit and improve existing products at different stages of maturity, ensuring they continue to evolve around user needs and opportunities
  • Bring structure, pace and accountability to the product development workstream

Product Proposition & Commercialisation


  • Work with Intelligence, Strategy and Innovation leadership across both networks to shape product propositions and packaging
  • Support the development of commercial models, propositions and go-to-market approaches
  • Identify opportunities to extend products across clients, markets, agencies and network applications
  • Help define the value proposition and use cases for different audiences, from internal teams to global clients
  • Work with community, learning and capacity-building teams to support roll-out, adoption and scale across both networks
  • Help establish feedback loops between adoption, client demand and the future product roadmap

Innovation & Future Products


  • Stay close to developments in AI, agentic technology, product innovation and emerging user behaviours to identify opportunities for both networks
  • Bring an entrepreneurial mindset to identifying what we should build next, for whom and why
  • Help turn early ideas into testable propositions and prototypes before committing significant development resource
  • Establish a culture of experimentation, rapid prototyping, testing and continuous product improvement
  • Contribute to the evolution of product development capability across Havas Creative Network and Havas Health Network

Permanent

title: Senior Cash Applications Specialist (6 months FTC)
description:
About Us:

At Sitecore, our mission is to simplify how brands reach, engage, and serve people by delivering intelligent, personalised digital experiences that connect the world. We empower the world’s most iconic brands to build lifelong relationships with their customers—seamlessly, smartly, and at scale.


As the leading provider of agentic digital experience software, Sitecore brings together content, commerce, and data into one composable platform that enables brands to deliver millions of meaningful, adaptive experiences every day. Trusted by global leaders such as American Express, Porsche, Starbucks, and L’Oréal, Sitecore helps brands transform engagement through experiences that are not only personalised but predictive and dynamic.


Our foundation is our people—a diverse, passionate, and collaborative global team spanning over 25 countries. We believe that every experience matters, and that belief starts with how we work together. Our values guide how we lead, innovate, and connect. They are the behaviours that bring our mission and vision to life, every day, in every interaction.


As we continue to evolve, we are actively cultivating AI skills across our teams to unlock new levels of creativity, efficiency, and insight. From engineering to customer experience, AI capabilities are becoming integral to how we design, build, and deliver the next generation of digital experiences.


Learn more at .

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Cash Application Specialist (6 months FTC) to join our Global Collections team and play an important role in keeping our order-to-cash operation running smoothly.

Reporting to the Global Collections Manager, you will take ownership of key activities across accounts receivable, collections, cash application, and account reconciliation, while partnering closely with teams across the business and customers around the world.

This is more than a transactional finance role. You will have the opportunity to identify issues, improve processes, support automation, and help shape how our global collections operation works as Sitecore continues to scale.

The ideal candidate is organized, proactive, commercially minded, and comfortable working in a fast-paced international environment where priorities can change quickly.

What You'll Do

  • Manage and resolve customer account issues, ensuring outstanding matters are investigated and followed through to resolution.

  • Support cash collection, cash application, payment posting, refunds, credit notes, and account reconciliations.

  • Work closely with Billing, Sales, Tax, Order Management, Deal Desk, Legal, and other teams to resolve issues and remove barriers to timely customer payment.

  • Maintain accurate and timely documentation of customer communications and collection activity in Tesorio.

  • Partner with the Global Collections Manager and wider Finance team to identify opportunities to improve processes, controls, and efficiency.

  • Support the implementation of automation and process improvements across the order-to-cash cycle.

  • Liaise with third-party collection agencies when required.

  • Help ensure accurate, timely, and customer-focused resolution of receivables across multiple markets.

  • Contribute to a collaborative global Finance environment by sharing knowledge and supporting continuous improvement.

What You'll Bring

  • Experience in Accounts Receivable, Cash Applications, Collections, or Finance Operations, ideally within a multinational organisation.

  • Good understanding of the full Accounts Receivable / Order-to-Cash cycle.

  • Experience working with customer accounts, payment allocation, reconciliations, and collection activities.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate issues and identify practical solutions.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a strong customer-service mindset.

  • Ability to work independently, prioritise effectively, and manage multiple deadlines in a high-volume environment.

  • A proactive mindset and genuine interest in improving processes rather than simply following them.

  • Experience working against collections or AR targets/KPIs.

  • Fluent English communication skills.

Additional Skills That Will Set You Apart

  • Experience working within a SaaS, software, or technology company.

  • Experience with NetSuite or another major ERP/finance platform.

  • Experience with Tesorio or other collections / accounts receivable technology.

  • Experience with multi-country or multi-currency AR operations.

  • Exposure to automation, process optimisation, or finance transformation initiatives.

  • Strong Excel and data-analysis skills.

  • Experience working with geographically distributed teams.

Why Join Sitecore?

This is an opportunity to join a global technology company at an exciting stage of growth and play a meaningful role in how our Finance organization scales.

You will have the opportunity to:

  • Make an impact: Take ownership of important AR and collections activities supporting a global business.

  • Improve how we work: Contribute ideas around automation, process improvement, and operational efficiency.

  • Work globally: Collaborate with colleagues and stakeholders across multiple countries and functions.

  • Grow your career: Develop your expertise across AR, collections, cash application, and broader Finance operations.

  • Be part of something bigger: Join a collaborative, international team where Finance is a business partner, not simply a back-office function.

  • Work with technology: Be part of an organization actively embracing AI, automation, and data to improve the way we operate.

At Sitecore, growth means opportunities for our people too. If you are looking for a role where you can combine finance expertise, problem-solving, collaboration, and continuous improvement, we'd love to hear from you.

Equal Opportunities at Sitecore

Sitecore is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can contribute, grow, and do their best work. We provide equal employment opportunities without unlawful regard to race, colour, ancestry, religion, gender, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, veteran status, or any other locally protected characteristic.

title: UK Customer Advisors
description:
Where unforgettable experiences begin

At AXS, we connect fans with the artists, teams and events they love. From The O2 and OVO Arena Wembley to festivals like BST Hyde Park, we help millions of people get to the shows that matter to them.

We're looking for Customer Advisors to join our Birmingham Contact Centre.

Is this the right role for you?

Before you apply, here's what you need to know.

This is a full-time, office-based contact centre role. You'll spend much of your day helping customers by phone, email, live chat and social media. Some conversations will be straightforward, while others will involve complaints or frustrated customers.

You'll work to individual and team targets, follow processes and receive regular coaching and feedback. Being reliable and punctual is important, particularly during your initial training when you'll need to attend every scheduled session.

The role also includes weekends and bank holidays, so please make sure you can genuinely commit to the working pattern before applying.

What you'll be doing

  • Helping customers by phone, email, live chat and social media
  • Resolving queries and complaints calmly and professionally
  • Selling tickets and relevant products
  • Keeping accurate customer records and following agreed processes
  • Working towards individual and team targets
  • Taking ownership of customer queries and following them through
  • Using feedback and coaching to continually improve

What we're looking for

You'll need to:

  • Have previous customer service or contact centre experience
  • Be reliable, punctual and committed
  • Enjoy helping and talking to customers throughout the day
  • Stay calm and professional when dealing with difficult conversations
  • Communicate clearly and listen well
  • Be comfortable working to targets
  • Pay attention to detail
  • Be open to feedback and coaching
  • Be able to work weekends and bank holidays

You can find out more about life at AXS here:

Where: AXS Birmingham Contact Centre, near Birmingham International Airport and the NEC. This is an office-based role and you'll be expected to work from the contact centre for your shifts. You will work 5 days out of 7, including weekends and Bank Holidays.

So why apply?

AEG is an inclusive organisation where we value everybody's contribution. We empower and trust our people to do the right thing. We go the extra mile, for our customers and each other, every time. We are always open to new ideas and respect all perspectives. We support and bring out the best in each other. We really value our people and inspire them to be the best in class, always!

Our commitment to inclusion

We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workforce. We believe in equality of opportunity for all and our approach to recruitment and selection is fair, open and based purely on merit. Applications from individuals are encouraged regardless of age, disability, sex, gender reassignment, sexual orientation, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief and marriage and civil partnerships. title:
Senior Technical Program Manager, Satellite
Amazon Leo, D2D Software
description:
Amazon Leo is building a low Earth orbit satellite constellation to bring fast, affordable connectivity to customers around the world. Direct to Device (D2D) extends Leo to standard mobile phones and devices: a fully regenerative fifth-generation (5G) mobile base station on each satellite, delivering service to standard handsets through mobile network operators (MNOs). D2D Software builds the embedded software that flies, the cloud and ground software that runs the service, and the platform that connects them. Our target is under a day from a defect being found to the fix deployed across the entire constellation, achieved by automating everything that a person would otherwise do by hand.

This role leads satellite in Software Delivery & Business Ops, reporting to the Director, Software Delivery & Business Ops. It owns handovers and supplier delivery for the satellite domain. Before anything is handed on, the bar is: every satellite handover has exit criteria agreed. It hands off to its customers as follows: integrated schedule and supplier scorecards to Satellite Software Development.

What the team needs to achieve
• Every satellite handover has exit criteria agreed.
• Hand-offs that meet their service level: integrated schedule and supplier scorecards to

Satellite Software Development.
• Measured, rising capability and efficiency of the team, with manual work falling release over release.

How the team is measured
• Satellite handovers with exit criteria agreed before work starts.
• Supplier drops delivered on schedule and accepted or rejected on time.
• Satellite milestones landing inside their forecast window.

Key job responsibilities
• Own handovers and supplier delivery for the satellite domain.
• Meet the bar before every hand-off: every satellite handover has exit criteria agreed.
• Work directly with engineers in the boundary teams as partners, through agreed contracts and service levels.
• Automate everything a person would otherwise do twice.
• Run the program's mechanisms, metrics, and reviews, and clear blockers with the right people, escalating when needed.
• Identify and mitigate program risks early, build consensus across teams, and mentor other program managers.



This role runs the handovers and supplier delivery for the satellite domain, from the radio and payload software suppliers to the manufacturing readiness gate. Supplier delivery is part of the role: drop schedules, supplier service levels, delivery commitments, and escalations, while the engineering team owns the technical relationship and Software Integration, Verification & Reliability gives the acceptance verdict. It matters because the satellite schedule depends on supplier drops, scarce hardware, and embedded software that must be ready before each satellite is built. Without it, supplier slips surface late, handovers between teams break, and satellite software misses the dates manufacturing depends on.


Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.


About the team
D2D Software is an evolving organization of many teams: Software Architecture & Specifications; Software Delivery & Business Ops; Software Integration, Verification & Reliability; DevOps & Release; Satellite Software Development; Ground Software Development; and Customer Software Engineering & Support. Each Director owns business outcomes: delivering the commitments, and the capability and efficiency of their teams. Teams work as internal customers and suppliers with agreed service levels, interfaces are agreed centrally while designs stay local, and engineers are expected to work directly with engineers across every boundary. Milestones are committed deadlines for delivery with quality, not gates to wait on, and every team runs on one toolchain and one system of record. Every measure is derived from the systems of record, never self-reported, and we improve release over release with a target of perfection.

title: Data & Infrastructure Engineer
description:
About Mecka AI

Mecka AI is building the data infrastructure layer for robotics and embodied AI.
We design and operate global systems for data capture, data labeling, and hardware-enabled workflows used by leading AI labs and robotics companies to train and validate humanoid and embodied AI systems.
We work closely with frontier robotics teams to bridge real-world data, simulation, learning-based systems, and deployed hardware.

The role

Every hour our operators work produces hours of synchronized video, robot state, and actions, and that data is a core product. You'll own the path from robot site to a searchable, trustworthy dataset that our researchers train on and our customers buy. You'll also run the infrastructure that keeps a growing, geographically spread fleet updated, monitored, and healthy.

What you'll do

  • Own data storage and lifecycle: ingest from sites, object storage layout, retention, tiering, and cost.

  • Build the catalog: episode metadata, task labels, operator and robot info, quality flags, and search, so anyone can find "all successful pick-and-place episodes on arm model X last month."

  • Build automated quality checks: dropped frames, sync drift, missing streams, failed or truncated episodes.

  • Build dataset export and delivery: convert raw episodes into the formats training teams and customers expect, with versioning and provenance.

  • Handle data governance: access control, customer and site data agreements, privacy (faces, sensitive scenes on site), and audit trails for data we sell.

  • Run fleet infrastructure: provisioning edge machines at sites, remote software deploys and rollbacks, secrets, VPN/connectivity, monitoring, and alerting.

  • Keep cloud costs and bandwidth under control as data volume grows.

  • Build dashboards to monitor data collection status and progress

What we're looking for

  • 3-4 years as a data, platform, or infrastructure engineer owning production systems end to end.

  • Experience with large unstructured data (video, sensor logs, images) in object storage, not only tabular warehouses.

  • Strong Python and SQL; comfortable with infrastructure-as-code, containers, and CI/CD.

  • You've built pipelines with real failure handling: retries, idempotency, backfills, and monitoring.

Nice to have

  • Experience with robotics or autonomous-vehicle data, or ML training data pipelines.

  • Edge fleet management: deploying to many remote Linux devices on unreliable networks.

  • Experience packaging and delivering datasets to external customers.

  • Familiarity with data privacy rules across multiple countries.

If you don't check every box above but believe you can do the job, we encourage you to apply — we're looking for capability and trajectory, not a perfect checklist match.

We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, we will partner with you to meet your needs.

We may use AI-assisted tools to help evaluate applications against the requirements of this role. These tools support our recruiting team in identifying qualified candidates but do not replace human judgment or limit which applications may be reviewed or considered.

title: Hardware Support Engineer, RDPI Global Engineering Hardware Development
description:
Are you inspired by invention? Is problem solving through teamwork in your DNA? Do you like the idea of seeing how your work impacts the bigger picture? Answer yes to any of these and you'll fit right in here at Amazon Robotics.

We are a smart team of doers who work passionately to apply advances in robotics and software to solve real-world challenges that will transform our customers' experiences in ways we can't even imagine yet. We invent every day. We are Amazon Robotics and we will give you the tools and support you need to invent with us in ways that are rewarding, fulfilling, and fun.

Job Overview

Amazon Robotics Delivery and Packaging Innovation (RDPI) Global Engineering Hardware team is seeking a motivated and hands-on Hardware Support Engineer to join our GE HW Field Service Tech team. This team operates in a multi-disciplinary environment alongside hardware engineers, controls engineers, test engineers, and test technicians dedicated to advancing sustainable packaging automation and robotics technologies that fulfill millions of customer orders every day.

In this role, you serve as the vital link between lab/on-site field testing activities and the RDPI GE HW Test Engineering team, ensuring maximum performance and reliability of advanced packaging automation and robotics systems during testing, deployment, and validation. You will provide hands-on troubleshooting and repair support of RDPI hardware platforms, including Universal SmartPac (USP), Olympus, Velocity, and Gen14 - to name a few - across laboratory and field environments during R&D, design verification, and production deployment phases. Working hand-in-hand with Test Technicians and Test Engineers, you will support site acceptance testing (SAT), design verification testing (DVT), and execute hardware troubleshooting, equipment recovery, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives across Amazon's fulfillment network.

You will develop and implement diagnostic solutions, escalation processes, standard operating procedures, and preventative maintenance protocols for the RDPI hardware product suite. You will proactively monitor system performance, identify trends, and provide "voice of the field" feedback to development and test engineering teams. This role requires independent judgment and comfort working with ambiguity in a complex, fast-paced, high-throughput environment where multi-tasking is essential.

Key job responsibilities
Provide on-site hands-on troubleshooting, repair, and hardware support for RDPI automation and robotics systems at Amazon Labs, Fulfillment Centers (FCs) and Sortation Centers (SCs) across North America



Execute and support SAT, DVT, and functional testing activities in both lab (BOS35) and field environments, working alongside Test Technicians, Test Engineers, and Hardware Design Engineers.

Identify, analyze, and resolve mechanical, electrical, and electro-mechanical system issues across the RDPI hardware product suite (USP, Olympus, Gen14, Velocity and emerging platforms)

Design and implement electro-mechanical tools, fixtures, and diagnostic solutions to minimize troubleshooting time and reduce machine downtime

Develop and implement proactive monitoring tools and methods to measure safety, reliability, and performance of RDPI hardware systems in the field

Create escalation processes, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and preventative maintenance protocols for RDPI hardware

Conduct root cause analysis (RCA) and failure investigations, documenting findings and driving corrective actions back to the HW development and test engineering teams

Design and lead training sessions and develop training content for on-site test technicians and site Reliability & Maintenance Engineering (RME) teams

Develop and implement spare parts management recommendations and processes for field-deployed RDPI hardware

Produce performance reports and provide "voice of the field" feedback to HW development, test engineering, and program teams

Oversee and provide technical guidance to Test Technicians during field deployments, ensuring adherence to test plans and safety protocols

Partner with site-level RME teams to maximize RDPI hardware system performance during and after testing campaigns

Up to 75% travel expected

A day in the life
As a Hardware Support Engineer on the RDPI GE HW Field Service team, your day begins by reviewing system performance data and field test reports from active deployment sites. Perhaps overnight testing at a New Jersey FC revealed an intermittent sensor fault on a USP machine, or a part failed at a New York site and a spare is not available. You analyze metrics to identify trends and risks, developing de-risking actions for the weekly business review with your Test Manager.

You troubleshoot remotely with on-site test technicians via video, walking them through diagnostic procedures for an electro-mechanical issue. Later that morning, you travel to an active testing site to conduct a hardware audit on a newly deployed Olympus system, gathering feedback from the site RME team and coordinating with the Test Engineer who owns the test plan.

In the afternoon, you're hands-on with the hardware—swapping a suspect actuator assembly, running functional checks, and documenting your findings in a detailed failure investigation report. You design a quick diagnostic fixture to help technicians isolate a recurring conveyor alignment issue more efficiently. Before wrapping up, you coordinate with the BOS35 Test Manager and Supervisor on the next week's field deployment schedule, update your SOPs based on lessons learned, and present a root cause summary to the HW development team that will influence the next design iteration.

We are open to hiring candidates to work out of: Boston, MA (BOS35) with up to 75% travel required to Amazon Fulfillment Centers and Sortation Centers across North America.

About the team
Our GE HW Field Service Tech team is part of the RDPI Global Engineering Hardware Engineering organization. We operate in a highly collaborative, multi-disciplinary environment working alongside hardware engineers, software engineers, controls engineers, reliability engineers, test engineers, and operations teams. Our field service team provides critical hands-on support to ensure RDPI hardware platforms perform reliably during testing, validation, and deployment across Amazon's fulfillment network.

We focus on bridging the gap between lab-based development and real-world field performance—our team is the eyes, ears, and hands of the HW Test Engineering organization in the field. We work backwards from the technician and site operator experience to identify hardware deficiencies, communicate risk, and propose mitigation strategies. Our hands-on approach to testing, troubleshooting, and investigating puts us in the shoes of operators and technicians in the field. We work backwards from these insights to satisfy engineering requirements, partnering with safety, hardware, software, controls, and cross-functional support teams.

Our work spans the entire product development lifecycle—from early design verification and factory acceptance through site acceptance testing and continuous improvement of deployed systems across hundreds of fulfillment centers in North America. What sets our team apart is our direct, hands-on engagement with the hardware at scale, ensuring our automation solutions deliver exceptional performance, reliability, and quality. Our contributions directly impact Amazon's sustainability goals, operational efficiency, and the customer experience for millions of packages shipped daily.

We're responsible for field support of diverse automation technologies including Universal SmartPac (USP), EcoPac, Assisted Bagging, URL-SLAM, UIS 2.0 (Universal Item Sortation), ASAD (Automatic Scanning at Dock Door), Olympus, Gen14, and emerging Pack Assist technologies.

title: Compensation Analyst
description:
AppFolio is more than a company. We’re a community of dreamers, big thinkers, problem solvers, active listeners, and multipliers. At every opportunity, we set the pace while delivering innovation built to carry real estate into the future. One in which every experience feels effortless, yet meaningful.
