The Compensation Analyst is the analytical engine behind how AppFolio pays its people. Every merit increase, promotion, bonus, and equity refresh runs through the models, benchmarks, and data you build, and leaders rely on that work to make sound pay decisions. In this role, you will power the analysis behind our broad-based pay programs across the Grow cycle, job architecture, and incentive plans, with support for equity refresh analysis.

This is a high-trust role. You will work with some of the most confidential data in the company, and the accuracy of your work shapes real outcomes for employees. You will be the analyst HRBPs, Talent Acquisition, and business leaders turn to for market data, and the partner who helps program owners deliver on time and with confidence. This role reports to the VP, Total Rewards.

What You’ll Do

  • Be the market data expert. Benchmark new and changing roles against market data, then recommend job matches and pay grades for review. Respond to ad hoc market data requests from HRBPs, Talent Acquisition, and business leaders with speed and care.

  • Build the models behind Grow. Build and QA the models that inform merit, promotion, and bonus decisions during the Grow cycle. Support Grow enablement by preparing the data, examples, and materials that equip managers to have strong pay conversations.

  • Support market pricing and salary structures. Contribute to market pricing and salary structure analysis that keeps our job architecture current and competitive.

  • Own survey submission readiness. Prepare and validate survey submissions so inputs are accurate and on time.

  • Support incentive programs. Support non-sales short-term incentive plans with calculations, reporting, and documentation.

  • Prepare the equity refresh. Prepare eligibility, guideline, and budget data for the annual equity refresh.

  • Strengthen pay equity. Provide data support for pay equity reviews.

  • Keep leaders informed. Maintain the dashboards and reports that give leaders timely, accurate pay information.

  • Support compliance. Support labor law reporting and audits.

  • Document with rigor. Document models and processes clearly so any teammate can run them.

  • Make the function smarter. Identify opportunities to automate recurring analyses and improve data quality.

What We’re Looking For

  • Analytical and detail-driven. You build models that hold up under scrutiny. You catch what others miss, and you design checks that catch what people miss.

  • Sound judgment with confidential data. Colleagues and leaders trust you with sensitive information because you handle it with discretion every time.

  • Clear communicator. You can explain complex data to non-technical partners in plain terms, in writing and in conversation.

  • Organized under pressure. You manage deadlines across several workstreams and deliver on the date you committed to.

  • Builder of durable work. You document your work and look for ways to automate it, so the whole team gets faster.

  • Curious about the craft. You want to build deep compensation expertise and grow with the function.

Must Have

  • Bachelor’s degree.

  • 2 to 4 years of compensation, total rewards, or related analytical experience, ideally in a SaaS or technology environment.

  • Advanced Excel skills, including complex modeling, lookups, and pivot analysis.

  • Working knowledge of Google Workspace.

  • Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain data to non-technical partners.

  • Strong organization and the ability to manage deadlines across several workstreams.

  • Sound judgment with confidential data.

Nice to Have

  • Workday experience.

  • Exposure to survey vendors or compensation consultants.

  • Exposure to equity plans, pay equity analysis, or regulatory compensation reporting.

Compensation & Benefits

title: SUE Technician II
description:
Overview

Are you ready to dig deep into a career that combines cutting-edge technology, field expertise, and infrastructure innovation? Join our high-performing team in Phoenix, AZ as a SUE Technician II and play a crucial role in mapping and protecting the unseen systems that keep our cities moving. At the heart of our work is precision, safety, and impact—and as a SUE Tech, you’ll be the boots-on-the-ground leader driving success in the field. From high-profile transportation corridors to evolving urban developments, your work will help engineers and designers make smarter, safer decisions every day. In this role you will work closely with Senior SUE Staff, Project Manager, and engineers to help identify utility conflicts using an array of technologies, including electromagnetic line locators, ground penetrating radar, GPS, conventional survey and vacuum excavation.


Join our Subsurface Utility Engineering (SUE) team, a branch of engineering that deals with mitigating risks associated with new infrastructure design and construction. We work closely with engineers and utility owners to help identify utility conflicts using an array of technologies, including electromagnetic line locators, ground penetrating radar, GPS, conventional survey and vacuum excavation. Our work requires a high level of precision and technical ability.


Responsibilities

  • Work with a team of talented individuals to help tackle a wide variety of projects.
  • Read and interpret utility records, as-built and survey drawings and highway design plans.
  • Designate existing utilities using electromagnetic and geophysical technologies.
  • Operate and drive a vacuum excavation truck and perform test holes to expose utilities.
  • Utilize appropriate maintenance of traffic.
  • Call “One-Call” tickets.
  • Coordinate survey work in relation with SUE.
  • Supervise activities of field crew.
  • Train junior crew members.
  • Represent Colliers Engineering & Design in the field and communicate/coordinate with utility companies.

Qualifications

  • Minimum 2 year experience in using electromagnetic and geophysical designating technologies.
  • 5+ years of experience preferred.
  • Experience with VAC Truck preferred.
  • Must be able to quickly grasp new technologies.
  • Should have basic computer skills and be able to learn and understand new software.
  • Need to have a high level of reading comprehension and communication skills.
  • Should enjoy working outdoors in a variety of weather conditions.
  • Need to be able to occasionally travel out of town and work overtime.
  • Should be able to walk long distances of several miles daily.
  • Will sometimes be lifting heavy equipment up to 80 lbs.
  • Need to have good driving skills and a clean driving record.
  • Must prioritize the safety of yourself and others.
  • May need to work nights/weekends.
  • Ability to read, write and understand English for purposes of comprehending written job-related communications and verbal instructions and interactions.

Requires a pre-employment drug screen and will require ongoing participation in the employer's random drug and alcohol testing program.


What We Offer

At Colliers Engineering & Design, our people are our most important resource. That’s why we are committed to providing all our employees with a safe, comfortable work environment, potential for career advancement, and the ability to impact society through their projects as well as Company sponsored activities.

This dedication begins with supporting a work life balance through a generous compensation package that includes: company paid medical, dental, and vision coverage; paid pregnancy disability leave; short- and long-term disability insurance; life insurance; a company-matched 401(k)/Roth; paid time off that includes parental and military leave; employee referral and professional license bonuses and a straight time policy that compensates exempt employees for billable hours worked in excess of 40 billable hours within a work week.

We have also created an internal culture that provides the resources and technology needed to encourage personal and professional growth opportunities through reimbursement for education; a free in-house resource for hundreds of educational and self-enrichment courses; mentorship program; wellness program; Women’s Organization and ongoing philanthropic opportunities.

Apply today to learn how you can join our team of professionals, so we can help you Accelerate Your Success!

title: Senior Developer, Billing Platform
description:
1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $500M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

The Billing & Payments Engineering team builds and owns the mission-critical systems that power 1Password’s revenue engine end-to-end. We are responsible for the highly available architecture that enables seamless subscription management, complex payment processing, and global financial compliance. From managing the intricate logic of the subscription lifecycle—creations, renewals, upgrades, and cancellations—to integrating with diverse payment gateways and app-store ecosystems, our work ensures a frictionless experience for our customers. As a team, we are actively architecting the next generation of our billing infrastructure, modernizing and consolidating our systems to support rapidly scaling product lines, guarantee absolute data integrity, and ensure robust integrations with downstream financial workflows.

In this role, you’ll design, build, and operate reliable backend services while owning complex initiatives from initial design through production. Your work will help create a safer, simpler digital future by making it easier for customers to access and rely on 1Password.

How we’re using AI today

Our Engineering, Product, and Design teams are thoughtfully integrating AI across the full software and product development lifecycle to move faster without sacrificing quality or security. In practice, that looks like engineers using AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate reviews and catch bugs earlier, product managers synthesizing user research at scale, and designers rapidly prototyping and iterating with AI-generated mockups. We approach AI the same way we approach security: with clear principles, human accountability at every consequential decision point, and rigorous evaluation before anything ships to customers.

This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.

What we're looking for:

  • Demonstrated expertise in engineering robust backend architectures using Go, alongside a history of taking end-to-end ownership of complex initiatives from initial design to live production deployment

  • A drive for and proven experience in software development best practices, and coding standards

  • You enjoy solving complex problems with a demonstrated ability propose effective solutions

  • You like communicating and collaborating and can demonstrate experience in working effectively with team and communicating technical concepts to non-technical cross-functional partners

  • You’re passionate about testing methodologies and debugging techniques to ensure high-quality code

Bonus points for:

  • Billing & Payments: Experience building or maintaining billing, payment processing, or subscription platforms (e.g., Stripe, native app stores).

  • Distributed Systems: A strong background in designing and scaling highly available, fault-tolerant distributed architectures.

  • API Integrations: Proven ability to build resilient integrations with third-party APIs, including handling webhooks, retries, and strict idempotency.

What you can expect:

  • Code, test, debug, deliver and maintain production software systems for new and existing product features

  • Collaborate with cross functional teams and/or stakeholders throughout the development cycle to ensure smooth releases

  • Work with your teammates and project manager to communicate technical requirements to stakeholders and solve technical problems in a scalable and realistic way

  • Mentor junior and new team members by helping them understand team expectations, providing technical guidance, sharing knowledge, and engaging in pair programming sessions

  • Participate in planning by identifying major tasks and breaking down, estimating, and planning work

  • Write comprehensive tests during various stages of the development cycle, ensuring code is functioning as expected

  • Review code for others to maintain high code quality, knowledge share within the team, and support creating a safe environment of giving and receiving feedback

  • Generate and review documentation on code processes to ensure scalability

  • Stay informed about the latest industry trends, technologies, and best practices in development

  • Be available for on-call rotational work to ensure uninterrupted support and resolve emergencies

USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $153,000 USD and $214,000 USD, plus immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $144,000 CAD and $202,000 CAD, plus immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.

At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.


Our culture
At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first.

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results.

How we work with AI
We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. To us, this means we do ask that you join live interviews without using AI tools so we can get to know how you communicate, solve problems, and collaborate with others.

Our approach to remote work
We believe in the power of remote work, but recognize that in-person connection is important to help us achieve our mission. While we are a remote-first company, travel for in-person engagement is a part of almost all roles, and we require our employees to be ready and willing to take part. Frequency will depend on role and responsibilities, and may include, but is not limited to: annual department-wide offsites, team meetings, and customer/industry events.

What we offer
We believe in working hard, and rewarding that hard work through our benefits. While not an exhaustive list, here is a glance at what we currently offer:

Health and wellbeing
👶 Maternity and parental leave top-up programs
🩺 Competitive health benefits
🏝 Generous PTO policy

Growth and future
📈 RSU program for most employees
💸 Retirement matching program
🔑 Free 1Password account

Community
🤝 Paid volunteer days
🏆 Peer-to-peer recognition through Bonusly
🌎 Remote-first work environment

title: Deal Desk Analyst - Americas
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

DEAL DESK ANALYST - AMERICAS

We're scaling our Deal Desk function and looking for a high-ownership IC to join the Americas team. You'll sit at the intersection of Sales, Legal, Finance, Product, and Business Operations, partnering closely with Americas sales leaders to structure and win the enterprise deals that form the backbone of our growth, and just as importantly, you'll help us systematize and scale how we get those deals done. We're in-person with cozy offices in North Beach, San Francisco and Manhattan, New York, complete with well-stocked libraries. This role requires five days a week in office.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Partner with Americas sales, legal, finance, and revenue operations to structure, negotiate, and close complex enterprise deals

  • Serve as a thought partner to sales reps on deal strategy: pricing, competitive positioning, negotiation approach, contract structure, executive engagement

  • Help evolve our pricing model and deal frameworks as the market and customer base shift, spotting trends across your deal flow, surfacing the patterns to finance and leadership, and driving the changes through

  • Lead cross-functional projects that systematize how we operate at scale, approval workflows, contracting playbooks, pricing guardrails, sales enablement materials, deal desk operating cadence

  • Improve the tools and processes we already have (Salesforce, Ironclad, our pricing infrastructure) by partnering with the GTM systems team, without needing to build them yourself

  • Balance a high-volume deal workload with longer-horizon strategic initiatives, managing competing priorities across multiple reps and deal cycles simultaneously

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 5+ years of experience across consulting, investing, commercial strategy, deal desk, or a combination

  • Experience working on enterprise B2B deals, ideally in SaaS or infrastructure, and direct experience with $1M+ ACV contracts

  • Experience operating in a high-volume deal environment and a track record of scaling yourself, building processes, playbooks, and enablement so you're not the bottleneck

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Has operated at a level of owning outcomes, not just tasks

  • Highly analytical, comfortable analyzing pricing, building ROI models in Excel, and grounding strategic recommendations in data

  • A point of view. You don't wait to be told what to think, you come with a perspective and know how to back it up

  • Operate with urgency, ownership, and very little hand-holding

  • Based in or able to relocate to San Francisco or New York City

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Onsite role: must be able to work in person at the San Francisco or New York office

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

Annual Salary:

$200,000 - $250,000 USD

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

title: Product Analyst
description:
What is Kalshi?

Kalshi has defined a new category: prediction markets. Kalshi allows people to trade on the outcome of any events and turn any question about the future into a financial asset. Kalshi fought for years and legalized prediction markets in the US for the first time in history, is currently the fastest growing financial market in America, and has thousands of markets across politics, economics, financials, weather, tech, AI, culture and more.

We believe prediction markets have the potential to be the largest financial market because they turn anything into a financial position.

  • Our vision: well… build the largest financial market on the planet.

  • Our mission: bring more truth to the world through the power of markets.

Our culture is simple: we hire really talented people, work really hard, and enjoy the climb. We are looking for ambitious and exceptional people to join our (relatively small) team to help us build the next generation of financial markets.

Role Roadmap

We are looking for an outlier Product Analyst to help craft the experience of prediction markets through elegant and simple UX and delightful product interactions. You will own the core customer journeys, including how our users discover, research, trade, manage their positions in, and reference prediction markets. Your role will push you to be close to customers and to bring creative solutions to their needs, including the ones they’re not aware of.

If you love creating moments of delight, you deeply care for our craft, and you are excited to bring prediction markets to the world, this role is for you.

What You'll Do

  • Build delightful product experiences that make our customers go from liking the product to loving it

  • Collaborating with product designers and engineers to integrate data-driven insights into feature design and rollout

  • Promote accessibility to Kalshi and take complicated financial actions and turn them into elegant, simple, and easy to understand product flows

  • Performing cohort analyses, A/B testing, and funnel optimization studies to improve user engagement and financial performance

  • Contributing to long-term strategic projects focused on scaling Kalshi’s user base and market offerings while ensuring sustainable financial growth within a regulated exchange environment

  • Refine and improve our understanding of our customers and their needs, including those they’re not aware of

  • Apply an experimental and iterative mindset to design and solution exploration

What You Bring

  • 4+ years of experience in product design

  • A compelling portfolio showcasing your ability to craft delightful product experiences (show us!)

  • Deeply in love with your craft, obsessive over design details, and focused on excellence in execution.

  • Strong customer intuition and consumer sensibility

  • Ability to move fast and adjust quickly, in a dynamic, fast-paced environment

  • Passion for prediction markets and/or financial markets

title: Senior Product Designer , Customer Service Design
description:
The Customer Service Innovation Lab (CSIL) is a new team inside Amazon Customer Service. Its mission is to challenge the status quo and shape the future of the customer experience industry. We're looking for a Senior UX Designer to be the founding design voice in a Pioneering Pod. You will observe Amazon customer’s experiences daily, and you'll use those insights to rethink how they get help. You'll own the experience from the first problem statement to a validated prototype, co-creating with contact handlers to turn unclear problems into clear, testable concepts. Much of the work involves AI-assisted and agentic experiences. You'll set the design rhythm for the lab and help build a design culture that rethinks customer service, not just improves it.

Key job responsibilities
- Put customers at the center: listen to customer contacts, observe customer journeys every day, and turn those signals into opportunities that change the experience.
- Challenge the status quo: question long-held assumptions about how customer service works, and push for new ideas that could reshape the industry.
- Lead end-to-end design for lab initiatives: discovery, framing, concepting, interaction and visual design, prototyping and handoff.
- Co-create with contact handlers through embedded observation, rapid workshops, and quick test-and-learn cycles on the lab floor.
- Prototype at speed with high-fidelity, interactive prototypes, including AI and GenAI-powered experiences, to test value, usability and feasibility in days.
- Shape product direction with PMs, engineers and science partners. Define customer-focused success metrics, scope MVPs, and make go/no-go recommendations based on evidence.
- Design for trust and responsible AI: transparency, human-in-the-loop controls, data privacy and accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA) from the start.
- Tell the story: write narratives, make concept videos and demos for senior CS leadership, and connect lab results to customer impact.
- Scale what works: partner with CS-UX product teams to move validated concepts into production, and add patterns to the design system.
- Raise the bar: mentor designers, run critiques, and help define the lab's design practices.

About the team
Our small, cross-functional Pioneering Pods of designers, product managers, engineers and data scientists work right next to our contact handlers. Every day they hear the voice of the customer and watch real customer experiences unfold. Pods turn that close view into bold ideas, prototype solutions in days instead of quarters, and prove what works before it scales across the CS network.

title: AI Engineer - Agents
description:
Labhouse is a Barcelona-based startup studio building AI-powered mobile apps used by hundreds of thousands of people worldwide. Our products, including Invoice Fly and Summary AI, are designed to make everyday tasks faster, smarter, and simpler through a subscription model that puts the user first.

We were founded by Andrés Bou and Horacio Martos, the duo behind SocialPoint (acquired by Take-Two Interactive), and we operate with the mindset of a product company: small teams, high ownership, and a relentless focus on building things that matter.

Would you like to make an impact as part of a company that builds the best mobile apps used by millions of users worldwide? If so, discover your next challenge below.

About the Role:

We’re bringing AI Agents into Summary AI and Invoice Fly, and you’ll be the one building them from scratch. This isn’t a role where you join an existing system and pick up tickets. You’ll own the whole cycle: decide what to build, design the architecture, implement it, measure how it performs with real users, and keep iterating until it works.

These won’t be thin wrappers around an LLM. You will build multi-agent systems that do real work for millions of users, and you’ll build the foundation underneath them: orchestration, tool use, context management, evaluation, and human-in-the-loop controls.

What You’ll Do

  • Design and build our agent architecture from the ground up.

  • Ship agentic features into Summary AI and Invoice Fly.

  • Set up evaluations to measure quality, catch failures, and guide improvements.

  • Iterate quickly based on real usage and data.

  • Track the latest models, tools, and techniques, and bring the best ones into our products.

About You:

  • You have 5+ years of experience building production systems.

  • You’ve built agents that real people use, and you know what it takes to make them reliable.

  • You take full ownership, from a blank page to production and beyond. You make the architecture decisions yourself and see them through.

  • You know how to evaluate AI systems, not just build them, and you use data to decide what to fix next.

  • You keep up with AI. You try new models and tools as they come out, and you know which ones are worth adopting.

  • You ship fast and iterate, without lowering the bar on quality.

  • You communicate clearly with everyone you work with. You explain technical tradeoffs clearly, listen to what each team needs, and keep everyone aligned.

Problem-solving and product focus:

  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to resolve complex technical challenges.

  • Eye for detail and a product-first mindset, with a passion for creating exceptional user experiences.

  • Self-driven, entrepreneurial attitude with the ability to work autonomously and take ownership of projects.

  • Excellent communication skills.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with subscription apps or mobile products

title: Satellite GNC Engineer, Amazon Leo
description:
Amazon Leo is building a constellation of thousands of low Earth orbit satellites. It will bring fast, reliable internet to customers beyond the reach of existing networks.

On the Guidance, Navigation and Control (GNC) team, you will design the algorithms, simulations and onboard autonomy that keep every satellite precisely pointed and stable. Your work lets the payload serve customers on the ground, and it keeps the fleet flying safely.

This is satellite GNC at constellation scale. The constellation is launching and growing today, so you will see your work go from concept to orbit, and then fly on many satellites.

In this role, you will:

- Take your GNC algorithms from concept to orbit, and stay with them through integration, test and on-orbit operations.
- Write the production C++ flight code for your own algorithms. The code that flies is the code you write.
- Solve hard problems in precise pointing, payload cueing and fleet autonomy.
- Work across design, simulation, test and flight operations, not a narrow slice of the lifecycle.

**Export Control Requirement:** Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and analyze algorithms for state estimation, attitude determination and control, precise pointing and payload cueing against demanding performance requirements.
- Implement these algorithms in production C++ flight software. Our GNC engineers own their algorithms all the way into flight, and partner with our embedded software engineers to integrate and test them.
- Write concepts of operations for each phase of a satellite's life, from launch and orbit raising to service and deorbit, including failures and recovery. Balance what the payload needs against momentum, power, thermal and ground-contact limits.
- Develop momentum management strategies with reaction wheels and magnetic torquers. Help select, size and place the GNC sensors and actuators for future satellites, and design the algorithms that use them. These include star trackers, magnetometers, sun sensors, IMUs and GNSS receivers.
- Develop onboard autonomy, including Fault Detection, Isolation and Recovery (FDIR), so that the fleet operates safely at scale with minimal ground intervention.
- Build and validate satellite and constellation models and simulations at several levels of fidelity, including 6-DOF simulation and Monte Carlo analysis. Verify closed-loop performance in hardware-in-the-loop (HITL) tests.
- Support component environmental tests, functional and performance checkout, and subsystem and satellite integration in our labs.
- Analyze telemetry from the whole fleet. Build the metrics, dashboards and tools that track pointing performance and payload operations time as the constellation grows, and use them to improve the fleet.
- Operate the GNC system on orbit and take part in the team's on-call rotation. Review fleet data, support maneuvers, and resolve anomalies when on-orbit behavior differs from the ground model.
- Review designs and code with the team, and document your algorithms, analyses and results clearly.

A day in the life
This role covers a wide range of problems across the spacecraft and the network. You will derive and prototype estimation and control algorithms, and then turn them into production flight code. You will prove them in 6-DOF and Monte Carlo simulation and in hardware-in-the-loop tests in the lab. You will support satellite integration. When a satellite does not behave as the ground model predicted, you will dig into fleet telemetry, find the cause and drive the fix. You will own each problem end to end, with the focus to go deep on it.

GNC is at the center of safe flight, so you will work across the whole program. The payload, power, thermal and operations teams all depend on GNC, and you will balance their needs against the pointing and momentum budgets. You will partner closely with avionics, flight software and embedded software engineers to make your algorithms run reliably on the spacecraft. You will help the mechanical teams shape the next generation of satellite hardware, from reaction wheels to star trackers. As satellites move from design through manufacturing into orbit, you will work with systems engineering and Assembly, Integration and Test.

The problems are hard: tight pointing requirements, a large constellation to keep flying safely, and the chance to invent capabilities that do not exist yet. Constant work with other teams makes this a place where you keep learning and growing.

About the team
You will join the Satellite Attitude Determination and Control team. We own GNC for our satellites end to end: algorithm design, flight software, lab integration, and flight operations of our own satellites on orbit. Our engineers bring deep experience from many satellite programs and other flight vehicles, with real strength in both our mission and the core GNC disciplines. We design, prototype, test, iterate and learn together. Because GNC is central to safe flight, we drive the concepts of operations and many of the system-level analyses on the program.

We also have a lot of freedom. We trust our engineers to choose their own tools and approaches for the problems they face, and to own the results. If you want the autonomy to solve hard problems your way, with a team of strong engineers, you will feel at home here.

title: Senior Program Manager, RBS : Cost to Serve
description:
Amazon strives to be Earth's most customer-centric company, where customers can find and discover anything they want to buy online. Retail Business Services (RBS) accelerates Amazon's growth by improving customer and Selling Partner (SP) experiences, while optimizing costs across Stores WW. RBS operates at the intersection of retail, operations, technology, and finance, ensuring Amazon's systems and processes scale reliably while maintaining a high-quality customer and selling-partner experience.

Cost to Serve (CtS) is a specialized organization within RBS focused on improving Amazon's per-unit economics across the global supply chain. CtS operates on two pillars: defect identification and defect elimination. The UDE Governance team builds mechanisms that enable standardized tracking and reporting of upstream defect elimination (UDE) outcomes — improving cost visibility, strengthening operational metric visibility, and enabling consistent governance across high-impact cost categories.

Amazon's RBS CtS organization is seeking an experienced Senior Program Manager to lead the charter for establishing governance mechanisms and automating them through AI-powered solutions. This role serves as the primary business point of contact, engaging with RBS and Retail/FBA/Ops Finance teams to: (i) Identify improvement opportunities in UDE reporting for cost-out delivery (ii) Define the right input metrics to track operational benefits delivered by cost-out projects and (iii) standardize reporting methodologies, terminologies, and formats across teams. Once these standards are established, this leader will drive automation of the end-to-end reporting journey by coordinating with RBS Tech and Analytics teams. These automations are aimed at improving productivity of PMs across RBS by 30%. Final delivery is a world-class UDE MBR P0 reporting that is traceable to P&L — presenting a holistic view of output and input metrics for each individual cost out project.

This leader will define the project roadmap, engage with business and Finance leaders to align on reporting requirements, own the working-backward plan, and architect the automation framework. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable managing technical product delivery and presenting program health to Director-level leadership, with the judgment to navigate ambiguity in a fast-moving, high-visibility space.

Why You’ll Love This Role

• High Impact at Scale: You'll lead accurate reporting of cost out projects for the entire RBS Org.
• Build with Tech: Serve as the key business voice shaping an AI-powered automation solution that has the potential to be replicated across several Amazon orgs.
• Leadership Visibility: Own updates to senior leaders across business and Finance teams with direct influence on how the organization invests in automation long-term.

Key job responsibilities
• Business/Tech Partnership & Requirements Definition: Serve as the primary business counterpart to the analytics and tech teams.
• Working Backward Planning: Own the milestone delivery plan for above two projects. Identify risks early, adjust plans proactively, and maintain credible path-to-green narratives for leadership.
• BA Team Oversight: Manage the Business Analysts who develop MLP of the products. Iteratively capture feedbacks from Stores leaders and ensure the feedback mechanism runs smoothly, quality standards are maintained, and BAs are effectively translating domain expertise into product development.
• Quality & Trade-off Decisions: Hold a high bar on output quality. When design or quality blockers arise, make trade-off decisions that balance speed, accuracy, and adoption — escalating to senior leaders for significant calls.

title: Applied Scientist, PXT Central Science
description:
The Central Science Team within Amazon’s People Experience and Technology org (PXTCS) uses economics, behavioral science, statistics, and machine learning to proactively identify mechanisms and process improvements which simultaneously improve Amazon and the lives, well-being, and the value of work to Amazonians. We are an interdisciplinary team, which combines the talents of science and engineering to develop and deliver solutions that measurably achieve this goal.

We are looking for an Applied Scientist to build production machine learning solutions that improve employee experiences and inform workforce decisions. You will work on problems spanning predictive modeling, natural language processing, recommendation systems, personalization, generative AI, and causal evaluation. These solutions will predict workforce outcomes, identify individual and organizational needs, recommend targeted actions, and measure the causal impact of programs, products, and policies across diverse employee populations and business contexts.

As an Applied Scientist, you will develop models and algorithms from prototype through production. You will collaborate with other scientists and economists to combine machine learning with causal inference and experimentation, allowing teams to understand both what is likely to happen and which actions will improve outcomes. You will also work with product managers, engineers, and business partners to translate business needs into technical solutions and communicate methods and results to technical and nontechnical audiences.

Key job responsibilities
• Design, develop, and deploy machine learning solutions in production environments.
• Develop solutions using techniques that include predictive modeling, deep learning, natural language processing, recommendation systems, personalization, and generative AI.
• Build models that predict workforce outcomes, identify employee and organizational needs, and recommend targeted actions.
• Partner with economists and other scientists to design causal evaluations and experimental frameworks that measure the impact of programs, products, and policies.
• Combine predictive models with causal estimates to help business partners identify effective actions and make evidence-based decisions.
• Collaborate with product managers, engineers, and business partners to translate business requirements into modeling approaches and contribute to technical design and roadmap decisions.
• Evaluate model accuracy, performance, calibration, and limitations, and identify opportunities for improvement.
• Communicate technical concepts, methods, results, and recommendations to technical peers and business partners.

A day in the life
• Analyze data to investigate model performance or understand an unexpected result from a causal evaluation.
• Brainstorm modeling and evaluation approaches with applied scientists and economists on the team.
• Develop and test model features, recommendation methods, or generative AI applications.
• Design or analyze experiments and observational studies to estimate the causal impact of programs, products, or policies.
• Run simulations, offline evaluations, or backtests to assess model performance.
• Meet with product, engineering, and business partners to review requirements, data, designs, and implementation decisions.
• Review code changes or technical design documents from scientists and engineers.
• Write and present documents covering methods, results, limitations, and recommendations.

About the team
The People eXperience and Technology Central Science Team (PXTCS) uses economics, behavioral science, statistics, and machine learning to proactively identify mechanisms and process improvements which simultaneously improve Amazon and the lives, wellbeing, and the value of work to Amazonians. We are an interdisciplinary team that combines the talents of science and engineering to develop and deliver solutions that measurably achieve this goal.

title: Sr. Learning Designer - Technical Training, RME Learning Experience
description:
The Reliability and Maintenance Engineering (RME) team keeps Amazon's fulfillment network running. Our technicians, engineers, and maintenance leaders are builders, problem-solvers, and operators who take ownership of the systems our customers depend on, operating 24/7 to deliver uptime, equipment reliability, safety, and quality. As the network grows and becomes more complex, our workforce needs training that makes the complex simple and puts the right knowledge in their hands at the right moment.

We're reshaping our learning function, rethinking how one of the largest engineering workforces in the world learns. If you want to help build what comes next, come join us.

RME Learning Experience (RLX) is looking for a Sr. Learning Designer with deep experience creating content for technical training to design and deliver learning experiences that grow capability across RME's engineering workforce.

You will design learning that makes complex technical content accessible, durable, and applicable in a live, 24/7 operations environment where safety and speed both matter. Your work will span the full spectrum of RME's technical workforce: technicians building foundational skills, engineers deepening expertise, and career changers entering engineering for the first time.

Your experience creating technical training content will allow you to translate complex engineering concepts into structured, effective learning experiences. You will take programs from needs analysis through design, development, and scaled delivery, building content that drives genuine behavior change and measurable skill development.

You will integrate AI into learning design and delivery, using AI-augmented analysis, design, and development to streamline launch times and focus effort on high-value creative work.

You will build the case for design decisions using learning science and data-driven analysis, and bring stakeholders along through evidence and clear communication.

Key job responsibilities
- Design technical training content that builds real capability. Translate complex engineering processes, systems, and procedures into structured learning experiences grounded in learning science and instructional design best practices.
- Apply multiple modalities to technical content. Design across formats (eLearning, simulation, hands-on labs, job aids, blended programs) selecting the right approach based on the complexity of the technical content and the context in which it will be applied.
- Design for transfer, not just knowledge. Build learning that closes the gap between knowing and doing, ensuring technicians and engineers can apply what they learn in real operational conditions where safety is non-negotiable.
- Partner with SMEs to ensure technical accuracy and relevance. Build strong working relationships with engineers and technical leaders to ensure content reflects current systems, standards, and operational realities.
- Build scalable, maintainable content architectures. Design content structures, templates, and standards that allow technical training to scale across regions, site types, and operating models without losing accuracy or effectiveness.
- Integrate AI into the design and development process. Use AI-augmented tools to accelerate content development, streamline review cycles, and focus effort on the design decisions that require human judgment.

title: Senior NPI TPM, Ops, Last Mile Delivery & Technology, Last Mile Delivery & Technology
description:
Smart Delivery Technologies (SDT) is building the sensing, edge intelligence, and interfaces that make Amazon's delivery network the world's safest and most efficient logistics operation — from the delivery station to the customer's doorstep. Our portfolio includes real-time hazard detection, guidance systems for drivers and associates, environmental data capture, and edge compute devices.

We are looking for a Senior New Product Introduction (NPI) Technical Program Manager (TPM), Operations to lead new products end-to-end at the intersection of engineering, supply chain, and operations. This role requires someone who can drive cross-functional execution while also going deep on build and sourcing strategy, supplier negotiations, and cost structure.

The ideal candidate has a strong background in Operations Program Management (OPM), is comfortable owning supplier sourcing decisions, and can build and defend detailed costing breakdowns (BOM cost, tooling, NRE, landed cost) that inform business decisions. You will partner with engineering, product, finance, procurement, and manufacturing teams to launch new products on time, at target cost, and at the right quality bar.

Because SDT lives inside an operations org, our timelines are tight and we must justify product value through pilots before progressing toward mass production. The right person embraces this tension: applying the rigor of a high-volume NPI process while pragmatically right-sizing it to an operations-driven, pilot-to-production reality. This is a high-visibility role for someone who thrives in ambiguity, dives deep into data, and is equally comfortable in a supplier negotiation, a design review, or a business review with senior leadership. Travel should be expected up to 25-30% of the time to engage with suppliers and contract manufacturers globally for builds and relationship development.

Key job responsibilities
* Own the end-to-end NPI program plan across multiple concurrent product launches, from design freeze through mass production ramp
* Drive OPM rigor: schedules, milestones, risk registers, and readiness reviews across engineering, supply chain, quality, and manufacturing
* Lead supplier sourcing strategy, including RFQs, supplier selection, and negotiations in partnership with procurement
* Own material availability across multiple programs by partnering with key component suppliers, manufacturing partners, and product owners to proactively drive sourcing activities and risk buy authorizations
* Build and maintain detailed costing breakdowns (component-level BOM cost, tooling/NRE, labor, overhead, landed cost) and identify cost-reduction opportunities
* Monitor and proactively manage component and product-level End of Life (EOL)
* Partner with finance to align program costs against business case targets and flag variances early
* Identify, track, and resolve program risks and blockers; escalate trade-offs to leadership with clear data-backed recommendations
* Drive design-for-cost and design-for-manufacturability discussions with engineering teams
* Plan and execute pilots/POCs that justify product value, and translate pilot results into go/no-go decisions and the path toward mass production
* Create and present program status, cost, and sourcing updates to senior leadership on a regular cadence
* Establish and improve NPI processes, tools, and mechanisms to scale program management across the organization

title: GTA VI Researcher
description:
What is Kalshi?

Kalshi has defined a new category: prediction markets. Kalshi allows people to trade on the outcome of any events and turn any question about the future into a financial asset. Kalshi fought for years and legalized prediction markets in the US for the first time in history, is currently the fastest growing financial market in America, and has thousands of markets across politics, economics, financials, weather, tech, AI, culture and more.

We believe prediction markets have the potential to be the largest financial market because they turn anything into a financial position.

  • Our vision: well… build the largest financial market on the planet.

  • Our mission: bring more truth to the world through the power of markets.

Our culture is simple: we hire really talented people, work really hard, and enjoy the climb. We are looking for ambitious and exceptional people to join our (relatively small) team to help us build the next generation of financial markets.

Role Roadmap

This is a real job.

We’re looking for someone whose parents said video games would never pay the bills. They were wrong, and you can tell them we said so.

As Kalshi’s GTA VI Researcher, you’ll begin at midnight on November 19 and play until you beat the story. You’ll stream the entire journey, investigate Leonida’s economy, and study what happens to the real economy when everyone suddenly has a “family emergency” on launch day.

We want the person who finds the optimal money-making strategy, builds a spreadsheet to prove it, and gets accused of ruining the game for everyone else.

What You’ll Do

  • Lock in for launch. Be installed, patched, and live at midnight, then play through the story at your own pace. Sleep and touching grass are both allowed.

  • Stream on Twitch or YouTube. Cam on, no hiding.

  • Study the Leonida economy and deliver an official State of the Leonida Economy address.

  • Track the real-world fallout: who called in “sick,” how DoorDash carried the entire nation through launch week, and how much productivity America lost.

  • Min-max everything. Find what’s broken, what’s mid, and what’s actually goated, and bring receipts.

  • Drop a weekly research report on the Leonida economy.

What You Bring

  • 18+ years of life IRL, 10+ years of sweaty gaming, 3+ years of streaming experience.

  • A degree in Economics or Finance is a plus, not a requirement.

  • Preferably your own setup.

  • Eagerness to play 10+ hours per day during the launch push.

  • You need to know how a system works, how to optimize it, and whether the guide everyone is following is actually wrong.

Compensation

  • $100,000-120,000 base pay equivalent for the duration of the contract.

  • $15,000 video game/streaming bonus, plus a 100-inch TV.

  • A PS5 or Xbox of your choice.

  • $75 DoorDash credit provided every day.

  • Gym membership - because we care about you.

Our Culture

Meritocracy is at our core, and we value people who take ownership and figure (usually hard) things out. We dream big. We love our craft deeply and are proud of what we put out in the world. We are committed to our vision of building something big… but also useful: a product that brings more truth through the power of markets.

Kalshians are Kalshi’s most important asset: we pick Kalshians carefully, so we trust them fully on day 1.

Commitment to Equal Opportunity

Kalshi is committed to creating a culture of inclusion and belonging, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe it is our collective responsibility to uphold these values and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to join us in our mission. All qualified applicants will be treated with respect and receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, uniform service, veteran status, age, or any other protected characteristic per federal, state, or local law. If you are passionate about what you do and want to use your talents to support our mission and values, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Solutions Engineer - US
description:
About CertifyOS

CertifyOS is building the data infrastructure that powers modern healthcare.

Today, healthcare organizations rely on fragmented and outdated provider data. This creates unnecessary administrative work, regulatory risk, and higher costs across the system. We’re solving that problem.

Our API-first platform automates provider licensing, enrollment, credentialing, and network monitoring by connecting directly to hundreds of primary data sources. We help healthcare organizations maintain accurate, compliant, and reliable provider networks at scale.

Our vision is simple: One API. One provider ID. Frictionless provider data.

We’re backed by leading investors and built by a team with deep experience in provider data systems. At CertifyOS, we value authenticity, accountability, collaboration, results, and openness to feedback. We’re building a high-ownership team focused on solving real infrastructure problems that impact millions of patients.

About the role

You'll be reporting to the Head of Solutions Engineering. This is a builder role- you'll help shape how the function works as it grows, alongside running your own deals.

What you'll do

Solution design (about 70%)

  • Partner with Account Executives on mid-market deals as the technical lead from discovery through close.

  • Run discovery sessions with payer and provider organization stakeholders across credentialing, operations, IT, and compliance.

  • Map a prospect's current-state provider data workflows and design a future state on the CertifyOS platform, including where we fit and where we don't.

  • Scope integrations with client systems: APIs, file-based roster exchange, SFTP, and SSO.

  • Deliver tailored demos and produce client-facing solution design documents, scoping summaries, and RFP/RFI responses.

  • Bring what you hear from prospects back to Product and Engineering so it shapes the roadmap.

Scaling Solutions Engineering with AI (about 30%)

  • Identify the highest-effort, most repetitive parts of the SE workflow, such as discovery prep, requirements extraction, RFP responses, solution design drafting, and demo setup.

  • Design, build, and maintain AI-powered workflows, prompts, and tools that cut the time and improve the consistency of that work.

  • Test what you build on your own deals first, then roll it out to the team with documentation and training.

  • Help turn one-off deliverables into reusable templates, playbooks, and a searchable knowledge base.

What you bring

  • 3–6 years in a customer-facing technical role at a B2B SaaS company or Consulting Firm, such as Solutions Engineer, Sales Engineer, Solutions Consultant, Implementation Consultant.

  • Background in health tech, healthcare operations or provider data management

  • Experience running discovery and technical scoping on deals with enterprise or regulated buyers.

  • Ability to turn complex, messy operational workflows into a clear solution design and explain it to both business and technical audiences.

  • Fluency and experience consulting directly regarding integrations: REST APIs, file-based data exchange, SFTP, and SSO. Should be able to digest, advise on, and consult regarding the implementation of APIs.

  • Fluency with AI tools to build scalable systems, such as Claude Code

  • Clear, precise writing. Much of this role is client-facing documentation.

title: Software Engineer II, Autonomy Evaluation & Metrics Platform
description: About Rivian Rivian is on a mission to keep the world adventurous forever. This goes for the emissions-free Electric Adventure Vehicles we build, and the curious, courageous souls we seek to attract. As a company, we constantly challenge what’s possible, never simply accepting what has always been done. We reframe old problems, seek new solutions and operate comfortably in areas that are unknown. Our backgrounds are diverse, but our team shares a love of the outdoors and a desire to protect it for future generations. Role Summary Rivian’s Autonomy Eval Infrastructure team builds the software that helps engineers understand and improve the ML models behind our driving systems and gives release teams evidence they can trust. Within Autonomy’s AI Platform organization, we connect model development with evaluation workflows, metrics, triage and visualization across simulation and real-world vehicle data. As a metrics-platform engineer, you will build backend services, Python libraries and data pipelines that turn model outputs into reproducible measurements and useful comparisons. Working alongside Perception, Planning and Systems engineers, you will learn how models behave, investigate regressions and help turn evaluation findings into better models and data, as well as trusted release scorecards. You will own well-scoped components from implementation through deployment and operation, with support from senior engineers on design and complex trade-offs. Joining this newly formed team offers the opportunity to help shape a shared platform while developing your software engineering and distributed-systems skills. Responsibilities Build and test services, APIs and libraries for registering metric definitions, computing results and retrieving them consistently across engineering tools. Implement scalable metric-processing pipelines with safe retries, incremental computation and backfills. Make missing inputs, failed jobs and incomplete results visible. Capture code, metric, model, dataset and scenario versions so a reported result can be traced to its inputs and reproduced. Build tools for comparing model versions and exploring results by scenario, geography, vehicle platform and operating conditions, using consistent aggregation and denominators. Work with model developers to run evaluation experiments, inspect predictions and investigate failure patterns. Help translate findings into targeted evaluation datasets and regression tests. Integrate metrics into evaluation workflows, CI regression checks and release scorecards, and connect results to recordings and triage tools for investigation. Improve automated tests, performance, observability and deployment tooling. Debug production issues and document the components you support. Work with engineers in Palo Alto, London and Belgrade to turn user needs into maintainable software, participate in design and code reviews, and deliver improvements iteratively. Qualifications 2+ years of software engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated experience building and maintaining substantial software systems. Strong Python programming skills and a solid foundation in data structures, algorithms, software design and debugging. Practical SQL skills, with AI coding tools expected to support writing and refining queries; ability to validate query logic, results and performance. Experience building backend services, reusable libraries or data-processing pipelines with automated tests, version control and code review. Ability to reason about APIs, data models and component design, explain trade-offs, and identify failure cases such as duplicate, delayed or missing data. Experience with cloud services, containers and CI/CD, and an understanding of how software is deployed and monitored in production. Care with data correctness and basic statistical reasoning, including sample sizes, rates and variability; curiosity about how measurements reflect real driving behavior. Clear written communication and a collaborative approach to gathering requirements, asking for feedback and resolving technical problems. Bonus Points Hands-on experience with ML models using PyTorch or similar frameworks, such as running inference or analyzing prediction errors; experience in autonomy, robotics or simulation. Experience with distributed data processing or analytical storage, such as Spark, Databricks, Delta Lake or comparable systems. Experience with AWS, Docker and GitLab CI, or with developer tools, experiment tracking, data lineage or results visualization. Prior autonomy or robotics experience is welcome but is not required for this role. Pay Disclosure Salary Range for California Based Applicants: $142,000-$177,500 (actual compensation will be determined based on experience, location, and other factors permitted by law). Benefits Summary: Rivian provides robust medical/Rx, dental and vision insurance packages for full-time employees, their spouse or domestic partner, and children up to age 26. Coverage is effective on the first day of employment, and Rivian covers most of the premiums. Equal Opportunity Rivian is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information or characteristics, physical or mental disability, marital/domestic partner status, age, military/veteran status, medical condition, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you have a disability or limitation, such as those covered by the Americans with Disabilities Act, that requires accommodations to assist you in the search and application process, please email us at candidateaccommodations@rivian.com. Candidate Data Privacy and Technology Rivian may collect, use and disclose your personal information or personal data (within the meaning of the applicable data protection laws) when you apply for employment and/or participate in our recruitment processes (“Candidate Personal Data”). This data includes contact, demographic, communications, educational, professional, employment, social media/website, network/device, recruiting system usage/interaction, security and preference information. Rivian may use your Candidate Personal Data for the purposes of (i) tracking interactions with our recruiting system; (ii) carrying out, analyzing and improving our application and recruitment process, including assessing you and your application and conducting employment, background and reference checks; (iii) establishing an employment relationship or entering into an employment contract with you; (iv) complying with our legal, regulatory and corporate governance obligations; (v) recordkeeping; (vi) ensuring network and information security and preventing fraud; and (vii) as otherwise required or permitted by applicable law. How We Use AI in Our Hiring Process: To ensure transparency, we want candidates to know that Rivian uses iCIMS Talent Cloud Artificial Intelligence (TCAI) and AI-enabled tools to assist with screening, reviewing, organizing and highlighting profiles and applications that match the key requirements for each role. title: Senior Manager, Change & Configuration Management Amazon Leo, D2D Software
description:
Amazon Leo is building a low Earth orbit satellite constellation to bring fast, affordable connectivity to customers around the world. Direct to Device (D2D) extends Leo to standard mobile phones and devices: a fully regenerative fifth-generation (5G) mobile base station on each satellite, delivering service to standard handsets through mobile network operators (MNOs). D2D Software builds the embedded software that flies, the cloud and ground software that runs the service, and the platform that connects them. Our target is under a day from a defect being found to the fix deployed across the entire constellation, achieved by automating everything that a person would otherwise do by hand.
Amazon Leo is building a low Earth orbit satellite constellation to bring fast, affordable connectivity to customers around the world. Direct to Device (D2D) extends Leo to standard mobile phones and devices: a fully regenerative fifth-generation (5G) mobile base station on each satellite, delivering service to standard handsets through mobile network operators (MNOs). D2D Software builds the embedded software that flies, the cloud and ground software that runs the service, and the platform that connects them. This role leads change and configuration management in Software Delivery & Business Ops, reporting to the Director, Software Delivery & Business Ops. It owns the change control board, traceability, configuration and baselines, the decision log, and supplier delivery for lifecycle tools; the lead is the technical program manager for Software Architecture & Specifications. Before anything is handed on, the bar is: every baseline change through the board. It hands off to its customers as follows: board decisions to all teams.

What the team needs to achieve
• Every baseline change through the board.
• Hand-offs that meet their service level: board decisions to all teams.
• Measured, rising capability and efficiency of the team, with manual work falling release over release.

How the team is measured
• Every baseline change through the board, with impact analysis.
• Time from change request to decision.
• Changes that reach manufacturing without board approval: none.

Key job responsibilities
• Own the change control board, traceability, configuration and baselines, the decision log, and supplier delivery for lifecycle tools; the lead is the technical program manager for Software Architecture & Specifications.
• Meet the bar before every hand-off: every baseline change through the board.
• Work directly with engineers in the boundary teams as partners, through agreed contracts and service levels.
• Automate everything a person would otherwise do twice.
• Hire, coach, and grow a small team, with clear expectations and career development for every member.
• Set the strategy and mechanisms for this area across the organization, and remove the bottlenecks that slow teams down.
• Own supplier delivery for this area: schedules, service levels, and escalation.
• Identify and mitigate risks before they become roadblocks, and escalate serious risks to senior leaders early.

This role leads a small team that runs change and configuration management for the whole of D2D Software: the change control board, requirements traceability, the configuration and baselines for requirements, interfaces, timing, resources, and schedule, the decision log, and supplier delivery for the requirements and lifecycle tools. The leader is also the program manager for Software Architecture & Specifications. It matters because every team depends on stable, agreed baselines, and a change to one ripples through embedded satellite software, ground services, and suppliers. Without it, baselines move without impact analysis, teams build against different versions of the truth, and late changes reach manufacturing.

Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.


About the team
D2D Software is an evolving organization of many teams: Software Architecture & Specifications; Software Delivery & Business Ops; Software Integration, Verification & Reliability; DevOps & Release; Satellite Software Development; Ground Software Development; and Customer Software Engineering & Support. Each Director owns business outcomes: delivering the commitments, and the capability and efficiency of their teams. Teams work as internal customers and suppliers with agreed service levels, interfaces are agreed centrally while designs stay local, and engineers are expected to work directly with engineers across every boundary. Milestones are committed deadlines for delivery with quality, not gates to wait on, and every team runs on one toolchain and one system of record. Every measure is derived from the systems of record, never self-reported, and we improve release over release with a target of perfection.

We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

SENIOR INTEGRATED CAMPAIGNS MANAGER, AMER

SpaceXSI is hiring a Senior Campaigns Manager to join our integrated campaigns team and help shape how SpaceXSI shows up to enterprise audiences. This is a full-time, in-office role based at our San Francisco headquarters. You will own high-priority campaigns that turn broad company priorities into focused, executable programs, working seamlessly across product marketing, sales, customer marketing, field, and leadership. The campaign strategies and programs you develop will shape our narrative in the market, create demand, generate & accelerate pipeline, and support customer growth.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Concept, develop, and run integrated campaigns end to end: Lead the strategy and audience selection through launch, optimization, and reporting; design the end-to-end campaign architecture, including the full-funnel content engine, channel strategies, promotional offers, program mix, and hand-offs from marketing to sales; translate company priorities into focused campaign plans with clear goals, messaging, milestones, owners, and success metrics; identify the highest-leverage assets needed to support campaign performance, including messaging frameworks, email nurtures, landing page copy, field activation ideas, customer story packaging, and sales-facing materials; bring multi-channel expertise to deliver campaigns via digital, web, email, online events, direct mail, social, events, sales plays, and more, all in partnership with functional and regional teams; strengthen cross-functional alignment, unifying all parts of the business around top go-to-market priorities; develop trusted relationships and facilitate integrated collaboration across product marketing, field marketing, performance marketing, growth marketing, strategic events, and design; work with creative partners to brief campaigns clearly and carry the message through across formats, channels, and moments in market; align closely with sales stakeholders to identify top priorities, build programs for strategic accounts, and ensure campaign initiatives are closely tied to revenue impact

  • Establish measurement frameworks, KPIs, and scaleable processes: Own campaign performance by measuring, analyzing, and reporting on the impact of campaigns on pipeline, revenue, target account penetration, and the demand funnel. Share learnings regularly to improve overall campaign efficacy; work closely with operations and analytics partners to define the right KPIs, shape useful dashboards and reporting, and surface actionable account or campaign insights to the business; help establish repeatable campaign systems, workflows, and handoffs that let the function scale without becoming fragmented

  • Adapt campaigns for SpaceXSI's most strategic accounts and business priorities: Build campaigns for enterprise and strategic audiences, including vertical, segment, buying-group, or use-case-specific motions. Translate vertical-specific messaging and proof points into campaign activations that make SpaceXSI feel relevant to the priorities of different enterprise audiences; build 1:few ABM motions & ABM-at-scale programs for priority accounts or segments, in partnership with sales and field teams

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 8+ years of experience owning integrated campaign strategy and execution for a B2B SaaS or enterprise technology company

  • Experience building integrated B2B campaigns across multiple channels (content, email, digital, field, and sales motions)

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Knows how to connect content, email, digital, field, and sales motions into cohesive, high-impact motions

  • Know how to turn a campaign idea into a real operating plan, from narrative and audience strategy through asset development, launch, field enablement, lead follow-up, and reporting

  • Able to take complex, ambiguous problems and bring structure, clarity, and a clear recommendation

  • Comfortable being both strategic and hands-on, you can set direction, write a brief, shape the content, and help get the work shipped

  • Strong instincts for what makes a campaign cohesive across content, creative, distribution, and follow-up

  • Comfortable working across both global strategy and regional execution, and can adapt campaigns thoughtfully for different markets without losing the core narrative

  • Strong instincts for what makes enterprise campaigns resonate with senior technical and business buyers

  • Thrive in creative, fast-paced environments where original thinking and bias to action are celebrated

  • Able to shift between air cover demand generation and more targeted programs for strategic accounts, named accounts, and priority verticals

  • Balance thoughtful dedication to quality with a clear focus on impact and ability to execute with sharp, decisive speed

  • Extensive familiarity with lead-routing & handoff. You're able to diagnose funnel health and quickly course correct in tight alignment with your SDR counterparts

  • A proven track record of building campaigns for enterprise audiences, including technical decision-makers, executives, and complex buying groups

  • Owned pipeline goals in the past, and have experience using pipeline, engagement, and revenue signals to optimize campaign performance. You iterate continuously, quickly adapting to new signals, business priorities, and shifts in the market
